The published edition from which this e-text was transcribed is printed in the Devanāgarī
        script. The electronic text below is in a lossless transliteration using the Latin alphabet.
        The transliteration scheme used is the IAST (
The International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration
ṛ -> r̥ and ṃ -> ṁ

Text division is with spaces between words ("ity evam" not "ityevam") except when words are
        joined by sandhi Devanāgarī ("atheyam" not "atha+iyam").
Initial vowel elision for avagraha is marked with a " '": e.g., "prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ"
External sandhis are not undone or marked: "yathāmara" not "yathā+amarā"

The text was typed, analyzed and proofread by Peter Schreiner and Renate Söhnen,
            1982-1988.

children.text: Chapter 1: Setting of the recitation of the Purāṇa; creation of the world
yasmāt sarvam idaṃ prapañcaracitaṃ māyājagaj jāyate |
yasmiṃs tiṣṭhati yāti cāntasamaye kalpānukalpe punaḥ |
yaṃ dhyātvā munayaḥ prapañcarahitaṃ vindanti mokṣaṃ dhruvaṃ |
taṃ vande puruṣottamākhyam amalaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ niścalam || 1 ||
yaṃ dhyāyanti budhāḥ samādhisamaye śuddhaṃ viyatsannibham |
taṃ saṃsāravināśahetum ajaraṃ vande hariṃ muktidam || 2 ||
śālais tālais tamālaiś ca nārikelais tathārjunaiḥ |
anyaiś ca bahubhir vṛkṣaiś campakādyaiś ca śobhite || 6 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś cānyaiś ca jātibhiḥ |
cīnakādyais tathā medhyaiḥ sasyaiś cānyaiś ca śobhite |
tān āgatān dvijāṃs te tu pūjāṃ cakrur yathocitām |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā te munivarāḥ pūjāṃ cakrur mudānvitāḥ || 13 ||
kathāṃ cakrus tadānyonyaṃ sūtena sahitā dvijāḥ || 14 ||
kathānte vyāsaśiṣyaṃ te papracchuḥ saṃśayaṃ mudā |
ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitāḥ sarve sadasyaiḥ saha dīkṣitāḥ || 15 ||
jānāsi devadaityānāṃ caritaṃ janma karma ca || 16 ||
na te 'sty aviditaṃ kiñcid vede śāstre ca bhārate |
śrotum icchāmahe sūta brūhi sarvaṃ yathā jagat |
babhūva bhūyaś ca yathā mahābhāga bhaviṣyati || 19 ||
yataś caiva jagat sūta yataś caiva carācaram |
līnam āsīt tathā yatra layam eṣyati yatra ca || 20 ||
viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇuṃ viśvasya sthitau sarge tathā prabhum |
sarvajñaṃ jagatām īśam ajam akṣayam avyayam || 27 ||
ādyaṃ susūkṣmaṃ viśveśaṃ brahmādīn praṇipatya ca |
yas tv imāṃ dhārayen nityaṃ śṛṇuyād vāpy abhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yat tan nityaṃ sadasadātmakam |
pradhānaṃ puruṣas tasmān nirmame viśvam īśvaraḥ || 33 ||
ahaṅkāras tu mahatas tasmād bhūtāni jajñire |
bhūtabhedāś ca bhūtebhya iti sargaḥ sanātanaḥ || 35 ||
tataḥ svayambhūr bhagavān sisṛkṣur vividhāḥ prajāḥ || 37 ||
apa eva sasarjādau tāsu vīryam athāsṛjat |
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ || 38 ||
ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tatra jajñe svayaṃ brahmā svayambhūr iti naḥ śrutam |
tad aṇḍam akarod dvaidhaṃ divaṃ bhuvam athāpi ca |
tayoḥ śakalayor madhya ākāśam akarot prabhuḥ || 41 ||
apsu pāriplavāṃ pṛthvīṃ diśaś ca daśadhā dadhe |
tatra kālaṃ mano vācaṃ kāmaṃ krodham atho ratim || 42 ||
sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ sraṣṭum icchan prajāpatīn |
vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahātejāḥ so 'sṛjat sapta mānasān |
sapta brahmāṇa ity ete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ || 44 ||
sanatkumāraṃ ca vibhuṃ pūrveṣām api pūrvajam |
saptasv etā ajāyanta prajā rudrāś ca bho dvijāḥ || 46 ||
skandaḥ sanatkumāraś ca tejaḥ saṅkṣipya tiṣṭhataḥ |
vayāṃsi ca sasarjādau parjanyaṃ ca sasarja ha |
sādhyān ajanayad devān ity evam anusañjaguḥ |
sṛjyamānāḥ prajā naiva vivardhante yadā tadā || 51 ||
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ tu so 'sṛjad dvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 52 ||
divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ caiva mahimnā vyāpya tiṣṭhati |
virājam asṛjad viṣṇuḥ so 'sṛjat puruṣaṃ virāṭ || 53 ||
puruṣaṃ taṃ manuṃ vidyāt tasya manvantaraṃ smṛtam |
sa vairājaḥ prajāsargaṃ sasarja puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ |
āyuṣmān kīrtimān puṇyaprajāvāṃś ca bhaven naraḥ |
Chapter 2: Descendants of Manu Svāyambhuva; creation by Dakṣa
sa sṛṣṭvā tu prajās tv evam āpavo vai prajāpatiḥ |
lebhe vai puruṣaḥ patnīṃ śatarūpām ayonijām || 1 ||
āpavasya mahimnā tu divam āvṛtya tiṣṭhataḥ |
sā tu varṣāyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
sa vai svāyambhuvo viprāḥ puruṣo manur ucyate |
kāmyā nāma sutā śreṣṭhā kardamasya prajāpateḥ |
kāmyāputrās tu catvāraḥ samrāṭ kukṣir virāṭ prabhuḥ || 6 ||
dharmasya kanyā suśroṇī sūnṛtā nāma viśrutā |
dhruvaṃ ca kīrtimantaṃ ca āyuṣmantaṃ vasuṃ tathā |
dhruvo varṣasahasrāṇi trīṇi divyāni bho dvijāḥ |
tapas tepe mahābhāgaḥ prārthayan sumahad yaśaḥ || 10 ||
tasmai brahmā dadau prītaḥ sthānam ātmasamaṃ prabhuḥ |
tasyābhimānam ṛddhiṃ ca mahimānaṃ nirīkṣya ca |
devāsurāṇām ācāryaḥ ślokaṃ prāg uśanā jagau || 12 ||
aho 'sya tapaso vīryam aho śrutam aho 'dbhutam |
yam adya purataḥ kṛtvā dhruvaṃ saptarṣayaḥ sthitāḥ || 13 ||
tasmāc chliṣṭiṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca dhruvāc chambhur vyajāyata |
śliṣṭer ādhatta succhāyā pañca putrān akalmaṣān || 14 ||
kutsaḥ puruḥ śatadyumnas tapasvī satyavāk kaviḥ |
agniṣṭud atirātraś ca sudyumnaś ceti te nava || 18 ||
puror ajanayat putrān ṣaḍ āgneyī mahāprabhān || 19 ||
aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ svātiṃ kratum aṅgirasaṃ mayam |
aṅgāt sunīthāpatyaṃ vai veṇam ekaṃ vyajāyata || 20 ||
prajārtham ṛṣayo yasya mamanthur dakṣiṇaṃ karam || 21 ||
veṇasya mathite pāṇau sambabhūva mahān nṛpaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ prāhur eṣa vai muditāḥ prajāḥ || 22 ||
kariṣyati mahātejā yaśaś ca prāpsyate mahat |
pṛthur vaiṇyas tathā cemāṃ rarakṣa kṣatrapūrvajaḥ |
teneyaṃ gaur muniśreṣṭhā dugdhā sasyāni bhūbhṛtā || 25 ||
sarpaiḥ puṇyajanaiś caiva vīrudbhiḥ parvatais tathā |
teṣu teṣu ca pātreṣu duhyamānā vasundharā || 27 ||
prādād yathepsitaṃ kṣīraṃ tena prāṇān adhārayan |
nāśakan māruto vātuṃ vṛtaṃ kham abhavad drumaiḥ |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi na śekuś ceṣṭituṃ prajāḥ || 36 ||
tad upaśrutya tapasā yuktāḥ sarve pracetasaḥ |
mukhebhyo vāyum agniṃ ca sasṛjur jātamanyavaḥ || 37 ||
unmūlān atha vṛkṣāṃs tu kṛtvā vāyur aśoṣayat |
tān agnir adahad ghora evam āsīd drumakṣayaḥ || 38 ||
drumakṣayam atho buddhvā kiñcic chiṣṭeṣu śākhiṣu |
bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā tāta dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā || 41 ||
māriṣā nāma nāmnaiṣā vṛkṣāṇām iti nirmitā |
asyām utpatsyate vidvān dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 43 ||
tataḥ somasya vacanāj jagṛhus te pracetasaḥ |
saṃhṛtya kopaṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ patnīṃ dharmeṇa māriṣām || 45 ||
dakṣo jajñe mahātejāḥ somasyāṃśena bho dvijāḥ || 46 ||
acarāṃś ca carāṃś caiva dvipado 'tha catuṣpadaḥ |
sa sṛṣṭvā manasā dakṣaḥ paścād asṛjata striyaḥ || 47 ||
dadau daśa sa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
śiṣṭāḥ somāya rājñe ca nakṣatrākhyā dadau prabhuḥ || 48 ||
tāsu devāḥ khagā gāvo nāgā ditijadānavāḥ |
saṅkalpād darśanāt sparśāt pūrveṣāṃ procyate prajā || 50 ||
sambhavas tu śruto 'smābhir dakṣasya ca mahātmanaḥ || 51 ||
aṅguṣṭhād brahmaṇo jajñe dakṣaḥ kila śubhavrataḥ |
vāmāṅguṣṭhāt tathā caivaṃ tasya patnī vyajāyata || 52 ||
kathaṃ prācetasatvaṃ sa punar lebhe mahātapāḥ |
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ sūta vyākhyātuṃ tvam ihārhasi |
dauhitraś caiva somasya kathaṃ śvaśuratāṃ gataḥ || 53 ||
utpattiś ca nirodhaś ca nityaṃ bhūteṣu bho dvijāḥ |
ṛṣayo 'tra na muhyanti vidyāvantaś ca ye janāḥ || 54 ||
yuge yuge bhavanty ete punar dakṣādayo nṛpāḥ |
punaś caiva nirudhyante vidvāṃs tatra na muhyati || 55 ||
jyaiṣṭhyaṃ kāniṣṭham apy eṣāṃ pūrvaṃ nāsīd dvijottamāḥ |
tapa eva garīyo 'bhūt prabhāvaś caiva kāraṇam || 56 ||
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ dakṣasya yo vidyāt sacarācarām |
Chapter 3: Creation of beings; descendants of Dakṣa
prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā |
yathā sasarja bhūtāni tathā śṛṇuta bho dvijāḥ || 2 ||
mānasāny eva bhūtāni pūrvam evāsṛjat prabhuḥ |
yadāsya mānasī viprā na vyavardhata vai prajā |
sa maithunena dharmeṇa sisṛkṣur vividhāḥ prajāḥ |
asiknyāṃ janayām āsa dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ |
tāṃs tu dṛṣṭvā mahābhāgān saṃvivardhayiṣūn prajāḥ || 7 ||
pūrvaṃ sa hi samutpanno nāradaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
taṃ bhūyo janayām āsa piteva munipuṅgavam |
tena dakṣasya vai putrā haryaśvā iti viśrutāḥ || 11 ||
nirmathya nāśitāḥ sarve vidhinā ca na saṃśayaḥ |
kanyāyāṃ nārado mahyaṃ tava putro bhaved iti |
tato dakṣaḥ sutāṃ prādāt priyāṃ vai parameṣṭhine |
sa tasyāṃ nārado jajñe bhūyaḥ śāpabhayād ṛṣiḥ || 14 ||
samāgatā mahāvīryā nāradas tān uvāca ha || 16 ||
bāliśā bata yūyaṃ vai nāsyā jānīta vai bhuvaḥ |
antar ūrdhvam adhaś caiva kathaṃ sṛjatha vai prajāḥ |
te tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prayātāḥ sarvato diśaḥ || 18 ||
haryaśveṣv atha naṣṭeṣu dakṣaḥ prācetasaḥ punaḥ || 19 ||
vairaṇyām atha putrāṇāṃ sahasram asṛjat prabhuḥ |
vivardhayiṣavas te tu śabalāśvās tathā prajāḥ || 20 ||
pūrvoktaṃ vacanaṃ te tu nāradena pracoditāḥ |
anyonyam ūcus te sarve samyag āha mahān ṛṣiḥ || 21 ||
bhrātṝṇāṃ padavīṃ jñātuṃ gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
jñātvā pramāṇaṃ pṛthvyāś ca sukhaṃ srakṣyāmahe prajāḥ || 22 ||
te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa prayātāḥ sarvato diśam |
tadā prabhṛti vai bhrātā bhrātur anveṣaṇe dvijāḥ |
prayāto naśyati kṣipraṃ tan na kāryaṃ vipaścitā || 24 ||
tāṃś caiva naṣṭān vijñāya putrān dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
ṣaṣṭiṃ tato 'sṛjat kanyā vairaṇyām iti naḥ śrutam || 25 ||
tās tadā pratijagrāha bhāryārthaṃ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ |
somo dharmaś ca bho viprās tathaivānye maharṣayaḥ || 26 ||
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
dve caiva bahuputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tathā |
dve kṛśāśvāya viduṣe tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 28 ||
arundhatī vasur yāmī lambā bhānur marutvatī |
saṅkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bho dvijāḥ || 29 ||
dharmapatnyo daśa tv etās tāsv apatyāni bodhata |
viśvedevās tu viśvāyāḥ sādhyā sādhyān vyajāyata || 30 ||
marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasos tu vasavaḥ sutāḥ |
bhānos tu bhānavaḥ putrā muhūrtās tu muhūrtajāḥ || 31 ||
lambāyāś caiva ghoṣo 'tha nāgavīthī ca yāmijā |
saṅkalpāyās tu viśvātmā jajñe saṅkalpa eva hi |
nāgavīthyāṃ ca yāminyāṃ vṛṣalaś ca vyajāyata || 33 ||
parā yāḥ somapatnīś ca dakṣaḥ prācetaso dadau |
ye tv anye khyātimanto vai devā jyotiṣpurogamāḥ |
āpo dhruvaś ca somaś ca dhavaś caivānilo 'nalaḥ |
pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo nāmabhiḥ smṛtāḥ || 36 ||
āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śrānto munis tathā |
somasya bhagavān varcā varcasvī yena jāyate |
anilasya śivā bhāryā tasyāḥ putro manojavaḥ |
avijñātagatiś caiva dvau putrāv anilasya ca || 39 ||
agniputraḥ kumāras tu śarastambe śriyā vṛtaḥ |
tasya śākho viśākhaś ca naigameyaś ca pṛṣṭhajaḥ || 40 ||
apatyaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu kārttikeya iti smṛtaḥ |
pratyūṣasya viduḥ putram ṛṣiṃ nāmnātha devalam || 41 ||
yogasiddhā jagat kṛtsnam asaktā vicacāra ha |
prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnām aṣṭamasya tu || 43 ||
bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kartā śilpavatāṃ varaḥ |
yaḥ sarveṣāṃ vimānāni daivatānāṃ cakāra ha || 45 ||
ajaikapād ahirbudhnyas tvaṣṭā rudraś ca vīryavān || 47 ||
haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryambakaś cāparājitaḥ |
vṛṣākapiś ca śambhuś ca kapardī raivatas tathā || 48 ||
mṛgavyādhaś ca śarvaś ca kapālī ca dvijottamāḥ |
śataṃ tv evaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇām amitaujasām |
aditir ditir danuś caiva ariṣṭā surasā khasā || 51 ||
surabhir vinatā caiva tāmrā krodhavaśā irā |
kadrur muniś ca bho viprās tāsv apatyāni bodhata || 52 ||
āgacchata drutaṃ devā aditiṃ sampraviśya vai |
manvantare prasūyāmas tan naḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati || 55 ||
evam uktvā tu te sarve cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ |
mārīcāt kaśyapāj jātās tv adityā dakṣakanyayā || 56 ||
tatra viṣṇuś ca śakraś ca jajñāte punar eva hi |
aryamā caiva dhātā ca tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathaiva ca || 57 ||
vivasvān savitā caiva mitro varuṇa eva ca |
aṃśo bhagaś cātitejā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 58 ||
ete yugasahasrānte jāyante punar eva hi |
sarve devagaṇāś cātra trayastriṃśat tu kāmajāḥ || 62 ||
teṣām api ca bho viprā nirodhotpattir ucyate |
evaṃ devanikāyās te sambhavanti yuge yuge |
dityāḥ putradvayaṃ jajñe kaśyapād iti naḥ śrutam || 64 ||
saiṃhikeyā iti khyātā yasyāḥ putrā mahābalāḥ |
hrādaś ca anuhrādaś ca prahrādaś caiva vīryavān |
saṃhrādaś ca caturtho 'bhūd dhrādaputro hradas tathā || 67 ||
hradasya putrau dvau vīrau śivaḥ kālas tathaiva ca |
virocanaś ca prāhrādir balir jajñe virocanāt || 68 ||
dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca sūryaś ca candramāś candratāpanaḥ || 69 ||
bāṇas teṣām atibalo jyeṣṭhaḥ paśupateḥ priyaḥ || 70 ||
purā kalpe tu bāṇena prasādyomāpatiṃ prabhum |
pārśvato vihariṣyāmi ity evaṃ yācito varaḥ || 71 ||
mahānābhaś ca vikrāntaḥ kālanābhas tathaiva ca |
dvimūrdhā śaṅkukarṇaś ca tathā hayaśirā vibhuḥ || 74 ||
ayomukhaḥ śambaraś ca kapilo vāmanas tathā |
mārīcir maghavāṃś caiva ilvalaḥ svasṛmas tathā || 75 ||
indrajit sarvajic caiva vajranābhas tathaiva ca || 76 ||
svarbhānur vṛṣaparvā ca vipracittiś ca vīryavān |
sarva ete danoḥ putrāḥ kaśyapād abhijajñire || 78 ||
eteṣāṃ putrapautraṃ tu na tac chakyaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 79 ||
svarbhānos tu prabhā kanyā pulomnas tu śacī sutā || 80 ||
paulomāḥ kālakeyāś ca dānavās te mahābalāḥ |
vaṃśyaḥ śalyaś ca balinau nalaś caiva tathā balaḥ || 87 ||
vātāpir namuciś caiva ilvalaḥ svasṛmas tathā |
añjiko narakaś caiva kālanābhas tathaiva ca || 88 ||
saramānas tathā caiva svarakalpaś ca vīryavān |
ete vai dānavāḥ śreṣṭhā danor vaṃśavivardhanāḥ || 89 ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ |
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ sutās teṣāṃ maṇivatyāṃ nivāsinaḥ || 91 ||
krauñcī śyenī ca bhāsī ca sugrīvī śucigṛdhrikā |
śyenī śyenāṃs tathā bhāsī bhāsān gṛdhrāṃś ca gṛdhry api |
śucir audakān pakṣigaṇān sugrīvī tu dvijottamāḥ || 94 ||
aśvān uṣṭrān gardabhāṃś ca tāmrāvaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
vinatāyās tu dvau putrau vikhyātau garuḍāruṇau || 95 ||
garuḍaḥ patatāṃ śreṣṭho dāruṇaḥ svena karmaṇā |
kuharaḥ puṣpadaṃṣṭraś ca durmukhaḥ sumukhas tathā || 100 ||
śaṅkhaś ca śaṅkhapālaś ca kapilo vāmanas tathā |
nahuṣaḥ śaṅkharomā ca maṇir ity evamādayaḥ || 101 ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ |
gaṇaṃ krodhavaṃśaṃ viprās tasya sarve ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
sthalajāḥ pakṣiṇo 'bjāś ca dharāyāḥ prasavāḥ smṛtāḥ || 103 ||
gās tu vai janayām āsa surabhir mahiṣīs tathā |
irā vṛkṣalatā vallīs tṛṇajātīś ca sarvaśaḥ || 104 ||
khasā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi munir apsarasas tathā |
yeṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ || 106 ||
eṣa manvantare viprāḥ sargaḥ svārociṣe smṛtaḥ |
pūrvaṃ yatra samutpannān brahmarṣīn sapta mānasān || 108 ||
putratve kalpayām āsa svayam eva pitāmahaḥ |
tato virodhe devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ || 109 ||
ditir vinaṣṭaputrā vai toṣayām āsa kaśyapam |
kaśyapas tu prasannātmā samyag ārādhitas tayā || 110 ||
vareṇa cchandayām āsa sā ca vavre varaṃ tadā |
sa ca tasmai varaṃ prādāt prārthitaḥ sumahātapāḥ |
dattvā ca varam atyugro mārīcaḥ samabhāṣata || 112 ||
indraṃ putro nihantā te garbhaṃ vai śaradāṃ śatam |
tathety abhihito bhartā tayā devyā mahātapāḥ |
dhārayām āsa garbhaṃ tu śuciḥ sā munisattamāḥ || 114 ||
rodhayan vai gaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devānām amitaujasam || 115 ||
tejaḥ saṃhṛtya durdharṣam avadhyam amarair api |
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucaṃ ditiḥ śayanam āviśat |
nidrāṃ cāhārayām āsa tasyāṃ kukṣiṃ praviśya saḥ || 118 ||
vajrapāṇis tato garbhaṃ saptadhā taṃ nyakṛntayat |
sa pāṭyamāno garbho 'tha vajreṇa praruroda ha || 119 ||
mā rodīr iti taṃ śakraḥ punaḥ punar athābravīt |
so 'bhavat saptadhā garbhas tam indro ruṣitaḥ punaḥ || 120 ||
maruto nāma te devā babhūvur dvijasattamāḥ || 121 ||
kramaśas tāni rājyāni pṛthupūrvāṇi bho dvijāḥ || 124 ||
sa hariḥ puruṣo vīraḥ kṛṣṇo jiṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ |
parjanyas tapano 'nantas tasya sarvam idaṃ jagat || 125 ||
apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ patim |
ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnām atha pāvakam || 3 ||
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ tu marutām atha vāsavam |
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ tathaiva ca || 5 ||
śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nadīnām atha sāgaram || 6 ||
nāgānāṃ vāsukiṃ cakre sarpāṇām atha takṣakam || 7 ||
mṛgāṇām atha śārdūlaṃ govṛṣaṃ tu gavāṃ patim |
diśāṃ pālān atha tataḥ sthāpayām āsa sa prabhuḥ || 10 ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi putraṃ tu vairājasya prajāpateḥ |
paścimasyāṃ diśi tathā rajasaḥ putram acyutam |
tair iyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā |
tasya vistaram ākhyāsye manor vaivasvatasya ha |
mahad etad adhiṣṭhānaṃ purāṇe tad adhiṣṭhitam || 18 ||
yathā mahātmanā tena dugdhā veyaṃ vasundharā || 19 ||
yathā vāpi nṛbhir dugdhā yathā devair maharṣibhiḥ |
yathā daityaiś ca nāgaiś ca yathā yakṣair yathā drumaiḥ || 20 ||
yathā śailaiḥ piśācaiś ca gandharvaiś ca dvijottamaiḥ |
rākṣasaiś ca mahāsattvair yathā dugdhā vasundharā || 21 ||
teṣāṃ pātraviśeṣāṃś ca vaktum arhasi suvrata |
yasmāc ca kāraṇāt pāṇir veṇasya mathitaḥ purā |
kruddhair maharṣibhis tāta kāraṇaṃ tac ca kīrtaya || 23 ||
ekāgrāḥ prayatāś caiva puṇyārthaṃ vai dvijarṣabhāḥ || 24 ||
svargyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ vedaiś ca sammitam |
rahasyam ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vai yathātatham || 26 ||
yaś cemaṃ kīrtayen nityaṃ pṛthor vaiṇyasya vistaram |
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya na sa śocet kṛtākṛtam || 27 ||
āsīd dharmasya saṅgoptā pūrvam atrisamaḥ prabhuḥ |
atrivaṃśe samutpannas tv aṅgo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 28 ||
maryādāṃ bhedayām āsa dharmopetāṃ sa pārthivaḥ |
pravṛttaṃ na papuḥ somaṃ hutaṃ yajñeṣu devatāḥ || 32 ||
na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyam iti tasya prajāpateḥ |
aham ijyaś ca yaṣṭā ca yajñaś ceti bhṛgūdvaha |
mayi yajño vidhātavyo mayi hotavyam ity api || 34 ||
adharmaṃ kuru mā veṇa eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 36 ||
prajāś ca pālayiṣye 'ham itīha samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 37 ||
tāṃs tathā bruvataḥ sarvān maharṣīn abravīt tadā |
veṇaḥ prahasya durbuddhir imam artham anarthavit || 38 ||
sraṣṭā dharmasya kaś cānyaḥ śrotavyaṃ kasya vā mayā |
śrutavīryatapaḥsatyair mayā vā kaḥ samo bhuvi || 39 ||
sammūḍhā na vidur nūnaṃ bhavanto māṃ vicetasaḥ || 40 ||
icchan daheyaṃ pṛthivīṃ plāvayeyaṃ jalais tathā |
dyāṃ vai bhuvaṃ ca rundheyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 41 ||
yadā na śakyate mohād avalepāc ca pārthivaḥ |
apanetuṃ tadā veṇas tataḥ kruddhā maharṣayaḥ || 42 ||
tato 'sya savyam ūruṃ te mamanthur jātamanyavaḥ || 43 ||
tasmin nimathyamāne vai rājña ūrau tu jajñivān |
hrasvo 'timātraḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇaś ceti babhūva ha || 44 ||
sa bhītaḥ prāñjalir bhūtvā tasthivān dvijasattamāḥ |
tam atrir vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā niṣīdety abravīt tadā || 45 ||
adharmarucayo viprās te tu vai veṇakalmaṣāḥ || 47 ||
tataḥ punar mahātmānaḥ pāṇiṃ veṇasya dakṣiṇam |
dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā sākṣād agnir iva jvalan || 49 ||
atha so 'jagavaṃ nāma dhanur gṛhya mahāravam |
śarāṃś ca divyān rakṣārthaṃ kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham || 50 ||
samāpetur mahābhāgā veṇas tu tridivaṃ yayau || 51 ||
trātaḥ sa puruṣavyāghraḥ punnāmno narakāt tadā || 52 ||
taṃ samudrāś ca nadyaś ca ratnāny ādāya sarvaśaḥ |
pitāmahaś ca bhagavān devair āṅgirasaiḥ saha |
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 54 ||
ādhirājye tadā rājñāṃ pṛthur vaiṇyaḥ pratāpavān || 56 ||
parvatāś ca dadur mārgaṃ dhvajabhaṅgaś ca nābhavat || 58 ||
etasminn eva kāle tu yajñe paitāmahe śubhe |
tasminn eva mahāyajñe jajñe prājño 'tha māgadhaḥ |
pṛthoḥ stavārthaṃ tau tatra samāhūtau maharṣibhiḥ || 61 ||
tāv ūcur ṛṣayaḥ sarve stūyatām eṣa pārthivaḥ |
karmaitad anurūpaṃ vāṃ pātraṃ cāyaṃ narādhipaḥ || 62 ||
tāv ūcatus tadā sarvāṃs tān ṛṣīn sūtamāgadhau |
āvāṃ devān ṛṣīṃś caiva prīṇayāvaḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 63 ||
na cāsya vidmo vai karma nāma vā lakṣaṇaṃ yaśaḥ |
stotraṃ yenāsya kuryāva rājñas tejasvino dvijāḥ || 64 ||
ṛṣibhis tau niyuktau tu bhaviṣyaiḥ stūyatām iti |
yāni karmāṇi kṛtavān pṛthuḥ paścān mahābalaḥ || 65 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti vai loke staveṣu munisattamāḥ |
tayoḥ stavānte suprītaḥ pṛthuḥ prādāt prajeśvaraḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāḥ prajāḥ procur manīṣiṇaḥ |
vṛttīnām eṣa vo dātā bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ || 68 ||
tvaṃ no vṛttiṃ vidhatsveti maharṣivacanāt tadā || 69 ||
dhanur gṛhya pṛṣatkāṃś ca pṛthivīm ādravad balī || 70 ||
tato vaiṇyabhayatrastā gaur bhūtvā prādravan mahī |
tāṃ pṛthur dhanur ādāya dravantīm anvadhāvata || 71 ||
sā lokān brahmalokādīn gatvā vaiṇyabhayāt tadā |
alabhantī tu sā trāṇaṃ vaiṇyam evānvapadyata |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā pūjyā lokais tribhis tadā || 74 ||
kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi prajā rājan vinā mayā || 75 ||
mayi lokāḥ sthitā rājan mayedaṃ dhāryate jagat |
madvināśe vinaśyeyuḥ prajāḥ pārthiva viddhi tat || 76 ||
na mām arhasi hantuṃ vai śreyaś cet tvaṃ cikīrṣasi |
prajānāṃ pṛthivīpāla śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama || 77 ||
upāyaṃ paśya yena tvaṃ dhārayethāḥ prajām imām || 78 ||
hatvāpi māṃ na śaktas tvaṃ prajānāṃ poṣaṇe nṛpa |
avadhyāṃ ca striyaṃ prāhus tiryagyonigateṣv api |
yady evaṃ pṛthivīpāla na dharmaṃ tyaktum arhasi || 80 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā rājā mahāmanāḥ |
kopaṃ nigṛhya dharmātmā vasudhām idam abravīt || 81 ||
ekasyārthe tu yo hanyād ātmano vā parasya vā |
bahūn vā prāṇino 'nantaṃ bhavet tasyeha pātakam || 82 ||
sukham edhanti bahavo yasmiṃs tu nihate 'śubhe |
tasmin hate nāsti bhadre pātakaṃ copapātakam || 83 ||
yadi me vacanān nādya kariṣyasi jagaddhitam || 84 ||
sā tvaṃ śāsanam āsthāya mama dharmabhṛtāṃ vare |
sañjīvaya prajāḥ sarvāḥ samarthā hy asi dhāraṇe || 86 ||
duhitṛtvaṃ ca me gaccha tata enam ahaṃ śaram |
sarvam etad ahaṃ vīra vidhāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
vatsaṃ tu mama sampaśya kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā || 88 ||
samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra māṃ tvaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara |
yathā visyandamānaṃ me kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvayet || 89 ||
dhanuṣkoṭyā tadā vaiṇyas tena śailā vivardhitāḥ || 90 ||
saṃvibhāgaḥ purāṇāṃ vā grāmāṇāṃ vābhavat tadā || 91 ||
na sasyāni na gorakṣyaṃ na kṛṣir na vaṇikpathaḥ |
naiva satyānṛtaṃ cāsīn na lobho na ca matsaraḥ || 92 ||
vaiṇyāt prabhṛti vai viprāḥ sarvasyaitasya sambhavaḥ || 93 ||
yatra yatra samaṃ tv asyā bhūmer āsīt tadā dvijāḥ |
tatra tatra prajāḥ sarvā nivāsaṃ samarocayan || 94 ||
kṛcchreṇa mahatā yukta ity evam anuśuśruma || 95 ||
sa kalpayitvā vatsaṃ tu manuṃ svāyambhuvaṃ prabhum |
ṛṣayaś ca tadā devāḥ pitaro 'tha sarīsṛpāḥ |
daityā yakṣāḥ puṇyajanā gandharvāḥ parvatā nagāḥ || 98 ||
ete purā dvijaśreṣṭhā duduhur dharaṇīṃ kila |
kṣīraṃ vatsaś ca pātraṃ ca teṣāṃ dogdhā pṛthak pṛthak || 99 ||
ṛṣīṇām abhavat somo vatso dogdhā bṛhaspatiḥ |
kṣīraṃ teṣāṃ tapo brahma pātraṃ chandāṃsi bho dvijāḥ || 100 ||
devānāṃ kāñcanaṃ pātraṃ vatsas teṣāṃ śatakratuḥ |
kṣīram ojaskaraṃ caiva dogdhā ca bhagavān raviḥ || 101 ||
pitṝṇāṃ rājataṃ pātraṃ yamo vatsaḥ pratāpavān |
antakaś cābhavad dogdhā kṣīraṃ teṣāṃ sudhā smṛtā || 102 ||
dogdhā tv airāvato nāgas teṣāṃ kṣīraṃ viṣaṃ smṛtam || 103 ||
asurāṇāṃ madhur dogdhā kṣīraṃ māyāmayaṃ smṛtam |
virocanas tu vatso 'bhūd āyasaṃ pātram eva ca || 104 ||
yakṣāṇām āmapātraṃ tu vatso vaiśravaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
dogdhā rajatanābhas tu kṣīrāntardhānam eva ca || 105 ||
sumālī rākṣasendrāṇāṃ vatsaḥ kṣīraṃ ca śoṇitam |
dogdhā rajatanābhas tu kapālaṃ pātram eva ca || 106 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho vatsaḥ pātraṃ ca paṅkajam |
dogdhā ca suruciḥ kṣīraṃ teṣāṃ gandhaḥ śuciḥ smṛtaḥ || 107 ||
śailaṃ pātraṃ parvatānāṃ kṣīraṃ ratnauṣadhīs tathā |
vatsas tu himavān āsīd dogdhā merur mahāgiriḥ || 108 ||
plakṣo vatsas tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ dogdhā śālas tu puṣpitaḥ |
seyaṃ dhātrī vidhātrī ca pāvanī ca vasundharā |
carācarasya sarvasya pratiṣṭhā yonir eva ca || 110 ||
tato 'bhyupagamād rājñaḥ pṛthor vaiṇyasya bho dvijāḥ |
pṛthunā pravibhaktā ca śodhitā ca vasundharā |
namasyaś caiva pūjyaś ca bhūtagrāmair na saṃśayaḥ || 115 ||
yodhair api ca vikrāntaiḥ prāptukāmair jayaṃ yudhi |
yo hi yoddhā raṇaṃ yāti kīrtayitvā pṛthuṃ nṛpam |
sa ghorarūpāt saṅgrāmāt kṣemī bhavati kīrtimān || 119 ||
pṛthur eva namaskāryaḥ śreyaḥ param ihepsubhiḥ || 121 ||
ete vatsaviśeṣāś ca dogdhāraḥ kṣīram eva ca |
pātrāṇi ca mayoktāni kiṃ bhūyo varṇayāmi vaḥ || 122 ||
yāvanto manavaś caiva yāvantaṃ kālam eva ca |
manvantarāṇi bhoḥ sūta śrotum icchāma tattvataḥ || 2 ||
na śakyo vistaro viprā vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api |
svāyambhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ manuḥ svārociṣas tathā |
uttamas tāmasaś caiva raivataś cākṣuṣas tathā || 4 ||
vaivasvataś ca bho viprāḥ sāmprataṃ manur ucyate |
sāvarṇiś ca manus tadvad raibhyo raucyas tathaiva ca || 5 ||
kīrtitā manavas tubhyaṃ mayaivaite yathā śrutāḥ |
ṛṣīṃs tv eṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi putrān devagaṇāṃs tathā || 7 ||
marīcir atrir bhagavān aṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pulastyaś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca saptaite brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || 8 ||
uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā dvijāḥ saptarṣayas tathā |
āgniidhraś cāgnibāhuś ca medhyo medhātithir vasuḥ || 9 ||
etad vai prathamaṃ viprā manvantaram udāhṛtam |
aurvo vasiṣṭhaputraś ca stambaḥ kaśyapa eva ca || 11 ||
devāś ca tuṣitā nāma smṛtāḥ svārociṣe 'ntare |
havighnaḥ sukṛtir jyotir āpo mūrtir api smṛtaḥ || 13 ||
pratītaś ca nabhasyaś ca nabha ūrjas tathaiva ca |
svārociṣasya putrās te manor viprā mahātmanaḥ || 14 ||
dvitīyam etat kathitaṃ viprā manvantaraṃ mayā || 15 ||
idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vakṣyāmi tad budhyadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
auttameyān muniśreṣṭhā daśa putrān manor imān |
iṣa ūrjas tanūrjas tu madhur mādhava eva ca || 18 ||
śuciḥ śukraḥ sahaś caiva nabhasyo nabha eva ca |
bhānavas tatra devāś ca manvantaram udāhṛtam || 19 ||
kāvyaḥ pṛthus tathaivāgnir jahnur dhātā dvijottamāḥ || 20 ||
kapīvān akapīvāṃś ca tatra saptarṣayo dvijāḥ |
purāṇe kīrtitā viprāḥ putrāḥ pautrāś ca bho dvijāḥ || 21 ||
tāmasasya manor ete daśa putrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 23 ||
devabāhur yadudhraś ca munir vedaśirās tathā || 24 ||
vāriplavaś ca raibhyaś ca manor antaram ucyate || 26 ||
atha putrān imāṃs tasya budhyadhvaṃ gadato mama |
āraṇyaś ca prakāśaś ca nirmohaḥ satyavāk kṛtī |
raivatasya manoḥ putrāḥ pañcamaṃ caitad antaram || 28 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu sampravakṣyāmi tad budhyadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
bhṛgur nabho vivasvāṃś ca sudhāmā virajās tathā || 29 ||
atināmā sahiṣṇuś ca saptaite ca maharṣayaḥ |
cākṣuṣasyāntare viprā manor devās tv ime smṛtāḥ || 30 ||
lekhāś ca nāmato viprāḥ pañca devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 31 ||
nāḍvaleyā muniśreṣṭhā daśa putrās tu viśrutāḥ || 32 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ manvantaraṃ proktaṃ saptamaṃ tu nibodhata || 33 ||
atrir vasiṣṭho bhagavān kaśyapaś ca mahān ṛṣiḥ |
saptamo jamadagniś ca ṛṣayaḥ sāmprataṃ divi || 35 ||
sādhyā rudrāś ca viśve ca vasavo marutas tathā |
ādityāś cāśvinau cāpi devau vaivasvatau smṛtau || 36 ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca dikṣu sarvāsu bho dvijāḥ || 38 ||
manvantareṣu sarveṣu prāg āsan sapta saptakāḥ |
kṛtvā karma divaṃ yānti brahmalokam anāmayam || 40 ||
tato 'nye tapasā yuktāḥ sthānaṃ tat pūrayanty uta |
atītā vartamānāś ca krameṇaitena bho dvijāḥ || 41 ||
anāgatāś ca saptaite smṛtā divi maharṣayaḥ |
manor antaram āsādya sāvarṇasyeha bho dvijāḥ || 42 ||
gautamaś cājaraś caiva śaradvān nāma gautamaḥ |
kauśiko gālavaś caiva aurvaḥ kāśyapa eva ca || 44 ||
vairī caivādhvarīvāṃś ca śamano dhṛtimān vasuḥ || 45 ||
ariṣṭaś cāpy adhṛṣṭaś ca vājī sumatir eva ca |
eteṣāṃ kalyam utthāya kīrtanāt sukham edhate |
yaśaś cāpnoti sumahad āyuṣmāṃś ca bhaven naraḥ || 47 ||
etāny uktāni bho viprāḥ sapta sapta ca tattvataḥ |
sāvarṇā manavo viprāḥ pañca tāṃś ca nibodhata |
eko vaivasvatas teṣāṃ catvāras tu prajāpateḥ || 49 ||
dakṣasyaite hi dauhitrāḥ priyāyās tanayā nṛpāḥ || 50 ||
ruceḥ prajāpateḥ putro raucyo nāma manuḥ smṛtaḥ || 51 ||
bhūtyāṃ cotpādito devyāṃ bhautyo nāma ruceḥ sutaḥ |
anāgatāś ca saptaite kalpe 'smin manavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 52 ||
tair iyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā |
prajāpatiś ca tapasā saṃhāraṃ teṣu nityaśaḥ |
yugāni saptatis tāni sāgrāṇi kathitāni ca || 54 ||
prajānāṃ patayo viprā dhanyam eṣāṃ prakīrtanam || 56 ||
na śakyate 'ntas teṣāṃ vai vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api || 57 ||
visargasya prajānāṃ vai saṃhārasya ca bho dvijāḥ |
saśeṣās tatra tiṣṭhanti devāḥ saptarṣibhiḥ saha |
pūrṇe yugasahasre tu kalpo niḥśeṣa ucyate |
avyaktaḥ śāśvato devas tasya sarvam idaṃ jagat || 62 ||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi manor vaivasvatasya vai |
yatrotpanno mahātmā sa harir vṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ || 64 ||
Chapter 6: Story of Vivasvat and Sañjñā and their progeny
tasya bhāryābhavat sañjñā tvāṣṭrī devī vivasvataḥ || 1 ||
sā vai bhāryā bhagavato mārtaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 ||
ādityasya hi tad rūpaṃ maṇḍalasya sutejasā |
na khalv ayaṃ mṛto 'ṇḍasya iti snehād abhāṣata |
ajānan kāśyapas tasmān mārtaṇḍa iti cocyate || 5 ||
tejas tv abhyadhikaṃ tasya nityam eva vivasvataḥ |
trīṇy apatyāni bho viprāḥ sañjñāyāṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ |
ādityo janayām āsa kanyāṃ dvau ca prajāpatī || 7 ||
yamaś ca yamunā caiva yamajau sambabhūvatuḥ || 8 ||
śyāmavarṇaṃ tu tad rūpaṃ sañjñā dṛṣṭvā vivasvataḥ |
asahantī tu svāṃ chāyāṃ savarṇāṃ nirmame tataḥ || 9 ||
māyāmayī tu sā sañjñā tasyāṃ chāyāsamutthitām |
prāñjaliḥ praṇatā bhūtvā chāyā sañjñāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 10 ||
uvāca kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ kathayasva śucismite |
sthitāsmi tava nirdeśe śādhi māṃ varavarṇini || 11 ||
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te svam eva bhavanaṃ pituḥ |
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ceyaṃ sumadhyamā |
sambhāvyās te na cākhyeyam idaṃ bhagavate kvacit || 13 ||
ā kacagrahaṇād devi ā śāpān naiva karhicit |
ākhyāsyāmi namas tubhyaṃ gaccha devi yathāsukham || 14 ||
samādiśya savarṇāṃ tu tathety uktā tayā ca sā |
pituḥ samīpagā sā tu pitrā nirbhartsitā śubhā |
bhartuḥ samīpaṃ gaccheti niyuktā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 16 ||
āgacchad vaḍavā bhūtvā ācchādya rūpam aninditā |
kurūn athottarān gatvā tṛṇāny atha cacāra ha || 17 ||
dvitīyāyāṃ tu sañjñāyāṃ sañjñeyam iti cintayan |
ādityo janayām āsa putram ātmasamaṃ tadā || 18 ||
pūrvajasya manor viprāḥ sadṛśo 'yam iti prabhuḥ |
manur evābhavan nāmnā sāvarṇa iti cocyate || 19 ||
dvitīyo yaḥ sutas tasyāḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śanaiścaraḥ |
sañjñā tu pārthivī viprāḥ svasya putrasya vai tadā || 20 ||
cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ na tathā pūrvajeṣu vai |
manus tasyāḥ kṣamat tat tu yamas tasyā na cakṣame || 21 ||
sa vai roṣāc ca bālyāc ca bhāvino 'rthasya vānagha |
padā santarjayām āsa sañjñāṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ || 22 ||
taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ krodhāt sāvarṇajananī tadā |
yamas tu tat pituḥ sarvaṃ prāñjaliḥ pratyavedayat |
mātrā snehena sarveṣu vartitavyaṃ suteṣu vai || 25 ||
tasyāṃ mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ || 26 ||
bālyād vā yadi vā laulyān mohāt tat kṣantum arhasi |
śapto 'ham asmi lokeśa jananyā tapatāṃ vara |
tava prasādāc caraṇo na paten mama gopate || 27 ||
asaṃśayaṃ putra mahad bhaviṣyaty atra kāraṇam |
yena tvām āviśat krodho dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam || 28 ||
na śakyam etan mithyā tu kartuṃ mātṛvacas tava |
kṛmayo māṃsam ādāya yāsyanty avanim eva ca || 29 ||
kṛtam evaṃ vacas tathyaṃ mātus tava bhaviṣyati |
śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi || 30 ||
ādityaś cābravīt sañjñāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai |
tulyeṣv abhyadhikaḥ sneha ekasmin kriyate tvayā || 31 ||
sā tat pariharantī tu nācacakṣe vivasvate |
sa cātmānaṃ samādhāya yogāt tathyam apaśyata || 32 ||
mūrdhajeṣu nijagrāha sa tu tāṃ munisattamāḥ || 33 ||
vivasvān atha tac chrutvā kruddhas tvaṣṭāram abhyagāt || 34 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ yathānyāyam arcayitvā vibhāvasum |
nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāntvayām āsa vai tadā || 35 ||
asahantī ca sañjñā sā vane carati śāḍvale || 36 ||
draṣṭā hi tāṃ bhavān adya svāṃ bhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm |
anukūlaṃ tu te deva yadi syān mama sammatam |
rūpaṃ nirvartayāmy adya tava kāntam arindama || 38 ||
bhramim āropya tat tejaḥ śātayām āsa bho dvijāḥ || 39 ||
tato nirbhāsitaṃ rūpaṃ tejasā saṃhatena vai |
kāntāt kāntataraṃ draṣṭum adhikaṃ śuśubhe tadā || 40 ||
dadarśa yogam āsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ tataḥ |
sā tan niravamac chukraṃ nāsikābhyāṃ vivasvataḥ || 43 ||
devau tasyām ajāyetām aśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau |
nāsatyaś caiva dasraś ca smṛtau dvāv aśvināv iti || 44 ||
tāṃ tu rūpeṇa kāntena darśayām āsa bhāskaraḥ || 45 ||
sā tu dṛṣṭvaiva bhartāraṃ tutoṣa munisattamāḥ |
yamas tu karmaṇā tena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ || 46 ||
dharmeṇa rañjayām āsa dharmarāja imāḥ prajāḥ |
sa lebhe karmaṇā tena śubhena paramadyutiḥ || 47 ||
pitṝṇām ādhipatyaṃ ca lokapālatvam eva ca |
manuḥ prajāpatis tv āsīt sāvarṇiḥ sa tapodhanāḥ || 48 ||
merupṛṣṭhe tapo nityam adyāpi sa caraty uta || 49 ||
bhrātā śanaiścaras tasya grahatvaṃ sa tu labdhavān |
tvaṣṭā tu tejasā tena viṣṇoś cakram akalpayat || 50 ||
yavīyasī tu sāpy āsīd yamī kanyā yaśasvinī || 51 ||
manur ity ucyate loke sāvarṇa iti cocyate || 52 ||
dvitīyo yaḥ sutas tasya manor bhrātā śanaiścaraḥ |
grahatvaṃ sa ca lebhe vai sarvalokābhipūjitaḥ || 53 ||
ya idaṃ janma devānāṃ śṛṇuyān narasattamaḥ |
āpadaṃ prāpya mucyeta prāpnuyāc ca mahad yaśaḥ || 54 ||
manor vaivasvatasyāsan putrā vai nava tatsamāḥ |
ikṣvākuś caiva nābhāgo dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātir eva ca || 1 ||
nariṣyantaś ca ṣaṣṭho vai prāṃśū riṣṭaś ca saptamaḥ |
karūṣaś ca pṛṣadhraś ca navaite munisattamāḥ || 2 ||
akarot putrakāmas tu manur iṣṭiṃ prajāpatiḥ |
anutpanneṣu bahuṣu putreṣv eteṣu bho dvijāḥ |
tasyāṃ ca vartamānāyām iṣṭyāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ || 4 ||
divyasaṃhananā caiva ilā jajña iti śrutiḥ |
tām ilety eva hovāca manur daṇḍadharas tadā || 6 ||
anugacchasva māṃ bhadre tam ilā pratyuvāca ha |
tayoḥ sakāśaṃ yāsyāmi na māṃ dharmahatāṃ kuru || 8 ||
saivam uktvā manuṃ devaṃ mitrāvaruṇayor ilā |
aṃśe 'smi yuvayor jātā devau kiṃ karavāṇi vām |
manunā cāham uktā vāai anugacchasva mām iti || 10 ||
mitraś ca varuṇaś cobhāv ūcatus tāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 11 ||
anena tava dharmeṇa praśrayeṇa damena ca |
satyena caiva suśroṇi prītau svo varavarṇini || 12 ||
āvayos tvaṃ mahābhāge khyātiṃ kanyeti yāsyasi || 13 ||
manor vaṃśakaraḥ putras tvam eva ca bhaviṣyasi |
sudyumna iti vikhyātas triṣu lokeṣu śobhane || 14 ||
nivṛttā sā tu tac chrutvā gacchantī pitur antikāt || 15 ||
somaputrād budhād viprās tasyāṃ jajñe purūravāḥ || 16 ||
janayitvā tataḥ sā tam ilā sudyumnatāṃ gatā |
utkalaś ca gayaś caiva vinatāśvaś ca bho dvijāḥ |
dik pūrvā muniśārdūlā gayasya tu gayā smṛtā |
praviṣṭe tu manau viprā divākaram arindamam || 19 ||
daśadhā tat punaḥ kṣatram akarot pṛthivīm imām |
kanyābhāvāt tu sudyumno naitad rājyam avāptavān |
tat purūravase prādād rājyaṃ prāpya mahāyaśāḥ || 22 ||
dhṛtavāṃs tām ilety evaṃ sudyumneti ca viśrutaḥ || 23 ||
nāriṣyantāḥ śakāḥ putrā nābhāgasya tu bho dvijāḥ |
dhṛṣṭasya dhārṣṭakaṃ kṣatraṃ raṇadṛptaṃ babhūva ha |
prāṃśor eko 'bhavat putraḥ prajāpatir iti smṛtaḥ || 26 ||
śaryāter mithunaṃ tv āsīd ānarto nāma viśrutaḥ || 27 ||
putraḥ kanyā sukanyā ca yā patnī cyavanasya ha |
ānartasya tu dāyādo raivo nāma mahādyutiḥ || 28 ||
raivasya raivataḥ putraḥ kakudmī nāma dhārmikaḥ || 29 ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ putraḥ sa tasyāsīd rājyaṃ prāpya kuśasthalīm |
ājagāma sa caivātha svāṃ purīṃ yādavair vṛtām || 31 ||
kanyāṃ tāṃ baladevāya subhadrāṃ nāma revatīm || 33 ||
dattvā jagāma śikharaṃ meros tapasi saṃsthitaḥ |
reme rāmo 'pi dharmātmā revatyā sahitaḥ sukhī || 34 ||
na jarā revatīṃ prāptā raivataṃ ca kakudminam || 35 ||
meruṃ gatasya vā tasya śaryāteḥ santatiḥ katham |
sthitā pṛthivyām adyāpi śrotum icchāma tattvataḥ || 36 ||
na jarā kṣutpipāsā vā na mṛtyur munisattamāḥ |
kakudminaḥ svarlokaṃ tu raivatasya gatasya ha || 37 ||
hṛtā puṇyajanair viprā rākṣasaiḥ sā kuśasthalī |
tasya bhrātṛśataṃ tv āsīd dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ || 38 ||
tad vadhyamānaṃ rakṣobhir diśaḥ prākrāmad acyutāḥ |
vidrutasya ca viprendrās tasya bhrātṛśatasya vai || 39 ||
anvavāyas tu sumahāṃs tatra tatra dvijottamāḥ |
teṣāṃ hy ete muniśreṣṭhāḥ śaryātā iti viśrutāḥ || 40 ||
pṛṣadhro hiṃsayitvā tu guror gāṃ dvijasattamāḥ |
kṣuvatas tu manor viprā ikṣvākur abhavat sutaḥ || 44 ||
tasya putraśataṃ tv āsīd ikṣvākor bhūridakṣiṇam |
teṣāṃ vikukṣir jyeṣṭhas tu vikukṣitvād ayodhatām || 45 ||
catvāriṃśad daśāṣṭau ca dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā diśi || 47 ||
ikṣvākus tu vikukṣiṃ vāai aṣṭakāyām athādiśat || 48 ||
māṃsam ānaya śrāddhārthaṃ mṛgān hatvā mahābala |
bhakṣayitvā śaśaṃ viprāḥ śaśādo mṛgayāṃ gataḥ |
ikṣvākau saṃsthite viprāḥ śaśādas tu nṛpo 'bhavat |
śaśādasya tu dāyādaḥ kakutstho nāma vīryavān || 51 ||
anenās tu kakutsthasya pṛthuś cānenasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
viṣṭarāśvaḥ pṛthoḥ putras tasmād ārdras tv ajāyata || 52 ||
ārdras tu yuvanāśvas tu śrāvastas tatsuto dvijāḥ |
jajñe śrāvastako rājā śrāvastī yena nirmitā || 53 ||
yaḥ sa dhundhuvadhād rājā dhundhumāratvam āgataḥ || 55 ||
dhundhor vadhaṃ mahāprājña śrotum icchāma tattvataḥ |
putrasaṅkrāmitaśrīs tu vanaṃ rājā viveśa ha |
bhavatā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tac ca kartuṃ tvam arhasi |
nirudvignas tapaś cartuṃ nahi śaknomi pārthiva || 60 ||
rākṣasasya madhoḥ putro dhundhur nāma mahāsuraḥ |
yadā tadā mahī tatra calati sma narādhipa || 64 ||
tena tāta na śaknomi tasmin sthātuṃ sva āśrame || 66 ||
lokāḥ svasthā bhavanty adya tasmin vinihate tvayā || 67 ||
tvaṃ hi tasya vadhāyaikaḥ samarthaḥ pṛthivīpate |
viṣṇunā ca varo datto mahyaṃ pūrvayuge nṛpa || 68 ||
yas taṃ mahāsuraṃ raudraṃ haniṣyati mahābalam |
vīryaṃ ca sumahat tasya devair api durāsadam |
sa evam ukto rājarṣir uttaṅkena mahātmanā |
bhagavan nyastaśastro 'ham ayaṃ tu tanayo mama |
sa taṃ vyādiśya tanayaṃ rājarṣir dhundhumāraṇe |
kuvalāśvas tu putrāṇāṃ śatena saha bho dvijāḥ |
tam āviśat tadā viṣṇus tejasā bhagavān prabhuḥ |
tasmin prayāte durdharṣe divi śabdo mahān abhūt |
divyair gandhaiś ca mālyaiś ca taṃ devāḥ samavākiran |
sa gatvā jayatāṃ śreṣṭhas tanayaiḥ saha vīryavān |
tasya putraiḥ khanadbhiś ca vālukāntarhitas tadā |
dhundhur āsādito viprā diśam āvṛtya paścimām || 79 ||
tasya putraśataṃ dagdhaṃ tribhir ūnaṃ tu rakṣasā || 81 ||
tataḥ sa rājā dyutimān rākṣasaṃ taṃ mahābalam |
tasya vārimayaṃ vegam āpīya sa narādhipaḥ |
yogī yogena vahniṃ ca śamayām āsa vāriṇā || 83 ||
uttaṅkas tu varaṃ prādāt tasmai rājñe mahātmane |
dharme ratiṃ ca satataṃ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam |
putrāṇāṃ cākṣayāṃl lokān svarge ye rakṣasā hatāḥ || 86 ||
tasya putrās trayaḥ śiṣṭā dṛḍhāśvo jyeṣṭha ucyate |
tasya haimavatī kanyā satāṃ matā dṛṣadvatī |
vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu putraś cāsyāḥ prasenajit || 90 ||
lebhe prasenajid bhāryāṃ gaurīṃ nāma pativratām |
abhiśastā tu sā bhartrā nadī vai bāhudābhavat || 91 ||
tasya putro mahān āsīd yuvanāśvo narādhipaḥ |
pativratā ca jyeṣṭhā ca bhrātṝṇām ayutasya vai |
tasyām utpādayām āsa māndhātā dvau sutau dvijāḥ || 94 ||
purukutsaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ mucukundaṃ ca pārthivam |
rājñas tridhanvanas tv āsīd vidvāṃs trayyāruṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
yena bhāryā kṛtodvāhā hṛtā caiva parasya ha || 98 ||
bālyāt kāmāc ca mohāc ca sāhasāc cāpalena ca |
so 'bravīt pitaraṃ tyaktaḥ kva gacchāmīti vai muhuḥ |
pitā ca tam athovāca śvapākaiḥ saha vartaya || 101 ||
ity uktaḥ sa nirākrāman nagarād vacanāt pituḥ || 102 ||
na ca taṃ vārayām āsa vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ |
pitrā tyakto 'vasad vīraḥ pitāpy asya vanaṃ yayau |
tatas tasmiṃs tu viṣaye nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ || 104 ||
samā dvādaśa bho viprās tenādharmeṇa vai tadā |
dārāṃs tu tasya viṣaye viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ || 105 ||
sannyasya sāgarānte tu cakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ |
tasya patnī gale baddhvā madhyamaṃ putram aurasam || 106 ||
taṃ ca baddhaṃ gale dṛṣṭvā vikrayārthaṃ nṛpātmajaḥ || 107 ||
maharṣiputraṃ dharmātmā mokṣayām āsa bho dvijāḥ |
so 'bhavad gālavo nāma gale bandhān mahātapāḥ |
maharṣiḥ kauśiko dhīmāṃs tena vīreṇa mokṣitaḥ || 109 ||
satyavratas tu bhaktyā ca kṛpayā ca pratijñayā |
hatvā mṛgān varāhāṃś ca mahiṣāṃś ca vanecarān |
pitur niyogād avasat tasmin vanagate nṛpe || 3 ||
ayodhyāṃ caiva rājyaṃ ca tathaivāntaḥpuraṃ muniḥ |
satyavratas tu bālyāc ca bhāvino 'rthasya vai balāt |
pitrā hi taṃ tadā rāṣṭrāt tyajyamānaṃ priyaṃ sutam |
nivārayām āsa munir bahunā kāraṇena na || 6 ||
na ca satyavratas tasmād dhatavān saptame pade || 7 ||
jānan dharmaṃ vasiṣṭhas tu na māṃ trātīti bho dvijāḥ |
guṇabuddhyā tu bhagavān vasiṣṭhaḥ kṛtavāṃs tathā |
na ca satyavratas tasya tam upāṃśum abudhyata || 9 ||
tasminn aparitoṣaś ca pitur āsīn mahātmanaḥ |
tena tv idānīṃ vihitāṃ dīkṣāṃ tāṃ durvahāṃ bhuvi |
kulasya niṣkṛtir viprāḥ kṛtā sā vai bhaved iti || 11 ||
na taṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavān pitrā tyaktaṃ nyavārayat |
abhiṣekṣyāmy ahaṃ putram asyety evammatir muniḥ || 12 ||
sa tu dvādaśa varṣāṇi tāṃ dīkṣām avahad balī |
tāṃ vai krodhāc ca mohāc ca śramāc caiva kṣudhānvitaḥ || 14 ||
tanmāṃsaṃ sa svayaṃ caiva viśvāmitrasya cātmajān || 15 ||
bhojayām āsa tac chrutvā vasiṣṭho 'py asya cukrudhe || 16 ||
pātayeyam ahaṃ krūra tava śaṅkum asaṃśayam |
yadi te dvāv imau śaṅkū na syātāṃ vai kṛtau punaḥ || 17 ||
evaṃ trīṇy asya śaṅkūni tāni dṛṣṭvā mahātapāḥ |
triśaṅkur iti hovāca triśaṅkus tena sa smṛtaḥ || 19 ||
tena tasmai varaṃ prādān muniḥ prītas triśaṅkave || 20 ||
saśarīro vraje svargam ity evaṃ yācito varaḥ || 21 ||
miṣatāṃ devatānāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya ca kauśikaḥ |
sa vai rājā hariścandras traiśaṅkava iti smṛtaḥ |
āhartā rājasūyasya samrāḍ iti ha viśrutaḥ || 25 ||
vijayaś ca muniśreṣṭhāś cañcuputro babhūva ha |
jetā sa sarvapṛthivīṃ vijayas tena sa smṛtaḥ || 27 ||
rurukasya vṛkaḥ putro vṛkād bāhus tu jajñivān || 28 ||
haihayās tālajaṅghāś ca nirasyanti sma taṃ nṛpam |
nāsatyo dhārmikaś caiva sa ha dharmayuge 'bhavat |
sagaras tu suto bāhor yajñe saha gareṇa vai || 30 ||
āgneyam astraṃ labdhvā ca bhārgavāt sagaro nṛpaḥ || 31 ||
śakānāṃ pahnavānāṃ ca dharmaṃ nirasad acyutaḥ |
kathaṃ sa sagaro jāto gareṇaiva sahācyutaḥ |
dharmān kulocitān rājā kruddho nirasad acyutaḥ |
etan naḥ sarvam ācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate || 34 ||
bāhor vyasaninaḥ pūrvaṃ hṛtaṃ rājyam abhūt kila |
haihayais tālajaṅghaiś ca śakaiḥ sārdhaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 35 ||
yavanāḥ pāradāś caiva kāmbojāḥ pahnavās tathā |
ete hy api gaṇāḥ pañca haihayārthe parākraman || 36 ||
hṛtarājyas tadā rājā sa vai bāhur vanaṃ yayau |
patnyā cānugato duḥkhī tatra prāṇān avāsṛjat || 37 ||
patnī tu yādavī tasya sagarbhā pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt |
sapatnyā ca garas tasyai dattaḥ pūrvaṃ kilānaghāḥ || 38 ||
sā tu bhartuś citāṃ kṛtvā vane tām abhyarohata |
aurvas tāṃ bhārgavo viprāḥ kāruṇyāt samavārayat || 39 ||
tasyāśrame ca garbhaḥ sa gareṇaiva sahācyutaḥ |
aurvas tu jātakarmādīṃs tasya kṛtvā mahātmanaḥ |
āgneyaṃ tu mahābhāgā amarair api duḥsaham |
haihayān vijaghānāśu kruddho rudraḥ paśūn iva |
ājahāra ca lokeṣu kīrtiṃ kīrtimatāṃ varaḥ || 43 ||
tataḥ śakāṃś ca yavanān kāmbojān pāradāṃs tathā |
pahnavāṃś caiva niḥśeṣān kartuṃ vyavasito nṛpaḥ || 44 ||
vasiṣṭhas tv atha tān dṛṣṭvā samayena mahādyutiḥ |
sagaraṃ vārayām āsa teṣāṃ dattvābhayaṃ tadā || 46 ||
sagaraḥ svāṃ pratijñāṃ tu guror vākyaṃ niśamya ca |
dharmaṃ jaghāna teṣāṃ vai veṣān anyāṃś cakāra ha || 47 ||
yavanānāṃ śiraḥ sarvaṃ kāmbojānāṃ tathaiva ca || 48 ||
sarve te kṣatriyā viprā dharmas teṣāṃ nirākṛtaḥ |
sa taṃ deśaṃ tadā putraiḥ khānayām āsa pārthivaḥ |
āsedus te tadā tatra khanyamāne mahārṇave || 54 ||
tam ādipuruṣaṃ devaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajāpatim |
dagdhāḥ sarve muniśreṣṭhāś catvāras tv avaśeṣitāḥ || 56 ||
barhiketuḥ suketuś ca tathā dharmaratho nṛpaḥ |
śūraḥ pañcanadaś caiva tasya vaṃśakarā nṛpāḥ || 57 ||
prādāc ca tasmai bhagavān harir nārāyaṇo varam |
akṣayaṃ vaṃśam ikṣvākoḥ kīrtiṃ cāpy anivartinīm || 58 ||
putraṃ samudraṃ ca vibhuḥ svarge vāsaṃ tathākṣayam |
samudraś cārgham ādāya vavande taṃ mahīpatim || 59 ||
sāgaratvaṃ ca lebhe sa karmaṇā tena tasya ha |
putrāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭis tasyeti naḥ śrutam || 61 ||
aurvas tābhyāṃ varaṃ prādāt tad budhyadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
ekaṃ vaṃśadharaṃ tv ekā yatheṣṭaṃ varayatv iti |
ekaṃ vaṃśadharaṃ tv ekā tathety āha tato muniḥ |
rājā pañcajano nāma babhūva sa mahādyutiḥ || 67 ||
itarā suṣuve tumbīṃ bījapūrṇām iti śrutiḥ |
ghṛtapūrṇeṣu kumbheṣu tān garbhān nidadhe tataḥ || 69 ||
dhātrīś caikaikaśaḥ prādāt tāvatīḥ poṣaṇe nṛpaḥ |
ekaḥ pañcajano nāma putro rājā babhūva ha |
dilīpas tasya tanayaḥ khaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ |
yena svargād ihāgatya muhūrtaṃ prāpya jīvitam || 74 ||
yaḥ sa gaṅgāṃ saricchreṣṭhām avātārayata prabhuḥ |
sudāsasya sutaḥ proktaḥ saudāso nāma pārthivaḥ || 81 ||
ajas tu rāghavo jajñe tathā daśaratho 'py ajāt || 86 ||
rāmasya tanayo jajñe kuśa ity abhisañjñitaḥ || 87 ||
atithis tu kuśāj jajñe dharmātmā sumahāyaśāḥ |
atithes tv abhavat putro niṣadho nāma vīryavān || 88 ||
niṣadhasya nalaḥ putro nabhaḥ putro nalasya ca |
nabhasya puṇḍarīkas tu kṣemadhanvā tataḥ smṛtaḥ || 89 ||
ahīnagos tu dāyādaḥ sudhanvā nāma pārthivaḥ |
sudhanvanaḥ sutaś cāpi tato jajñe śalo nṛpaḥ || 91 ||
ukyo nāma sa dharmātmā śalaputro babhūva ha |
vajranābhaḥ sutas tasya nalas tasya mahātmanaḥ || 92 ||
nalau dvāv eva vikhyātau purāṇe munisattamāḥ |
paṭhan samyag imāṃ sṛṣṭim ādityasya vivasvataḥ |
Chapter 9: The origin of Soma, the abduction of Tārā, and the birth of Budha
pitā somasya bho viprā jajñe 'trir bhagavān ṛṣiḥ |
anuttaraṃ nāma tapo yena taptaṃ hi tat purā |
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyānīti hi naḥ śrutam || 2 ||
ūrdhvam ācakrame tasya retaḥ somatvam īyivat |
netrābhyāṃ vāri susrāva daśadhā dyotayan diśaḥ || 3 ||
taṃ garbhaṃ vidhinādiṣṭā daśa devyo dadhus tataḥ |
sametya dhārayām āsur na ca tāḥ samaśaknuvan || 4 ||
yadā na dhāraṇe śaktās tasya garbhasya tā diśaḥ |
tatas tābhiḥ sa tyaktas tu nipapāta vasundharām || 5 ||
tasya yac caritaṃ tejaḥ pṛthivīm anvapadyata |
oṣadhyas tāḥ samudbhūtā yābhiḥ sandhāryate jagat || 10 ||
sa labdhatejā bhagavān saṃstavaiś ca svakarmabhiḥ |
tapas tepe mahābhāgaḥ padmānāṃ darśanāya saḥ || 11 ||
tatas tasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ |
sa tat prāpya mahārājyaṃ somaḥ saumyavatāṃ varaḥ |
dakṣiṇām adadāt somas trīṃl lokān iti naḥ śrutam |
tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaś ca bho dvijāḥ || 14 ||
sadasyo 'bhūd dharis tatra munibhir bahubhir vṛtaḥ || 15 ||
taṃ sinīś ca kuhūś caiva dyutiḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ |
kīrtir dhṛtiś ca lakṣmīś ca nava devyaḥ siṣevire || 16 ||
tasya tat prāpya duṣprāpyam aiśvaryam ṛṣisatkṛtam |
sa yācyamāno devaiś ca tathā devarṣibhir muhuḥ |
naiva vyasarjayat tārāṃ tasmāai aṅgirase tadā || 20 ||
uśanā tasya jagrāha pārṣṇim aṅgirasas tadā |
rudraś ca pārṣṇiṃ jagrāha gṛhītvājagavaṃ dhanuḥ || 21 ||
uddiśya devān utsṛṣṭaṃ yenaiṣāṃ nāśitaṃ yaśaḥ || 22 ||
tatra tad yuddham abhavat prakhyātaṃ tārakāmayam |
tatra śiṣṭās tu ye devās tuṣitāś caiva ye dvijāḥ |
tadā nivāryośanasaṃ taṃ vai rudraṃ ca śaṅkaram |
dadāv aṅgirase tārāṃ svayam eva pitāmahaḥ || 25 ||
tām antaḥprasavāṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddhaḥ prāha bṛhaspatiḥ |
madīyāyāṃ na te yonau garbho dhāryaḥ kathañcana || 26 ||
iṣīkāstambam āsādya garbhaṃ sā cotsasarja ha |
jātamātraḥ sa bhagavān devānām ākṣipad vapuḥ || 27 ||
tataḥ saṃśayam āpannās tārām ūcuḥ surottamāḥ |
satyaṃ brūhi sutaḥ kasya somasyātha bṛhaspateḥ || 28 ||
pṛcchyamānā yadā devair nāha sā vibudhān kila |
tadā tāṃ śaptum ārabdhaḥ kumāro dasyuhantamaḥ || 29 ||
taṃ nivārya tato brahmā tārāṃ papraccha saṃśayam |
yad atra tathyaṃ tad brūhi tāre kasya sutas tv ayam || 30 ||
uvāca prāñjaliḥ sā taṃ somasyeti pitāmaham |
tadā taṃ mūrdhni cāghrāya somo rājā sutaṃ prati || 31 ||
budha ity akaron nāma tasya bālasya dhīmataḥ |
urvaśyāṃ jajñire yasya putrāḥ sapta mahātmanaḥ |
etat somasya vo janma kīrtitaṃ kīrtivardhanam || 34 ||
Chapter 10: The lunar dynasty: Amāvasu branch
budhasya tu muniśreṣṭhā vidvān putraḥ purūravāḥ |
urvaśī varayām āsa hitvā mānaṃ yaśasvinī || 4 ||
tayā sahāvasad rājā daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca |
ṣaṭ pañca sapta cāṣṭau ca daśa cāṣṭau ca bho dvijāḥ || 5 ||
urvaśyā sahito rājā reme paramayā mudā || 8 ||
rājyaṃ sa kārayām āsa prayāge pṛthivīpatiḥ || 9 ||
viśvāyuś caiva dharmātmā śrutāyuś ca tathāparaḥ |
dṛḍhāyuś ca vanāyuś ca bahvāyuś corvaśīsutāḥ || 12 ||
amāvasos tu dāyādo bhīmo rājātha rājarāṭ |
ājahre yo mahat sattraṃ sarpamedhaṃ mahāmakham |
patilobhena yaṃ gaṅgā patitvena sasāra ha || 15 ||
necchataḥ plāvayām āsa tasya gaṅgā tadā sadaḥ |
sa tayā plāvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ samantataḥ || 16 ||
sauhotrir aśapad gaṅgāṃ kruddho rājā dvijottamāḥ |
eṣa te viphalaṃ yatnaṃ pibann ambhaḥ karomy aham || 17 ||
yuvanāśvasya putrīṃ tu kāverīṃ jahnur āvahat || 19 ||
kāverīṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ jahnor bhāryām aninditām || 20 ||
jahnus tu dayitaṃ putraṃ sunadyaṃ nāma dhārmikam |
kāveryāṃ janayām āsa ajakas tasya cātmajaḥ || 21 ||
kuśikaḥ kuśanābhaś ca kuśāmbo mūrtimāṃs tathā || 23 ||
ballavaiḥ saha saṃvṛddho rājā vanacaraḥ sadā |
kuśikas tu tapas tepe putram indrasamaṃ prabhuḥ || 24 ||
labheyam iti taṃ śakras trāsād abhyetya jajñivān |
pūrṇe varṣasahasre vai tataḥ śakro hy apaśyata || 25 ||
sa gādhir abhavad rājā maghavān kauśikaḥ svayam || 27 ||
paurā yasyābhavad bhāryā gādhis tasyām ajāyata |
gādheḥ kanyā mahābhāgā nāmnā satyavatī śubhā || 28 ||
tāṃ gādhiḥ kāvyaputrāya ṛcīkāya dadau prabhuḥ |
tasyāḥ prītaḥ sa vai bhartā bhārgavo bhṛgunandanaḥ || 29 ||
putrārthaṃ sādhayām āsa caruṃ gādhes tathaiva ca |
uvācāhūya tāṃ bhāryām ṛcīko bhārgavas tadā || 30 ||
upayojyaś carur ayaṃ tvayā mātrā svayaṃ śubhe |
evam uktvā tu tāṃ bhāryām ṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ || 33 ||
tapasy abhirato nityam araṇyaṃ praviveśa ha |
gādhiḥ sadāras tu tadā ṛcīkāśramam abhyagāt || 34 ||
carudvayaṃ gṛhītvā sā ṛṣeḥ satyavatī tadā || 35 ||
carum ādāya yatnena sā tu mātre nyavedayat |
mātā tu tasyā daivena duhitre svaṃ caruṃ dadau || 36 ||
tasyāś carum athājñānād ātmasaṃsthaṃ cakāra ha |
tām ṛcīkas tato dṛṣṭvā yogenābhyupasṛtya ca || 38 ||
viśvaṃ hi brahma tapasā mayā tasmin samarpitam |
evam uktā mahābhāgā bhartrā satyavatī tadā || 41 ||
prasādayām āsa patiṃ putro me nedṛśo bhavet |
brāhmaṇāpasadas tvatta ity ukto munir abravīt || 42 ||
naiṣa saṅkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathāstv iti |
ugrakarmā bhavet putraḥ pitur mātuś ca kāraṇāt || 43 ||
punaḥ satyavatī vākyam evam uktvābravīd idam |
icchaṃl lokān api mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punaḥ sutam || 44 ||
śamātmakam ṛjuṃ tvaṃ me putraṃ dātum ihārhasi |
kāmam evaṃvidhaḥ pautro mama syāt tava ca prabho || 45 ||
yady anyathā na śakyaṃ vai kartum etad dvijottama |
tataḥ prasādam akarot sa tasyās tapaso balāt || 46 ||
putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre vā varavarṇini |
tvayā yathoktaṃ vacanaṃ tathā bhadre bhaviṣyati || 47 ||
tataḥ satyavatī putraṃ janayām āsa bhārgavam |
tasya kanyā mahābhāgā kāmalī nāma reṇukā |
viśvāmitras tu dharmātmā nāmnā viśvarathaḥ smṛtaḥ || 56 ||
prakhyātās triṣu lokeṣu teṣāṃ nāmāny ataḥparam |
devarātaḥ katiś caiva yasmāt kātyāyanāḥ smṛtāḥ || 58 ||
sāṅkṛtir gālavaś caiva mudgalaś caiva viśrutaḥ || 59 ||
madhucchando jayaś caiva devalaś ca tathāṣṭakaḥ |
kacchapo hāritaś caiva viśvāmitrasya te sutāḥ || 60 ||
pāṇino babhravaś caiva dhyānajapyās tathaiva ca || 61 ||
lohitā yamadūtāś ca tathā kārūṣakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 62 ||
bhārgavaḥ kauśikatvaṃ hi prāptaḥ sa munisattamaḥ || 64 ||
devair dattaḥ śunaḥśepho viśvāmitrāya vai punaḥ |
devair dattaḥ sa vai yasmād devarātas tato 'bhavat || 66 ||
aṣṭakasya suto lauhiḥ prokto jahnugaṇo mayā |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vaṃśam āyor mahātmanaḥ || 68 ||
Chapter 11: The lunar dynasty (cont.): Branch of Āyu's younger sons
āyoḥ putrāś ca te pañca sarve vīrā mahārathāḥ |
nahuṣaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe vṛddhaśarmā tataḥ param |
rambho rajir anenāś ca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ || 2 ||
rajiḥ putraśatānīha janayām āsa pañca vai |
āvayor bhagavan yuddhe ko vijetā bhaviṣyati |
brūhi naḥ sarvabhūteśa śrotum icchāma tattvataḥ || 5 ||
yeṣām arthāya saṅgrāme rajir āttāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ |
yotsyate te vijeṣyanti trīṃl lokān nātra saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
yato rajir dhṛtis tatra śrīś ca tatra yato dhṛtiḥ |
yato dhṛtiś ca śrīś caiva dharmas tatra jayas tathā || 7 ||
te devā dānavāḥ prītā devenoktā rajiṃ tadā |
abhyayur jayam icchanto vṛṇvānās taṃ nararṣabham || 8 ||
te hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve rajiṃ vai devadānavāḥ |
athovāca rajis tatra tayor vai devadaityayoḥ |
arthajñaḥ svārtham uddiśya yaśaḥ svaṃ ca prakāśayan || 11 ||
yadi daityagaṇān sarvāñ jitvā vīryeṇa vāsavaḥ |
indro bhavāmi dharmeṇa tato yotsyāmi saṃyuge || 12 ||
evaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ nṛpate kāmaḥ sampadyatāṃ tava || 13 ||
śrutvā suragaṇānāṃ tu vākyaṃ rājā rajis tadā |
pratyūcus taṃ nṛpavaraṃ sābhimānam idaṃ vacaḥ || 15 ||
asmiṃs tu samare rājaṃs tiṣṭha tvaṃ rājasattama || 16 ||
sa tatheti bruvann eva devair apy aticoditaḥ |
bhaviṣyasīndro jitvainaṃ devair uktas tu pārthivaḥ || 17 ||
sa vipranaṣṭāṃ devānāṃ paramaśrīḥ śriyaṃ vaśī || 18 ||
nihatya dānavān sarvān ājahāra rajiḥ prabhuḥ |
tato rajiṃ mahāvīryaṃ devaiḥ saha śatakratuḥ || 19 ||
rajiputro 'ham ity uktvā punar evābravīd vacaḥ |
indro 'si tāta devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 20 ||
yasyāham indraḥ putras te khyātiṃ yāsyāmi karmabhiḥ |
sa tu śakravacaḥ śrutvā vañcitas tena māyayā || 21 ||
tasmiṃs tu devaiḥ sadṛśo divaṃ prāpte mahīpatau || 22 ||
dāyādyam indrād ājahrū rājyaṃ tattanayā rajeḥ |
pañca putraśatāny asya tad vai sthānaṃ śatakratoḥ || 23 ||
te yadā tu svasammūḍhā rāgonmattā vidharmiṇaḥ || 24 ||
tato lebhe svam aiśvaryam indraḥ sthānaṃ tathottamam || 25 ||
ya idaṃ cyāvanaṃ sthānāt pratiṣṭhānaṃ śatakratoḥ |
śṛṇuyād dhārayed vāpi na sa daurgatyam āpnuyāt || 26 ||
rambho 'napatyas tv āsīc ca vaṃśaṃ vakṣyāmy anenasaḥ |
sañjayasya jayaḥ putro vijayas tasya cātmajaḥ || 28 ||
vijayasya kṛtiḥ putras tasya haryatvataḥ sutaḥ |
kāśaḥ śalaś ca dvāv etau tathā gṛtsamadaḥ prabhuḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāś caiva vaiśyāḥ śūdrās tathaiva ca |
kāśasya kāśipo rājā putro dīrghatapās tathā |
dhanus tu dīrghatapaso vidvān dhanvantaris tataḥ || 35 ||
punar dhanvantarir devo mānuṣeṣv iha janmani || 36 ||
tasya gehe samutpanno devo dhanvantaris tadā |
tam aṣṭadhā punar vyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat || 38 ||
dhanvantares tu tanayaḥ ketumān iti viśrutaḥ |
atha ketumataḥ putro vīro bhīmarathaḥ smṛtaḥ || 39 ||
etasminn eva kāle tu purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ dvijāḥ |
śūnyāṃ niveśayām āsa kṣemako nāma rākṣasaḥ || 41 ||
śaptā hi sā matimatā nikumbhena mahātmanā |
śūnyā varṣasahasraṃ vai bhavitrī tu na saṃśayaḥ || 42 ||
bhadraśreṇyasya pūrvaṃ tu purī vārāṇasī abhūt |
bhadraśreṇyasya tad rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ yena balīyasā || 45 ||
bhadraśreṇyasya putras tu durdamo nāma viśrutaḥ |
haihayasya tu dāyādyaṃ hṛtavān vai mahīpatiḥ |
tena bālena putreṇa prahṛtaṃ tu punar balam || 49 ||
vatsaputro hy alarkas tu sannatis tasya cātmajaḥ || 50 ||
alarkas tasya putras tu brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ |
alarkaṃ prati rājarṣiṃ śloko gītaḥ purātanaiḥ || 51 ||
yuvā rūpeṇa sampannaḥ prāg āsīc ca kulodvahaḥ || 52 ||
ramyāṃ niveśayām āsa purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ punaḥ || 54 ||
sannater api dāyādaḥ sunītho nāma dhārmikaḥ |
sunīthasya tu dāyādaḥ kṣemo nāma mahāyaśāḥ || 55 ||
kṣemasya ketumān putraḥ suketus tasya cātmajaḥ |
suketos tanayaś cāpi dharmaketur iti smṛtaḥ || 56 ||
ānartas tu vibhoḥ putraḥ sukumāraś ca tatsutaḥ |
vatsasya vatsabhūmis tu bhārgabhūmis tu bhārgajaḥ |
ete tv aṅgirasaḥ putrā jātā vaṃśe 'tha bhārgava || 60 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyās trayaḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
ity ete kāśyapāḥ proktā nahuṣasya nibodhata || 61 ||
Chapter 12: The lunar dynasty (cont.): Story of Yayāti
yatir jyeṣṭhas tu teṣāṃ vai yayātis tu tataḥ param || 2 ||
yatis tu mokṣam āsthāya brahmabhūto 'bhavan muniḥ || 3 ||
teṣāṃ yayātiḥ pañcānāṃ vijitya vasudhām imām |
devayānīm uśanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryām avāpa saḥ || 4 ||
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata || 5 ||
druhyaṃ cānuṃ ca puruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī |
tasmai śakro dadau prīto rathaṃ paramabhāsvaram || 6 ||
yuktaṃ manojavaiḥ śubhrair yena kāryaṃ samudvahan || 7 ||
yayātir yudhi durdharṣas tathā devān sadānavān || 8 ||
sarathaḥ kauravāṇāṃ tu sarveṣām abhavat tadā |
jagāma sa ratho nāśaṃ śāpād gargasya dhīmataḥ || 10 ||
gargasya hi sutaṃ bālaṃ sa rājā janamejayaḥ |
kālena hiṃsayām āsa brahmahatyām avāpa saḥ || 11 ||
sa lohagandhī rājarṣiḥ paridhāvann itas tataḥ |
paurajānapadais tyakto na lebhe śarma karhicit || 12 ||
tataḥ sa duḥkhasantapto nālabhat saṃvidaṃ kvacit |
yājayām āsa ca jñānī śaunako janamejayam |
sa lohagandho vyanaśat tasyāvabhṛtham etya ca |
sa ca divyaratho rājño vaśaś cedipates tadā || 15 ||
dattaḥ śakreṇa tuṣṭena lebhe tasmād bṛhadrathaḥ |
tato hatvā jarāsandhaṃ bhīmas taṃ ratham uttamam |
saptadvīpāṃ yayātis tu jitvā pṛthvīṃ sasāgarām |
vibhajya pañcadhā rājyaṃ putrāṇāṃ nāhuṣas tadā || 18 ||
yayātir diśi pūrvasyāṃ yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat |
madhye puruṃ ca rājānam abhyaṣiñcat sa nāhuṣaḥ || 19 ||
tair iyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā || 20 ||
prajās teṣāṃ purastāt tu vakṣyāmi munisattamāḥ || 21 ||
dhanur nyasya pṛṣatkāṃś ca pañcabhiḥ puruṣarṣabhaiḥ |
jarāvān abhavad rājā bhāram āveśya bandhuṣu || 22 ||
evaṃ vibhajya pṛthivīṃ yayātir yadum abravīt |
jarāṃ me pratigṛhṇīṣva putra kṛtyāntareṇa vai || 24 ||
taruṇas tava rūpeṇa careyaṃ pṛthivīm imām |
jarāṃ tvayi samādhāya taṃ yaduḥ pratyuvāca ha || 25 ||
anapākṛtya tāṃ rājan na grahīṣyāmi te jarām || 26 ||
tasmāj jarāṃ na te rājan grahītum aham utsahe || 27 ||
santi te bahavaḥ putrā mattaḥ priyatarā nṛpa |
pratigrahītuṃ dharmajña putram anyaṃ vṛṇīṣva vai || 28 ||
sa evam ukto yadunā rājā kopasamanvitaḥ |
uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭho yayātir garhayan sutam || 29 ||
ka āśramas tavānyo 'sti ko vā dharmo vidhīyate |
mām anādṛtya durbuddhe yad ahaṃ tava deśikaḥ || 30 ||
evam uktvā yaduṃ viprāḥ śaśāpainaṃ sa manyumān |
arājyā te prajā mūḍha bhavitrīti na saṃśayaḥ || 31 ||
druhyaṃ ca turvasuṃ caivāpy anuṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ |
evam evābravīd rājā pratyākhyātaś ca tair api || 32 ||
evaṃ śaptvā sutān sarvāṃś caturaḥ purupūrvajān |
tad eva vacanaṃ rājā purum apy āha bho dvijāḥ || 34 ||
taruṇas tava rūpeṇa careyaṃ pṛthivīm imām |
jarāṃ tvayi samādhāya tvaṃ puro yadi manyase || 35 ||
sa jarāṃ pratijagrāha pituḥ puruḥ pratāpavān |
yayātir api rūpeṇa puroḥ paryacaran mahīm || 36 ||
viśvācyā sahito reme vane caitrarathe prabhuḥ || 37 ||
yadā ca tṛptaḥ kāmeṣu bhogeṣu ca narādhipaḥ |
tadā puroḥ sakāśād vai svāṃ jarāṃ pratyapadyata || 38 ||
yatra gāthā muniśreṣṭhā gītāḥ kila yayātinā |
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati |
yat pṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ |
nālam ekasya tat sarvam iti kṛtvā na muhyati || 41 ||
yadā bhāvaṃ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam |
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā || 42 ||
yadā tebhyo na bibheti yadā cāsmān na bibhyati |
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā || 43 ||
yā dustyajā durmatibhir yā na jīryati jīryataḥ |
yo 'sau prāṇāntiko rogas tāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham || 44 ||
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ |
dhanāśā jīvitāśā ca jīryato 'pi na jīryati || 45 ||
yac ca kāmasukhaṃ loke yac ca divyaṃ mahat sukham |
evam uktvā sa rājarṣiḥ sadāraḥ prāviśad vanam |
kālena mahatā cāyaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 47 ||
anaśnan deham utsṛjya sadāraḥ svargam āptavān || 48 ||
yair vyāptā pṛthivī sarvā sūryasyeva gabhastibhiḥ || 49 ||
yados tu vaṃśaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ rājasatkṛtam |
susthaḥ prajāvān āyuṣmān kīrtimāṃś ca bhaven naraḥ |
Chapter 13: The lunar dynasty (cont.): The branches of Yayāti's sons
puror vaṃśaṃ vayaṃ sūta śrotum icchāma tattvataḥ |
druhyasyānor yadoś caiva turvasoś ca pṛthak pṛthak || 1 ||
puroḥ putraḥ suvīro 'bhūn manasyus tasya cātmajaḥ |
rājā cābhayado nāma manasyor abhavat sutaḥ || 3 ||
sudhanvanaḥ subāhuś ca raudrāśvas tasya cātmajaḥ || 4 ||
ṛceyuś ca jaleyuś ca sthaleyuś ca mahābalaḥ |
dhaneyuś ca vaneyuś ca putrakāś ca daśa striyaḥ || 6 ||
bhadrā śūdrā ca madrā ca śaladā maladā tathā |
khaladā ca tato viprā naladā surasāpi ca || 7 ||
tathā gocapalā ca strīratnakūṭā ca tā daśa |
ṛṣir jāto 'trivaṃśe ca tāsāṃ bhartā prabhākaraḥ || 8 ||
bhadrāyāṃ janayām āsa sutaṃ somaṃ yaśasvinam |
svarbhānunā hate sūrye patamāne divo mahīm || 9 ||
tamobhibhūte loke ca prabhā yena pravartitā |
svasti te 'stv iti coktvā vai patamāno divākaraḥ || 10 ||
vacanāt tasya viprarṣer na papāta divo mahīm |
yajñeṣv atrer balaṃ caiva devair yasya pratiṣṭhitam |
sa tāsu janayām āsa putrikāsv ātmakāmajān || 12 ||
daśa putrān mahāsattvāṃs tapasy ugre ratāṃs tathā |
te tu gotrakarā viprā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ || 13 ||
kakṣeyos tanayās tv āsaṃs traya eva mahārathāḥ || 14 ||
sabhānaraś cākṣuṣaś ca paramanyus tathaiva ca |
sabhānarasya putras tu vidvān kālānalo nṛpaḥ || 15 ||
kālānalasya dharmajñaḥ sṛñjayo nāma vai sutaḥ |
mahāmanās tu putrau dvau janayām āsa bho dvijāḥ || 19 ||
uśīnaraṃ ca dharmajñaṃ titikṣuṃ ca mahābalam |
nṛgā kṛmir navā darvā pañcamī ca dṛṣadvatī |
uśīnarasya putrās tu pañca tāsu kulodvahāḥ || 21 ||
tapasā caiva mahatā jātā vṛddhasya cātmajāḥ |
nṛgāyās tu nṛgaḥ putraḥ kṛmyāṃ kṛmir ajāyata || 22 ||
navāyās tu navaḥ putro darvāyāḥ suvrato 'bhavat |
dṛṣadvatyās tu sañjajñe śibir auśīnaro nṛpaḥ || 23 ||
śibes tu śibayo viprā yaudheyās tu nṛgasya ha |
navasya navarāṣṭraṃ tu kṛmes tu kṛmilā purī || 24 ||
śibes tu śibayaḥ putrāś catvāro lokaviśrutāḥ || 25 ||
vṛṣadarbhaḥ suvīraś ca kekayo madrakas tathā |
teṣāṃ janapadāḥ sphītā kekayā madrakās tathā || 26 ||
vṛṣadarbhāḥ suvīrāś ca titikṣos tu prajās tv imāḥ |
titikṣur abhavad rājā pūrvasyāṃ diśi bho dvijāḥ || 27 ||
phenasya sutapā jajñe tataḥ sutapaso baliḥ || 28 ||
jāto mānuṣayonau tu sa rājā kāñcaneṣudhiḥ |
mahāyogī sa tu balir babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā || 29 ||
putrān utpādayām āsa pañca vaṃśakarān bhuvi |
aṅgaḥ prathamato jajñe vaṅgaḥ suhmas tathaiva ca || 30 ||
puṇḍraḥ kaliṅgaś ca tathā bāleyaṃ kṣatram ucyate |
bāleyā brāhmaṇāś caiva tasya vaṃśakarā bhuvi || 31 ||
baleś ca brahmaṇā datto varaḥ prītena bho dvijāḥ |
saṅgrāme cāpy ajeyatvaṃ dharme caiva pradhānatām || 33 ||
caturo niyatān varṇāṃs tvaṃ ca sthāpayiteti ca || 34 ||
ity ukto vibhunā rājā baliḥ śāntiṃ parāṃ yayau |
kālena mahatā viprāḥ svaṃ ca sthānam upāgamat || 35 ||
teṣāṃ janapadāḥ pañca aṅgā vaṅgāḥ sasuhmakāḥ |
kaliṅgāḥ puṇḍrakāś caiva prajās tv aṅgasya sāmpratam || 36 ||
vidvān dharmaratho nāma tasya citrarathaḥ sutaḥ || 38 ||
yajatā saha śakreṇa somaḥ pīto mahātmanā || 39 ||
lomapāda iti khyāto yasya śāntā sutābhavat || 40 ||
caturaṅgasya putras tu pṛthulākṣa iti smṛtaḥ |
campasya tu purī campā yā māliny abhavat purā |
avatārayām āsa mahīṃ mantrair vāhanam uttamam || 44 ||
haryaṅgasya sutas tatra rājā bhadrarathaḥ smṛtaḥ |
bṛhaddarbhaḥ sutas tasya yasmāj jajñe bṛhanmanāḥ |
bṛhanmanās tu rājendro janayām āsa vai sutam || 46 ||
nāmnā jayadrathaṃ nāma yasmād dṛḍharatho nṛpaḥ |
dāyādas tasya vaikarṇo vikarṇas tasya cātmajaḥ |
tasya putraśataṃ tv āsīd aṅgānāṃ kulavardhanam || 48 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ rājñas tu bho dvijāḥ || 50 ||
ilā nāma tu yasyāsīt kanyā vai munisattamāḥ |
brahmavādiny adhistrī sā taṃsus tām abhyagacchata || 53 ||
duṣyantam atha suṣmantaṃ pravīram anaghaṃ tathā || 55 ||
duṣyantasya tu dāyādo bharato nāma vīryavān |
śakuntalāyāṃ bharato yasya nāmnā tu bhāratāḥ || 57 ||
mātṝṇāṃ tu prakopeṇa mayā tat kathitaṃ purā || 58 ||
pūrvaṃ tu vitathe tasya kṛte vai putrajanmani |
tato 'tha vitathe jāte bharatas tu divaṃ yayau |
sa cāpi vitathaḥ putrāñ janayām āsa pañca vai |
suhotraṃ ca suhotāraṃ gayaṃ gargaṃ tathaiva ca || 62 ||
kāśikaṃ ca mahāsatyaṃ tathā gṛtsamatiṃ nṛpam || 63 ||
tathā gṛtsamateḥ putrā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥ |
kāśikasya tu kāśeyaḥ putro dīrghatapās tathā || 64 ||
dhanvantares tu tanayaḥ ketumān iti viśrutaḥ || 65 ||
tathā ketumataḥ putro vidvān bhīmarathaḥ smṛtaḥ |
divodāsasya putras tu vīro rājā pratardanaḥ || 67 ||
pratardanasya putrau dvau vatso bhārgava eva ca |
alarko rājaputras tu rājā sanmatimān bhuvi || 68 ||
haihayasya tu dāyādyaṃ hṛtavān vai mahīpatiḥ |
aṣṭāratho nāma nṛpaḥ suto bhīmarathasya vai |
tena putreṇa bālasya prahṛtaṃ tasya bho dvijāḥ || 71 ||
ramyāṃ niveśayām āsa purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ nṛpaḥ |
alarkasya tu dāyādaḥ kṣemako nāma pārthivaḥ || 75 ||
kṣemakasya tu putro vai varṣaketus tato 'bhavat |
varṣaketoś ca dāyādo vibhur nāma prajeśvaraḥ || 76 ||
ānartas tu vibhoḥ putraḥ sukumāras tato 'bhavat |
vatsasya vatsabhūmis tu bhargabhūmis tu bhārgavāt || 78 ||
ete tv aṅgirasaḥ putrā jātā vaṃśe 'tha bhārgave |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś ca munisattamāḥ || 79 ||
suhotrasya bṛhat putro bṛhatas tanayās trayaḥ || 80 ||
ajamīḍho dvimīḍhaś ca purumīḍhaś ca vīryavān |
ajamīḍhasya patnyas tu tisro vai yaśasānvitāḥ || 81 ||
nīlī ca keśinī caiva dhūminī ca varāṅganāḥ |
patilobhena yaṃ gaṅgā vinīteva sasāra ha || 83 ||
necchataḥ plāvayām āsa tasya gaṅgā ca tat sadaḥ |
tat tayā plāvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ samantataḥ || 84 ||
jahnur apy abravīd gaṅgāṃ kruddho viprās tadā nṛpaḥ |
eṣa te triṣu lokeṣu saṅkṣipyāpaḥ pibāmy aham |
tataḥ pītāṃ mahātmāno dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāṃ maharṣayaḥ |
yuvanāśvasya putrīṃ tu kāverīṃ jahnur āvahat |
jahnos tu dayitaḥ putro ajako nāma vīryavān |
pahnavaiḥ saha saṃvṛddho rājā vanacaraiḥ saha || 89 ||
kuśikas tu tapas tepe putram indrasamaṃ vibhum |
labheyam iti taṃ śakras trāsād abhyetya jajñivān || 90 ||
sa gādhir abhavad rājā maghavā kauśikaḥ svayam |
aṣṭakasya suto lauhiḥ prokto jahnugaṇo mayā |
ajamīḍhāt tu nīlyāṃ vai suśāntir udapadyata |
mudgalaḥ sṛñjayaś caiva rājā bṛhadiṣus tadā || 94 ||
yavīnaraś ca vikrāntaḥ kṛmilāśvaś ca pañcamaḥ |
pañcānāṃ te tu pañcālāḥ sphītā janapadāvṛtāḥ |
alaṃ saṃrakṣaṇe teṣāṃ pañcālā iti viśrutāḥ || 96 ||
indrasenā yato garbhaṃ vadhnyaṃ ca pratyapadyata || 97 ||
ajamīḍhasuto jātaḥ kṣīṇe vaṃśe tu somakaḥ |
somakasya suto jantur yasya putraśataṃ babhau || 100 ||
teṣāṃ yavīyān pṛṣato drupadasya pitā prabhuḥ |
ājamīḍhāḥ smṛtāś caite mahātmānas tu somakāḥ || 101 ||
hutvāgniṃ vidhivat sā tu pavitrā mitabhojanā |
dhūminyā sa tayā devyā tv ajamīḍhaḥ samīyivān |
ṛkṣāt saṃvaraṇo jajñe kuruḥ saṃvaraṇāt tathā |
yaḥ prayāgād atikramya kurukṣetraṃ cakāra ha || 106 ||
puṇyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca puṇyakṛdbhir niṣevitam |
kuroś ca putrāś catvāraḥ sudhanvā sudhanus tathā |
janamejayasya putras tu suratho matimāṃs tathā || 110 ||
surathasya tu vikrāntaḥ putro jajñe vidūrathaḥ |
dvitīyas tu bharadvājān nāmnā tenaiva viśrutaḥ |
dvāv ṛkṣau somavaṃśe 'smin dvāv eva ca parīkṣitau || 112 ||
bhīmasenās trayo viprā dvau cāpi janamejayau |
pratīpo bhīmasenāt tu pratīpasya tu śāntanuḥ |
devāpir bāhlikaś caiva traya eva mahārathāḥ || 114 ||
śāntanos tv abhavad bhīṣmas tasmin vaṃśe dvijottamāḥ |
bāhlikasya tu rājarṣer vaṃśaṃ śṛṇuta bho dvijāḥ || 115 ||
jajñire somadattāt tu bhūrir bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ || 116 ||
upādhyāyas tu devānāṃ devāpir abhavan muniḥ |
śāntanus tv abhavad rājā kauravāṇāṃ dhurandharaḥ |
gāṅgaṃ devavrataṃ nāma putraṃ so 'janayat prabhuḥ |
sa tu bhīṣma iti khyātaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ pitāmahaḥ || 119 ||
kālī vicitravīryaṃ tu janayām āsa bho dvijāḥ |
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ ca viduraṃ cāpy ajījanat || 121 ||
dhṛtarāṣṭras tu gāndhāryāṃ putrān utpādayac chatam |
teṣāṃ duryodhanaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarveṣām api sa prabhuḥ || 122 ||
pāṇḍor dhanañjayaḥ putraḥ saubhadras tasya cātmajaḥ |
abhimanyoḥ parīkṣit tu pitā pārīkṣitasya ha || 123 ||
candrāpīḍas tu nṛpatiḥ sūryāpīḍaś ca mokṣavit || 124 ||
jānamejayam ity evaṃ kṣātraṃ bhuvi pariśrutam || 125 ||
teṣāṃ jyeṣṭhas tu tatrāsīt pure vāraṇasāhvaye |
aputraḥ sa tu dharmātmā praviveśa tapovanam || 127 ||
sambhūte sa ca garbhe ca śvetakarṇaḥ prajeśvaraḥ |
sā tu dṛṣṭvā priyaṃ taṃ tu mālinī pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt |
pathi sā suṣuve bālā sukumāraṃ kumārakam |
dayārthaṃ tasya meghās tu prādurāsan mahātmanaḥ |
śraviṣṭhāyās tu putrau dvau paippalādiś ca kauśikaḥ || 133 ||
dṛṣṭvā kṛpānvitau gṛhya tau prākṣālayatāṃ jale |
nighṛṣṭau tasya pārśvau tu śilāyāṃ rudhiraplutau || 134 ||
athājapārśva iti vai cakrāte nāma tasya tau |
remakasya tu bhāryā tam udvahat putrakāraṇāt |
rematyāḥ sa tu putro 'bhūd brāhmaṇau sacivau tu tau || 137 ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca yugapattulyajīvinaḥ |
sa eṣa pauravo vaṃśaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām || 138 ||
eṣa vaḥ pauravo vaṃśo vikhyātaḥ kathito mayā |
turvasos tu pravakṣyāmi druhyoś cānor yados tathā || 141 ||
turvasos tu suto vahnir gobhānus tasya cātmajaḥ |
gobhānos tu suto rājā aiśānur aparājitaḥ || 142 ||
karandhamas tu aiśānor maruttas tasya cātmajaḥ |
anyas tv āvikṣito rājā maruttaḥ kathito mayā || 143 ||
dakṣiṇārthaṃ tu sā dattā saṃvartāya mahātmane |
duṣyantaṃ pauravaṃ cāpi lebhe putram akalmaṣam || 145 ||
pāṇḍyaś ca keralaś caiva kālaś colaś ca pārthivaḥ |
druhyoś ca tanayo rājan babhrusetuś ca pārthivaḥ || 148 ||
yuddhaṃ sumahad apy āsīn māsān paricarad daśa |
khyāyate yasya nāmnā vai gāndhāraviṣayo mahān |
anos tu putro dharmo 'bhūd dyūtas tasyātmajo 'bhavat |
dyūtād vanaduho jajñe pracetās tasya cātmajaḥ || 152 ||
pracetasaḥ sucetās tu kīrtitās tv anavo mayā |
babhūvus tu yadoḥ putrāḥ pañca devasutopamāḥ || 153 ||
sahasrādaḥ payodaś ca kroṣṭā nīlo 'ñjikas tathā |
haihayaś ca hayaś caiva rājā veṇuhayas tathā |
dharmanetrasya kārtas tu sāhañjas tasya cātmajaḥ |
sāhañjanī nāma purī tena rājñā niveśitā || 156 ||
durdamasya suto dhīmān kanako nāma nāmataḥ |
kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtaujāś ca kṛtadhanvā tathaiva ca |
sa hi varṣāyutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram |
tasmai datto varān prādāc caturo bhūritejasaḥ |
pūrvaṃ bāhusahasraṃ tu prārthitaṃ sumahad varam || 162 ||
saṅgrāmān subahūñ jitvā hatvā cārīn sahasraśaḥ |
tasya bāhusahasraṃ tu yudhyataḥ kila bho dvijāḥ |
tena saptasu dvīpeṣu sapta yajñaśatāni ca |
yasya yajñe jagau gāthāṃ gandharvo nāradas tathā |
na nūnaṃ kārtavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti pārthivāḥ |
yajñair dānais tapobhiś ca vikrameṇa śrutena ca || 171 ||
sa hi saptasu dvīpeṣu carmī khaḍgī śarāsanī |
rathī dvīpān anucaran yogī sandṛśyate nṛbhiḥ || 172 ||
anaṣṭadravyatā caiva na śoko na ca vibhramaḥ |
sa sarvaratnabhāk samrāṭ cakravartī babhūva ha |
sa eva paśupālo 'bhūt kṣetrapālaḥ sa eva ca || 174 ||
sa hi nāgān manuṣyeṣu māhiṣmatyāṃ mahādyutiḥ || 176 ||
krīḍann iva bhujodbhinnaṃ pratisrotaś cakāra ha |
prāvartayat tadā rājā sahasreṇa ca bāhunā || 181 ||
sa vai baddhvā dhanur jyābhir utsiktaṃ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 184 ||
laṅkeśaṃ mohayitvā tu sabalaṃ rāvaṇaṃ balāt |
nirjitya vaśam ānīya māhiṣmatyāṃ babandha tam || 185 ||
śrutvā tu baddhaṃ paulastyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tv arjunena ca |
tato gatvā pulastyas tam arjunaṃ dadṛśe svayam || 186 ||
yugānte toyadasyeva sphuṭato hy aśaner iva |
aho bata mṛdhe vīryaṃ bhārgavasya yad acchinat || 188 ||
sa bhikṣām adadād vīraḥ sapta dvīpān vibhāvasoḥ |
purāṇi grāmaghoṣāṃś ca viṣayāṃś caiva sarvaśaḥ || 190 ||
dadāha kārtavīryasya śailāṃś caiṣa vanāni ca |
sa śūnyam āśramaṃ ramyaṃ varuṇasyātmajasya vai || 192 ||
yaṃ lebhe varuṇaḥ putraṃ purā bhāsvantam uttamam || 193 ||
vasiṣṭhaṃ nāma sa muniḥ khyāta āpava ity uta |
yatrāpavas tu taṃ krodhāc chaptavān arjunaṃ vibhuḥ || 194 ||
yasmān na varjitam idaṃ vanaṃ te mama haihaya |
tasmāt te duṣkaraṃ karma kṛtam anyo haniṣyati || 195 ||
chittvā bāhusahasraṃ te pramathya tarasā balī || 196 ||
tapasvī brāhmaṇas tvāṃ tu haniṣyati sa bhārgavaḥ |
prāptas tato 'sya mṛtyur vai tasya śāpān mahāmuneḥ || 198 ||
varas tathaiva bho viprāḥ svayam eva vṛtaḥ purā |
tasya putraśataṃ tv āsīt pañca śeṣā mahātmanaḥ || 199 ||
śūrasenaś ca śūraś ca vṛṣaṇo madhupadhvajaḥ || 200 ||
jayadhvajaś ca nāmnāsīd āvantyo nṛpatir mahān |
tasya putraśataṃ khyātās tālajaṅghā iti smṛtāḥ || 202 ||
vītihotrāḥ sujātāś ca bhojāś cāvantayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 203 ||
tauṇḍikerāś ca vikhyātās tālajaṅghās tathaiva ca |
bharatāś ca sujātāś ca bahutvān nānukīrtitāḥ || 204 ||
vṛṣo vaṃśadharas tatra tasya putro 'bhavan madhuḥ || 205 ||

sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ sarvam utpannaṃ vividhaṃ jagat |

idānīṃ śrotum icchāmaḥ sakalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ |
vaktum arhasi sarvajña paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 7 ||

saṃsthānam asya jagato yathāvad vaktum arhasi || 9 ||
munayaḥ śrūyatām etat saṅkṣepād vadato mama |

ete dvīpāḥ samudrais tu sapta saptabhir āvṛtāḥ |
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhas tasya dakṣiṇe |

sarit pravartate sā ca pīyate tannivāsibhiḥ || 26 ||

bhadrāśvaṃ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaṃ ca paścime |

vaibhrājaṃ paścime tadvad uttare nandanaṃ smṛtam || 30 ||
śāntavāṃś cakrakuñjaś ca kurarī mālyavāṃs tathā |
trikūṭaḥ śiśiraś caiva pataṅgo rucakas tathā |
meror anantarās te ca jaṭharādiṣv avasthitāḥ |
meror upari viprendrā brahmaṇaḥ kathitā divi |
tasyāṃ samantataś cāṣṭau diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 37 ||
samantād brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ gaṅgā patati vai divi |
sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā pratyapadyata || 39 ||
sītā cālakanandā ca cakṣur badhrā ca vai kramāt |

dīrghikābhis taḍāgaiś ca puṣkariṇībhiś ca vāpibhiḥ |
