kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavair haṃsaiḥ kūrmair matsyaiś ca madgubhiḥ |
etaiś cānyaiś ca kūjadbhiḥ samantāj jalacāribhiḥ |
khagair jalacaraiś cānyaiḥ kusumaiś ca jalodbhavaiḥ || 31 ||
tāvat kṛṣṇaprasādena deśaḥ puṇyatamo hi saḥ |
yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā deśe sa puruṣottamaḥ || 36 ||
ahaṃ rudraś ca śakraś ca devāś cāgnipurogamāḥ || 37 ||
nivasāmo muniśreṣṭhās tasmin deśe sadā vayam |
sāṅgāś ca caturo vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 40 ||
nadyaś ca vividhāḥ puṇyās tīrthāny āyatanāni ca || 41 ||
sāgarāś ca tathā śailās tasmin deśe vyavasthitāḥ |
śreṣṭhatvaṃ kasya deśasya kiṃ cānyad adhikaṃ tataḥ || 43 ||
āste yatra svayaṃ devo muktidaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
dhanyās te vibudhaprakhyā ye vasanty utkale narāḥ || 44 ||
svarge vasanti te martyā na te yānti yamālaye || 45 ||
ye vasanty utkale kṣetre puṇye śrīpuruṣottame |
babhūva nṛpatiḥ śrīmān indradyumna iti śrutaḥ || 1 ||
rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro dātā bhoktā priyaṃvadaḥ || 2 ||
dhanurvede ca vede ca śāstre ca nipuṇaḥ kṛtī || 3 ||
evaṃ sa pālayan pṛthvīṃ rājā sarvaguṇākaraḥ |
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā harer ārādhanaṃ prati || 6 ||
evaṃ cintāparaḥ so 'tha nirīkṣya manasā mahīm |
ālokya sarvatīrthāni kṣetrāṇy atha purāṇy api || 8 ||
tatra saṅkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ sthāpya vīryavān || 11 ||
pañcatīrthaṃ ca vidhivat kṛtvā tatra mahīpatiḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ devatāprekṣaṇaṃ tathā || 12 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ |
sāgare cendradyumnākhye snātvā mokṣaṃ labhed dhruvam || 14 ||
kasmāt sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvam indradyumno jagatpatiḥ |
gatvā tatra suraśreṣṭha kathaṃ sa nṛpasattamaḥ |
kathaṃ sa kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca prajāpate |
vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa caritaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ || 20 ||
na tṛptim adhigacchāmas tava vākyāmṛtena vai |
śrotum icchāmahe brahman paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 21 ||
sādhu sādhu dvijaśreṣṭhā yat pṛcchadhvaṃ purātanam |
vakṣyāmi tasya caritaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ kṛte yuge |
avantī nāma nagarī mālave bhuvi viśrutā |
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś caiva dvijātibhiḥ || 30 ||
na tatra malināḥ santi na mūrkhā nāpi nirdhanāḥ || 31 ||
na rogiṇo na hīnāṅgā na dyūtavyasanānvitāḥ |
sadā hṛṣṭāḥ sumanaso dṛśyante puruṣāḥ striyaḥ || 32 ||
krīḍanti sma divā rātrau hṛṣṭās tatra pṛthak pṛthak |
anyāś ca tatra dṛśyante guṇācāryāḥ kulastriyaḥ |
pativratāś ca subhagā guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṅkṛtāḥ || 44 ||
vanaiś copavanaiḥ puṇyair udyānaiś ca manoramaiḥ |
śālais tālais tamālaiś ca bakulair nāgakesaraiḥ |
anyaiś ca vividhaiḥ puṣpavṛkṣaiś cānyair manoharaiḥ || 54 ||
kalaviṅkair mayūraiś ca śukaiḥ kokilakais tathā |
kapotaiḥ khañjarīṭaiś ca śyenaiḥ pārāvatais tathā || 57 ||
saritaḥ puṣkariṇyaś ca sarāṃsi subahūni ca || 58 ||
padmaiḥ sitetaraiḥ śubhraiḥ kahlāraiś ca sugandhibhiḥ || 59 ||
sārasaiś ca balākaiś ca kūrmair matsyaiḥ sanakrakaiḥ || 61 ||
jalapādaiḥ kadambaiś ca plavaiś ca jalakukkuṭaiḥ |
evaṃ nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpair vividhaiś ca jalāśayaiḥ || 63 ||
vividhaiḥ pādapaiḥ puṇyair udyānair vividhais tathā |
devān pitṝn ṛṣīṃś caiva santarpya vidhivad budhaḥ |
gatvā śivālayaṃ paścāt kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam || 67 ||
snānaiḥ puṣpais tathā gandhair dhūpair dīpaiś ca bhaktitaḥ || 68 ||
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca nṛtyaiḥ stotraiś ca śaṅkaram || 69 ||
sampūjya vidhivad bhaktyā mahākālaṃ sakṛc chivam |
āruhya tridivaṃ yāti yatra śambhor niketanam || 71 ||
bhuṅkte tatra varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasamplavam || 72 ||
yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt || 74 ||
āste tatra nadī puṇyā śiprā nāmeti viśrutā |
tasyāṃ snātas tu vidhivat santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || 75 ||
bhuṅkte ca vividhān kāmān nirātaṅko gatajvaraḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt |
dṛṣṭvā naro vā nārī vā phalaṃ pūrvoditaṃ labhet |
dṛṣṭvā tān vidhivad bhaktyā sampūjya praṇipatya ca || 84 ||
evaṃ sā nagarī ramyā rājasiṃhena pālitā || 85 ||
evaṃ mayā guṇāḍhyā sā taduyinī?? samudāhṛtā |
Chapter 44: Story of Indradyumna (cont.): The journey to the southern ocean
tasyāṃ sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ kurvan rājyam anuttamam |
pālayām āsa matimān prajāḥ putrān ivaurasān || 1 ||
āditya iva tejobhī rūpair āśvinayor iva || 3 ||
dānair yajñais tapobhiś ca tattulyo nāsti bhūpatiḥ || 5 ||
ratnānāṃ dhanadhānyānām antas tasya na vidyate || 7 ||
evaṃ sarvadhanair yukto guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṅkṛtaḥ |
vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi vidyāsthānāni yāni ca || 11 ||
svapurāt sa tu niṣkrānta ujjayinyāḥ prajāpatiḥ |
anujagmus tu taṃ sarve rathinaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
aśvaiḥ pavanasaṅkāśair anujagmus tu taṃ nṛpam || 18 ||
anujagmuś ca taṃ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā anujagmuś ca taṃ nṛpam || 27 ||
dhanai ratnaiḥ suvarṇaiś ca sadārāḥ saparicchadāḥ || 28 ||
tathā javasahārāś ca rajakāś ca sahasraśaḥ || 31 ||
vyokārās tāmrakārāś ca kāṃsyakārāś ca rūṭhakāḥ |
mallā dūtāś ca kāyasthā ye cānye karmakāriṇaḥ || 37 ||
gajavaidyāś ca vaidyāś ca naravaidyāś ca ye narāḥ |
vṛkṣavaidyāś ca govaidyā ye cānye chedadāhakāḥ || 39 ||
ete nāgarakāḥ sarve ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ |
anuyānti yathā putrās tathā taṃ te 'pi nāgarāḥ || 41 ||
evaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvair mahājanaiḥ |
evaṃ gatvā sa nṛpatir dakṣiṇasyodadhes taṭam |
sarvais tair dīrghakālena balair anugataḥ prabhuḥ || 43 ||
dadarśa sāgaraṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyantam iva ca sthitam |
matsyaiḥ kūrmaiś ca śaṅkhaiś ca śuktikānakraśaṅkubhiḥ |
śiṃśumāraiḥ karkaṭaiś ca vṛtaṃ sarpair mahāviṣaiḥ || 47 ||
tīrthānām uttamaṃ tīrtham avyayaṃ yādasāṃ patim |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭho vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 53 ||
nivāsam akarot tatra velām asādya sāgarīm |
vṛtaṃ śālaiḥ kadambaiś ca punnāgaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ |
dāḍimaiś ca tamālaiś ca pārijātais tathārjunaiḥ || 57 ||
Chapter 45: Story of Indradyumna (cont.): The disappearance of Nīlamādhava
kiṃ tatra pratimā pūrvaṃ na sthitā vaiṣṇavī prabho || 1 ||
sthāpayām āsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ śubhapradām || 2 ||
saṃśayo no mahān atra vismayaś ca jagatpate |
śrotum icchāmahe sarvaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ ca naḥ || 3 ||
pravakṣyāmi samāsena śriyā pṛṣṭaḥ purā hariḥ || 4 ||
anyaiś ca bahubhir vṛkṣaiḥ śālatālādibhir vanaiḥ |
anyaiś ca kāñcanaiś caiva phalabhāraiś ca nāmitaiḥ |
anyaiś ca vividhaiḥ puṣpair manasaḥ prītidāyakaiḥ |
evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpair nānāvidhais tathā || 15 ||
brūhi tvaṃ sarvalokeśa saṃśayaṃ me hṛdi sthitam |
na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
na vijñāto 'maraiḥ sarvair na daityair na ca dānavaiḥ |
tat te 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi tīrtharājaṃ ca sāmpratam |
tamobhūtam idaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana |
tataḥ prajāpatir brahmā cakre sarvaṃ carācaram |
brahma kṣatraṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva catuṣṭayam |
antyajātāṃś ca mlecchāṃś ca sasarja vividhān pṛthak || 35 ||
brahmā bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ nirmame sa carācaram || 36 ||
vāme caiva tu nārīṃ sa dvidhā bhūtam akalpayat || 37 ||
adhamottamamadhyāś ca mama kṣetrāṇi yāni ca || 38 ||
apaśyat sahasā taṃ tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
āsanair arghyapādyaiś ca akṣatair abhinandya ca || 42 ||
kāraṇaṃ vada māṃ tāta mama dhyānasya sāmpratam || 43 ||
yogaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ śraddhā tīrthāni vividhāni ca |
vihāya sarvam eteṣāṃ sukhaṃ tatsādhanaṃ vada || 45 ||
sthānaṃ jagatpate mahyām utkṛṣṭaṃ ca yad ucyate |
sarveṣām uttamaṃ sthānaṃ brūhi me puruṣottama || 46 ||
vidhātur vacanaṃ śrutvā tato 'haṃ proktavān priye |
śṛṇu brahman pravakṣyāmi nirmalaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 47 ||
mahāpuṇyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ siddhidaṃ vai pitāmahe || 49 ||
uttamaḥ puruṣo yasmāt tasmāt sa puruṣottamaḥ || 52 ||
vināśaṃ naivam abhyeti svayaṃ tatraivam āsthitaḥ || 54 ||
dṛṣṭamātre vaṭe tasmiṃś chāyām ākramya cāsakṛt |
brahmahatyāt pramucyeta pāpeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā || 55 ||
pradakṣiṇā kṛtā yais tu namaskāraś ca jantubhiḥ |
prāsādas tatra tiṣṭhet tu padaṃ dharmamayaṃ hi tat || 57 ||
pratimāṃ tatra vai dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ devena nirmitām |
anāyāsena vai yānti bhuvanaṃ me tato narāḥ || 58 ||
gacchamānāṃs tu tān prekṣya ekadā dharmarāṭ priye |
namas te bhagavan deva lokanātha jagatpate |
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ kartāram akṛtaṃ prabhum |
ity evaṃ dharmarājas tu purā nyagrodhasannidhau |
stutvā nānāvidhaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇāmam akarot tadā || 68 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahābhāge praṇataṃ prāñjalisthitam |
stotrasya kāraṇaṃ devi pṛṣṭavān aham antakam || 69 ||
kimarthaṃ stutavān māṃ tvaṃ saṅkṣepāt tad bravīhi me || 70 ||
śvetākhyaṃ bhavanaṃ yānti niṣkāmāś caiva mānavāḥ || 72 ||
ataḥ kartuṃ na śaknomi vyāpāram arisūdana |
śrutvā vaivasvatasyaitad vākyam etad uvāca ha |
tataḥ sā pratimā devi vallibhir gopitā mayā |
yathā tatra na paśyanti manujāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 75 ||
yamaṃ prasthāpayām āsa svāṃ purīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || 76 ||
luptāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ tu indranīlasya bho dvijāḥ |
yo bhūtas tatra vṛttānto devadevo janārdanaḥ |
taṃ sarvaṃ kathayām āsa sa tasyai bhagavān purā || 78 ||
vaṭasya darśanaṃ caiva vyuṣṭiṃ tasya ca bho dvijāḥ |
subhadrāyāś ca tatraiva māhātmyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ |
udadher darśanaṃ caiva snānaṃ tarpaṇam eva ca |
varṇanaṃ viṣṇulokasya kṣetrasya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
pūrvaṃ kathitavān sarvaṃ tasyai sa puruṣottamaḥ || 89 ||
Chapter 46: Story of Indradyumna (cont.): Description of Puruṣottamakṣetra
tasmin kṣetravare gatvā kiṃ cakāra narādhipaḥ || 1 ||
kṣetrasandarśanaṃ caiva kṛtyaṃ tasya ca bhūpateḥ || 2 ||
ubhayos taṭayor yasyā grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca || 6 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrās tatra pṛthak pṛthak |
krīḍantyas tāḥ sadā hṛṣṭā vilāsinyaḥ parasparam || 21 ||
ity evaṃ dadṛśe rājā kṣetraṃ paramaśobhanam |
jagadguruṃ paraṃ devaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ padam |
idaṃ tanmānasaṃ tīrthaṃ jñātaṃ me puruṣottamam |
na cātra dṛśyate cānyā pratimā vaiṣṇavī śubhā || 27 ||
tathā yatnaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā devo jagatpatiḥ |
yajñair dānais tapobhiś ca homair dhyānais tathārcanaiḥ |
upavāsaiś ca vidhivac careyaṃ vratam uttamam || 29 ||

Chapter 47: Story of Indradyumna (cont.): Construction of temple; Indradyumna's
          horse-sacrifice
prāsādārthaṃ hares tatra prārambham akarot tadā || 1 ||
bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya yatnena rājā tu parayā mudā || 2 ||
taiḥ sārdhaṃ sa samālocya sumuhūrte śubhe dine |
dadāv arghyaṃ tato rājā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ || 6 ||
dattvaivam arghyaṃ vidhivad ānāyya sa mahīpatiḥ |
kośalādhipatiṃ caiva tān uvāca tadā nṛpaḥ || 7 ||
saṃvāhyantāṃ ca śakaṭair naukābhir mā vilambatha || 9 ||
evaṃ gantuṃ samādiśya tān nṛpān sa mahīpatiḥ |
gacchantu dūtāḥ sarvatra mamājñāṃ pravadantu vai |
yatra tiṣṭhanti rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tān suśīghragāḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ dūtāḥ samājñātā rājñā tena mahātmanā |
gatvā tadā nṛpān ūcur vacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ || 13 ||
śrutvā tu te tathā sarve dūtānāṃ vacanaṃ nṛpāḥ |
ye nṛpāḥ sarvadigbhāge ye ca dakṣiṇataḥ sthitāḥ |
pārvatīyāś ca ye kecit tathā dvīpanivāsinaḥ || 16 ||
rathair nāgaiḥ padātaiś ca vājibhir dhanavistaraiḥ |
tān āgatān nṛpān dṛṣṭvā sāmātyān sapurohitān |
provāca rājā hṛṣṭātmā kāryam uddiśya sādaram || 18 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ nṛpaśārdūlā yathā kiñcid bravīmy aham |
kathaṃ śaknomy ahaṃ kartum iti cintākulaṃ manaḥ || 20 ||
bhavadbhiḥ susahāyais tu sarvam etat karomy aham |
yadi yūyaṃ sahāyā me bhavadhvaṃ nṛpasattamāḥ || 21 ||
sarve pramuditā hṛṣṭā bhūpās te tasya śāsanāt || 22 ||
gajair aśvair dhanaiś cānyai rathaiś caiva kareṇubhiḥ || 24 ||
anyaiś ca vividhair dhānyair grāmyāraṇyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ |
rājānaḥ pūrayām āsur yat kiñcid dravyasambhavaiḥ |
ṛṣīṃś caiva maharṣīṃś ca devarṣīṃś caiva tāpasān |
snātakān brāhmaṇāṃś cānyān agnihotre sadā sthitān |
dṛṣṭvā tān nṛpatiḥ śrīmān uvāca svaṃ purohitam || 33 ||
ity uktaḥ sa tathā cakre vacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ |
hṛṣṭaḥ sa mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ tadā rājapurohitaḥ || 35 ||
tato yayau purodhāś ca prājñaḥ sthapatibhiḥ saha |
stambhān kanakacitrāṃś ca toraṇāni bṛhanti ca |
kārayām āsa dharmātmā tatra tatra yathāvidhi || 40 ||
kārayām āsa vidhivac chālās tatrāpy anekaśaḥ || 41 ||
ratnāny anekāny ādāya striyaś cāyayur utsave || 42 ||
teṣām abhyāgatānāṃ ca sa rājā munisattamāḥ |
sarvāṃś ca tān anuyayau yāvad āvasathān iti || 47 ||
svayam eva mahātejā dambhaṃ tyaktvā nṛpottamaḥ |
tataḥ kṛtvā svaśilpaṃ ca śilpino 'nye ca ye tadā || 48 ||
kṛtsnaṃ yajñavidhiṃ rājñe tadā tasmai nyavedayan |
tataḥ śrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ sarvam atandritaḥ |
tasmin yajñe pravṛtte tu vāgmino hetuvādibhiḥ |
sthalajā jalajā ye ca paśavaḥ kecana dvijāḥ || 54 ||
sarvān eva samānītān apaśyaṃs tatra te nṛpāḥ |
gāś caiva mahiṣīś caiva tathā vṛddhastriyo 'pi ca || 55 ||
audakāni ca sattvāni śvāpadāni vayāṃsi ca |
parvatāny upadhānyāni bhūtāni dadṛśuś ca te |
yajñavāṭaṃ nṛpā dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ |
pūrṇe śatasahasre tu viprāṇāṃ tatra bhuñjatām |
evaṃ sa vavṛdhe yajñas tasya rājñas tu dhīmataḥ || 60 ||
dadhikulyāś ca dadṛśuḥ payasaś ca hradāṃs tathā || 61 ||
dvijāś ca tatra dṛśyante rājñas tasya mahāmakhe || 62 ||
tatra yāni sahasrāṇi puruṣāṇāṃ tatas tataḥ |
te vai nṛpopabhojyāni brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ saha || 65 ||
pūjāṃ cakre tadā teṣāṃ vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 66 ||
mudaṃ lebhe tadā rājā saṃhṛṣṭo vākyam abravīt || 74 ||
vidvadbhir dharmavidbhiś ca atra homo vidhīyatām |
anaḍvāhaṃ ca gāś caiva sarvāṃś ca paśupālakān |
iṣṭayaś ca pravartantāṃ prāsādaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tataḥ || 77 ||
sarvam etac ca viprebhyo dīyatāṃ manasepsitam |
striyaś ca ratnakoṭyaś ca grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca || 78 ||
samyak samṛddhabhūmyaś ca viṣayāś caivam arthinām |
sarveṣāṃ yācamānānāṃ nāsti hy etan na bhāṣayet |
tāvat pravartatāṃ yajño yāvad devaḥ purā tv iha |
evam uktvā tadā viprā rājasiṃho mahābhujaḥ |
arbudaṃ caiva vṛṣabhaṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīś ca dhenukāḥ || 82 ||
prāyacchat sa tu viprebhyo vedavidbhyo mudā yutaḥ || 83 ||
adadāt sa mahāyajñe ratnāni vividhāni ca || 85 ||
śatāni pañca viprebhyo rājā hṛṣṭaḥ pradattavān |
ekaikaśo 'dadāt tasmin kāmyāś ca kāminīr bahūḥ || 89 ||
annāny anyāni medhyāṃś ca ghṛtapūrāṃś ca khāṇḍavān || 91 ||
madhurāṃs tarjitān pūpān annaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ supākikam |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ yātā dṛṣṭvā kratuvaraṃ śubham || 94 ||
purodhā mantriṇo rājā hṛṣṭās tatraiva sarvaśaḥ |
na tatra malinaḥ kaścin na dīno na kṣudhānvitaḥ || 95 ||
na vopasargo na glānir nādhayo vyādhayas tathā |
nākālamaraṇaṃ tatra na daṃśo na grahā viṣam || 96 ||
ye ca tatra tapaḥsiddhā munayaś cirajīvinaḥ || 97 ||
evaṃ sa rājā vidhivad vājimedhaṃ dvijottamāḥ |

viveśa vadanaṃ tasya vivṛtaṃ cāvaśo muniḥ || 43 ||
dadarśa tān samudrāṃś ca jambu plakṣaṃ ca śālmalam || 2 ||
kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ ca śākaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ ca dadarśa saḥ |
bhāratādīni varṣāṇi tathā sarvāṃś ca parvatān || 3 ||
vyāghraiḥ siṃhair varāhaiś ca cāmarair mahiṣair gajaiḥ |
paryaṭan sa tadā vipras tasya bālasya codare || 8 ||
śvetaṃ ca durdharaṃ nīlaṃ kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ girim || 9 ||
sahyaṃ ca śuktimantaṃ ca mainākaṃ vakraparvatam || 10 ||
etāś cānyāś ca bahavo yāvantaḥ pṛthivīdharāḥ |
tatas tāṃs tu muniśreṣṭhāḥ so 'paśyad ratnabhūṣitān || 11 ||
kurukṣetraṃ ca pāñcālān matsyān madrān sakekayān |
bāhlīkān śūrasenāṃś ca kāśmīrāṃs taṅgaṇān khasān || 12 ||
antyajān antyajātīṃś ca so 'paśyat tasya codare || 13 ||
mṛgāñ śākhāmṛgān siṃhān varāhān sṛmarāñ śaśān |
gajāṃś cānyāṃs tathā sattvān so 'paśyat tasya codare || 14 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca |
śakrādīn vibudhāñ śreṣṭhāṃs tathānyāṃś ca divaukasaḥ |
yat kiñcit tena loke 'smin dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ carācaram |
apaśyat sa tadā sarvaṃ tasya kukṣau dvijottamāḥ || 18 ||
athavā kiṃ bahūktena kīrtitena punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ |
mahar janas tapaḥ satyam atalaṃ vitalaṃ tathā || 20 ||
pātālaṃ sutalaṃ caiva vitalaṃ ca rasātalam |
mahātalaṃ ca brahmāṇḍam apaśyat tasya codare || 21 ||
prasādāt tasya devasya smṛtilopaś ca nābhavat || 22 ||
bhramamāṇas tadā kukṣau kṛtsnaṃ jagad idaṃ dvijāḥ |
nāntaṃ jagāma dehasya tasya viṣṇoḥ kadācana || 23 ||
yadāsau nāgataś cāntaṃ tasya dehasya bho dvijāḥ |
tadā taṃ varadaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatavān muniḥ || 24 ||
mahātmano mukhāt tasya vivṛtāt puruṣasya saḥ || 25 ||
Chapter 55: Mārkaṇḍeya-episode (cont.): Mārkaṇḍeya's hymn to Viṣṇu
pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ ca taṃ devaṃ dadarśa śiśurūpiṇam |

dadarśa taṃ suduṣprekṣaṃ ratnair divyair alaṅkṛtam || 7 ||

prasādāt tasya devasya prādurbhūtā punar navā || 8 ||

vihvalo 'haṃ tathā śrāntas trāhi māṃ puruṣottama || 13 ||

na cāntam adhigacchāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama || 16 ||
tavodare ca deveśa mayā dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram |

tvaṃ mahī tvaṃ jalaṃ deva tvam agnis tvaṃ samīraṇaḥ || 23 ||

tvaṃ buddhiḥ prakṛtiś caiva sattvādyās tvaṃ jagatpate || 24 ||
puruṣas tvaṃ jagadvyāpī puruṣād api cottamaḥ |
tvam indriyāṇi sarvāṇi śabdādyā viṣayāḥ prabho || 25 ||
tvaṃ dikpālāś ca dharmāś ca vedā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ |
tvam indras tvaṃ śivo devas tvaṃ havis tvaṃ hutāśanaḥ || 26 ||
tvaṃ yamaḥ pitṛrāṭ deva tvaṃ rakṣodhipatiḥ svayam |

tvam īśānas tvam anantas tvaṃ gaṇeśaś ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ |

dānavās tvaṃ tathā yakṣās tvaṃ daityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ |

munayas tvam ṛṣigaṇās tvam aśvinau niśācarāḥ || 30 ||
anyāś ca jātayas tvaṃ hi yat kiñcij jīvasañjñitam |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tvaṃ jagat sacarācaram |

ahaṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaḥ pretādhipas tathā || 14 ||
ahaṃ śivaś ca somaś ca kaśyapaś ca prajāpatiḥ |
ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca yajñaś cāhaṃ dvijottama || 15 ||

mām eva satataṃ viprāś cintayanta upāsate |

naras tat phalam āpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca || 48 ||

kiṃ cātra bahunoktena māhātmye tasya bho dvijāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham || 51 ||

tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvad bhuktvā bhogān manoramān |
cyutas tasmād ihāyāto viprāṇāṃ pravare kule |

iha mānuṣatāṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vedavid bhavet |

bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ praṇamya narakesarīm |
mucyate pātakair martyaḥ samastair nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||

yathā kathayase deva tena no vismayo mahān || 8 ||
śrotum icchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 9 ||
bhaktānām upakārāya brūhi deva namo 'stu te || 10 ||
prasādān narasiṃhasya yā bhavanty atra siddhayaḥ |
brūhi tāḥ kuru cāsmākaṃ prasādaṃ prapitāmaha || 11 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ tasya bho viprāḥ prabhāvaṃ gadato mama |
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samastāṃs tasya bho dvijāḥ |
yāḥ kāścit siddhayaś cātra śrūyante daivamānuṣāḥ |

trirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyam abhedyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ |

oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca |
keśavāya namo nityaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca |
oṃ namo viṣṇave nityaṃ devāya vasuretase |
sṛṣṭikartre namas tubhyaṃ goptre dhātre namo namaḥ |

oṃ namo yajuṣāṃ dhātre yajūrūpadharāya ca |
oṃ namaḥ śrīpate deva śrīdharāya varāya ca |
sāmne ca sāmagītāya oṃ namaḥ sāmadhāriṇe |
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya te namaḥ || 56 ||
nārāyaṇa namas tubhyaṃ namo lokahitāya ca |
gatipradāya ca namo namo bandhaharāya ca |
oṃ namo vasukartre ca vasuvāsapradāya ca |
na me 'sti tvām ṛte bandhur narakottāraṇe prabho |
malaṃ yat kāyajaṃ vāpi mānasaṃ caiva keśava |
na tasyānyo 'sti deveśa kṣālakas tvām ṛte 'cyuta || 66 ||
saṅgo me 'stu tvayā sārdham ātmalābhāya keśava || 67 ||

eṣaṇābhir jagat sarvaṃ mohitaṃ māyayā tava |
ākarṣitaṃ ca lobhādyair atas tvām aham āśritaḥ || 69 ||
nāsti kiñcit sukhaṃ viṣṇo saṃsārasthasya dehinaḥ |
yathā yathā hi yajñeśa tvayi cetaḥ pravartate || 70 ||
tathā phalavihīnaṃ tu sukham ātyantikaṃ labhet |
govinda trāhi saṃsārān mām uddhartuṃ tvam arhasi |
uddhartā puṇḍarīkākṣa tvām ṛte 'nyo na vidyate || 72 ||
itthaṃ stutas tatas tena rājñā śvetena bho dvijāḥ |
bhaktiṃ tasya tu sañcintya devadevo jagadguruḥ |
ājagāma nṛpasyāgre sarvair devair vṛto hariḥ || 74 ||
uvāca sādhu bho rājan yasya te matir uttamā |
yad iṣṭaṃ vara bhadraṃ te prasanno 'smi tavānagha || 77 ||
yady ahaṃ bhagavan bhaktaḥ prayaccha varam uttamam |
tat padaṃ gantum icchāmi tvatprasādāj jagatpate || 80 ||
yat padaṃ vibudhāḥ sarve munayaḥ siddhayoginaḥ |
nābhigacchanti yad ramyaṃ paraṃ padam anāmayam || 81 ||
yāsyasi paramaṃ sthānaṃ rājyāmṛtam upāsya ca |
sarvāṃl lokān atikramya mama lokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 82 ||
kīrtis tavātra rājendra trīṃl lokāṃś ca gamiṣyati |
spṛṣṭvā svargaṃ gamiṣyanti madbhaktā ye samāhitāḥ |
yas tv imāṃ pratimāṃ gacchen mādhavākhyāṃ śaśiprabhām || 85 ||
vihāya sarvalokān vai mama loke mahīyate |
bhunakti vipulān bhogān yatheṣṭaṃ māmakaiḥ saha || 88 ||
cyutas tasmād ihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet |
tyaktvā dehaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā tataḥ śāntapadaṃ vrajet || 91 ||

āhvayām āsa tān viprān gautamītīram āśritān || 25 ||

yenākṣṇā hasitā pāpe bhajyatāṃ te 'kṣi pāpavat || 28 ||

Chapter 104: Story of Hariścandra, Rohita, and Śunaḥśepa

dattvā somaṃ tadā somo viṣṇave tan nyavedayat || 29 ||
ciccheda tarasā vatsa tacchiras tv amaraṃ tv abhūt || 30 ||
śiromātravihīnaṃ yad dehaṃ tad apatad bhuvi |
dehaṃ tad amṛtaspṛṣṭaṃ patitaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe || 31 ||
dehaṃ cāpy amaraṃ putra tad adbhutam ivābhavat || 32 ||
dehaṃ ca śiraso 'pekṣi śiro deham apekṣate |
ubhayaṃ cāmaraṃ jātaṃ daityaś cāyaṃ mahābalaḥ || 33 ||
śiraḥ kāye samāviṣṭaṃ sarvān bhakṣayate surān |
tasmād deham idaṃ pūrvaṃ nāśayāmo mahīgatam |
tatas te śaṅkaraṃ prāhur devāḥ sarve sasambhramāḥ || 34 ||
śirasā naiva yujyeta daityadehaṃ tathā kuru || 36 ||
preṣayām āsa ceśo 'pi śreṣṭhāṃ śaktiṃ tadātmanaḥ |
śiromātraṃ surāḥ sarve merau tatraiva sāntvayan |
deho devyā punas tatra yuyudhe bahavaḥ samāḥ || 39 ||
rāhus tatra surān āha bhittvā dehaṃ purā mama |
atrāste rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ tad ākṛṣya śarīrataḥ || 40 ||
bhasmībhūyāt kṣaṇenaiva tasmāt kurvantu tat purā || 41 ||
abhyaṣiñcan grahāṇāṃ tvaṃ graho bhūyā mudānvitaḥ || 42 ||
ākṛṣya śīghram utkṛṣṭaṃ pravaraṃ cāmṛtaṃ bahiḥ |
sthāpayitvā tu tad dehaṃ bhakṣayām āsa cāmbikā || 44 ||
sthāpitaṃ rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ rasānāṃ pravaraṃ rasam || 45 ||
vyasravat sthāpitaṃ tat tu pravarā sābhavan nadī |
ākṛṣṭam amṛtaṃ caiva sthāpitaṃ sāpy abhakṣayat || 46 ||
tataḥ śreṣṭhā nadī jātā pravarā cāmṛtā śubhā |
nadīnāṃ pravarā ramyā cāmṛtā preritā tahā |
tatra pañca sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca || 48 ||
tatra śambhuḥ svayaṃ tasthau sarvadā surapūjitaḥ |
tasyai tuṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve devyai nadyai pṛthak pṛthak || 49 ||
varān dadur mudā yuktā yathā pūjām avāpsyati |
śambhuḥ surapatir loke tathā pūjām avāpsyasi || 50 ||
nivāsaṃ kuru devi tvaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
tvāṃ namasyanti ye bhaktyā kiñcid āpekṣya sarvadā || 52 ||
ato vadanti munayo nivāsapuram ity adaḥ |
pravarāyāḥ purā devāḥ suprītās te varān daduḥ || 54 ||
gaṅgāyāḥ saṅgamo yas te vikhyātaḥ suravallabhaḥ |
tatrāplutānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhuktir vā muktir eva ca || 55 ||
yad vāpi manasaḥ kāmyaṃ devānām api durlabham |
syāt teṣāṃ sarvam eveha evaṃ dattvā surā yayuḥ || 56 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ pravarāsaṅgamaṃ viduḥ |
preritā devadevena śaktir yā preritā tu sā || 57 ||
Chapter 107: Story of Vṛddhagautama and the old maid
gautamo vṛddha ity ukto munir āsīn mahātapāḥ |
yadā purābhavad bālo gautamasya suto dvijaḥ || 2 ||
sa vairāgyāj jagāmātha deśaṃ tīrtham itas tataḥ || 3 ||
śiṣyair anyaiḥ sahādhyāyo lajjitasya ca nābhavat || 4 ||
upanītaḥ kathañcic ca pitrā vai gautamena saḥ |
evaṃ bahutithe kāle brahmamātrā dhṛte dvije |
naiva cādhyayanaṃ tasya sañjātaṃ gautamasya hi || 6 ||
agnikāryaṃ tataś cakre nityam eva yatavrataḥ || 7 ||
na dārasaṅgrahaṃ lebhe naiva dātāsti kanyakām || 10 ||
tathā caraṃs tīrthadeśe vaneṣu vividheṣu ca |
āśrameṣu ca puṇyeṣu aṭann āste sa gautamaḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ bhramañ śītagirim āśrityāste sa gautamaḥ |
cintayaṃs tu praviṣṭo 'sāv apaśyat striyam uttamām || 13 ||
śithilāṅgīm atha kṛśāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca tapasi sthitām |
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśreṣṭho namaskārāya tasthivān |
gurus tvaṃ bhavitā mahyaṃ na māṃ vanditum arhasi |
āyur vidyā dhanaṃ kīrtir dharmaḥ svargādikaṃ ca yat |
tasya naśyati vai sarvaṃ yaṃ namasyati vai guruḥ || 16 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭas tāṃ vai gautamaḥ prāha vismitaḥ || 17 ||
tapasvinī tvaṃ vṛddhā ca guṇajyeṣṭhā ca bhāminī |
alpavidyas tv alpavayā ahaṃ tava guruḥ katham || 18 ||
viśrāmam akarod asyāṃ guhāyāṃ sa ṛtadhvajaḥ || 20 ||
yuvā sa matimān dakṣo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ |
taṃ viśrāntaṃ nṛpavaram apsarā dadṛśe tataḥ || 21 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame rājā rājānaṃ cakame ca sā || 22 ||
iti krīḍā samabhavat tayā rājño mahāmate |
gacchantī māṃ tadā mātā idam āha tapodhana || 24 ||
yas tv asyāṃ praviśed bhadre sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati || 25 ||
ity uktvā sā jagamātha mātā mama mahāmate |
tasmād atra praviṣṭas tvaṃ pumān nānyaḥ kadācana || 26 ||
sahasrāṇi tathāśītiṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ pitā mama |
atraiva ca tapas taptvā tataḥ svargam upeyivān || 27 ||
svargaṃ yāte 'pi pitari sahasrāṇi tathā daśa |
varṣāṇi muniśārdūla rājyaṃ kṛtvā tathā paraḥ || 28 ||
svarge yāto mama bhrātā aham atraiva saṃsthitā |
ahaṃ brahman nānyavṛttā na mātā na pitā mama || 29 ||
tasmād bhajasva māṃ brahman vratasthāṃ puruṣārthinīm || 30 ||
sahasrāyur ahaṃ bhadre mattas tvaṃ vayasādhikā |
ahaṃ bālas tvaṃ tu vṛddhā naivāyaṃ ghaṭate mithaḥ || 31 ||
tvaṃ bhartā me purā diṣṭo nānyo bhartā mato mama |
dhātrā dattas tatas tvaṃ māṃ na nirākartum arhasi || 32 ||
athavā necchasi māṃ tvam apraduṣṭām anuvratām |
tatas tyakṣyāmi jīvaṃ me idānīṃ tava paśyataḥ || 33 ||
vṛddhāyās tad vacaḥ śrutvā gautamo vākyam abravīt || 35 ||
nāhaṃ varo hi yogyas te kurūpo bhogavarjitaḥ || 36 ||
anāso 'haṃ kiṃ karomi atapovidya eva ca |
tasmāt surūpaṃ suvidyām āpādya prathamaṃ śubhe |
paścāt te vacanaṃ kāryaṃ tato vṛddhābravīd dvijam || 37 ||
mayā sarasvatī devī toṣitā tapasā dvija |
tasmād vāgīśvarī devī sā te vidyāṃ pradāsyati |
agniś ca rūpavān devas tava rūpaṃ pradāsyati || 39 ||
evam uktvā gautamaṃ taṃ vṛddhovāca vibhāvasum |
prārthayitvā suvidyaṃ taṃ surūpaṃ cākaron munim || 40 ||
kadācit tatra vasator dampatyor mudator girau |
bhramantaḥ puṇyatīrthāni prāpnuvaṃs tasya tāṃ guhām || 43 ||
āgatāṃs tān ṛṣīñ jñātvā gautamaḥ saha bhāryayā |
satkāram akarot teṣāṃ jahasus taṃ ca kecana || 44 ||
ye bālā yauvanonmattā vayasā ye ca madhyamāḥ |
vṛddhāṃ ca gautamaṃ prekṣya jahasus tatra kecana || 45 ||
putro 'yaṃ tava pautro vā vṛddhe ko gautamo 'bhavat |
satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi ity evaṃ jahasur dvijāḥ || 46 ||
viṣaṃ vṛddhasya yuvatī vṛddhāyā amṛtaṃ yuvā |
ity evam ūcire kecid dampatyoḥ śṛṇvatos tadā |
evam uktvā kṛtātithyā yayuḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 48 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ubhāv api suduḥkhitau |
lajjitau ca mahāprājñau gautamo bhāryayā saha |
ko deśaḥ kim u tīrthaṃ vā yatra śreyaḥ samāpyate |
vadadbhir munibhir brahman mayā śrutam idaṃ vacaḥ |
sarve kāmās tatra pūrṇā gautamyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 51 ||
ahaṃ tvām anuyāsyāmi yathecchasi tathā kuru || 52 ||
tatra tepe tapas tīvraṃ patnyā sa bhagavān ṛṣiḥ || 53 ||
stutiṃ cakāra devasya śambhor viṣṇos tathaiva ca |
gaṅgāṃ ca toṣayām āsa bhāryārthaṃ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ || 54 ||
khinnātmanām atra bhave tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ |
tatas tuṣṭāvadad vākyaṃ gautamaṃ vṛddhayā yutam |
kalaśair upacāraiś ca tataḥ patnī tava priyā || 59 ||
rūpavatyā punas tvaṃ vai bhāryayā cābhiṣecitaḥ |
tatheti gāṅgavacanād yathoktaṃ tau ca cakratuḥ |
surūpatām ubhau prāptau gautamyāś ca prasādataḥ || 62 ||
abhiṣekodakaṃ yac ca sā nadī samajāyata |
tasyā nāmnā tu vikhyātā vṛddhāyā munisattama || 63 ||
vṛddhā tu gautamīṃ prāha gaṅgāṃ pratyakṣarūpiṇīm || 64 ||
mannāmnīyaṃ nadī devi vṛddhā cety abhidhīyatām |
tvayā ca saṅgamas tasyās tasyās tīrtham anuttamam || 65 ||
astv ity āha ca tāṃ gaṅgā suvṛddhāṃ gautamapriyām |
tatraiva ca mudaṃ prāpto vṛddhayā munisattamaḥ |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || 68 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ vṛddhāsaṅgamam ucyate || 69 ||
Chapter 108: Story of King Ila who became Ilā, the mother of Purūravas
gacchantu nagaraṃ sarve mama putreṇa pālitam |
deśaṃ kośaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ pālayantu punaś ca tam || 5 ||
vasiṣṭho 'pi tathā yātu ādāyāgnīn piteva naḥ |
patnībhiḥ sahito dhīmān araṇye 'haṃ vasāmy atha || 6 ||
mṛgayāśīlibhiḥ kaiścid yāntu sarva itaḥ purīm || 7 ||
tathety uktvā yayus te 'pi svayaṃ prāyāc chanair girim |
himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ vasaṃs tatra ilo nṛpaḥ || 8 ||
tatra yakṣeśvaraḥ kaścit samanyur iti viśrutaḥ || 9 ||
tasmin vasaty asau yakṣo ramaṇīye nagottame || 10 ||
itthaṃ sa yakṣo jānāti mṛgarūpadharo 'pi ca |
ilas tu taṃ na jānāti kandaraṃ yakṣapālitam || 12 ||
vāsaṃ cakre sa tatraiva gehe yakṣasya dhīmataḥ |
ilaṃ jetuṃ na śaknomi yācito na dadāti ca |
hṛtaṃ gehaṃ mamānena kiṃ karomīty acintayat || 15 ||
yudhi mattaṃ kathaṃ hanyāṃ ceti sthitvā sa yakṣarāṭ |
ātmīyān preṣayām āsa yakṣāñ śūrān dhanurdharān || 16 ||
yuddhe jitvā ca rājānam ilam uddhatadantinam |
gṛhād yathānyato yāti mama tat kartum arhatha || 17 ||
yakṣeśvarasya tad vākyād yakṣās te yuddhadurmadāḥ |
na ced yuddhāt paribhraṣṭaḥ palāyya kva gamiṣyasi |
tad yakṣavacanāt kopād yuddhaṃ cakre sa rājarāṭ || 19 ||
jitvā yakṣān bahuvidhān uvāsa daśa śarvarīḥ |
yakṣeśvaro mṛgo bhūtvā bhāryayāpi vane vasan || 20 ||
hṛtageho vanaṃ prāpto hṛtabhṛtyaḥ sa yakṣiṇīm |
praviśet tatra rājāyaṃ strī bhaviṣyaty asaṃśayam |
karaṇīyaṃ tvayā bhadre na caitad yujyate mama |
ahaṃ tu puruṣo yena tvaṃ punaḥ strī ca yakṣiṇī || 24 ||
kathaṃ tvayā na gantavyam umāvanam anuttamam |
gate 'pi tvayi ko doṣas tan me kathaya tattvataḥ || 25 ||
pārvatī śaṅkaraṃ prāha kadācid rahasi sthitam || 26 ||
strīṇām eṣa svabhāvo 'sti rataṃ gopāyitaṃ bhavet |
tasmān me niyataṃ deśam ājñayā rakṣitaṃ tava || 27 ||
dehi me tridaśeśāna umāvanam iti śrutam |
yas tv atra praviśen nātha strītvaṃ tasya bhaved iti || 29 ||
kiṃ karomi pumān kānte tvayā praṇayanārditaḥ |
tasmān mayā na gantavyam umāyā vanam uttamam || 30 ||
yakṣas tu saṃsthitas tatra dadarśelo mṛgīṃ tadā |
eka eva hayārūḍho niryayau tāṃ mṛgīm anu |
sākarṣata śanais taṃ tu rājānaṃ mṛgayākulam || 33 ||
śanair jagāma sā tatra yad umāvanam ucyate |
adṛśyā tu mṛgī tasmai darśayantī kvacit kvacit || 34 ||
tiṣṭhantī caiva gacchantī dhāvantī ca vibhītavat |
hariṇī capalākṣī sā tam ākarṣad umāvanam || 35 ||
anuprāpto hayārūḍhas tat prāpa sa umāvanam |
umāvanaṃ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā sā yakṣiṇī tadā || 36 ||
hasantī nṛpatiṃ prekṣya śrāntaṃ hayagataṃ tadā |
mṛgīm ālokayantaṃ taṃ capalākṣam ilaṃ tadā || 39 ||
hayārūḍhābalā tanvi kva ekaiva tu gacchasi |
puruṣasya ca veṣeṇa ile kam anuyāsyasi || 41 ||
yakṣiṇīṃ bhartsayitvāsau tām apṛcchan mṛgīṃ punaḥ || 42 ||
tathāpi yakṣiṇī prāha ile kim anuvīkṣase |
punaḥ sā prāha nṛpatiṃ mahātmānam ile svayam || 44 ||
prekṣasva paścān māṃ brūhi asatyāṃ satyavādinīm |
tadā cālokayad rājā stanau tuṅgau bhujāntare || 45 ||
kim idaṃ mama sañjātam ity evaṃ cakito 'bhavat || 46 ||
kim idaṃ mama sañjātaṃ jānīte bhavatī sphuṭam |
vada sarvaṃ yathātathyaṃ tvaṃ kā vā vada suvrate || 47 ||
yakṣāṇām adhipaḥ śrīmāṃs tadbhāryāhaṃ tu yakṣiṇī || 48 ||
yasya yakṣā hatā mohāt tvayā hi saṅgaraṃ vinā || 49 ||
tato 'haṃ nirgamārthaṃ te mṛgī bhūtvā umāvanam |
praviṣṭā tvaṃ praviṣṭo 'si purā prāha maheśvaraḥ || 50 ||
yas tv atra praviśen mandaḥ pumān strītvam avāpsyati |
tasmāt strītvam avāpto 'si na tvaṃ duḥkhitum arhasi |
tam āśvāsya punaḥ saiva yakṣiṇī vākyam abravīt || 52 ||
strītvaṃ jātaṃ jātam eva na puṃstvaṃ kartum arhasi |
gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ strīyogyāṃ nṛtyaṃ gītam alaṅkṛtim |
strīlālityaṃ strīvilāsaṃ strīkṛtyaṃ sarvam eva tat || 53 ||
ilā sarvam athāvāpya yakṣiṇīṃ vākyam abravīt || 54 ||
ko vā bhartā kiṃ tu kṛtyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
budhaḥ somasuto nāma vanād asmāc ca pūrvataḥ |
āśramas tasya subhage pitaraṃ nityam eṣyati || 56 ||
anenaiva pathā somaṃ pitaraṃ sa budho grahaḥ |
draṣṭuṃ yāti tato nityaṃ namaskartuṃ tathaiva ca || 57 ||
yadā yāti budhaḥ śāntas tadātmānaṃ ca darśaya |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu subhage sarvakāmān avāpsyasi || 58 ||
tām āśvāsya tataḥ subhrūr yakṣiṇy antaradhīyata |
yakṣiṇī sā tam ācaṣṭa yakṣo 'pi sukham āptavān || 59 ||
ilasainyaṃ ca tatrāsīt tad gataṃ ca yathāsukham |
tām apaśyad budho dhīmān pitaraṃ gantum udyataḥ |
ilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatiṃ tyaktvā tām āgatyābravīd budhaḥ || 62 ||
bhāryā bhava mama svasthā sarvābhyas tvaṃ priyā bhava || 63 ||
budhavākyam ilā bhaktyā tv abhinandya tathākarot |
smṛtvā ca yakṣiṇīvākyaṃ tatas tuṣṭābhavan mune || 64 ||
budho reme tayā prītyā nītvā svasthānam uttamam |
sā cāpi sarvabhāvena toṣayām āsa taṃ patim |
tato bahutithe kāle budhas tuṣṭo 'vadat priyām || 65 ||
kiṃ te deyaṃ mayā bhadre priyaṃ yan manasi sthitam || 66 ||
ilā budhaṃ somasutaṃ prītimantaṃ priyaṃ tathā || 67 ||
putras te bhavitā tasmāt kṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ || 68 ||
vīryeṇājau harir iva kopena hutabhug yathā || 70 ||
jayaśabdaś ca sarvatra tv āsīc ca suraveśmani || 71 ||
aham apy āgamaṃ tatra mudā yukto mahāmate || 72 ||
jātamātraḥ suto rāvam akarot sa pṛthusvaram |
tena sarve 'py avocan vai saṅgatā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ || 73 ||
yasmāt purū ravo 'syeti tasmād eṣa purūravāḥ |
syād ity evaṃ nāma cakruḥ sarve santuṣṭamānasāḥ || 74 ||
budho 'py adhyāpayām āsa kṣātravidyāṃ sutaṃ śubhām |
sa śīghraṃ vṛddhim agamac chuklapakṣe yathā śaśī |
budho mātar mama pitā tava bhartā priyas tathā |
ahaṃ ca putraḥ karmaṇyaḥ kasmāt te mānaso jvaraḥ || 77 ||
satyaṃ putra budho bhartā tvaṃ ca putro guṇākaraḥ |
tathāpi pūrvajaṃ kiñcid duḥkhaṃ smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ |
nivedayasva me mātas tad eva prathamaṃ mama || 80 ||
ilā cainam uvācedaṃ rahovācaṃ kathaṃ vade |
tathāpi putra te vacmi pitroḥ putro yato gatiḥ |
tan mātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā vinītaḥ prāha mātaram |
pādayoḥ patitaś cāpi vada mātar yathā tathā || 82 ||
sā purūravasaṃ prāha ikṣvākūṇāṃ tathā kulam |
tatrotpattiṃ svasya nāma rājyaprāptiṃ priyān sutān || 83 ||
purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca priyāṃ bhāryāṃ svakaṃ padam |
preṣaṇaṃ ca nagaryāṃ tāṃ mṛgayāsaktim eva ca |
yakṣiṇīvākyam apy asya varadānaṃ tathaiva ca |
kathayām āsa tat sarvaṃ śrutvā mātaram abravīt |
purūravāḥ kiṃ karomi kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 88 ||
etāvatā te tṛptiś ced alam etena cāmbike |
yad apy anyan manovarti tad apy ājñāpayasva me || 89 ||
iccheyaṃ puṃstvam utkṛṣṭam iccheyaṃ rājyam uttamam |
abhiṣekaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ tava cāpi viśeṣataḥ || 90 ||
dānaṃ dātuṃ ca yaṣṭuṃ ca muktimārgasya vīkṣaṇam |
sarvaṃ ca kartum icchāmi tava putra prasādataḥ || 91 ||
upāyaṃ tvā tu pṛcchāmi yena puṃstvam avāpsyasi |
tapaso vānyato vāpi vadasva mama tattvataḥ || 92 ||
budhaṃ tvaṃ pitaraṃ pṛccha gatvā putra yathārthavat |
sa tu sarvaṃ tu jānāti upadekṣyati te hitam || 93 ||
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā mātuḥ kṛtyaṃ tathātmanaḥ || 94 ||
ilaṃ jāne mahāprājña ilāṃ jātāṃ punas tathā |
umāvanapraveśaṃ ca śambhor ājñāṃ tathaiva ca || 95 ||
viśāpo bhavitā putra tāv ārādhya na cānyathā || 96 ||
paśyeyaṃ taṃ kathaṃ devaṃ kathaṃ vā mātaraṃ śivām |
tīrthād vā tapaso vāpi tat pitaḥ prathamaṃ vada || 97 ||
gautamīṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ tatrāste sarvadā śivaḥ |
purūravāḥ pitur vākyaṃ śrutvā tu mudito 'bhavat |
puṃstvam icchaṃs tathā mātur jagāma tapase tvaran |
himavantaṃ giriṃ natvā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum || 100 ||
gacchantam anvagāt putram ilā somasutas tathā |
tatra snātvā tapaḥ kiñcit kṛtvā cakruḥ stutiṃ parām |
budhas tuṣṭāva prathamam ilā ca tadanantaram |

ilo rājā tavājñātvā vanaṃ prāviśad ambike |
tat kṣamasva sureśāni puṃstvaṃ dātuṃ tvam arhasi || 110 ||

tataḥ sa bhagavān āha devīvākyarataḥ sadā || 111 ||

yatra puṃstvam avāpyātha yatra putrāḥ samāgatāḥ || 121 ||
nadyo bhūtvā yatra gaṅgāṃ saṅgatās tāni nārada || 122 ||

ubhayos tīrayos tāta tatra śambhur ileśvaraḥ |

yatra cakreśvaro devaś cakram āpa yato hariḥ || 1 ||

Chapter 110: Story of Dadhīci and his son Pippalāda
yatra cakreśvaro devaś cakram āpa yato hariḥ || 1 ||
yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vibhum |

ihaivāsadhvam amarās tasyā vo na bhayaṃ bhavet || 137 ||

tat tyaktvātra kathaṃ nātha vatsyāmas tridaśārcita || 138 ||
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā śivo vākyam athābravīt || 140 ||
yo raśmibhis tu dhamate nityaṃ yo janako mataḥ || 141 ||
sa sūrya eka evātra sākṣād rūpeṇa sarvadā |
sthitiṃ karotu tanmūrtau bhaviṣyanty akhilāḥ sthitāḥ || 142 ||

tīrthānāṃ tatra vyuṣṭiṃ ca kaḥ śṛṇoti bravīti vā || 146 ||
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve vinītāḥ śivam abruvan || 147 ||
om ity uktvā jagannāthaḥ pippalādam avocata || 149 ||
nāśiteṣv api deveṣu pitā te nāgamiṣyati |
dattāḥ pitrā tava prāṇā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye || 150 ||
tathā yātā divaṃ tāta tava mātā pativratā || 151 ||
samā kāpy atra matayā lopāmudrāpy arundhatī |
yad asthibhiḥ surāḥ sarve jayinaḥ sukhinaḥ sadā || 152 ||
tenāvāptaṃ yaśaḥ sphītaṃ tava mātrākṣayaṃ kṛtam |
tvayā putreṇa sarvatra nātaḥ parataraṃ kṛtam || 153 ||
tvatpratāpabhayāt svargāc cyutāṃs tvaṃ pātum arhasi |
kāndiśīkāṃs tava bhayād amarāṃs trātum arhasi |
mṛtās ta evātra yaśo na yeṣām |
ye dharmaśīlā na ta eva śocyāḥ || 156 ||
yair ahaṃ vardhito nityaṃ mātṛvat pitṛvat prabho |
yaśas tu teṣāṃ bhavitā tebhyo 'ham anṛṇas tataḥ |
yāni kṣetrāṇi devānāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūtale || 161 ||
tebhyo yad idam adhikam anumanyantu devatāḥ |
vatsa yad vai priyaṃ kāmaṃ yac cāpi suravallabham |

yācitaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ parārthaṃ nātmane dvija |
tasmād anyatamaṃ brūhi kiñcid dāsyāmahe vayam || 171 ||
punaḥ punas tad evocuḥ surasaṅghā dvijottamam |
uvāca pippalādaś ca umāṃ natvā ca pippalān || 172 ||
te dhanyāḥ prāṇino loke mātāpitror vaśe sthitāḥ || 173 ||
indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca kulaṃ śaktiṃ dhiyaṃ vapuḥ || 174 ||
parilabhya tayoḥ kṛtye kṛtakṛtyo bhavet svayam |
durlabhaṃ mama tac cāpi pṛcche pāpaphalaṃ nu kim |
durlabhaṃ ca tathā cet syāt sarveṣāṃ yasya kasyacit || 176 ||
tayor darśanamātraṃ ca yadi prāpsye surottamāḥ || 177 ||
pitarau ye na paśyanti samutpannā na saṃsṛtau |
teṣāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ kaḥ saṅkhyāṃ kartum īśvaraḥ || 178 ||
tad ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā mithaḥ sammantrya te surāḥ |
viṣādaṃ lobhamohau ca tyaktvā cittaṃ śamaṃ naya || 180 ||
paśya paśyeti taṃ prāhur dādhīcaṃ surasattamāḥ |
tārayanty eva pitarāv anye putrāḥ kulodvahāḥ |
ahaṃ tu mātur udare kevalaṃ bhedakāraṇam |
tāv ālokya tato duḥkhād vaktuṃ naiva śaśāka saḥ |
dhanyas tvaṃ putra lokeṣu yasya kīrtir gatā divam |
sākṣātkṛtas tvayā tryakṣo devāś cāśvāsitās tvayā |
tvayā putreṇa sallokā na kṣīyante kadācana || 186 ||
puṣpavṛṣṭis tadā svargāt papāta tasya mūrdhani |
āśiṣaṃ tu sute dattvā dadhīciḥ saha bhāryayā |
śambhuṃ gaṅgāṃ surān natvā putraṃ vākyam athābravīt || 188 ||
prāpya bhāryāṃ śive bhaktiṃ kuru gaṅgāṃ ca sevaya |
putrān utpādya vidhivad yajñān iṣṭvā sadakṣiṇān |
kṛtakṛtyas tato vatsa ākramasva ciraṃ divam || 189 ||
karomy evam iti prāha dadhīciṃ pippalāśanaḥ |
dadhīciḥ putram āśvāsya bhāryayā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 190 ||

devā apy ūcire sarve pippalādaṃ sasambhramāḥ || 191 ||
kṛtyāṃ śamaya bhadraṃ te tad utpannaṃ mahānalam || 192 ||

tām eva gatvā vibudhāḥ procus te śāntikāraṇam || 194 ||

tathā ca matprasūto 'gnir anyathā tat kathaṃ bhavet |

pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ surāṇām api vallabham || 228 ||

yatra nāgeśvaro devaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi vistaram || 1 ||

santāpaṃ nityam āpnoti sarpād varam aputratā || 6 ||

anyathāpi ca kṛtyaṃ te na sidhyed iti me matiḥ || 10 ||

yasya śabdād api trāsaṃ yānti śūrāś ca pūruṣāḥ |
tasmai kanyāṃ tu ko dadyād vada putra karomi kim || 13 ||
tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā sarpaḥ prāha vicakṣaṇaḥ || 14 ||
vivāhā bahavo rājan rājñāṃ santi janeśvara |
prasahyāharaṇaṃ cāpi śastrair vaivāha eva ca || 15 ||
jāte vivāhe putrasya pitāsau kṛtakṛd bhavet |
no ced atraiva gaṅgāyāṃ mariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||
rathe nāge sa dhanuṣi pṛthivyāṃ nopamīyate |
vivāhas tasya kartavyo hy ahaṃ vṛddhas tathaiva ca || 19 ||
rājyabhāraṃ sute nyasya niścinto 'haṃ bhavāmy ataḥ |
na dārasaṅgraho yāvat tāvat putro mama priyaḥ || 20 ||
bālabhāvaṃ no jahāti tasmāt sarve 'numanya ca |
vivāhāyātha kurvantu yatnaṃ mama hite ratāḥ || 21 ||
na me kācit tadā cintā kṛtodvāho yadātmajaḥ |
sute nyastabharā yānti kṛtinas tapase vanam || 22 ||
tava putro guṇajyeṣṭhas tvaṃ ca sarvatra viśrutaḥ |
vivāhe tava putrasya kiṃ mantryaṃ kiṃ tu cintyate || 24 ||
putraṃ sarpaṃ tv amātyānāṃ na cākhyāti na te viduḥ || 25 ||
rājā punas tān uvāca kā syāt kanyā guṇādhikā |
mahāvaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān ko rājā syād guṇāśrayaḥ || 26 ||
rājño matiṃ viditvā tu iṅgitajño 'bravīd idam || 28 ||
teṣāṃ svasā bhogavatī sākṣāl lakṣmīr ivāparā |
tava putrasya yogyā sā bhāryā rājan mayoditā || 30 ||
sutā tasya kathaṃ me 'sya sutasya syād vadasva tat || 32 ||
lakṣito 'si mahārāja yat te manasi vartate |
yac chūrasena kṛtyaṃ syād anujānīhi māṃ tataḥ || 33 ||
sampūjya preṣayām āsa mahatyā senayā saha || 34 ||

avāpya pūjāṃ nṛpatir dadāmīty avadat tadā |
jagāma tarasā sarvair anyaiś ca sacivair vṛtaḥ || 40 ||

mene vākyaṃ tathā satyam amātyaṃ bhūpatiṃ tadā || 45 ||
śastreṇa ca yathāśāstraṃ preṣayām āsa tāṃ punaḥ || 46 ||
svān amātyāṃs tathā gāś ca hiraṇyaturagādikam |
bahu dattvātha vijayo harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ || 47 ||
nyavedayaṃs tathocus te vijayasya vaco bahu |
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi dāsyo vastrādikaṃ ca yat || 49 ||
vijayāya yathā prītis tathā kṛtvā vyasarjayat || 51 ||

mama bhāryā rājaputrī kiṃ māṃ naivopasarpati |
dhātrike gaccha subhage śīghraṃ bhogavatīṃ vada |
tava bhartā sarpa iti tataḥ sā kiṃ vadiṣyati || 56 ||
dhātrikā ca tathety uktvā gatvā bhogavatīṃ tadā |
jāne 'haṃ subhage bhadre bhartāraṃ tava daivatam |
na cākhyeyaṃ tvayā kvāpi sarpo na puruṣo dhruvam || 58 ||
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bhogavaty abravīd idam || 59 ||
mānuṣīṇāṃ manuṣyo hi bhartā sāmānyato bhavet |
kiṃ punar devajātis tu bhartā puṇyena labhyate || 60 ||
bhogavatyās tu tad vākyaṃ sā ca sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
sarpāya sarpamātre ca rājñe caiva yathākramam || 61 ||
ruroda rājā tadvākyāt smṛtvā tāṃ karmaṇo gatim |
bhogavaty api tāṃ prāha uktapūrvāṃ punaḥ sakhīm || 62 ||
kāntaṃ darśaya bhadraṃ te vṛthā yāti vayo mama || 63 ||
tataḥ sā darśayām āsa sarpaṃ tam atibhīṣaṇam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ bhartāraṃ ratnabhūṣitam |
dhanyāsmy anugṛhītāsmi yasyā me daivataṃ patiḥ || 66 ||
ity uktvā śayane sthitvā taṃ sarpaṃ sarpabhāvanaiḥ |
sugandhakusumaiḥ pānais toṣayām āsa taṃ patim |
tasyāś caiva prasādena sarpasyābhūt smṛtir mune |
smṛtvā sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ rātrau sarpo 'bravīt priyām || 68 ||
rājakanyāpi māṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhītāsi kathaṃ priye |
patir eva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ sarvadaiva viśeṣataḥ || 69 ||
śrutveti hṛṣṭas tām āha nāgaḥ prahasitānanaḥ || 70 ||
tuṣṭo 'smi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kiṃ dadāmi tavepsitam |
tava prasādāc cārvaṅgi sarvasmṛtir abhūd iyam || 71 ||
so 'haṃ patis tvaṃ ca bhāryā nāmnā bhogavatī purā |
tatas tu kupitaḥ śambhuḥ prādāc chāpaṃ mamedṛśam || 74 ||
manuṣyayonau tvaṃ sarpo bhavitā jñānavān iti || 75 ||
tataḥ prasāditaḥ śambhus tvayā bhadre mayā saha |
tataś coktaṃ tena bhadre gautamyāṃ mama pūjanam || 76 ||
kurvato jñānam ādhāsye yadā sarpākṛtes tava |
tasmād idaṃ mamāpannaṃ tava cāpi śubhānane |
tasmān nītvā gautamīṃ māṃ pūjāṃ kuru mayā saha || 78 ||
tato viśāpo bhavitā āvāṃ yāvaḥ śivaṃ punaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ sarvadārtānāṃ śiva eva parā gatiḥ || 79 ||
tac chrutvā bhartṛvacanaṃ sā bhartrā gautamīṃ yayau |
tataḥ snātvā tu gautamyāṃ pūjāṃ cakre śivasya tu || 80 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān divyarūpaṃ dadau mune |
āpṛcchya pitarau sarpo bhāryayā gantum udyataḥ |
śivalokaṃ tato jñātvā pitā prāha mahāmatiḥ || 81 ||
yuvarājyadharo jyeṣṭhaḥ putra eko bhavān iti |
tasmād rājyam aśeṣeṇa kṛtvotpādya sutān bahūn |
yāte mayi paraṃ dhāma tato yāhi śivaṃ puram || 82 ||
etac chrutvā pitṛvacas tathety āha sa nāgarāṭ |
pitrā mātrā tathā putrai rājyaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram |
yāte pitari svarlokaṃ putrān sthāpya svake pade || 84 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ nāgatīrtham iti śrutam || 85 ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam || 86 ||

Chapter 121: Kaṭha and his special gift to his teacher Bharadvāja

evaṃ smṛtvā tu yaḥ kaścid gautamyāṃ snānam ācaret |
āvābhyāṃ tu prasādena dharmaḥ sampūrṇatām iyāt |
pūrvajanmakṛtād doṣāt sa muktaḥ puṇyavān bhavet || 92 ||
tenābhūd yā nadī puṇyā maṅgalety uditā tu sā |
tayā ca saṅgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāḥ śubhadas tv asau || 94 ||
tannāmnā cāpi vikhyāto govinda iti tatra ca |
dattā ca hariṇā tatra govindas tad abhūd dhariḥ |
trailokyarājyaṃ yat prāptaṃ hariṇā ca harer mune || 97 ||
siddheśvaras tatra devo liṅgaṃ tu tridaśārcitam || 99 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ govindam iti viśrutam |
indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca viśrutam |
yatra siddheśvaro devo viṣṇur govinda eva ca || 101 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yat kiñcit sukṛtārjanam |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt pitṝṇām ativallabham || 102 ||
śṛṇoti yaś cāpi paṭhed yaś ca smarati nityaśaḥ |
niṣphalaṃ tasya janmādi yo na seveta tan naraḥ || 105 ||
Chapter 123: Story of Daśaratha and his dutiful son Rāma
balavān matimāñ śūro yathā śakraḥ purandaraḥ || 2 ||
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ kurvann āste yathā baliḥ |
tasya tisro mahiṣyaḥ syū rājño daśarathasya hi || 3 ||
kauśalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca mahāmate |
tasmin rājani rājye tu sthite 'yodhyāpatau mune |
na ca vyādhir na durbhikṣaṃ na cāvṛṣṭir na cādhayaḥ |
āśramāṇāṃ tu sarveṣām ānando 'bhūt pṛthak pṛthak |
kvāpi tatra jayaṃ prāpur devāḥ kvāpi tathetare || 8 ||
devāṃś cāpi viśeṣeṇa na kṛtaṃ tair madīritam |
punaś ca saṅgaras teṣāṃ babhūva sumahān mithaḥ || 10 ||
viṣṇuṃ gatvā surāḥ procus tatheśānaṃ jaganmayam |
tāv ūcatur ubhau devān asurān daityadānavān || 11 ||
tapasā balino yāntu punaḥ kurvantu saṅgaram |
tathety āhur yayuḥ sarve tapase niyatavratāḥ || 12 ||
yayus tu rākṣasān devāḥ punas te matsarānvitāḥ |
na tatra devā jetāro naiva daityāś ca dānavāḥ |
yeṣāṃ daśaratho rājā te jetāro na cetare || 15 ||
tatra vāyus tvaran prāpto rājānam avadat tadā || 16 ||
yatra rājā daśaratho jayas tatreti viśrutam || 17 ||
tasmāt tvaṃ devapakṣe syā bhaveyur jayinaḥ surāḥ || 18 ||
tad vāyuvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā daśaratho nṛpaḥ |
āgamyate mayā satyaṃ gaccha vāyo yathāsukham || 19 ||
gate vāyau tadā daityā ājagmur bhūpatiṃ prati |
te 'py ūcur bhagavann asmatsāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi || 20 ||
rājan daśaratha śrīman vijayas tvayi saṃsthitaḥ |
tasmāt tvaṃ vai daityapateḥ sāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi || 21 ||
tataḥ provāca nṛpatir vāyunā prārthitaḥ purā |
pratijñātaṃ mayā tac ca yāntu daityāś ca dānavāḥ || 22 ||
sa tu rājā tathā cakre gatvā caiva triviṣṭapam |
yuddhaṃ cakre tathā daityair dānavaiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ || 23 ||
vividhur niśitair bāṇair athākṣaṃ nṛpates tathā || 24 ||
bhinnākṣaṃ taṃ rathaṃ rājā na jānāti sa sambhramāt |
na jñāpitaṃ tayā rājñe svayam ālokya suvratā |
bhagnam akṣaṃ samālakṣya cakre hastaṃ tadā svakam || 26 ||
akṣavan muniśārdūla tad etan mahad adbhutam |
rathena rathināṃ śreṣṭhas tayā dattakareṇa ca || 27 ||
jitavān daityadanujān devaiḥ prāpya varān bahūn |
tato devair anujñātas tv ayodhyāṃ punar abhyagāt || 28 ||
sa tu madhye mahārājo mārge vīkṣya tadā priyām |
kaikeyyāḥ karma tad dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 29 ||
tatas tasyai varān prādāt trīṃs tu nārada sā api |
tvayi tiṣṭhantu rājendra tvayā dattā varā amī || 31 ||
vibhūṣaṇāni rājendro dattvā sa priyayā saha |
rathena vijayī rājā yayau svanagaraṃ sukhī || 32 ||
yoṣitāṃ kim adeyaṃ hi priyāṇām ucitāgame |
iti jānann api ca tac cakāra tu vidher vaśāt |
gartaṃ praviśya pānārtham āgatān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 35 ||
gartaṃ praviṣṭe nṛpatau tasminn eva nagottame || 36 ||
vṛddho vaiśravaṇo nāma na śṛṇoti na paśyati |
tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā tāv abrūtāṃ tadā sutam || 37 ||
āvāṃ tṛṣārtau rātriś ca kṛṣṇā cāpi pravartate |
vṛddhānāṃ jīvitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ bālas tvam asi putraka || 38 ||
andhānāṃ badhirāṇāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ dhik ca jīvitam |
tāvat pumbhir jīvitavyaṃ yāval lakṣmīr dṛḍhaṃ vapuḥ |
ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhayor guruvatsalaḥ |
putraḥ provāca tad duḥkhaṃ girā madhurayā haran || 41 ||
mayi jīvati kiṃ nāma yuvayor duḥkham īdṛśam |
na haraty ātmajaḥ pitror yaś caritrair manorujam || 42 ||
ity uktvā pitarau natvā tāv āśvāsya mahāmanāḥ |
taruskandhe samāropya vṛddhau ca pitarau tadā || 44 ||
sa ṛṣir na tu rājānaṃ jānāti nṛpatir dvijam || 45 ||
ubhau sarabhasau tatra dvijo vāri samāviśat |
satvaraṃ kalaśe nyubje vāri gṛhṇantam āśugaiḥ || 46 ||
dvijaṃ rājā dvipaṃ matvā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
vanadvipo 'pi bhūpānām avadhyas tad vidann api || 47 ||
vivyādha taṃ nṛpaḥ kuryān na kiṃ kiṃ vidhivañcitaḥ |
sa viddho marmadeśe tu duḥkhito vākyam abravīt || 48 ||
kenedaṃ duḥkhadaṃ karma kṛtaṃ sadbrāhmaṇasya me |
maitro brāhmaṇa ity ukto nāparādho 'sti kaścana || 49 ||
tad etad vacanaṃ śrutvā muner ārtasya bhūpatiḥ |
niśceṣṭaś ca nirutsāho śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt || 50 ||
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvijavaraṃ jvalantam iva tejasā |
asāv apy abhavat tatra saśalya iva mūrcchitaḥ || 51 ||
ātmānam ātmanā kṛtvā sthiraṃ rājābravīd idam || 52 ||
ko bhavān dvijaśārdūla kimartham iha cāgataḥ |
vada pāpakṛte mahyaṃ vada me niṣkṛtiṃ parām || 53 ||
brahmahā varṇibhiḥ kintu śvapacair api jātucit |
na spraṣṭavyo mahābuddhe draṣṭavyo na kadācana || 54 ||
utkramiṣyanti me prāṇā ato vakṣyāmi kiñcana |
ātmārthaṃ tu na śocāmi vṛddhau tu pitarau mama |
tayoḥ śuśrūṣakaḥ kaḥ syād andhayor ekaputrayoḥ || 57 ||
vinā mayā mahāraṇye kathaṃ tau jīvayiṣyataḥ |
jātā me 'dya vinā prāṇair hā vidhe kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā |
tathāpi gaccha tatra tvaṃ gṛhītakalaśas tvaran || 59 ||
tābhyāṃ dehy udapānaṃ tvaṃ yathā tau na mariṣyataḥ || 60 ||
ity evaṃ bruvatas tasya gatāḥ prāṇā mahāvane |
visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpam ādāya kalaśaṃ nṛpaḥ || 61 ||
tatrāgāt sa tu vegena yatra vṛddhau mahāvane |
vṛddhau cāpi tadā rātrau tāv anyonyaṃ samūcatuḥ || 62 ||
udvignaḥ kupito vā syād athavā bhakṣitaḥ katham |
na prāptaś cāvayor yaṣṭiḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ kā gatir bhavet || 63 ||
na kopi tādṛśaḥ putro vidyate sacarācare |
yaḥ pitror anyathā vākyaṃ na karoty api ninditaḥ || 64 ||
vajrād api kaṭhoraṃ vā jīvitaṃ tam apaśyatoḥ |
śīghraṃ na yānti yat prāṇās tadekāyattajīvayoḥ || 65 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhā vāco vṛddhayor vadator vane |
tadā daśaratho rājā śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt || 66 ||
kuto vatsa cirāt prāptas tvaṃ dṛṣṭis tvaṃ parāyaṇam |
na brūṣe kintu ruṣṭo 'si vṛddhayor andhayoḥ sutaḥ || 68 ||
saśalya iva duḥkhārtaḥ śocan duṣkṛtam ātmanaḥ |
sa bhīta iva rājendras tāv uvācātha nārada || 69 ||
udapānaṃ ca kurutāṃ tac chrutvā nṛpabhāṣitam |
nāyaṃ vaktā suto 'smākaṃ ko bhavāṃs tat purā vada || 70 ||
paścāt pibāvaḥ pānīyaṃ tato rājābravīc ca tau || 71 ||
tatra tiṣṭhati vāṃ putro yatra vārisamāśrayaḥ || 72 ||
tac chrutvocatur ārtau tau satyaṃ brūhi na cānyathā |
ācacakṣe tato rājā sarvam eva yathātatham || 73 ||
tatas tu patitau vṛddhau tatrāvāṃ naya mā spṛśa |
ninye vai śravaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ sabhāryaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ |
yatrāsau patitaḥ putras taṃ spṛṣṭvā tau vilepatuḥ || 75 ||
yathā putraviyogena mṛtyur nau vihitas tathā |
tvaṃ cāpi pāpa putrasya viyogān mṛtyum āpsyasi || 76 ||
evaṃ tu jalpator brahman gatāḥ prāṇās tato nṛpaḥ |
agninā yojayām āsa vṛddhau ca ṛṣiputrakam || 77 ||
tato jagāma nagaraṃ duḥkhito nṛpatir mune |
vasiṣṭhāya ca tat sarvaṃ nyavedayad aśeṣataḥ || 78 ||
nṛpāṇāṃ sūryavaṃśyānāṃ vasiṣṭho hi parā gatiḥ |
gālavaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālim atha kaśyapam |
akarod dhayamedhāṃś ca rājā daśaratho dvijaiḥ |
pūtaṃ śarīram abhavad rājño daśarathasya hi |
vyavahāryaś ca bhavitā bhaviṣyanti tathā sutāḥ |
kauśalyāyāṃ tathā rāmaḥ sumitrāyāṃ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ |
te sarve matimantaś ca priyā rājño vaśe sthitāḥ |
taṃ rājānam ṛṣiḥ prāpya viśvāmitraḥ prajāpatiḥ || 86 ||
rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ cāpi ayācata mahāmate |
saśarīram idaṃ rājyaṃ dāsye naiva sutāv imau || 90 ||
vasiṣṭhena tadā prokto rājā daśarathas tv iti || 91 ||
raghavaḥ prārthanābhaṅgaṃ na rājan kvāpi śikṣitāḥ || 92 ||
rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva kathañcid avadan nṛpaḥ || 93 ||
vadann iti sutau soṣṇaṃ niśvasan glapitādharaḥ |
tathety uktvā daśarathaṃ namasya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sa munir mudā prādāt tadobhayoḥ |
śāstrīm āstrīṃ laukikīṃ ca rathavidyāṃ gajodbhavām |
putrābhyāṃ sahito rājño janakaṃ draṣṭum abhyagāt |
tatprīto janakaḥ prādāt sītāṃ lakṣmīm ayonijām || 103 ||
rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmān vivāham akaron mune |
tato bahutithe kāle rājyaṃ tasya prayacchati || 105 ||
bharatasya ca tad rājyaṃ rājā naiva ca dattavān || 107 ||
pitaraṃ satyavākyaṃ taṃ kurvan rāmo mahāvanam |
viveśa sītayā sārdhaṃ tathā saumitriṇā saha || 108 ||
satāṃ ca mānasaṃ śuddhaṃ sa viveśa svakair guṇaiḥ |
taṃ rāmaṃ cāpi saumitriṃ sītāṃ ca guṇaśālinīm || 110 ||
tadā daśaratho rājā prāṇāṃs tatyāja duḥkhitaḥ || 111 ||
narakāṇy atha ghorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni bahūni ca || 113 ||
tatra kṣiptas tadā rājā narakeṣu pṛthak pṛthak |
pacyate chidyate rājā piṣyate cūrṇyate tathā || 114 ||
śoṣyate daśyate bhūyo dahyate ca nimajjyate |
punaḥ sa dakṣiṇām āśām ākrāmad daṇḍakaṃ vanam |
vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu deśānāṃ tad dhi puṇyadam || 117 ||
tadbhayād ṛṣibhis tyaktaṃ hatvā daityāṃs tu rākṣasān || 118 ||
tatredaṃ vṛttam ākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ || 119 ||
tāvac chanais tv agād rāmo yāvad yojanapañcakam |
gautamīm abhito yāti pitaraṃ tasya dhīmataḥ || 121 ||
ākarṣantv atha rājānaṃ narakān nātra saṃśayaḥ |
rāmas tāvat tasya pitā narake naiva pacyatām |
yad etan madvacaḥ puṇyaṃ na kuryur yadi dūtakāḥ || 123 ||
tataś ca narake ghore yūyaṃ sarve nimajjatha |
yā kāpy uktā parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī || 124 ||
tām eva gautamīṃ santo vadanty ambhaḥsvarūpiṇīm |
haribrahmamaheśānāṃ mānyā vandyā ca saiva yat || 125 ||
nistīryate na kenāpi tad atikramajaṃ tv agham |
pāpino 'py ātmajaḥ kaścid yaś ca gaṅgām anusmaret || 126 ||
kiṃ punas tādṛśaḥ putro gautamīnikaṭe sthitaḥ || 127 ||
yasyāsau narake paktuṃ na kairapi hi śakyate |
dhanyo 'si nṛpaśārdūla yasya putraḥ sa tādṛśaḥ |
iha cāmutra viśrāntiḥ suputraḥ kena labhyate || 130 ||
sa viśrāntaḥ śanai rājā kiṅkarān vākyam abravīt || 131 ||
narakeṣv atha ghoreṣu pacyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
kathaṃ tv ākarṣitaḥ śīghraṃ tan me vaktum ihārhatha || 132 ||
tatra kaścic chāntamanā rājānam idam abravīt || 133 ||
prakāśyate tad api te sāmarthyaṃ putratīrthayoḥ || 134 ||
rāmas tava sutaḥ śrīmān gautamītīram āgataḥ |
tasmāt tvaṃ narakād ghorād ākṛṣṭo 'si narottama || 135 ||
yadi tvāṃ tatra gautamyāṃ smared rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvātha piṇḍādi te dadyāt sa nṛpottama |
tatas tvaṃ sarvapāpebhyo mukto yāsi triviṣṭapam || 136 ||
tatra gatvā bhavadvākyam ākhyāsye svasutau prati |
bhavanta eva śaraṇam anujñāṃ dātum arhatha || 137 ||
ājñāṃ ca pradadus tasmai rājā prāgāt sutau prati || 138 ||
nirīkṣya svaṃ lajjamānaḥ kṛtaṃ karma ca saṃsmaran || 139 ||
svecchayā viharan gaṅgām āsasāda ca rāghavaḥ |
gautamyās taṭam āśritya rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca || 140 ||
sītayā saha vaidehyā sasnau caiva yathāvidhi |
naiva tatrābhavad bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vā gautamītaṭe || 141 ||
tad dṛṣṭvā duḥkhito bhrātā lakṣmaṇo rāmam abravīt || 142 ||
bhrātar yad vihitaṃ karma naiva tac cānyathā bhavet |
saumitre nūnam asmābhir na brāhmaṇamukhe hutam |
te ye lakṣmaṇa jāyante sarvadaiva bubhukṣitāḥ |
snātvā devān athābhyarcya hotavyaś ca hutāśanaḥ |
tataḥ svasamaye devo vidhāsyaty aśanaṃ tu nau || 146 ||
bhrātroḥ sañjalpator evaṃ paśyatoḥ karmaṇo gatim |
śanair daśaratho rājā taṃ deśam upajagmivān || 147 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt |
dhanur ākṛṣya kopena rakṣas tvaṃ dānavo 'thavā || 148 ||
āsannaṃ ca punar dṛṣṭvā yāhi yāhy atra puṇyabhāk |
rāmo dāśarathī rājā dharmabhāk paśya vartate || 149 ||
na tatra tvādṛśām asti praveśaḥ pāpakarmaṇām |
yadi praviśase pāpa tato vadham avāpsyasi || 151 ||
tat putravacanaṃ śrutvā śanair āhūya vācayā |
ahaṃ daśaratho rājā putrau me śṛṇutaṃ vacaḥ |
chinnaṃ paśyata me dehaṃ narakeṣu ca pātitam || 153 ||
tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rāmaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca |
bhūmau praṇemus te sarve vacanaṃ caitad abruvan || 154 ||
sa ca prāha yathāvṛttaṃ brahmahatyātrayaṃ tathā || 156 ||
niṣkṛtir brahmahantṝṇāṃ putrau kvāpi na vidyate || 157 ||
tato duḥkhena mahatā āvṛtāḥ sarve bhuvaṃ gatāḥ |
rājānaṃ vanavāsaṃ ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā || 158 ||
evamādy atha saṃsmṛtya mumoha nṛpateḥ sutaḥ |
visañjñaṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā sītā vākyam athābravīt || 159 ||
cintayanti pratīkāraṃ daivyam apy atha mānuṣam || 160 ||
dehi hatyāṃ prathamato yā jātā hy atibhīṣaṇā || 162 ||
anāgā yo hato vipras tatpāpasyātra niṣkṛtim || 163 ||
ācarāmi yathāśāstraṃ mā śokaṃ kurutaṃ yuvām |
dvitīyāṃ lakṣmaṇo hatyāṃ gṛhṇātu tv aparāṃ bhavān || 164 ||
etad dharmayutaṃ vākyaṃ sītayā bhāṣitaṃ dṛḍham |
tvaṃ hi brahmavidaḥ kanyā janakasya tv ayonijā |
bhāryā rāmasya kiṃ citraṃ yad yuktam anubhāṣase || 166 ||
na kopi bhavatāṃ kintu śramaḥ svalpo 'pi vidyate |
godāvaryāḥ prasādena kiṃ nāmāsty atra durlabham || 169 ||
lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha vinayād iṅgudyāś ca phalāni ca |
santi teṣāṃ ca piṇyākam ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇād iva || 171 ||
piṇyākenātha gaṅgāyāṃ piṇḍaṃ dātuṃ tathā pituḥ |
manaḥ kurvaṃs tato rāmo mando 'bhūd duḥkhitas tadā || 172 ||
daivī vāg abhavat tatra duḥkhaṃ tyaja nṛpātmaja |
rājyabhraṣṭo vanaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ vai niṣkiñcano bhavān || 173 ||
vittaśāṭhyena yo dharmaṃ karoti sa tu pātakī || 174 ||
śrūyate sarvaśāstreṣu yad rāma śṛṇu yatnataḥ |
yadannaḥ puruṣo rājaṃs tadannās tasya devatāḥ || 175 ||
piṇḍe nipatite bhūmau nāpaśyat pitaraṃ tadā |
śavaṃ ca patitaṃ yatra śavatīrtham anuttamam || 176 ||
svaṃ svaṃ vimānam ārūḍhās teṣāṃ madhye 'tidīptimān |
tam adṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ devān dṛṣṭvā vimāninaḥ || 179 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmaḥ pitā me kvety abhāṣata |
iti divyābhavad vāṇī rāmaṃ sambodhya sītayā || 180 ||
vṛtaṃ paśya surais tāta devā apy ūcire ca tam || 181 ||
dhanyo 'si kṛtakṛtyo 'si rāma svargaṃ gataḥ pitā |
dṛṣṭvābravīt sutaṃ rājā āśīrbhir abhinandya ca || 185 ||
dhanyaḥ sa putro loke 'smin pitṝṇāṃ yas tu tārakaḥ || 186 ||
rāmaṃ ca puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ gaccha tāta yathāsukham |
tatas tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmas tān abravīt surān || 187 ||
gurau pitari me devāḥ kiṃ kṛtyam avaśiṣyate || 188 ||
nadī na gaṅgayā tulyā na tvayā sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ |
na śivena samo devo na tāreṇa samo manuḥ || 189 ||
tvayā rāma gurūṇāṃ ca kāryaṃ sarvam anuṣṭhitam |
tāritāḥ pitaro rāma tvayā putreṇa mānada |
gacchantu sarve svasthānaṃ tvaṃ ca gaccha yathāsukham || 190 ||
tad dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vismito vākyam abravīt || 191 ||
vayaṃ dhanyā yato gaṅgā dṛṣṭāsmābhis tripāvanī || 192 ||
harṣeṇa mahatā yukto devaṃ sthāpya maheśvaram |
tataḥ sa bhagavān āha rāmaṃ śambhuḥ salakṣmaṇam |
varān vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te rāmaḥ prāha vṛṣadhvajam || 207 ||
stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā toṣyanti tvāṃ surottama |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ yāntu maheśvara || 208 ||
yeṣāṃ ca pitaraḥ śambho patitā narakārṇave |
atra tu snānamātreṇa tat sadyo nāśam āpnuyāt || 210 ||
atra ye bhaktitaḥ śambho dadaty arthibhya aṇv api |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ śambho dātṝṇāṃ phalakṛd bhavet || 211 ||
evam astv iti taṃ rāmaṃ śaṅkaro hṛṣito 'bravīt |
gate tasmin suraśreṣṭhe rāmo 'py anucaraiḥ saha || 212 ||
gautamī yatra cotpannā śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt |
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ rāmatīrtham udāhṛtam || 213 ||
dayālor apatat tatra lakṣmaṇasya karāc charaḥ |
tat tīrthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ jātaṃ tathā sītāsamudbhavam || 215 ||
sa yatra snānam akarot tad vaiśiṣṭyaṃ kim ucyate |
tad rāmatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ kvāpi na vidyate || 217 ||
Chapter 124: Story of Indra and Diti
putratīrtham iti khyātaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ tad ucyate |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti yanmahimnaḥ śruter api || 1 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada |
diteḥ putrāś ca danujāḥ parikṣīṇā yadābhavan |
adites tu sutā jyeṣṭhāḥ sarvabhāvena nārada || 2 ||
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ ca ditiṃ danuḥ provāca nārada || 10 ||
bhartāraṃ kaśyapaṃ bhadre toṣayasva nijair guṇaiḥ |
tuṣṭo yadi bhaved bhartā tataḥ kāmān avāpsyasi || 11 ||
tathety uktvā sarvabhāvais toṣayām āsa kaśyapam |
kiṃ dadāmi vadābhīṣṭaṃ dite varaya suvrate || 13 ||
ditir apy āha bhartāraṃ putraṃ bahuguṇānvitam |
taṃ vareyaṃ surapitar ity āha vinayānvitā || 15 ||
tata āgatya te garbham ādhāsye yan manogatam |
tataś cīrṇe vrate tasyāṃ dityāṃ garbham adhārayat |
punaḥ kāntām athovāca kaśyapas tāṃ ditiṃ rahaḥ || 19 ||
ninditaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ sandhyayor ubhayor api |
na svaptavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ muktakeśī ca no bhava || 21 ||
bhoktavyaṃ subhage naiva kṣutaṃ vā jṛmbhaṇaṃ tathā |
sāntardhānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ hasitaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
udakśīrṣaṃ tu śayanaṃ na sandhyāsu viśeṣataḥ |
kāntād anyo na vīkṣyas tu prayatnena naraḥ kvacit |
gataś ca kaśyapo brahmann itaś cetaḥ surān prati || 27 ||
etat sarvaṃ mayo daityo māyayā vetti tattvataḥ || 28 ||
mayo gatvā rahaḥ prāha indraṃ sa vinayānvitaḥ || 29 ||
diter danor abhiprāyaṃ vrataṃ garbhasya vardhanam |
tasya vīryaṃ ca vividhaṃ prītyendrāya nyavedayat || 30 ||
arjitaṃ sukṛtaṃ nānāvidhaṃ cet tad avāpyate || 31 ||
namuceś ca priyo bhrātā mayo daityo mahābalaḥ |
daityānām adhipaś cāsīd balavān namuciḥ purā |
yuddhaṃ hitvā kadācid bho gacchantaṃ tu śatakratum |
airāvataṃ gajaṃ tyaktvā indraḥ phenam athāviśat || 35 ||
namucir nāśam agamat tasya bhrātā mayo 'nujaḥ || 36 ||
māyāṃ ca vividhām āpa devānām atibhīṣaṇām || 37 ||
agnīṃś ca brāhmaṇān pūjya jetum indraṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ |
dātāraṃ ca tadārthibhyaḥ stūyamānaṃ ca bandibhiḥ || 39 ||
viditvā maghavā vāyor mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ ripum |
upakrāntaṃ suyuddhāya vipro bhūtvā tam abhyagāt |
śacībhartā mayaṃ daityaṃ provācedaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 40 ||
mayo 'pi brāhmaṇaṃ matvā 'vadad dattaṃ mayā tava |
vicārayanti kṛtino bahv alpaṃ vā puro 'rthini || 42 ||
ity ukte tu hariḥ prāha sakhyam icche hy ahaṃ tvayā |
indraṃ mayaḥ punaḥ prāha kim anena dvijottama || 43 ||
na tvayā mama vairaṃ bhoḥ svastīty āha harir mayam |
tattvaṃ vadeti sa harir daityenoktaḥ svakaṃ vapuḥ || 44 ||
darśayām āsa daityāya sahasrākṣaṃ yad ucyate |
tataḥ savismayo daityo mayo harim uvāca ha || 45 ||
kim idaṃ vajrapāṇis tvaṃ tavāyogyā kṛtiḥ sakhe || 46 ||
pariṣvajya vihasyātha vṛttam ity abravīd dhariḥ |
kenāpi sādhayanty atra paṇḍitāś ca samīhitam || 47 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti śakrasya mayena mahatī hy abhūt |
indrasya bhavanaṃ gatvā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
kiṃ me kṛtyam iti prāha mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ hariḥ || 49 ||
haraye ca mayo māyāṃ prādāt prītyā tathā hariḥ |
prāptaḥ samprītimān āha kiṃ kṛtyaṃ maya tad vada || 50 ||
tasyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kurvann āssva tatra kiyanti ca || 51 ||
ahāni maghavaṃs tasyā garbham āviśya vajradhṛk |
vardhamānaṃ ca taṃ chindhi yāvad vaśyo 'thavā mṛtim |
prāpnoti tāvad vajreṇa tato na bhavitā ripuḥ || 52 ||
tathety uktvā mayaṃ pūjya maghavān eka eva hi |
vinītavat tadā prāyād ditiṃ mātaram añjasā |
sā na jānāti tac cittaṃ śakrasya dviṣato ditiḥ || 53 ||
garbhe sthitaṃ tu yad bhūtaṃ devendrasya viceṣṭitam |
amoghaṃ tan munes tejaḥ kaśyapasya durāsadam || 54 ||
idam antaram ity uktvā dityāḥ kukṣiṃ samāviśat || 56 ||
antarvarti ca yad bhūtam indraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtāyudham |
kiṃ māṃ na rakṣase vajrin bhrātaraṃ tvaṃ jighāṃsasi |
nāraṇe māraṇād anyat pātakaṃ vidyate mahat || 58 ||
ṛte yuddhān mahābāho śakra yudhyasva nirgate |
mayi tasmān naitad evaṃ tava yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati || 59 ||
vajrapāṇiḥ surendras tvaṃ te na yuktaṃ bhavet prabho || 60 ||
athavā yuddhakāmas tvaṃ mama niṣkramaṇaṃ yathā |
tathā kuru mahābāho mārgād asmād apāsara || 61 ||
avidyaś cāpy aśastraś ca naiva cāyudhasaṅgrahaḥ || 62 ||
tvaṃ vidyāvān vajrapāṇe māṃ nighnan kiṃ na lajjase |
kurvanti garhitaṃ karma na kulīnāḥ kadācana || 63 ||
hatvā vā kiṃ tu jāyeta yaśo vā puṇyam eva vā |
vadhyante bhrātaraḥ kāmād garbhasthāḥ kiṃ nu pauruṣam || 64 ||
yadi vā yuddhabhaktis te mayi bhrātar asaṃśayam |
evambhūtaṃ phalaṃ śakra kasmān māṃ hantum udyataḥ || 66 ||
sa hantā bālakaṃ māṃ vai kiṃ yaśaḥ kiṃ tu pauruṣam || 67 ||
evaṃ bruvantaṃ taṃ garbhaṃ ciccheda kuliśena saḥ |
krodhāndhānāṃ lobhināṃ ca na ghṛṇā kvāpi vidyate || 68 ||
na mamāra tato duḥkhād āhus te bhrātaro vayam |
punaś ciccheda tān khaṇḍān mā vadhīr iti cābruvan || 69 ||
rudanti bahurūpāṇi mā rutety abravīd dhariḥ || 72 ||
tatas te maruto jātā balavanto mahaujasaḥ |
garbhasthā eva te 'nyonyam ūcuḥ śakraṃ gatabhramāḥ || 73 ||
asmatpitā tava bhrātā sakhyaṃ te bahu manyate || 74 ||
asmān upari sasnehaṃ manas te vidmahe mune |
na yat karoti śvapacaḥ pravṛttas tatra vajradhṛk || 75 ||
ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā agastyo 'gāt sasambhramaḥ |
saṅgrāme ripavaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśyeyus te sadā hare |
jīvatām eva maraṇam etad eva hi māninām |
pṛṣṭhaṃ palāyamānānāṃ yat paśyanty ahitā raṇe || 78 ||
sāpi taṃ garbhasaṃsthaṃ ca śaśāpendraṃ ruṣā ditiḥ || 79 ||
na pauruṣaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmāc chāpo 'yaṃ bhavitā tava |
strībhiḥ paribhavaṃ prāpya rājyāt prabhraśyase hare || 80 ||
etasminn antare tatra kaśyapo vai prajāpatiḥ |
agastyāc ca diteś caiva bibhemi kramituṃ bahiḥ || 82 ||
putrakarma ca tad dṛṣṭvā garbhāntaḥsthitim eva ca |
nirgaccha śakra putraitat pāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtavān asi |
yad uktam atra śreyaḥ syāt tatkartāham asaṃśayam || 86 ||
tato mamāntikaṃ prāyāl lokapālaiḥ sa kaśyapaḥ |
sarvaṃ vṛttam athovāca punaḥ papraccha māṃ suraiḥ || 87 ||
garbhasthānāṃ ca sarveṣām indreṇa saha mitratām || 88 ||
indreṇa sahitaḥ śīghraṃ gautamīṃ yāhi mānada |
tatra snātvā maheśānaṃ stuhi sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 91 ||
tataḥ śivaprasādena sarvaṃ śreyo bhaved iti |
tathety uktvā jagāmāsau kaśyapo gautamīṃ tadā || 92 ||
snātvā tuṣṭāva deveśam ebhir eva padakramaiḥ |
gautamī vā puṇyanadī śivo vā karuṇākaraḥ || 93 ||
pāhi godhara lakṣmīśa pāhi śarva gajāmbara || 95 ||
pāhi prabhava sarvasya pāhi pālaka vāsava || 97 ||
pāhi viśveśa siddheśa pāhi pūrṇa namo 'stu te || 98 ||
śarīriṇāṃ kṛpāsindho tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śiva || 99 ||
vareṇa cchandayām āsa kaśyapaṃ taṃ prajāpatim || 100 ||
kaśyapo 'pi śivaṃ prāha vinītavad idaṃ vacaḥ |
sa prāha vistareṇātha indrasya tu viceṣṭitam || 101 ||
śāpaṃ nāśaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ parasparam amitratām |
pāpaprāptiṃ tu śakrasya śāpaprāptiṃ tathaiva ca |
tato vṛṣākapiḥ prāha ditiṃ cāgastyam eva ca || 102 ||
indrasya tu havirbhāgo yatra yatra makhe bhavet |
ādau tu marutas tatra bhaveyur nātra saṃśayaḥ || 105 ||
marudbhiḥ sahitaṃ śakraṃ na jayeyuḥ kadācana |
jetā bhavet sarvadaiva sukhaṃ tiṣṭha prajāpate || 106 ||
vaṃśacchedo vipattiś ca nityaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati || 107 ||
agastyam ṛṣiśārdūlaṃ śambhur apy āha yatnataḥ || 108 ||
na kuryās tvaṃ ca kopaṃ ca śacībhartari vai mune |
śamaṃ vraja mahāprājña marutas tv amarā bhavan || 109 ||
ditiṃ cāpi śivaḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 110 ||
ity evaṃ cintayantī tvaṃ tapase niyatābhavaḥ || 111 ||
tad etat saphalaṃ te 'dya putrā bahuguṇāḥ śubhāḥ |
abhavan balinaḥ śūrās tasmāj jahi manorujam |
anyān api varān subhrūr yācasva gatasambhramā || 112 ||
tad etad vacanaṃ śrutvā devadevasya sā ditiḥ |
loke yad etat paramaṃ yat pitroḥ putradarśanam |
viśeṣeṇa tu tan mātuḥ priyaṃ syāt surapūjita || 114 ||
eko 'pi tanayaḥ kintu bahavaś cet kim ucyate || 115 ||
matputrās te prabhāvāc ca jetāro balino dhruvam |
indrasya bhrātaraḥ satyaṃ putrāś caiva prajāpateḥ || 116 ||
agastyasya prasādāc ca gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ |
yatra deva prasādas te tac chubhaṃ ko 'tra saṃśayaḥ || 117 ||
kṛtārthāhaṃ tathāpi tvāṃ bhaktyā vijñāpayāmy aham |
śṛṇuṣva deva vacanaṃ kuruṣva ca jagaddhitam || 118 ||
vadety uktā jagaddhātrā ditir namrābravīd idam || 119 ||
viśeṣeṇa priyaṃ mātuḥ putraś cet kiṃ nu varṇyate || 120 ||
sa cāpi guṇavāñ śrīmān āyuṣmān yadi jāyate |
kiṃ tu svargeṇa deveśa pārameṣṭhyapadena vā || 121 ||
striyā vā puruṣasyāpi vandhyatvaṃ yadi jāyate || 123 ||
tad atra snānamātreṇa taddoṣo nāśam āpnuyāt |
snātvā tatra phalaṃ dadyāt stotram etac ca yaḥ paṭhet || 124 ||
aputriṇī tv atra snānaṃ kṛtvā putram avāpnuyāt || 125 ||
ṛtusnātā tu yā kācit tatra snātā sutāṃl labhet |
trimāsābhyantaraṃ yā tu gurviṇī bhaktitas tv iha || 126 ||
phalaiḥ snātvā tu māṃ paśyet stotreṇa stauti māṃ tathā |
tasyāḥ śakrasamaḥ putro jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 127 ||
pitṛdoṣaiś ca ye putraṃ na labhante dite śṛṇu |
kiñcit suvarṇadānena tataḥ putro bhaved dhruvam || 129 ||
śrāddhakarmavihīnāś ca teṣāṃ vaṃśo na vardhate || 130 ||
doṣiṇāṃ tu paretānāṃ gatir eṣā bhaved iti |
yaḥ karoty atra gaṅgāyāṃ sa putraśatam āpnuyāt || 135 ||
samprāpya sakalān kāmān ante śivapuraṃ vrajet |
stotreṇānena yaḥ kaścid yatra kvāpi stavīti mām |
ṣaṇmāsāt putram āpnoti api vandhyāpy aśaṅkitam || 136 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ putratīrtham udāhṛtam |
marudbhiḥ saha maitryeṇa mitratīrthaṃ tad ucyate |
aindrīṃ śriyaṃ yatra lebhe tat tīrthaṃ kamalābhidham |
kṛtakṛtyāś ca te jagmuḥ sarva eva yathāgatam |
tīrthānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tatra lakṣam ekaṃ prakīrtitam || 140 ||
Chapter 125: The emnity between Anuhrāda and Ulūka
anuhrāda iti khyātaḥ kapoto balavān abhūt || 2 ||
mṛtyoḥ pautro hy anuhrādo dauhitrī hetir eva ca || 3 ||
kālenātha tayoḥ putrāḥ pautrāś caiva babhūvire |
tasya śatruś ca balavān ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ || 4 ||
tasya putrāś ca pautrāś ca āgneyās te balotkaṭāḥ |
tayoś ca vairam abhavad bahukālaṃ dvijanmanoḥ || 5 ||
tasyāś ca dakṣiṇe kūla ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ || 6 ||
vāsaṃ cakre tatra putraiḥ pautraiś ca dvijasattama |
tayoś ca yuddham abhavad bahukālaṃ viruddhayoḥ || 7 ||
putraiḥ pautraiś ca vṛtayor balinor balibhiḥ saha |
ulūko vā kapoto vā naivāpnoti jayājayau || 8 ||
kapoto yamam ārādhya mṛtyuṃ paitāmahaṃ tathā |
kapoto 'py atha pāśān vai yāmyān ākṣipya śatrave || 11 ||
punas tad abhavad yuddhaṃ purāḍibakayor yathā || 12 ||
hetiḥ kapotakī dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ prāptam antike |
agninā veṣṭyamānāṃś ca putrān dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ |
sā gatvā jvalanaṃ hetis tuṣṭāva vividhoktibhiḥ || 14 ||
rūpaṃ na dānaṃ na parokṣam asti |
hotāraṃ cāpi devānāṃ devānāṃ dūtam eva ca || 16 ||
taṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi ādidevaṃ vibhāvasum |
antaḥ sthitaḥ prāṇarūpo bahiś cānnaprado hi yaḥ |
yo yajñasādhanaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ taṃ dhanañjayam || 17 ||
amogham etad astraṃ me nyastaṃ yuddhe kapotaki |
yatra viśramayed astraṃ tan me brūhi pativrate || 18 ||
mayi viśramyatām astraṃ na putre na ca bhartari |
satyavāg bhava havyeśa jātavedo namo 'stu te || 19 ||
tavāpi bhartṛputrāṇāṃ heti kṣemaṃ dadāmy aham || 20 ||
āgneyam etad astraṃ me na bhartāraṃ sutān api |
na tvāṃ dahet tato yāhi sukhena tvaṃ kapotaki || 21 ||
etasminn antare tatra ulūkī dadṛśe patim |
ulūkī duḥkhitā bhūtvā yamaṃ prāyād bhayāturā || 22 ||
evaṃ bruvatyāṃ tasyāṃ tām āha dakṣiṇadikpatiḥ || 25 ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dāsye 'haṃ manasaḥ priyam || 26 ||
yamasyeti vacaḥ śrutvā sā tam āha pativratā || 27 ||
bhartā me veṣṭitaḥ pāśair daṇḍenābhihatas tava |
tasmād rakṣa suraśreṣṭha putrān bhartāram eva ca || 28 ||
tadvākyāt kṛpayā yukto yamaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ || 29 ||
pāśānāṃ cāpi daṇḍasya sthānaṃ vada śubhānane || 30 ||
sā provāca yamaṃ devaṃ mayi pāśās tvayeritāḥ |
āviśantu jagannātha daṇḍo mayy eva saṃviśet |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān yamas tāṃ kṛpayā punaḥ || 31 ||
tava bhartā ca putrāś ca sarve jīvantu vijvarāḥ || 32 ||
nyavārayad yamaḥ pāśān āgneyāstraṃ tu havyavāṭ |
kapotolūkayoś cāpi prītiṃ vai cakratuḥ surau |
āhatuś ca dvijanmānau vriyatāṃ vara īpsitaḥ || 33 ||
vayaṃ ca pakṣiṇaḥ pāpāḥ kiṃ vareṇa surottamau || 34 ||
ātmārthaṃ yas tu yāceta sa śocyo hi sureśvarau |
jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ tasya yaḥ parārthodyataḥ sadā || 36 ||
agnir āpo raviḥ pṛthvī dhānyāni vividhāni ca |
parārthaṃ vartanaṃ teṣāṃ satāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ || 37 ||
brahmādayo 'pi hi yato yujyante mṛtyunā saha |
evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśau vṛthā svārthapariśramaḥ || 38 ||
janmanā saha yat puṃsāṃ vihitaṃ parameṣṭhinā |
kadācin nānyathā tad vai vṛthā kliśyanti jantavaḥ || 39 ||
tasmād yācāvahe kiñcid dhitāya jagatāṃ śubham |
guṇadāyi tu sarveṣāṃ tad yuvām anumanyatām || 40 ||
tāv āhatur ubhau devau pakṣiṇau lokaviśrutau |
āvābhyām āśramau tīrthe gaṅgāyā ubhaye taṭe |
bhavetāṃ jagatāṃ nāthāv eṣa eva paro varaḥ || 42 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi pūjanam |
sukṛtī duṣkṛtī vāpi yaḥ karoti yathā tathā |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ syād ity eṣa paro varaḥ || 43 ||
evam astu tathā cānyat suprītau tu bravāvahai || 44 ||
teṣāṃ saptasu vaṃśeṣu nākāle mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 45 ||
puruṣo bhājanaṃ ca syāt sarvadā sarvasampadām |
yas tv idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ mṛtyustotraṃ jitātmavān || 46 ||
aṣṭāśītisahasraiś ca vyādhibhir na sa bādhyate |
asmiṃs tīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhau trimāsād gurviṇī satī || 47 ||
arvāgvandhyā ca ṣaṇmāsāt saptāhaṃ snānam ācaret |
vīrasūḥ sā bhaven nārī śatāyuḥ sa suto bhavet || 48 ||
manovākkāyajāt pāpāt snānān mukto bhaven naraḥ || 49 ||
yamavākyād anu tathā havyavāḍ āha pakṣiṇau || 50 ||
matstotraṃ dakṣiṇe tīre ye paṭhanti yatavratāḥ |
teṣām ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ lakṣmīṃ rūpaṃ dadāmy aham || 51 ||
idaṃ stotraṃ tu yaḥ kaścid yatra kvāpi paṭhen naraḥ |
naivāgnito bhayaṃ tasya likhite 'pi gṛhe sthite || 52 ||
