tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca punarāvṛttidurlabham || 2 ||
tatra vṛttāny athākhyāsye gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe |
indreśvaraṃ cottare ca śṛṇu bhaktyā yatavrataḥ || 3 ||
śiraś chittvā tac ca phenaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe || 5 ||
nyapatad bhūmiṃ bhittvā tu rasātalam athāviśat |
taj jalaṃ phenanāmnā tu nadī pheneti gadyate || 7 ||
tasyās tu saṅgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgayā lokaviśrutaḥ |
mārjāraṃ ceti tat tīrthaṃ purā proktaṃ mayā tava |
hanūmataṃ ca tat proktaṃ tatrākhyānaṃ puroditam || 10 ||
vṛṣākapaṃ cābjakaṃ ca tatredaṃ prayataḥ śṛṇu |
hiraṇya iti vikhyāto daityānāṃ pūrvajo balī || 11 ||
tapas taptvā suraiḥ sarvair ajeyo 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ |
tasyāpi balavān putro devānāṃ durjayaḥ sadā || 12 ||
mahāśanir iti khyātas tasya bhāryā parājitā |
jitvā nāgena sahitaṃ śakraṃ pitre nyavedayat || 14 ||
baddhvā hastisamāyuktaṃ svasāraṃ vīkṣya tāṃ tadā |
śacīkāntaṃ tale sthāpya tasya rakṣām athākarot || 16 ||
mahāśanir hariṃ jitvā jetuṃ varuṇam abhyagāt |
udadhiṃ svālayaṃ prādād varuṇas tu mahāśaneḥ |
tayoś ca sakhyam abhavad varuṇasya mahāśaneḥ || 18 ||
vāruṇī cāpi yā kanyā sā priyābhūn mahāśaneḥ |
vīryeṇa yaśasā cāpi śauryeṇa ca balena ca || 19 ||
nirindratvaṃ gate loke devāḥ sarve nyamantrayan || 20 ||
viṣṇur evendradātā syād daityahantā sa eva ca |
mantradṛg vā sa eva syād indraṃ cānyaṃ kariṣyati || 21 ||
evaṃ sammantrya te devā viṣṇor mantraṃ nyavedayan |
prāyād vārīśvaraṃ viṣṇuḥ śvaśuraṃ varuṇaṃ tadā |
varuṇaḥ prāha taṃ daityaṃ yad āgamanakāraṇam || 26 ||
indraṃ dehi mahābāho yas tvayā nirjitaḥ purā |
baddhaṃ rasātalasthaṃ taṃ devānām adhipaṃ sakhe || 27 ||
asmākaṃ sarvadā mānyaṃ dehi tvaṃ mama śatruhan |
baddhvā vimokṣaṇaṃ śatror mahate yaśase satām || 28 ||
tathety uktvā kathañcit sa daityeśo varuṇāya tam |
tvaṃ vai pumān bhavitā śakra sādho || 32 ||
sarvaṃ hi tvā kiṃ tu mukto jaleśād |
sa eva mṛtyur yaśaso yad virodhi |
evam uktvā tu daityeśo varuṇāya mahātmane |
prādād indraṃ punaś cedaṃ vacanaṃ tad abhāṣata || 38 ||
adya prabhṛty asau śiṣya indraḥ syād varuṇo guruḥ |
śvaśuro mama yena tvaṃ muktim āpto 'si vāsava || 39 ||
tathā tvaṃ bhṛtyabhāvena vartethā varuṇaṃ prati |
no ced baddhvā punas tvāṃ vai kṣepsye caiva rasātalam || 40 ||
evaṃ nirbhartsya taṃ śakraṃ hasaṃś cāpi punaḥ punaḥ |
abravīd gaccha gaccheti varuṇaṃ cānumanya tu || 41 ||
sa tu prāptaḥ svanilayaṃ lajjayā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ |
paulomyāṃ prāha tat sarvaṃ yat tac chatruparābhavam || 42 ||
evam uktaḥ kṛtaś caiva śatruṇāhaṃ varānane |
nirvāpayāmi yena svam ātmānaṃ subhage vada || 43 ||
tasmād yasmāt tasya mṛtyur athavāpi parābhavaḥ |
jāyeta śṛṇu tat sarvaṃ vakṣye 'haṃ prītaye tava || 45 ||
hiraṇyasya suto vīraḥ pitṛvyasya suto balī |
tasmān mama syāt sa bhrātā varadānāc ca darpitaḥ || 46 ||
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayām āsa tapasā niyamena ca |
īdṛśaṃ balam āpannaṃ tapasā kiṃ na sidhyati || 47 ||
tasmāt tvayā cittarāgo vismayo vā kathañcana |
na kāryaḥ śṛṇu tatredaṃ kāryaṃ yat tu kramāgatam || 48 ||
evam uktvā tu paulomī prāhendraṃ vinayānvitā || 49 ||
nāsādhyaṃ lokanāthasya viṣṇor bhaktyā harasya ca || 50 ||
punaś cedaṃ mayā kānta śrutam asty atiśobhanam |
strīṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ jānanti striya eva surādhipa || 51 ||
tasmād bhūmes tathā cāpāṃ nāsādhyaṃ vidyate prabho |
tapo vā yajñakarmādi tābhyām eva yato bhavet || 52 ||
tatrāpi tīrthabhūtā tu yā bhūmis tāṃ vrajed bhavān |
tatra viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ pūjya sarvān kāmān avāpsyasi || 53 ||
śrutam asti punaś cedaṃ striyo yāś ca pativratāḥ |
tā eva sarvaṃ jānanti dhṛtaṃ tābhiś carācaram || 54 ||
pṛthivyāṃ sārabhūtaṃ syāt tanmadhye daṇḍakaṃ vanam |
tatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī tatreśaṃ pūjaya prabho || 55 ||
viṣṇuṃ vā jagatām īśaṃ dīnārtārtiharaṃ vibhum |
haro harir vā gaṅgā vā kvāpy anyac charaṇaṃ nahi |
bhaktyā stotraiś ca tapasā kuru caiva mayā saha |
jñātvā śataguṇaṃ tat syād bhāryayā ca tad akṣayam || 59 ||
svalpānām api kāryāṇāṃ nahi siddhis tayā vinā || 60 ||
ekena yat kṛtaṃ karma tasmād ardhaphalaṃ bhavet |
jāyayā tu kṛtaṃ nātha puṣkalaṃ puruṣo labhet || 61 ||
tasmād etat suviditam ardho jāyā iti śruteḥ |
tasmād gaccha mayā tatra kuru puṇyaṃ mahāphalam || 63 ||
tataḥ śatrūn nihatyājau mahat sukham avāpsyasi || 64 ||
tathety uktvā sa guruṇā bhāryayā ca śatakratuḥ |
yayau gaṅgāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ gautamīṃ ceti viśrutām || 65 ||
tapaḥ kartuṃ manaś cakre devadevāya śambhave || 66 ||
gaṅgāṃ natvā tu prathamaṃ snātvā ca sa kṛtāñjaliḥ |
sukhaṃ prabhūtaṃ ca śubhaṃ ca nityaṃ |
eke tarkair vimuhyanti līyante tatra cāpare |
evaṃ tu stuvatas tasya purastād abhavac chivaḥ || 82 ||
kim abhīṣṭaṃ varayase hare vada parāyaṇam || 83 ||
balavān me ripuś cāsīd darśanaiś ca śanir yathā |
tena baddhas talaṃ nītaḥ paribhūtas tv anekadhā || 84 ||
vāksāyakais tathā viddhas tadvadhāya tv iyaṃ kṛtiḥ |
tadarthaṃ jagatām īśa yena jeṣye ripuṃ prabho || 85 ||
tad eva dehi vīryaṃ me yac cānyad ripunāśanam |
jātaḥ parābhavo yasmāt tadvināśe kṛte sati |
punarjātam ahaṃ manye varaṃ kīrtir jayaśriyoḥ || 86 ||
sa śivaḥ śakram āhedaṃ na mayaikena te ripuḥ |
vadham āpnoti tasmāt tvaṃ viṣṇum apy avyayaṃ harim || 87 ||
tataḥ prāpsyasi tasmāc ca mattaś cāpi priyaṃ hare |
mantrābhyāsas tapo vāpi yogābhyasanam eva ca |
saṅgame yatra kutrāpi siddhidaṃ munayo viduḥ || 90 ||
girīṇāṃ gahvare yad vā saritām atha saṅgame || 91 ||
āste tasyāpy ahaṃ toṣam agamaṃ balasūdana |
tena tvaṃ bhāryayā caiva toṣayasva gadādharam || 93 ||
tuṣṭāva devaṃ prayataḥ snātvā puṇye 'tha saṅgame || 94 ||
phenāyāś caiva gaṅgāyās tatra devaṃ janārdanam |
tatas tuṣṭo 'bhavad viṣṇuḥ kiṃ deyaṃ cety abhāṣata |
dehi me śatruhantāram ity āha bhagavān hariḥ || 96 ||
dattam ity eva jānīhi tam uvāca janārdanaḥ |
cakrapāṇiḥ śūladharaḥ sa gatvā tu rasātalam || 98 ||
sakhābhavat sa cendrasya abjakaḥ sa vṛṣākapiḥ || 99 ||
divistho 'pi sadā cendras tam anveti vṛṣākapim |
śacīṃ tāṃ sāntvayann āha śatamanyur hasann idam || 100 ||
nāham indrāṇi śaraṇam ṛte sakhyur vṛṣākapeḥ |
vāri vāpi havir yasya agneḥ priyakaraṃ sadā || 101 ||
nāham anyatra gantāsmi priye cāṅgena te śape |
tasmān nārhasi māṃ vaktuṃ śaṅkayānyatra bhāmini || 102 ||
pativratā priyā me tvaṃ dharme mantre sahāyinī |
sāpatyā ca kulīnā ca tvatto 'nyā kā priyā mama || 103 ||
tathā śivasya devasya prasādāc ca vṛṣākapeḥ |
jalodbhavāc ca me mitrād abjakāl lokaviśrutāt || 105 ||
kiṃ na sādhyaṃ yatra bhāryā bhartṛcittānugāminī || 106 ||
duṣkarā tatra no muktiḥ kintv arthāditrayaṃ śubhe |
tayā hy asādhyaṃ kim iha trilokyām || 108 ||
tasmāt tava dhiyā kānte mamedaṃ śubham āgatam |
itas tavoditaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ nānyad asti me || 109 ||
paraloke ca dharme ca satputrasadṛśaṃ na ca |
gaṅgayā sadṛśaṃ nāsti śṛṇu cānyad varānane || 111 ||
tasmāt tava dhiyā sādhvi sarvam etan manogatam |
avāptaṃ ca śivād viṣṇor gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ || 113 ||
indratvaṃ me sthiraṃ ceto manye mitrabalāt punaḥ |
vṛṣākapir mama sakhā yo jātas tv apsu bhāmini || 114 ||
tvaṃ ca priyasakhī nityaṃ nānyat priyataraṃ mama |
tasmād ebhyaḥ prasādena sarvaṃ cepsitam āptavān |
tasmād etad dhi yāciṣye devān sarvān anukramāt |
indreśvare cābjake ca ubhayos tīrayoḥ surāḥ |
ekatra śaṅkaro devo hy aparatra janārdanaḥ || 118 ||
atra tu snānamātreṇa sarve te muktim āpnuyuḥ |
pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpato muktim āpnuyur ye ca dharmiṇaḥ || 120 ||
teṣāṃ tu paramā muktiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ |
atra kiñcic ca ye dadyur arthibhyas tilamātrakam || 121 ||
dātṛbhyo hy akṣayaṃ tat syāt kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā |
ākhyānaṃ viṣṇuśambhvoś ca jñātvā snānāc ca muktidam |
asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca || 123 ||
puṇyabhājo bhaveyus te tebhyo 'traiva smṛtir bhavet |
bhaviṣyaty evam eveti taṃ devā ṛṣayo 'bruvan |
tathaiva dakṣiṇe tīre tīrthāny ekādaśaiva tu || 126 ||
viśrāmasthānam īśasya viṣṇor brahmaṇa eva ca || 127 ||
Chapter 130: Story of Agastya teaching Āpastamba
śiṣyair anugato dhīmāṃs taṃ praṣṭum upacakrame || 4 ||
trayāṇāṃ ko nu pūjyaḥ syād devānāṃ munisattama |
bhuktir muktiś ca kasmād vā syād anādiś ca ko bhavet || 5 ||
anantaś cāpi ko vipra devānām api daivatam |
yajñaiḥ ka ijyate devaḥ ko vedeṣv anugīyate |
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chettuṃ vadāgastya mahāmune || 6 ||
tatrāpi vaidikaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ mataḥ || 7 ||
vedena gīyate yas tu puruṣaḥ sa parāt paraḥ |
mṛto 'paraḥ sa vijñeyo hy amṛtaḥ para ucyate || 8 ||
yo 'mūrtaḥ sa paro jñeyo hy aparo mūrta ucyate |
brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaś ceti eka eva tridhocyate |
trayāṇām api devānāṃ vedyam ekaṃ paraṃ hi tat || 10 ||
yas tattvaṃ vetti paramaṃ sa ca vidvān na cetaraḥ |
tatra yo bhedam ācaṣṭe liṅgabhedī sa ucyate || 12 ||
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti yaś caiṣāṃ vyāhared bhidam |
trayāṇām api devānāṃ mūrtibhedaḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 13 ||
vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvatra sākāreṣu pṛthak pṛthak |
nirākāraṃ ca yat tv ekaṃ tat tebhyaḥ paramaṃ matam || 14 ||
nānena nirṇayaḥ kaścin mayātra vidito bhavet |
tatrāpy atra rahasyaṃ yat tad vimṛśyāśu kīrtyatām |
etad ākarṇya bhagavān agastyo vākyam abravīt || 16 ||
yadyapy eṣāṃ na bhedo 'sti devānāṃ tu parasparam |
tathāpi sarvasiddhiḥ syāc chivād eva sukhātmanaḥ || 17 ||
prapañcasya nimittaṃ yat taj jyotiś ca paraṃ śivaḥ |
tam eva sādhaya haraṃ bhaktyā paramayā mune |
etac chrutvā muner vākyaṃ parāṃ prītim upāgataḥ |
sṛṣṭyākāras tataḥ śaktaḥ pālanākāra eva ca |
dātā ca hanti sarvaṃ yo yasmād etat samāpyate || 20 ||
āpastambas tadā gaṅgāṃ gatvā snātvā yatavrataḥ |
hutaṃ havir yā ca kṛtā ca pūjā |
yasmāt paraṃ no mahatāṃ mahac ca |
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān āha nārada taṃ munim |
ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca āpastambo 'bravīc chivam || 32 ||
sarvān kāmān āpnuyus te ye snātvā devam īśvaram |
paśyeyur jagatām īśam astv ity āha śivo munim || 33 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham āpastambam udāhṛtam |
tatrākhyānam idaṃ tv āsīd itihāsaṃ purātanam |
tasyāḥ putrau mahāśreṣṭhau śvānau nityaṃ janān anu |
gā rakṣati sma devānāṃ yajñārthaṃ kalpitān paśūn |
rakṣantīṃ tāṃ mahāprājñāḥ śvānayor mātaraṃ śunīm |
pralobhayitvā vividhair vākyair dānaiś ca yatnataḥ || 5 ||
hṛtā gā rākṣasaiḥ pāpaiḥ paśvarthe kalpitāḥ śubhāḥ |
tata āgatya sā devān idam āha kramāc chunī || 6 ||
māṃ baddhvā rākṣasaiḥ pāśais tāḍayitvā prahārakaiḥ |
nītā gā yajñasiddhyarthaṃ kalpitāḥ paśavaḥ surāḥ || 7 ||
tasyā vācaṃ niśamyāśu surān prāha bṛhaspatiḥ || 8 ||
iyaṃ vikṛtarūpāste asyāḥ pāpaṃ ca lakṣaye |
asyā matena tā gāvo nītā nānyena hetunā |
tad guror vacanāc chakraḥ padā tāṃ prāharac chunīm |
padāghātāt tadā tasyā mukhāt kṣīraṃ prasusruve || 10 ||
punaḥ prāha śacībhartā kṣīraṃ pītaṃ tvayā śuni |
rākṣasaiś ca tadā dattaṃ tasmān nītās tu gā mama || 11 ||
nāparādho 'sti me nātha na cānyasyāpi kasyacit |
tasmād ruṣṭo 'si kiṃ nātha ripavo balinas tu te || 12 ||
tato dhyātvā devagurur jñātvā tasyā viceṣṭitam |
satyaṃ śakra tv iyaṃ duṣṭā ripūṇāṃ pakṣakāriṇī || 13 ||
tataḥ śaśāpa tāṃ śakraḥ pāpiṣṭhe tvaṃ śunī bhava |
tadendrasya tu śāpena mānuṣe sā vyajāyata |
yathā śaptā maghavatā pāpāt sā hy atibhīṣaṇā || 15 ||
gāvo yā rākṣasair nītās tāsām ānayanāya ca |
yatnaṃ kurvan surapatir viṣṇave tan nyavedayat || 16 ||
viṣṇur daityāṃś ca danujān gohartṝṃś caiva rākṣasān |
hantuṃ prayatnam akaroj jagṛhe ca mahad dhanuḥ || 17 ||
śārṅgaṃ yal lokavikhyātaṃ daityanāśanam eva ca |
jitāriḥ pūjito devaiḥ svayaṃ sthitvā janārdanaḥ || 18 ||
punar jaghne sa vai viṣṇur gā yair nītāś ca rākṣasaiḥ |
tatra vai daṇḍakāraṇye śārṅgapāṇir iti śrutaḥ || 20 ||
yudhyamānas tato viṣṇur ditijai rākṣasaiḥ saha |
te jagmur dakṣiṇām āśāṃ viṣṇos trāsān mahāmune || 21 ||
anvagacchat tato viṣṇus tān eva parameśvaraḥ |
bāṇais tān vyāhanad viṣṇur gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe |
kṣayaṃ prāptā viṣṇubāṇais tatas te devaśatravaḥ || 24 ||
gāvo labdhā yatra devair bāṇatīrthaṃ tad ucyate |
paśvarthe kalpitā gāvo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe |
pradrutās te surāḥ sarve gaṅgāyāṃ sannyaveśayan || 26 ||
tanmadhye kārayām āsur dvīpaṃ caivāśrayaṃ gavām |
tair gobhis tatra gaṅgāyāṃ surayajño vyajāyata || 27 ||
yajñatīrthaṃ tu tat proktaṃ godvīpaṃ gāṅgamadhyataḥ |
devānāṃ yajanaṃ tac ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham || 28 ||
gorakṣaṃ tu tatas tīrthaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe || 30 ||
mātuḥ śāpaṃ cāparādhaṃ sarvaṃ cāpi savistaram || 31 ||
nivedya tu yathānyāyaṃ kāryaṃ cāpi sukhapradam |
sa tābhyāṃ sahitaḥ sauriḥ pitre sūryāya cābravīt |
śrutvā sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāha gaṅgāyāṃ surasattama || 33 ||
brahmāṇaṃ caiva viṣṇuṃ ca mām īśaṃ ca yathākramam |
stuhi tvaṃ sarvabhāvena bhṛtyau prītim avāpsyataḥ || 35 ||
tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā yamaḥ prītamanās tadā |
tayoś ca prītaye prāyād devatarpaṇayor yamaḥ || 36 ||
śvabhyāṃ ca sahitaḥ śrīmān dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayām āsa bhānuṃ vai dakṣiṇe taṭe || 38 ||
īśānam uttare viṣṇuṃ svayaṃ dharmaḥ pratāpavān |
eṣu snānaṃ tu ye kuryur brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca te kāmān āpnuyuḥ śubhān || 40 ||
bāṇatīrthe tu ye snātvā śārṅgapāṇiṃ smaranti vai |
tebhyo dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyur yuge yuge || 41 ||
gotīrthe brahmatīrthe vā yas tu snātvā yatavrataḥ |
yaḥ kuryāt tena pṛthivī saptadvīpā vasundharā |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tatra kiñcid dattvā vasu dvijam || 43 ||
tad devayajanaṃ prāpya kiñcid dhutvā hutāśane |
yaḥ sakṛt tatra paṭhati gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram |
adhītās tena vedā vai niṣkāmo muktibhājanam || 45 ||
snātvā tu dakṣiṇe kūle śaktiṃ devīṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti putravān dhanavān bhavet || 47 ||
ādityaṃ bhaktito yas tu dakṣiṇe niyato naraḥ |
kūle yaś cottare caiva gaṅgāyā daityasūdanam |
snātvā paśyeta taṃ natvā tasya viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 49 ||
yameśvaraṃ tato yas tu yamatīrthe tu pūjitam |
snātaḥ paśyati yuktātmā sa karoty acireṇa hi || 50 ||
tatra snānena dānena japena stavanena ca |
ityādy aṣṭa sahasrāṇi tīrthāni trīṇi nārada |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvam akṣayapuṇyadam || 52 ||
śravaṇāt pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ paṭhanāt svakulaiḥ saha || 53 ||
teṣām apy atipāpāni nāśaṃ yānti mamājñayā |
tatra snānādi yaḥ kṛtvā kiñcid dattvā yatātmavān || 54 ||
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi kṛtvā natvā surān imān |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśo vīryam āyur ārogyasampadaḥ || 55 ||
putrān pautrān priyāṃ bhāryāṃ labdhvā cānyan manīṣitam |
narakasthān api pitṝṃs tārayitvā kulāni ca |
pāvayitvā priyair yukto hy ante viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ smaret |
tato muktipadaṃ gacched devānāṃ vacanaṃ yathā || 57 ||

ito yāntu tapas taptuṃ gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm |
sa cchedayiṣyaty akhilaṃ saṃśayaṃ vo mahāmatiḥ |

ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ nityaṃ siddhai rājarṣibhis tathā || 1 ||

putraḥ sūryaṃ namaskartuṃ tava yāty anivāritaḥ |

svaduḥkhaṃ gūhamānā sā kadrūṃ prāha suvismitā || 14 ||
tava putrās tu kim iti raviṃ draṣṭuṃ na yānti ca || 15 ||
putrān madīyān subhage naya nāgālayaṃ prati |
samudrasya samīpe tu tad āste śītalaṃ saraḥ || 16 ||
suparṇas tv avahan nāgān kadrūṃ ca vinatā tathā |
surāṇāṃ netu nilayaṃ garuḍo matsutān iti |
putrā me draṣṭum icchanti haṃsaṃ trijagatāṃ gurum |
namaskṛtvā tataḥ sūryam eṣyanti nilayaṃ mama |
haṇḍe tvaṃ naya putrān me sūryamaṇḍalam anvaham || 19 ||
sā vepamānā vinatā dīnā kadrūm abhāṣata || 20 ||
nāhaṃ kṣamā sarpamātaḥ putro me neṣyate sutān |
dṛṣṭvā dinakaraṃ devaṃ punar eva prayāntu te || 21 ||
bhāsvantam ity uvāceyaṃ māṃ sarpajananī haṭhāt |
tathety uktvā sa garuḍo mām ārohantu pannagāḥ || 23 ||
śanaiḥ śanair upagamad yatra devo divākaraḥ |
alaṃ sūryasya sadanaṃ dagdhāḥ sūryasya tejasā |
yāmas tvayā vā garuḍa vihāya tvām athāpi vā || 25 ||
evaṃ nāgair ucyamāna ādityaṃ darśayāmi vaḥ |
dagdhabhogā nipetus te dvīpaṃ taṃ vīraṇaṃ prati |
āśvāsituṃ samāyātā tān sā kadrūḥ suvihvalā || 28 ||
kṛtavān atidurmedhā yeṣāṃ śāntir na vidyate || 29 ||
sa kāśyapo bṛhattejā yady atra syād anāmayam || 30 ||
bhavec caivaṃ kathaṃ śāntiḥ putrāṇāṃ mama bhāmini |
kadrvās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vinatā hy atibhītavat || 31 ||
nedaṃ yuktataraṃ putra bhūṣaṇaṃ vinayena hi |
vartituṃ yuktam ity uktaṃ vaiparītyaṃ na yujyate || 33 ||
nāmitreṣv api kartavyaṃ sadbhir jihmaṃ kadācana |
śrotriye cāntyaje vāpi samaṃ candraḥ prakāśate || 34 ||
kurvanty aniṣṭaṃ kapaṭais ta eva mama putraka |
prasahya kartuṃ ye sākṣād aśaktāḥ puruṣādhamāḥ || 35 ||
vinatā ca tataḥ prāha kadrūṃ tāṃ sarpamātaram || 36 ||
kiṃ kṛtvā śāntir abhyeti putrāṇāṃ te karomi tat |
jarayā tu gṛhītās te vada śāntiṃ karomi tat || 37 ||
kadrūr apy āha vinatāṃ rasātalagataṃ payaḥ |
kadrvās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rasātalagataṃ payaḥ |
tathā vavarṣa parjanyo nāgānām abhavac chivam |
garuḍena yato vāri ānītaṃ tad rasātalāt |
jarāyā vāraṇaṃ yasmān nāgānām abhavac chivam |
tayoś ca saṅgamo yaḥ syāt kiṃ punas tatra varṇyate |
tatra ca snānadānānāṃ phalaṃ ko vaktum īśvaraḥ |
sapādaṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ lakṣam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 48 ||
Chapter 160: Battle between gods and demons
tatra vṛttaṃ samākhyāsye tava yatnena nārada |

vyathitā mām upājagmuḥ kiṃ kṛtyam iti cābruvan |

Chapter 161: Creation of the world from Brahman's primordial sacrifice
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pāpaharaṃ śubham |
vindhyasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sahyo nāma mahāgiriḥ || 2 ||
yatrābhavat tad virajam ekavīrā ca yatra sā || 3 ||
na tasya mahimā kaiścid api śakyo 'nuvarṇitum |
tasmin girau puṇyadeśe śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ || 4 ||
guhyād guhyataraṃ vakṣye sākṣād vedoditaṃ śubham |
yan na jānanti munayo devāś ca pitaro 'surāḥ || 5 ||

Chapter 170: The good merchant and the treacherous Brahmin
yatra yogeśvaro devo gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe || 1 ||

gacchāmo dhanam ādātuṃ parvatān udadhīn api |

dhanaṃ vinā tat kathaṃ syād aho dhiṅ nirdhanaṃ naram || 7 ||
bahv asti kiṃ dhanenādya kariṣye dvijasattama |
sa putraḥ śasyate loke pitṛbhiś cābhinandyate |
yaḥ paitryam abhilipseta na vācāpi tu kuṇḍala || 11 ||

deśād deśāntaraṃ yātau dhanārthaṃ tau vaṇigdvijau |
yena kenāpy upāyena tad dhanaṃ hi samāhare |
manoharās tatra tatra santi kiṃ kriyate mayā || 20 ||
dhanam āhṛtya yatnena yoṣidbhyo yadi dīyate |
bhujyante tās tato nityaṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ hi tat || 21 ||
bhokṣye kathaṃ tu tad vittaṃ vaiśyān maddhastam āgatam || 22 ||
vṛddhiṃ sukham abhīṣṭāni prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ |
nety uvāca tato vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ dharme pratiṣṭhitam |

yato dharmas tato muktiḥ svadharmaḥ kiṃ vinaśyati || 26 ||
evaṃ vivadatos tatra samparāyas tayor abhūt |
yasya pakṣo bhavej jyāyān sa parārtham avāpnuyāt || 27 ||

vedāt tu laukikaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ loke dharmāt sukhaṃ bhavet || 28 ||
evaṃ vivadamānau tāv ūcatuḥ sakalāñ janān |
dharmasya vāpy adharmasya prābalyam anayor bhuvi || 29 ||
tad vadantu yathāvṛttam evam ūcatur ojasā |
tair duḥkham anubhūyate pāpiṣṭhāḥ sukhino janāḥ |
samparāye dhanaṃ sarvaṃ jitaṃ vipre nyavedayat || 31 ||
maṇimantaṃ dvijaḥ prāha kiṃ dharmam anuśaṃsasi |
tatheti cety āha vaiśyo brāhmaṇaḥ punar abravīt || 32 ||
jitaṃ mayā dhanaṃ vaiśya nirlajjaḥ kiṃ nu bhāṣase |
tad brāhmaṇavacaḥ śrutvā vaiśyaḥ sasmita ūcivān || 34 ||
pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu |
tathaiva tān sakhe manye yeṣāṃ dharmo na vidyate || 35 ||

kathaṃ brūṣe dvijaśreṣṭha mayā vijitam ity adaḥ || 36 ||
dvijo vaiśyaṃ punaḥ prāha hastābhyāṃ jāyatāṃ paṇaḥ |

atikopād dvijo vaiśyam ākṣipan punar abravīt || 42 ||

āvayoḥ prāṇayor atra paṇaḥ syād iti vai mune || 47 ||

punar apy ūcatur ubhau lokāṃl lokās tathocire || 48 ||

pṛṣṭo 'si mitra gacchāmi maivaṃ brūyāḥ kathāntare || 50 ||

hā kaṣṭaṃ me kim abhavad dharmaikamanaso hare || 51 ||

sa tu yogeśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi |

jāte kārye tam ādāya himavantam athāgamat || 59 ||

aharniśam asau vaiśyaḥ śrutvā ghoṣam athābravīt || 74 ||
tataḥ savismayo rājā ko bhavān iti cābravīt |

iti saṅkalpya manasi kanyāṃ rājyaṃ ca dattavān |

tena vipreṇa sarvais taiḥ svakīyair gotrajair vṛtaḥ |
yajñān iṣṭvā surān pūjya tataḥ svargam upeyivān || 88 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ mṛtasañjīvanaṃ viduḥ |
Chapter 171: The game of dice between Indra and Pramati

tvam ādityas tvam oṅkāras tvaṃ prāṇas tvaṃ tamisrahā |

tvam ahas tvaṃ tathā rātris tvām āhur vatsaraṃ budhāḥ || 145 ||
tvaṃ kālas tvaṃ kalā kāṣṭhā tvaṃ muhūrtaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ |
tvaṃ bālas tvaṃ tathā vṛddhas tvaṃ pumān strī napuṃsakaḥ || 146 ||
tvaṃ viśvayonis tvaṃ cakṣus tvaṃ sthāṇus tvaṃ śuciśravāḥ |
tvaṃ śāśvatas tvam ajitas tvam upendras tvam uttamaḥ || 147 ||
tvaṃ sarvaviśvasukhadas tvaṃ vedāṅgaṃ tvam avyayaḥ |
tvaṃ vedavedas tvaṃ dhātā vidhātā tvaṃ samāhitaḥ || 148 ||
tvaṃ jalanidhir āmūlaṃ tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ punar vasuḥ |
tvaṃ vaidyas tvaṃ dhṛtātmā ca tvam atīndriyagocaraḥ || 149 ||
tvam agraṇīr grāmaṇīs tvaṃ tvaṃ suparṇas tvam ādimān |
tvaṃ saṅgrahas tvaṃ sumahat tvaṃ dhṛtātmā tvam acyutaḥ || 150 ||
tvaṃ yamas tvaṃ ca niyamas tvaṃ prāṃśus tvaṃ caturbhujaḥ |
tvam evānnāntarātmā tvaṃ paramātmā tvam ucyate || 151 ||
tvaṃ gurus tvaṃ gurutamas tvaṃ vāmas tvaṃ pradakṣiṇaḥ |
tvaṃ pippalas tvam agamas tvaṃ vyaktas tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 152 ||
hiraṇyanābhas tvaṃ devas tvaṃ śaśī tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ |
anirdeśyavapus tvaṃ vai tvaṃ yamas tvaṃ surārihā || 153 ||
tvaṃ ca saṅkarṣaṇo devas tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ sanātanaḥ |
tvaṃ jyeṣṭhas tvaṃ variṣṭhas tvaṃ tvaṃ sahiṣṇuś ca mādhavaḥ |
sahasraśīrṣā tvaṃ devas tvam avyaktaḥ sahasradṛk || 155 ||
sahasrapādas tvaṃ devas tvaṃ virāṭ tvaṃ suraprabhuḥ |
tvam eva tiṣṭhase bhūyo devadeva daśāṅgulaḥ || 156 ||
yad bhūtaṃ tat tvam evoktaḥ puruṣaḥ śakra uttamaḥ |
yad bhāvyaṃ tat tvam īśānas tvam ṛtas tvaṃ tathāmṛtaḥ || 157 ||
tvatto rohaty ayaṃ loko mahīyāṃs tvam anuttamaḥ |
tvaṃ jyāyān puruṣas tvaṃ ca tvaṃ deva daśadhā sthitaḥ || 158 ||
bhāgadvayaṃ ca bhūsaṃsthaṃ caturbhāgo 'py abhūd iha |
tvatto virāṭ samutpanno jagato hṛdi yaḥ pumān |
dhyeyadhyānaparas tvaṃ ca kṛtavān asi cauṣadhīḥ |
tvattaḥ sarvam idaṃ jātaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 164 ||
aniruddhas tvaṃ mādhavas tvaṃ pradyumnaḥ surārihā |
trāhi mām aravindākṣa nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te |
namas te bhagavan viṣṇo namas te puruṣottama || 166 ||
namas te sarvalokeśa namas te kamalālaya |
guṇālaya namas te 'stu namas te 'stu guṇākara || 167 ||
vāsudeva namas te 'stu namas te 'stu surottama |
janārdana namas te 'stu namas te 'stu sanātana || 168 ||
namas te yogināṃ gamya yogāvāsa namo 'stu te |
gopate śrīpate viṣṇo namas te 'stu marutpate || 169 ||
jagatpate jagatsūte namas te jñānināṃ pate |
divaspate namas te 'stu namas te 'stu mahīpate || 170 ||
namas te madhuhantre ca namas te puṣkarekṣaṇa |
kaiṭabhaghna namas te 'stu subrahmaṇya namo 'stu te || 171 ||
namo 'nantāya sūkṣmāya mukhyāya ca varāya ca |
itthaṃ stutas tadā tena prītaḥ provāca mādhavaḥ |
kṣipraṃ brūhi muniśreṣṭha matto yad abhivāñchasi || 178 ||
bhramāmi suciraṃ kālaṃ māyayā mohitas tava |
gato 'smi śaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa mām uddhara bhavārṇavāt || 182 ||
gantum icchāmi paramaṃ padaṃ yat te sanātanam |
bhakto 'si me muniśreṣṭha mām ārādhaya nityaśaḥ |
matprasādād dhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpyasi tvaṃ samīhitam || 184 ||
prāpnuvanti parāṃ siddhiṃ kiṃ punas tvaṃ dvijottama || 185 ||
prāpnoty abhimatāṃ siddhim anyeṣāṃ tatra kā kathā || 186 ||
evam uktvā tu taṃ viprāḥ sa devo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
sarvān kāmān parityajya svasthacitto bhavat punaḥ || 188 ||
avāpa paramaṃ mokṣaṃ surāṇām api durlabham || 190 ||
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi kathāṃ kaṇḍor mahātmanaḥ |
mokṣakṣetraṃ ca paramaṃ devaṃ ca puruṣottamam || 192 ||
ye paśyanti vibhuṃ stuvanti varadaṃ dhyāyanti muktipradaṃ |
te bhuktvā manujendrabhogam amalāḥ svarge ca divyaṃ sukhaṃ |
paścād yānti samastadoṣarahitāḥ sthānaṃ harer avyayam || 194 ||
prītā babhūvuḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vismitāś ca punaḥ punaḥ || 1 ||
vismayo hi na caikasya śrutvā māhātmyam uttamam |
puruṣākhyasya kṣetrasya prītiś ca vadatāṃ vara || 3 ||
cirāt prabhṛti cāsmākaṃ saṃśayo hṛdi vartate |
bhadrāyāś caiva kārtsnyena pṛcchāmas tvāṃ mahāmune || 5 ||
yāni karmāṇi cakrus te samutpannā mahītale |
vistareṇa mune tāni brūhi no vadatāṃ vara || 9 ||
kathaṃ sa bhagavān devaḥ sureśaḥ surasattamaḥ || 10 ||
yaś cakraṃ vartayaty eko mānuṣāṇām anāmayam || 13 ||
sa mānuṣye kathaṃ buddhiṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ |
sa kathaṃ gāṃ gato viṣṇur gopatvam akarot prabhuḥ |
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yo dadhāra cakāra ca || 15 ||
śrīgarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhe striyā bhūcarayā dhṛtaḥ |
yena lokān kramair jitvā tribhir vai tridaśepsayā || 16 ||
sthāpitā jagato mārgās trivargāś cābhavaṃs trayaḥ |
yo 'ntakāle jagat pītvā kṛtvā toyamayaṃ vapuḥ || 17 ||
yaḥ purāṇaḥ purāṇātmā vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ || 18 ||
yaḥ purā puruhūtārthe trailokyam idam avyayam || 19 ||
yena saiṃhavapuḥ kṛtvā dvidhā kṛtvā ca tat punaḥ || 20 ||
yaḥ purā hy analo bhūtvā aurvaḥ saṃvartako vibhuḥ || 21 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ yam āhur vai yuge yuge |
nābhyāṃ padmaṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham || 23 ||
yena te nihatā daityāḥ saṅgrāme tārakāmaye || 24 ||
yaḥ śete śāśvataṃ yogam āsthāya timiraṃ mahat || 26 ||
agnim āhavanīyaṃ ca vedaṃ dīkṣāṃ samid dhruvam || 29 ||
prokṣaṇīyaṃ sruvaṃ caiva āvabhṛthyaṃ tathaiva ca |
avākpāṇis tu yaś cakre havyabhāgabhujas tathā || 30 ||
havyādāṃś ca surāṃś cakre kavyādāṃś ca pitṝn atha |
pātrāṇi dakṣiṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ carūṃś colūkhalāni ca |
yūpaṃ samit sruvaṃ somaṃ pavitrān paridhīn api || 32 ||

adya niṣkauravām urvīṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi tāṃ purīm || 26 ||
karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ droṇam adya bhīṣmaṃ sabāhlikam |
duḥśāsanādīn bhūriṃ ca bhūriśravasam eva ca || 27 ||
vīram ādāya taṃ sāmbaṃ sapatnīkaṃ tataḥ purīm |
āghūrṇitaṃ tat sahasā tato vai hastināpuram |
rāma rāma mahābāho kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ tvayā |
eṣa sāmbaḥ sapatnīkas tava niryātito bala |
tato niryātayām āsuḥ sāmbaṃ patnyā samanvitam |
kṣāntam eva mayety āha balo balavatāṃ varaḥ || 37 ||
adyāpy āghūrṇitākāraṃ lakṣyate tat puraṃ dvijāḥ |
tatas tu kauravāḥ sāmbaṃ sampūjya halinā saha |
kṛtaṃ yad anyad evābhūt tad api śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥ || 1 ||
vairānubandhaṃ balavān sa cakāra surān prati || 3 ||
bibheda sādhumaryādāṃ kṣayaṃ cakre ca dehinām |
tena viprakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagad etad durātmanā || 10 ||
tataḥ sa vānaro 'bhyetya gṛhītvā sīriṇo halam || 13 ||
muśalaṃ ca cakārāsya sammukhaḥ sa viḍambanām |
pānapūrṇāṃś ca karakāṃś cikṣepāhatya vai tadā |
tataḥ kopaparītātmā bhartsayām āsa taṃ balam || 15 ||
tataḥ samutthāya balo jagṛhe muśalaṃ ruṣā || 16 ||
cikṣepa ca sa tāṃ kṣiptāṃ muśalena sahasradhā || 17 ||
tato balena kopena muṣṭinā mūrdhni tāḍitaḥ || 19 ||
praśaśaṃsus tadābhyetya sādhv etat te mahat kṛtam |
jagan nirākṛtaṃ vīra diṣṭyā sa kṣayam āgataḥ || 22 ||
Chapter 210: The destruction of the Yādavas
kṣiteś ca bhāraṃ bhagavān phālgunena samaṃ vibhuḥ |
utsṛjya dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇas tyaktvā mānuṣyam ātmabhūḥ |
svāṃśo viṣṇumayaṃ sthānaṃ praviveśa punar nijam || 4 ||
kathaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ deham utsasarja janārdanaḥ || 5 ||
viśvāmitras tathā kaṇvo nāradaś ca mahāmuniḥ |
iyaṃ strī putrakāmā tu prabho kiṃ janayiṣyati || 8 ||
śāpaṃ dadus tadā viprās teṣāṃ nāśāya suvratāḥ || 9 ||
ity uktās taiḥ kumārās ta ācacakṣur yathātatham |
jajñe tac cairakā cūrṇaṃ prakṣiptaṃ vai mahodadhau || 12 ||
khaṇḍaṃ cūrṇayituṃ śekur naiva te tomarākṛti || 13 ||
tad apy ambunidhau kṣiptaṃ matsyo jagrāha jālibhiḥ |
ghātitasyodarāt tasya lubdho jagrāha taj jarā || 14 ||
naicchat tad anyathā kartuṃ vidhinā yat samāhṛtam || 15 ||
devaiś ca prahito dūtaḥ praṇipatyāha keśavam |
rahasy evam ahaṃ dūtaḥ prahito bhagavan suraiḥ || 16 ||
vijñāpayati vaḥ śakras tad idaṃ śrūyatāṃ prabho || 17 ||
tad atītaṃ jagannātha varṣāṇām adhikaṃ śatam |
idānīṃ gamyatāṃ svargo bhavatā yadi rocate || 20 ||
devair vijñāpito devo 'py athātraiva ratis tava |
yat tvam ātthākhilaṃ dūta vedmi caitad ahaṃ punaḥ |
prārabdha eva hi mayā yādavānām api kṣayaḥ || 22 ||
prāpta evāsmi mantavyo devendreṇa tathā suraiḥ || 25 ||
kṣites tebhyaḥ sa bhāro hi yadūnāṃ samadhīyata || 26 ||
tad etat sumahābhāram avatārya kṣiter aham |
ity ukto vāsudevena devadūtaḥ praṇamya tam |
dvijāḥ sa divyayā gatyā devarājāntikaṃ yayau || 28 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā yādavān āha paśyadhvam atidāruṇān |
mahotpātāñ śamāyaiṣāṃ prabhāsaṃ yāma mā ciram || 30 ||
bhagavan yan mayā kāryaṃ tad ājñāpaya sāmpratam |
manye kulam idaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavān saṃhariṣyati |
ahaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi upasaṃhṛtya vai kulam |
dvārakāṃ ca mayā tyaktāṃ samudraḥ plāvayiṣyati || 35 ||
ity uktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ jagāma sa tadoddhavaḥ |
tatas te yādavāḥ sarve rathān āruhya śīghragān |
prāpya prabhāsaṃ prayatā prītās te kukkurāndhakāḥ |
pibatāṃ tatra vai teṣāṃ saṅgharṣeṇa parasparam |
jaghnuḥ parasparaṃ te tu śastrair daivabalāt kṛtāḥ |
erakā tu gṛhītā tair vajrabhūteva lakṣyate |
aniruddhādayaś cānye pṛthur vipṛthur eva ca || 42 ||
nivārayām āsa harir yādavās te ca keśavam |
sahāyaṃ menire prāptaṃ te nijaghnuḥ parasparam || 44 ||
vadhāya teṣāṃ muśalaṃ muṣṭiloham abhūt tadā || 45 ||
jaghāna tena niḥśeṣān ātatāyī sa yādavān |
jaghnuś ca sahasābhyetya tathānye tu parasparam || 46 ||
cakraṃ gadā tathā śārṅgaṃ tūṇau śaṅkho 'sir eva ca |
kṣaṇamātreṇa vai tatra yādavānām abhūt kṣayaḥ |
ṛte kṛṣṇaṃ mahābāhuṃ dārukaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 49 ||
niṣkramya sa mukhāt tasya mahābhogo bhujaṅgamaḥ |
tam arghyam ādāya tadā jaladhiḥ sammukhaṃ yayau |
dṛṣṭvā balasya niryāṇaṃ dārukaṃ prāha keśavaḥ || 52 ||
yoge sthitvāham apy etat parityajya kalevaram |
vācyaś ca dvārakāvāsī janaḥ sarvas tathāhukaḥ || 54 ||
tasmād rathaiḥ susajjais tu pratīkṣyo hy arjunāgamaḥ || 55 ||
na stheyaṃ dvārakāmadhye niṣkrānte tatra pāṇḍave |
tenaiva saha gantavyaṃ yatra yāti sa kauravaḥ || 56 ||
gatvā ca brūhi kaunteyam arjunaṃ vacanaṃ mama |
ity arjunena sahito dvāravatyāṃ bhavāñ janam |
gṛhītvā yātu vajraś ca yadurājo bhaviṣyati || 58 ||
ity ukto dārukaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṛtvā prāyād yathoditam || 1 ||
sa ca gatvā tathā cakre dvārakāyāṃ tathārjunam |
ānināya mahābuddhiṃ vajraṃ cakre tathā nṛpam || 2 ||
sa mānayan dvijavaco durvāsā yad uvāca ha |
samprāpto vai jarā nāma tadā tatra sa lubdhakaḥ |
gataś ca dadṛśe tatra caturbāhudharaṃ naram |
kṣamyatām ātmapāpena dagdhaṃ mā dagdhum arhasi || 8 ||
tatas taṃ bhagavān āha nāsti te bhayam aṇv api |
gate tasmin sa bhagavān saṃyojyātmānam ātmani |
tyaktvā sa mānuṣaṃ deham avāpa trividhāṃ gatim || 12 ||
Chapter 212: Arjuna's deeds and failures after Kṛṣṇa's death
aṣṭau mahiṣyaḥ kathitā rukmiṇīpramukhās tu yāḥ |
upagṛhya harer dehaṃ viviśus tā hutāśanam || 2 ||
revatī caiva rāmasya deham āśliṣya sattamāḥ |
niścakrāma janaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhītvā vajram eva ca || 5 ||
vajraṃ janaṃ ca kaunteyaḥ pālayañ śanakair yayau || 6 ||
svargaṃ jagāma bho viprāḥ pārijātaś ca pādapaḥ || 7 ||
yasmin dine harir yāto divaṃ santyajya medinīm |
plāvayām āsa tāṃ śūnyāṃ dvārakāṃ ca mahodadhiḥ |
nātikrāmati bho viprās tad adyāpi mahodadhiḥ |
nityaṃ sannihitas tatra bhagavān keśavo yataḥ || 10 ||
nayaty asmān atikramya dhig etat kriyatāṃ balam || 15 ||
karṇādīṃś ca na jānāti balaṃ grāmanivāsinām || 16 ||
balajyeṣṭhān narān anyān grāmyāṃś caiva viśeṣataḥ |
sarvān evāvajānāti kiṃ vo bahubhir uttaraiḥ || 17 ||
tato nivṛttaḥ kaunteyaḥ prāhābhīrān hasann iva || 18 ||
avajñāya vacas tasya jagṛhus te tadā dhanam |
tato 'rjuno dhanur divyaṃ gāṇḍīvam ajaraṃ yudhi |
āropayitum ārebhe na śaśāka sa vīryavān || 21 ||
cakāra sajjaṃ kṛcchrāt tu tad abhūc chithilaṃ punaḥ |
na sasmāra tathāstrāṇi cintayann api pāṇḍavaḥ || 22 ||
śarān mumoca caiteṣu pārthaḥ śeṣān sa harṣitaḥ |
na bhedaṃ te paraṃ cakrur astā gāṇḍīvadhanvanā || 23 ||
vahninā cākṣayā dattāḥ śarās te 'pi kṣayaṃ yayuḥ |
acintayat tu kaunteyaḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva hi tad balam |
yan mayā śarasaṅghātaiḥ sabalā bhūbhṛto jitāḥ || 25 ||
jaghāna dasyūṃs te cāsya prahārāñ jahasur dvijāḥ || 27 ||
jagmur ādāya te mlecchāḥ samantān munisattamāḥ || 28 ||
tataḥ sa duḥkhito jiṣṇuḥ kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭam iti bruvan |
aho bhagavatā tena mukto 'smīti ruroda vai || 29 ||
tad dhanus tāni cāstrāṇi sa rathas te ca vājinaḥ |
sarvam ekapade naṣṭaṃ dānam aśrotriye yathā || 30 ||
aho cāti balaṃ daivaṃ vinā tena mahātmanā |
tau bāhū sa ca me muṣṭiḥ sthānaṃ tat so 'smi cārjunaḥ |
puṇyeneva vinā tena gataṃ sarvam asāratām || 32 ||
vinā tena yad ābhīrair jito 'haṃ katham anyathā || 33 ||
itthaṃ vadan yayau jiṣṇur indraprasthaṃ purottamam |
sa dadarśa tato vyāsaṃ phālgunaḥ kānanāśrayam |
uvāca pārthaṃ vicchāyaḥ katham atyantam īdṛśaḥ || 36 ||
bhuṅkte pradāya viprebhyo miṣṭam ekam atho bhavān |
duṣṭacakṣur hato vāpi niḥśrīkaḥ katham anyathā || 40 ||
tenātīvāsi vicchāyo nyūnair vā yudhi nirjitaḥ || 41 ||
tataḥ pārtho viniḥśvasya śrūyatāṃ bhagavann iti |
yad balaṃ yac ca nas tejo yad vīryaṃ yat parākramaḥ |
yā śrīś chāyā ca naḥ so 'smān parityajya harir gataḥ || 43 ||
hīnā vayaṃ mune tena jātās tṛṇamayā iva || 44 ||
astrāṇāṃ sāyakānāṃ ca gāṇḍīvasya tathā mama |
sāratā yābhavan mūrtā sa gataḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 45 ||
yasyāvalokanād asmāñ śrīr jayaḥ sampad unnatiḥ |
na tatyāja sa govindas tyaktvāsmān bhagavān gataḥ || 46 ||
yatprabhāvena nirdagdhāḥ sa kṛṣṇas tyaktavān bhuvam || 47 ||
vibhāti tāta naiko 'haṃ virahe tasya cakriṇaḥ || 48 ||
vinā tenādya kṛṣṇena gopālair asmi nirjitaḥ || 49 ||
gāṇḍīvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu khyātaṃ yad anubhāvataḥ |
mama tena vinābhīrair laguḍais tu tiraskṛtam || 50 ||
niḥśrīkatā na me citraṃ yaj jīvāmi tad adbhutam |
śrutvāhaṃ tasya tad vākyam abravaṃ dvijasattamāḥ |
alaṃ te vrīḍayā pārtha na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi |
kālo bhavāya bhūtānām abhavāya ca pāṇḍava |
kālamūlam idaṃ jñātvā kuru sthairyam ato 'rjuna || 56 ||
nadyaḥ samudrā girayaḥ sakalā ca vasundharā |
devā manuṣyāḥ paśavas taravaś ca sarīsṛpāḥ || 57 ||
sṛṣṭāḥ kālena kālena punar yāsyanti saṅkṣayam |
kālātmakam idaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā śamam avāpnuhi || 58 ||
bhārākrāntā dharā yātā devānāṃ sannidhau purā |
tac ca niṣpāditaṃ kāryam aśeṣā bhūbhṛto hatāḥ |
na kiñcid anyat kartavyam asya bhūmitale 'rjuna |
tato gataḥ sa bhagavān kṛtakṛtyo yathecchayā || 62 ||
sṛṣṭiṃ sarge karoty eṣa devadevaḥ sthitiṃ sthitau |
ante tāpasamartho 'yaṃ sāmprataṃ vai yathā kṛtam || 63 ||
tasmāt pārtha na santāpas tvayā kāryaḥ parābhavāt |
teṣām arjuna kālotthaḥ kiṃ nyūnābhibhavo na saḥ || 65 ||
bhavodbhave ca kaunteya sahāyas te janārdanaḥ |
kaḥ śraddadhyāt sagāṅgeyān hanyās tvaṃ sarvakauravān |
ābhīrebhyaś ca bhavataḥ kaḥ śraddadhyāt parābhavam || 69 ||
tvayā yat kauravā dhvastā yad ābhīrair bhavāñ jitaḥ || 70 ||
gṛhītā dasyubhir yac ca rakṣitā bhavatā striyaḥ |
tad apy ahaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ kathayāmi tavārjuna || 71 ||
bahūn varṣagaṇān pārtha gṛṇan brahma sanātanam || 72 ||
babhūva tatra gacchantyo dadṛśus taṃ surastriyaḥ || 73 ||
tuṣṭuvus taṃ mahātmānaṃ praśaśaṃsuś ca pāṇḍava || 74 ||
yathā yathā prasanno 'bhūt tuṣṭuvus taṃ tathā tathā |
sarvās tāḥ kauravaśreṣṭha variṣṭhaṃ taṃ dvijanmanām || 76 ||
mattas tad vriyatāṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmy api durlabham || 77 ||
prasanne tvayy asamprāptaṃ kim asmākam iti dvijāḥ || 79 ||
itarās tv abruvan vipra prasanno bhagavan yadi |
tad icchāmaḥ patiṃ prāptuṃ viprendra puruṣottamam || 80 ||
evaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā uttatāra jalān muniḥ |
tam uttīrṇaṃ ca dadṛśur virūpaṃ vakram aṣṭadhā || 81 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gūhamānānāṃ yāsāṃ hāsaḥ sphuṭo 'bhavat |
tāḥ śaśāpa muniḥ kopam avāpya kurunandana || 82 ||
bhavatībhiḥ kṛtā tasmād eṣa śāpaṃ dadāmi vaḥ || 83 ||
ity udīritam ākarṇya munis tābhiḥ prasāditaḥ |
punaḥ surendralokaṃ vai prāha bhūyo gamiṣyatha || 85 ||
evaṃ tasya muneḥ śāpād aṣṭāvakrasya keśavam |
bhartāraṃ prāpya tāḥ prāptā dasyuhastaṃ varāṅganāḥ || 86 ||
tat tvayā nātra kartavyaḥ śoko 'lpo 'pi hi pāṇḍava |
balaṃ tejas tathā vīryaṃ māhātmyaṃ copasaṃhṛtam || 88 ||
jātasya niyato mṛtyuḥ patanaṃ ca tathonnateḥ |
vijñāya na budhāḥ śokaṃ na harṣam upayānti ye |
teṣām evetare ceṣṭāṃ śikṣantaḥ santi tādṛśāḥ || 90 ||
tasmāt tvayā naraśreṣṭha jñātvaitad bhrātṛbhiḥ saha |
tad gaccha dharmarājāya nivedyaitad vaco mama |
paraśvo bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ gatiṃ vīra yathā kuru || 92 ||
ity ukto dharmarājaṃ tu samabhyetya tathoktavān |
dṛṣṭaṃ caivānubhūtaṃ vā kathitaṃ tad aśeṣataḥ || 93 ||
rājye parīkṣitaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ pāṇḍusutā vanam || 94 ||
ity evaṃ vo muniśreṣṭhā vistareṇa mayoditam |
jātasya ca yador vaṃśe vāsudevasya ceṣṭitam || 95 ||
rāmasya ca muniśreṣṭha tvayoktaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 1 ||
tasmād brūhi mahābhāga bhūyo devasya ceṣṭitam || 2 ||
satāṃ kathayatām eva varāha iti naḥ śrutam || 3 ||
na jānīmo 'sya caritaṃ na vidhiṃ na ca vistaram |
kimātmako varāho 'sau kā mūrtiḥ kā ca devatā |
kimācāraprabhāvo vā kiṃ vā tena tadā kṛtam || 5 ||
yathā nārāyaṇo brahman vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ |
śrotuṃ no vartate buddhir hareḥ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ || 8 ||
karmaṇām ānupūrvyā ca prādurbhāvāś ca ye vibho |
yā vāsya prakṛtir brahmaṃs tāś cākhyātuṃ tvam arhasi || 9 ||
yathāśaktyā tu vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 10 ||
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvaśravaṇe diṣṭyā vo matir utthitā |
tasmād viṣṇoḥ samastā vai śṛṇudhvaṃ yāḥ pravṛttayaḥ || 11 ||
havanaṃ savanaṃ caiva hotāraṃ havyam eva ca |
pātrāṇi ca pavitrāṇi vediṃ dīkṣāṃ samit sruvam || 14 ||
adhvaryuṃ sāmagaṃ vipraṃ sadasyaṃ sadanaṃ sadaḥ || 15 ||
yūpaṃ cakraṃ dhruvāṃ darvīṃ carūṃś colūkhalāni ca |
prāgvaṃśaṃ yajñabhūmiṃ ca hotāraṃ ca paraṃ ca yat || 16 ||
prāyaścittāni vārghyaṃ ca sthaṇḍilāni kuśās tathā || 17 ||
mantrayajñavahaṃ vahniṃ bhāgaṃ bhāgavahaṃ ca yat |
āhur vedavido viprā yaṃ yajñe śāśvataṃ prabhum |
bhūyaś caiva bhaviṣyanti hy evam āha pitāmahaḥ || 20 ||
yat pṛcchadhvaṃ mahābhāgā divyāṃ puṇyām imāṃ kathām |
prādurbhāvāṃś ca vakṣyāmi puṇyān divyān guṇānvitān || 24 ||
brahmā ca kapilaś caiva tryambakas tridaśās tathā |
devāḥ saptarṣayaś caiva nāgāś cāpsarasas tathā || 26 ||
hatau bhagavatā tena tayor dattvāmitaṃ varam || 29 ||
puṣkare tatra sambhūtā devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tathā || 30 ||
yatra viṣṇuḥ suraśreṣṭho vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ || 32 ||
vārāha eṣa kathito nārasiṃhas tato dvijāḥ |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca |
tataḥ śamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa caiva hi |
prīto 'bhavat tatas tasya tapasā niyamena ca || 46 ||
taṃ vai svayambhūr bhagavān svayam āgamya bho dvijāḥ |
ādityair vasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ marudbhir daivatais tathā |
diśābhiḥ pradiśābhiś ca nadībhiḥ sāgarais tathā |
nakṣatraiś ca muhūrtaiś ca khecaraiś ca mahāgrahaiḥ || 49 ||
devarṣibhis tapovṛddhaiḥ siddhair vidvadbhir eva ca |
carācaraguruḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ surais tathā |
brahmā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho daityaṃ vacanam abravīt || 51 ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmam āpnuhi || 52 ||
ṛṣayo vātha māṃ śāpaiḥ kruddhā lokapitāmaha || 53 ||
śapeyus tapasā yuktā vara eṣa vṛto mayā |
na śastreṇa na vāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena vā || 54 ||
na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa na caivordhvaṃ na cāpy adhaḥ |
yo māṃ nāśayituṃ śaktaḥ sa me mṛtyur bhaviṣyati |
bhaveyam aham evārkaḥ somo vāyur hutāśanaḥ || 56 ||
salilaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca ākāśaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ |
ahaṃ krodhaś ca kāmaś ca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ |
ete divyā varās tāta mayā dattās tavādbhutāḥ |
sarvān kāmān imāṃs tāta prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 58 ||
evam uktvā tu bhagavāñ jagāmāśu pitāmahaḥ |
tato devāś ca nāgāś ca gandharvā munayas tathā |
tat prasīdāśu bhagavan vadho 'py asya vicintyatām || 61 ||
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānām avyaktaṃ prakṛtir dhruvam || 62 ||
tato lokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
avaśyaṃ tridaśās tena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam |
tapaso 'nte ca bhagavān vadhaṃ viṣṇuḥ kariṣyati || 64 ||
etac chrutvā surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ paṅkajajanmanaḥ |
svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmus te vai mudānvitāḥ || 65 ||
labdhamātre vare cāpi sarvāḥ so 'bādhata prajāḥ |
trailokyaṃ vaśam ānīya svarge vasati so 'suraḥ || 68 ||
yajñīyān akarod daityān ayajñīyāś ca devatāḥ || 69 ||
ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśve ca marutas tathā |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtam |
nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 71 ||
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devas tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ || 72 ||
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo dhātā brahmādīnāṃ surottama |
kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhavasva naḥ || 73 ||
bhayaṃ tyajadhvam amarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmy aham |
tathaiva tridivaṃ devāḥ pratilapsyatha mā ciram || 74 ||
evam uktvā tu bhagavān visṛjya tridaśeśvarān |
nṛsiṃha eṣa kathito bhūyo 'yaṃ vāmanaḥ paraḥ |
baler balavato yajñe balinā viṣṇunā purā |
vikramais tribhir akṣobhyāḥ kṣobhitās te mahāsurāḥ || 81 ||
vipracittiḥ śivaḥ śaṅkur ayaḥśaṅkus tathaiva ca |
puṣkaraḥ puṣkalaś caiva śāśvo 'śvapatir eva ca || 83 ||
śarabhaḥ śalabhaś caiva kupathaḥ krodhanaḥ krathaḥ |
vāyur gariṣṭho namuciḥ sambaro viskaro mahān || 86 ||
kālakaḥ kālakopaś ca vṛtraḥ krodho virocanaḥ || 87 ||
gariṣṭhaś ca variṣṭhaś ca pralambanarakāv ubhau |
asilomā pulomā ca bāṣkalaḥ pramado madaḥ |
svamiśraḥ kālavadanaḥ karālaḥ keśir eva ca || 89 ||
ekākṣaś candramā rāhuḥ saṃhrādaḥ sambaraḥ svanaḥ |
bhīmā makaravaktrāś ca krauñcavaktrāś ca dānavāḥ || 96 ||
svāny āyudhāni saṅgṛhya pradīptāni ca tejasā |
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahābhīmaṃ jahārāśu sa medinīm || 101 ||
nabhaḥ prakramamāṇasya nābhyāṃ kila tathā sthitau || 102 ||
hṛtvā sa medinīṃ kṛtsnāṃ hatvā cāsurapuṅgavān |
dadau śakrāya vasudhāṃ viṣṇur balavatāṃ varaḥ || 104 ||
eṣa vo vāmano nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ |
vedavidbhir dvijair etat kathyate vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ || 105 ||
dattātreya iti khyātaḥ kṣamayā parayā yutaḥ || 106 ||
tena naṣṭeṣu vedeṣu prakriyāsu makheṣu ca |
cāturvarṇye ca saṅkīrṇe dharme śithilatāṃ gate || 107 ||
sayajñāḥ sakriyā vedāḥ pratyānītā hi tena vai |
etad bāhudvayaṃ yat te tat te mama kṛte nṛpa |
śatāni daśa bāhūnāṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 111 ||
eṣa vo vaiṣṇavaḥ śrīmān prādurbhāvo 'dbhutaḥ śubhaḥ |
triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā || 117 ||
vāraṇāṃs turagāñ śubhrān rathāṃś ca rathināṃ varaḥ |
hiraṇyam akṣayaṃ dhenur gajendrāṃś ca mahīpatiḥ || 120 ||
caramāṇas tapo ghoraṃ jāmadagnyaḥ punaḥ prabhuḥ |
āste vai devavac chrīmān mahendre parvatottame || 122 ||
loke rāma iti khyātas tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ || 125 ||
dharmasya ca vivṛddhyarthaṃ jajñe tatra mahāyaśāḥ || 126 ||
tam apy āhur manuṣyendraṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam |
caturdaśa vane taptvā tapo varṣāṇi rāghavaḥ || 128 ||
rūpiṇī tasya pārśvasthā sīteti prathitā jane |
pūrvoditā tu yā lakṣmīr bhartāram anugacchati || 129 ||
janasthāne vasan kāryaṃ tridaśānāṃ cakāra saḥ |
jaghāna sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ sasainyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ yudhi || 134 ||
madhoś ca tanayo dṛpto lavaṇo nāma dānavaḥ |
mārīcaś ca subāhuś ca balena balināṃ varau || 138 ||
nihatau ca nirāśau ca kṛtau tena mahātmanā |
virādhaś ca kabandhaś ca rākṣasau bhīmavikramau |
bhagnaṃ māheśvaraṃ cāpaṃ krīḍatā līlayā purā || 143 ||
etāni kṛtvā karmāṇi rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
na vittaharaṇaṃ cāsīd rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati || 145 ||
sarvam āsīc chubhaṃ tatra rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati || 146 ||
na cāpi vṛddhā bālānāṃ pretakāryāṇi cakrire || 147 ||
brahmacaryaparaṃ kṣatraṃ viśas tu kṣatriye ratāḥ |
śūdrāś caiva hi varṇāṃs trīñ śuśrūṣanty anahaṅkṛtāḥ || 148 ||
nāryo nātyacaran bhartṝn bhāryāṃ nātyacarat patiḥ |
sarvam āsīj jagad dāntaṃ nirdasyur abhavan mahī || 149 ||
arogāḥ prāṇinaś cāsan rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati |
devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 151 ||
gāthām apy atra gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ || 152 ||
ati candraṃ ca sūryaṃ ca rāmo dāśarathir babhau || 156 ||
hitvāyodhyāṃ divaṃ yāto rāghavo hi mahābalaḥ || 157 ||
rāvaṇaṃ sagaṇaṃ hatvā divam ācakrame vibhuḥ || 158 ||
yatra śālvaṃ ca caidyaṃ ca kaṃsaṃ dvividam eva ca |
narakaś ca hataḥ saṅkhye yavanaś ca mahābalaḥ || 162 ||
durācārāś ca nihitāḥ pārthivā ye mahītale || 163 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo divyā devagaṇair vṛtāḥ || 165 ||
Chapter 214: The path to Yama's world; the gates to his city
mune tvanmukhagītasya tathā kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 1 ||
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ karmaṇo gatim |
vetsi sarvaṃ mune tena pṛcchāmas tvāṃ mahāmatim || 2 ||
kathaṃ tena narā yānti mārgeṇa yamasādanam |
pramāṇaṃ caiva mārgasya brūhi no vadatāṃ vara || 4 ||
mune pṛcchāma sarvajña brūhi sarvam aśeṣataḥ |
mānuṣasya ca yāmyasya lokasya kiyad antaram || 6 ||
kathaṃ ca svargatiṃ yānti narakaṃ kena karmaṇā |
kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ vā ko varṇas tūbhayor api |
saṃsāracakram ajaraṃ sthitir yasya na vidyate || 9 ||
so 'haṃ vadāmi vaḥ sarvaṃ yamamārgasya nirṇayam |
svarūpaṃ caiva mārgasya yan māṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ |
tad avaśyaṃ hi gantavyaṃ prāṇibhir jīvasañjñakaiḥ |
dvāviṃśatiś ca narakā yamasya viṣaye sthitāḥ |
narako rauravo raudraḥ śūkaras tāla eva ca |
kīṭādaḥ kṛmibhakṣaś ca nālābhakṣo bhramas tathā |
nadyaḥ pūyavahāś cānyā rudhirāmbhas tathaiva ca || 16 ||
na tatra vṛkṣacchāyā vā na taḍāgāḥ sarāṃsi ca |
na vāpyo dīrghikā vāpi na kūpo na prapā sabhā || 18 ||
na maṇḍapo nāyatanaṃ na nadyo na ca parvatāḥ |
na kiñcid āśramasthānaṃ vidyate tatra vartmani || 19 ||
avaśyam eva gantavyaḥ sa sarvais tu mahāpathaḥ || 20 ||
pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe vā madhyāhne vā tathā punaḥ || 23 ||
vṛddhair vā madhyamair vāpi yauvanasthais tathaiva ca || 24 ||
garbhavāse 'tha bālye vā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ |
pravāsasthair gṛhasthair vā parvatasthaiḥ sthale 'pi vā || 25 ||
kṣetrasthair vā jalasthair vā gṛhamadhyagatais tathā |
jāgradbhir vā prasuptair vā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ |
ihānubhūya nirdiṣṭam āyur jantuḥ svayaṃ tadā || 27 ||
tasyānte ca svayaṃ prāṇair anicchann api mucyate |
jalam agnir viṣaṃ śastraṃ kṣud vyādhiḥ patanaṃ gireḥ || 28 ||
nimittaṃ kiñcid āsādya dehī prāṇair vimucyate |
tena bhuṅkte sa kṛcchrāṇi pāpakartā naro bhṛśam |
sukhāni dhārmiko hṛṣṭa iha nīto yamakṣaye || 31 ||
udāno nāma pavanas tataś cordhvaṃ pravartate |
dattāḥ sa tasyām āhlādam āpadi pratipadyate || 34 ||
so 'pi tṛptim avāpnoti vināpy annena vai tadā || 35 ||
yenānṛtāni noktāni prītibhedaḥ kṛto na ca |
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaś ca sukhamṛtyuṃ sa gacchati || 36 ||
śuklā vadānyā hrīmantas te narāḥ sukhamṛtyavaḥ || 37 ||
yaḥ kāmān nāpi saṃrambhān na dveṣād dharmam utsṛjet |
yathoktakārī saumyaś ca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyum ṛcchati || 38 ||
kūṭasākṣī mṛṣāvādī yo gurur nānuśāsti vai || 41 ||
te mohamṛtyavaḥ sarve tathā ye vedanindakāḥ |
prāpteṣu dṛkpathaṃ teṣu jāyate tasya vepathuḥ || 43 ||
sā tu vāg asphuṭā viprā ekavarṇā vibhāvyate || 44 ||
dṛṣṭir vibhrāmyate trāsāt kāsāvṛṣṭy aty athānanam |
tataḥ sa vedanāviṣṭaṃ tac charīraṃ vimuñcati || 45 ||
tato dūto yamasyātha pāśair badhnāti dāruṇaiḥ || 47 ||
mātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiś caiva bhrātṛbhir mātulais tathā |
dāraiḥ putrair vayasyaiś ca gurubhis tyajyate bhuvi || 50 ||
dṛśyamānaś ca tair dīnair aśrupūrṇekṣaṇair bhṛśam |
duḥsahaṃ ca durantaṃ ca durnirīkṣaṃ durāsadam |
kṛṣyamāṇāś ca tair bhūtair yāmyaiḥ pāśais tu saṃyatāḥ |
mudgarais tāḍyamānāś ca nīyante taṃ mahāpatham || 54 ||
uṣṭreṣu vānareṣv anye vṛścikeṣu vṛkeṣu ca || 56 ||
kecid dvibāhavas tatra tathānye ca caturbhujāḥ |
yat tac charīram ādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmajam |
tad asya nīyate jantor yamasya sadanaṃ prati || 70 ||
baddhvā tat kālapāśaiś ca nigaḍair vajraśṛṅkhalaiḥ |
praskhalantaṃ rudantaṃ ca ākrośantaṃ muhur muhuḥ |
hā tāta mātaḥ putreti vadantaṃ karmadūṣitam || 72 ||
āhatya niśitaiḥ śūlair mudgarair niśitair ghanaiḥ |
sa muhyamāno duḥkhārtaḥ pratapaṃś ca itas tataḥ |
kvacid bhītaiḥ kvacit trastaiḥ praskhaladbhiḥ kvacit kvacit |
kūjadbhiḥ krandamānaiś ca vikrośadbhiś ca visvaram |
vedanārtaiś ca sadbhiś ca gantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ || 83 ||
śvānair vyāghrair vṛkaiḥ kaṅkair bhakṣyamāṇaiś ca pāpibhiḥ || 85 ||
viśvastaṃ svāminaṃ mitraṃ striyaṃ vā yas tu ghātayet || 88 ||
śastrair nikṛtyamānaiś ca gantavyaṃ cāturair naraiḥ |
ghātayanti ca ye jantūṃs tāḍayanti nirāgasaḥ || 89 ||
rākṣasair bhakṣyamāṇās te yānti yāmyapathaṃ narāḥ |
te yānti vidrutā nagnāḥ pretībhūtā yamālayam |
vāso dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā gṛhakṣetram athāpi vā || 91 ||
pāṣāṇair laguḍair daṇḍais tāḍyamānais tu jarjaraiḥ || 92 ||
vahadbhiḥ śoṇitaṃ bhūri gantavyaṃ tu yamālayam |
kiṅkarair bhīṣaṇaiś caṇḍais tāḍyamānāś ca dāruṇaiḥ || 95 ||
yadaiva krandate jantur duḥkhārtaḥ patitaḥ kvacit || 100 ||
evaṃ santāḍyamānaś ca lubdhaḥ pāpeṣu yo 'nayaḥ || 101 ||
sarvair eva hi gantavyam adhvānaṃ tat sudurgamam || 102 ||
sā purī vividhaiḥ saṅghair ghorā ghoraiḥ samākulā || 106 ||
praveśas tena devānām ṛṣīṇāṃ yogināṃ tathā |
grīṣme vāripradā ye ca śīte cāgnipradā narāḥ || 112 ||
śrāntasaṃvāhakā ye ca priyavādaratāś ca ye |
ye ca dānaratāḥ śūrā mātāpitṛparāś ca ye || 113 ||
paścimaṃ tu mahādvāraṃ puryā ratnair vibhūṣitam || 114 ||
sarvatīrthaplutā ye ca pañcāgner ye ca sevakāḥ |
prasthāne ye mṛtā vīrā mṛtāḥ kālañjare girau || 117 ||
agnau vipannā ye vīrāḥ sādhitaṃ yair anāśakam |
te viśanti narāḥ śūrāḥ paścimena tapodhanāḥ |
vilumpadbhir vṛkair vyāghrair ṛkṣaiḥ siṃhaiḥ sajambukaiḥ || 121 ||
praveśas tena vai nityaṃ sarveṣām apakāriṇām || 122 ||
ye ghātayanti viprān gā bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ tathāturam |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva ye vadanti ca pauruṣam || 127 ||
dakṣiṇena tu te sarve dvāreṇa praviśanti vai || 128 ||
Chapter 215: Punishment of the wicked in Yama's world; description of hells
śrotum icchāma tad brūhi vistareṇa tapodhana || 1 ||
sughoraṃ tan mahāghoraṃ dvāraṃ vakṣyāmi bhīṣaṇam |
bhūtapretapiśācaiś ca vṛtaṃ cānyaiś ca rākṣasaiḥ || 3 ||
mohaṃ gacchanti sahasā trāsād vipralapanti ca || 4 ||
tatas tāñ śṛṅkhalaiḥ pāśair baddhvā karṣanti nirbhayāḥ |
tāḍayanti ca daṇḍaiś ca bhartsayanti punaḥ punaḥ || 5 ||
labdhasañjñās tatas te vai rudhireṇa pariplutāḥ |
vrajanti dakṣiṇaṃ dvāraṃ praskhalantaḥ pade pade || 6 ||
kvacit paṅkena nicitā niruttāraiś ca khātakaiḥ |
sutaptavālukābhiś ca tathā tīkṣṇaiś ca śaṅkubhiḥ || 10 ||
kvacit taptaśilābhiś ca kvacid vyāptaṃ himena ca || 11 ||
kvacid duṣṭāmbunā vyāptaṃ kvacit karṣāgninā punaḥ || 12 ||
kvacit siṃhair vṛkair vyāghrair daśakīṭaiś ca dāruṇaiḥ |
mahāśṛṅgaiś ca mahiṣair uṣṭrair mattaiś ca khādanaiḥ || 15 ||
ḍākinībhiś ca raudrābhir vikarālaiś ca rākṣasaiḥ |
vyādhibhiś ca mahāraudraiḥ pīḍyamānā vrajanti te || 16 ||
meghāravaiḥ sughoraiś ca vitrāsyante muhur muhuḥ || 20 ||
samantād dīryamāṇāś ca śuṣyante saṅkucanti ca || 22 ||
nīyante dehinaḥ sarve ye mūḍhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ || 24 ||
śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi rudanti ca muhur muhuḥ |
bhakṣyān uccāvacān dṛṣṭvā bhojyān peyāṃś ca puṣkalān || 30 ||
pānāni ca sugandhīni śītalāny udakāni ca |
tān yācamānāṃs te yāmyā bhartsayantas tadābruvan |
na bhavadbhir hutaṃ kāle na dattaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu ca |
prasabhaṃ dīyamānaṃ ca vāritaṃ ca dvijātiṣu || 33 ||
tasya pāpasya ca phalaṃ bhavatāṃ samupāgatam |
nāgnau dagdhaṃ jale naṣṭaṃ na hṛtaṃ nṛpataskaraiḥ || 34 ||
kuto vā sāmprataṃ vipre yan na dattaṃ purādhamāḥ |
yair dattāni tu dānāni sādhubhiḥ sāttvikāni tu || 35 ||
teṣām ete pradṛśyante kalpitā hy annaparvatāḥ |
bhakṣyabhojyāś ca peyāś ca lehyāś coṣyāś ca saṃvṛtāḥ || 36 ||
na yūyam abhilapsyadhve na dattaṃ ca kathañcana |
yais tu dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇāś caiva pūjitāḥ || 37 ||
teṣām annaṃ samānīya iha nikṣipyate sadā |
parasvaṃ katham asmābhir dātuṃ śakyeta nārakāḥ || 38 ||
