na praveṣṭuṃ na nirgantuṃ labhante duḥkhitā bhṛśam |
nīyante pāpinas tatra yatra tiṣṭhet svayaṃ yamaḥ || 43 ||
tatas te pāpakarmāṇas taṃ paśyanti bhayānakam || 45 ||
yat svayaṃ kriyate karma tat svayaṃ bhujyate punaḥ |
tat kim ātmopaghātārthaṃ bhavadbhir duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 58 ||
idānīṃ kiṃ nu śocadhvaṃ pīḍyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ |
bhuñjadhvaṃ svāni duḥkhāni nahi doṣo 'sti kasyacit || 59 ||
alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 61 ||
yad daṇḍitāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhuñjadhvam adhunā nṛpāḥ || 62 ||
kuto rājyaṃ kalatraṃ ca yadartham aśubhaṃ kṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ samparityajya yūyam ekākinaḥ sthitāḥ || 63 ||
paśyāmo na balaṃ sarvaṃ yena vidhvaṃsitāḥ prajāḥ |
evaṃ bahuvidhair vākyair upālabdhā yamena te |
śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhanti pārthivāḥ || 65 ||
iti karma samādiśya nṛpāṇāṃ dharmarāṭ svayam |
bho bhoś caṇḍa mahācaṇḍa gṛhītvā nṛpatīn imān |
tataḥ śīghraṃ samutthāya nṛpān saṅgṛhya pādayoḥ |
bhrāmayitvā tu vegena kṣiptvā cordhvaṃ pragṛhya ca || 68 ||
tatas tu raktaṃ srotobhiḥ sravate jarjarīkṛtaḥ |
niḥsañjñaḥ sa tadā dehī niśceṣṭaś ca prajāyate || 70 ||
tataḥ sa vāyunā spṛṣṭaḥ śanair ujjīvate punaḥ |
anyāṃś ca te tadā dūtāḥ pāpakarmaratān narān |
eṣa deva tavādeśād asmābhir mohito bhṛśam |
prabhur asya kriyāyoge vayaṃ vā paripanthinaḥ || 77 ||
kiṅkarās te tato yānti grahītum aparān narān |
pratipanne kṛte doṣe yamo vai pāpakāriṇām || 79 ||
pāpasya tad bhṛśaṃ kruddhāḥ kurvanti yamakiṅkarāḥ |
śṛṇudhvaṃ narakāṇāṃ ca svarūpaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram || 83 ||
nāmāni ca pramāṇaṃ ca yena yānti narāś ca tān |
bhidyante tatra nārācaiḥ sajvālair narake narāḥ || 89 ||
ikṣuvat tatra pīḍyante ye narāḥ kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ |
nikṣiptās tatra dahyante bandigrāhakṛtāś ca ye |
narakaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ jayantī cāyasī śilā || 94 ||
ye tu rāgaiḥ kaṭākṣaiś ca vīkṣante parayoṣitam || 97 ||
mātaraṃ ye 'pi gacchanti bhaginīṃ duhitaraṃ snuṣām |
puraṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ grāmaṃ yo dīpayati vahninā || 100 ||
sa tatra dahyate mūḍho yāvat kalpasthitir naraḥ |
tatra caurā narāḥ kṣiptās tāḍyante yamakiṅkaraiḥ || 102 ||
tiṣṭhanti takṣyamāṇāś ca yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī |
pātitas tatra taiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śatadhā tu samāhataḥ || 106 ||
yena dagdho jano nityaṃ mithyopāyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
kṣipyate tatra duṣṭātmā ekākī miṣṭabhuṅ naraḥ |
nāmnā vai tilapāketi narakaṃ dāruṇaṃ smṛtam || 113 ||
tilavat tatra pīḍyante parapīḍāratāś ca ye |
pacyate tatra mitraghno hantā ca śaraṇāgatam |
pīḍyante nirdayaṃ tatra yaiḥ kṛtaḥ kṣīravikrayaḥ |
dahyate tatra yenoktaṃ dānaṃ viprāya nārpitam |
dahyate tatra suciraṃ yaḥ pāpe buddhikṛn naraḥ |
narakaṃ krakacākhyātaṃ pīḍyante tatra vai narāḥ || 120 ||
garado madhuhartā ca pacyate tatra pāpakṛt |
tatra saṅkṣipyate kalpaṃ sadā māṃsarucir naraḥ |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā parakīyaṃ haranti ye || 131 ||
yamadūtaiś ca caurās te chidyante lavaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ |
ye hatvā prāṇinaṃ mūḍhāḥ khādante kākagṛdhravat || 132 ||
bhojyante ca svamāṃsaṃ te kalpāntaṃ yamakiṅkaraiḥ |
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ vastraṃ parakīyaṃ haranti ye || 133 ||
yamadūtaiś ca te mūḍhā bhidyante śaktitomaraiḥ |
phalaṃ pattraṃ nṛṇāṃ vāpi hṛtaṃ yais tu kubuddhibhiḥ || 134 ||
yamadūtaiś ca te kruddhair dahyante tṛṇavahnibhiḥ |
paradravye kalatre ca yaḥ sadā duṣṭadhīr naraḥ || 135 ||
yamadūtair jvalat tasya hṛdi śūlaṃ nikhanyate |
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye dharmavimukhā narāḥ || 136 ||
yamaloke tu te ghorā labhante pariyātanāḥ |
iha kṛtvā svalpam api naraḥ karmāśubhātmakam || 138 ||
na śṛṇvanti narā mūḍhā dharmoktaṃ sādhu bhāṣitam || 139 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ keneti pratyakṣaṃ pratyuktyaivaṃ vadanti te |
divā rātrau prayatnena pāpaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ || 140 ||
nācaranti hi te dharmaṃ pramādenāpi mohitāḥ |
ihaiva phalabhoktāraḥ paratra vimukhāś ca ye || 141 ||
naraiḥ samprāpyate tatra karma kṛtvā śubhāśubham || 142 ||
Chapter 216: Reward of the righteous in Yama's world
narakāṇi ca ghorāṇi dvāraṃ yāmyaṃ ca sattama || 1 ||
asty upāyo na vā brahman yamamārge 'tibhīṣaṇe |
brūhi yena narā yānti sukhena yamasādanam || 2 ||
iha ye dharmasaṃyuktās tv ahiṃsāniratā narāḥ |
yasmin manuṣyalokās te sabhāryāḥ sasutās tathā |
tam adhvānaṃ ca gacchanti yathā tat kathayāmi vaḥ || 4 ||
ye prayacchanti te yānti sukhenaiva mahāpathe || 6 ||
annaṃ ye tu prayacchanti brāhmaṇebhyaḥ susaṅkṛtam |
ye ca satyaṃ prabhāṣante bahir antaś ca nirmalāḥ |
te yānty aśvai rathaiś caiva kuñjaraiś cāpy alaṅkṛtāḥ |
ye ca bhaktyā prayacchanti guḍapānakam arcitam |
te yānti kāñcanair yānair vividhais tu yamālayam |
ye ca kṣīraṃ prayacchanti ghṛtaṃ dadhi guḍaṃ madhu |
ye phalāni prayacchanti puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca |
haṃsayuktair vimānais tu yānti dharmapuraṃ narāḥ || 18 ||
ye tilāṃs tiladhenuṃ ca ghṛtadhenum athāpi vā |
yeṣāṃ vāpyaś ca kūpāś ca taḍāgāni sarāṃsi ca |
dīrghikāḥ puṣkariṇyaś ca śītalāś ca jalāśayāḥ || 21 ||
yeṣāṃ devakulāny atra citrāṇy āyatanāni ca |
te yānti lokapālais tu vimānair vātaraṃhasaiḥ |
te vitṛṣṇāḥ sukhaṃ yānti vimānais taṃ mahāpatham || 25 ||
yair dattāni dvijātibhyas te 'dhvānaṃ yānti vai sukham || 26 ||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi vidrumaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā |
ye prayacchanti te yānti vimānaiḥ kanakojjvalaiḥ || 30 ||
bhūmidā dīpyamānāś ca sarvakāmais tu tarpitāḥ |
kanyāṃ tu ye prayacchanti brahmadeyām alaṅkṛtām |
te sugandhāḥ suveśāś ca suprabhāḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ |
dīpadā yānti yānaiś ca dīpayanto diśo daśa |
ye prayacchanti viprebhyas te yānty aśvair yamālayam || 38 ||
viśrāmayanti ye viprāñ śrāntān adhvani karśitān |
svāgatena ca yo vipraṃ pūjayed āsanena ca |
sa gacchati tam adhvānaṃ sukhaṃ paramanirvṛtaḥ || 40 ||
gāṃ ca pāpaharety uktvā sukhaṃ yānti ca tat patham || 41 ||
te 'pi sārasayuktais tu yānti yānaiś ca tat patham || 42 ||
haṃsayuktair vimānais tu sukhaṃ yānti yamālayam || 43 ||
tṛtīye divase ye tu bhuñjate niyatavratāḥ |
te 'pi hastirathair divyair yānti yānaiś ca tat padam || 45 ||
sa yāti kuñjarasthas tu śacīpatir iva svayam || 46 ||
ye ca māsopavāsaṃ tu kurvate saṃyatendriyāḥ |
te 'pi sūryapradīptais tu yānti yānair yamālayam || 49 ||
sevyamānas tu gandharvair yāti yānair yamālayam || 50 ||
prāṇāṃs tyajati yo martyaḥ smaran viṣṇuṃ sanātanam |
praviṣṭo 'ntar jalaṃ yas tu prāṇāṃs tyajati mānavaḥ |
svaśarīraṃ hi gṛdhrebhyo vaiṣṇavo yaḥ prayacchati |
strīgrahe gograhe vāpi yuddhe mṛtyum upaiti yaḥ |
vaiṣṇavā ye ca kurvanti tīrthayātrāṃ jitendriyāḥ |
tat pathaṃ yānti te ghoraṃ sukhayānair alaṅkṛtāḥ || 57 ||
kurvanti te sukhaṃ yānti vimānaiḥ kanakojjvalaiḥ || 59 ||
ekabhāvena ye viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ tryambakaṃ ravim |
pūjayanti hi te yānti vimānair bhāskaraprabhaiḥ || 62 ||
ye ca māṃsaṃ na khādanti satyaśaucasamanvitāḥ |
tasmān māṃsaṃ na bhuñjīta nāsti miṣṭaiḥ sukhodayaḥ || 64 ||
gosahasraṃ tu yo dadyād yas tu māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet |
samāv etau purā prāha brahmā vedavidāṃ varaḥ || 65 ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yat phalam |
amāṃsabhakṣaṇe viprās tac ca tac ca ca tatsamam || 66 ||
evaṃ sukhena te yānti yamalokaṃ ca dhārmikāḥ |
dānavrataparā yānair yatra devo raveḥ sutaḥ || 67 ||
dṛṣṭvā tān dhārmikān devaḥ svayaṃ sammānayed yamaḥ |
yat kiñcid alpam aśubhaṃ phalaṃ tad iha bhokṣyatha || 71 ||
ye tu taṃ dharmarājānaṃ narāḥ puṇyānubhāvataḥ |
dharmād arthas tathā kāmo mokṣaś ca parikīrtyate || 73 ||
dharmo mātā pitā bhrātā dharmo nāthaḥ suhṛt tathā |
dharmaḥ svāmī sakhā goptā tathā dhātā ca poṣakaḥ || 74 ||
dharmād artho 'rthataḥ kāmaḥ kāmād bhogaḥ sukhāni ca |
dharmād aiśvaryam ekāgryaṃ dharmāt svargagatiḥ parā || 75 ||
dharmas tu sevito viprās trāyate mahato bhayāt |
devatvaṃ ca dvijatvaṃ ca dharmāt prāpnoty asaṃśayam || 76 ||
yadā ca kṣīyate pāpaṃ narāṇāṃ pūrvasañcitam |
tadaiṣāṃ bhajate buddhir dharmaṃ cātra dvijottamāḥ || 77 ||
yo hi nācarate dharmaṃ bhavet sa khalu vañcitaḥ || 78 ||
kutsitā ye daridrāś ca virūpā vyādhitās tathā |
parapreṣyāś ca mūrkhāś ca jñeyā dharmavivarjitāḥ || 79 ||
ye hi dīrghāyuṣaḥ śūrāḥ paṇḍitā bhogino 'rthinaḥ |
arogā rūpavantaś ca tais tu dharmaḥ purā kṛtaḥ || 80 ||
evaṃ dharmaratā viprā gacchanti gatim uttamām |
adharmaṃ sevamānās tu tiryagyoniṃ vrajanti te || 81 ||
te svapne 'pi na paśyanti yamaṃ vā narakāṇi vā || 82 ||
ye namanti narā nityaṃ nahi paśyanti te yamam || 83 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye 'cyutaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ |
na samartho yamas teṣāṃ te muktiphalabhāginaḥ || 84 ||
ye janā jagatāṃ nāthaṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dvijāḥ |
namanti nahi te viṣṇoḥ sthānād anyatra gāminaḥ || 85 ||
na te dūtān na tan mārgaṃ na yamaṃ na ca tāṃ purīm |
na yānti narakaṃ natvā sarvapāpaharaṃ harim || 87 ||
śāṭhyenāpi narā nityaṃ ye smaranti janārdanam |
te 'pi yānti tanuṃ tyaktvā viṣṇulokam anāmayam || 88 ||
so 'pi doṣakṣayān muktiṃ labhec cedipatir yathā || 89 ||

Chapter 217: The fate of the soul after death; retribution for deeds by
          rebirth
śrutvaivaṃ yamamārgaṃ te narakeṣu ca yātanām |
papracchuś ca punar vyāsaṃ saṃśayaṃ munisattamāḥ || 1 ||
martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ || 2 ||
gacchanty amutra loke vai kaś ca tān anugacchati || 3 ||
ekaḥ prasūyate viprā eka eva hi naśyati |
ekas tarati durgāṇi gacchaty ekas tu durgatim || 4 ||
asahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ |
muhūrtam iva roditvā tato yānti parāṅmukhāḥ || 6 ||
tais tac charīram utsṛṣṭaṃ dharma eko 'nugacchati |
tasmād dharmaḥ sahāyaś ca sevitavyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ || 7 ||
lobhān mohād anukrośād bhayād vātha bahuśrutaḥ |
dharmaś cārthaś ca kāmaś ca tritayaṃ jīvataḥ phalam |
śrutaṃ bhagavato vākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ paraṃ hitam |
mṛtaṃ śarīraṃ hi nṛṇāṃ sūkṣmam avyaktatāṃ gatam |
pṛthivī vāyur ākāśam āpo jyotir manontaram |
buddhir ātmā ca sahitā dharmaṃ paśyanti nityadā || 14 ||
etaiś ca saha dharmo hi taṃ jīvam anugacchati || 15 ||
tvag asthi māṃsaṃ śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ |
tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ sukham edhate |
ihaloke pare caiva kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi vaḥ || 17 ||
etat tu jñātum icchāmaḥ kathaṃ retaḥ pravartate || 18 ||
annam aśnanti ye devāḥ śarīrasthā dvijottamāḥ |
pṛthivī vāyur ākāśam āpo jyotir manas tathā || 19 ||
tatas tṛpteṣu bho viprās teṣu bhūteṣu pañcasu |
tato garbhaḥ sambhavati śleṣmā strīpuṃsayor dvijāḥ |
etad vaḥ sarvam ākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchatha || 21 ||
ākhyātaṃ no bhagavatā garbhaḥ sañjāyate yathā |
yathā jātas tu puruṣaḥ prapadyate tad ucyatām || 22 ||
viprayuktas tu tair bhūtaiḥ punar yāty aparāṃ gatim || 23 ||
sa ca bhūtasamāyuktaḥ prāpnoti jīvam eva hi |
tato 'sya karma paśyanti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham |
devatāḥ pañcabhūtasthāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchatha || 24 ||
tvag asthi māṃsam utsṛjya tais tu bhūtair vivarjitaḥ |
jīvaḥ sa bhagavan kvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute || 25 ||
strīṇāṃ puṣpaṃ samāsādya tataḥ kālena bho dvijāḥ || 26 ||
yamasya puruṣaiḥ kleśo yamasya puruṣair vadhaḥ |
duḥkhaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca naraḥ kleśaṃ ca vindati || 27 ||
iha loke sa tu prāṇī janmaprabhṛti bho dvijāḥ |
sukṛtaṃ karma vai bhuṅkte dharmasya phalam āśritaḥ || 28 ||
tataḥ sa puruṣo bhūtvā sevate nityadā sukham || 29 ||
karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṃ yonau prajāyate |
jīvo mohasamāyuktas tan me śṛṇuta sāmpratam || 32 ||
yad etad ucyate śāstraiḥ setihāsaiś ca chandasi |
iha sthānāni puṇyāni devatulyāni bho dvijāḥ |
karmabhir niyatair baddho jantur duḥkhāny upāśnute || 35 ||
yena yena hi bhāvena yena vai karmaṇā gatim |
prayāti puruṣo ghorāṃ tathā vakṣyāmy ataḥ param || 36 ||
kharo jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ |
kharo mṛto balīvardaḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvati || 38 ||
brahmarakṣas tu māsāṃs trīṃs tato jāyeta brāhmaṇaḥ || 39 ||
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ || 40 ||
gardabhaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi śūkaraḥ || 41 ||
kukkuṭaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi jambukaḥ |
śvā varṣam ekaṃ bhavati tato jāyeta mānavaḥ || 42 ||
upādhyāyasya yaḥ pāpaṃ śiṣyaḥ kuryād abuddhimān |
sa janmānīha saṃsāre trīn āpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || 43 ||
prāk śvā bhavati bho viprās tataḥ kravyāt tataḥ kharaḥ |
pretya ca parikliṣṭeṣu paścāj jāyeta brāhmaṇaḥ || 44 ||
manasāpi guror bhāryāṃ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakṛt |
śvayonau tu sa sambhūtas trīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati |
kṛmibhāvam anuprāpto varṣam ekaṃ tu jīvati |
tatas tu nidhanaṃ prāpya brahmayonau prajāyate || 47 ||
yadi putrasamaṃ śiṣyaṃ gurur hanyād akāraṇam |
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva yas tu putro 'vamanyate |
so 'pi viprā mṛto jantuḥ pūrvaṃ jāyeta gardabhaḥ || 49 ||
gardabhatvaṃ tu samprāpya daśa varṣāṇi jīvati |
saṃvatsaraṃ tu kumbhīras tato jāyeta mānavaḥ || 50 ||
putrasya mātāpitarau yasya ruṣṭāv ubhāv api |
kharo jīvati māsāṃś ca daśa cāpi caturdaśa |
biḍālaḥ sapta māsāṃs tu tato jāyeta mānavaḥ || 52 ||
tāḍayitvā tu tāv eva jāyate kacchapo dvijāḥ || 53 ||
kacchapo daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi śalyakaḥ |
vyālo bhūtvā tu ṣaṇ māsāṃs tato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ || 54 ||
vānaro daśa varṣāṇi sapta varṣāṇi mūṣakaḥ |
śvā ca bhūtvā tu ṣaṇ māsāṃs tato jāyeta mānavaḥ || 56 ||
nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ |
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ |
duṣkṛtasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ || 58 ||
asūyako naraś cāpi mṛto jāyeta śārṅgakaḥ |
viśvāsahartā ca naro mīno jāyeta durmatiḥ || 59 ||
bhūtvā mīno 'ṣṭa varṣāṇi mṛgo jāyeta bho dvijāḥ |
mṛgas tu caturo māsāṃs tataś chāgaḥ prajāyate || 60 ||
chāgas tu nidhanaṃ prāpya pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ |
kīṭaḥ sañjāyate jantus tato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ || 61 ||
dhānyān yavāṃs tilān māṣān kulitthān sarṣapāṃś caṇān |
kalāyān atha mudgāṃś ca godhūmān atasīs tathā || 62 ||
sasyāny anyāni hartā ca martyo mohād acetanaḥ |
tataḥ pretya muniśreṣṭhā mṛto jāyeta śūkaraḥ |
śūkaro jātamātras tu rogeṇa mriyate punaḥ || 64 ||
śvā tato jāyate mūkaḥ karmaṇā tena mānavaḥ |
bhūtvā śvā pañca varṣāṇi tato jāyeta mānavaḥ || 65 ||
paradārābhimarśaṃ tu kṛtvā jāyeta vai vṛkaḥ |
śvā śṛgālas tato gṛdhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakas tathā || 66 ||
bhrātur bhāryāṃ tu pāpātmā yo dharṣayati mohitaḥ |
sakhibhāryāṃ guror bhāryāṃ rājabhāryāṃ tathaiva ca |
śūkaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi daśa varṣāṇi vai bakaḥ |
pipīlikas tu māsāṃs trīn kīṭaḥ syān māsam eva ca || 69 ||
tatra jīvati māsāṃs tu kṛmiyonau caturdaśa || 70 ||
pūrvaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye dātum icchati || 71 ||
so 'pi viprā mṛto jantuḥ krimiyonau prajāyate |
devakāryam akṛtvā tu pitṛkāryam athāpi vā || 73 ||
anirvāpya pitṝn devān mṛto jāyeta vāyasaḥ |
jāyate vyālakaś cāpi māsaṃ tasmāt tu mānuṣaḥ |
krauñco jīvati varṣāṇi daśa jāyeta jīvakaḥ || 76 ||
tataḥ samprāpya nidhanaṃ jāyate śūkaraḥ punaḥ |
śūkaro jātamātras tu rogeṇa mriyate dvijāḥ || 78 ||
śvā ca vai jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena bho dvijāḥ |
śvā bhūtvā kṛtakarmāsau jāyate mānuṣas tataḥ || 79 ||
kṛtaghnas tu mṛto viprā yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ || 80 ||
yamasya viṣaye krūrair baddhaḥ prāpnoti vedanām |
daṇḍakaṃ mudgaraṃ śūlam agnidaṇḍaṃ ca dāruṇam || 81 ||
etāś cānyāś ca bahavo yamasya viṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 82 ||
yātanāḥ prāpya ghorās tu tato yāti ca bho dvijāḥ |
krimir bhavati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ |
tato garbhaṃ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate naraḥ || 84 ||
saṃsārān subahūn gatvā tatas tiryak prajāyate || 85 ||
dadhi hṛtvā bakaś cāpi plavo matsyān asaṃskṛtān |
phalaṃ vā mūlakaṃ hṛtvā pūpaṃ vāpi pipīlikaḥ |
apo hṛtvā tu durbuddhir vāyaso jāyate naraḥ |
kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhir hārīto jāyate naraḥ || 90 ||
hṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kṛmiyonau prajāyate || 91 ||
kośakāraṃ tato hṛtvā naro jāyeta nartakaḥ || 92 ||
aṃśukaṃ corayitvā tu śuko jāyeta mānavaḥ |
corayitvā dukūlaṃ tu mṛto haṃsaḥ prajāyate || 93 ||
krauñcaḥ kārpāsikaṃ hṛtvā mṛto jāyeta mānavaḥ |
corayitvā naraḥ paṭṭaṃ tv āvikaṃ caiva bho dvijāḥ || 94 ||
kṣaumaṃ ca vastram āhṛtya śaśo jantuḥ prajāyate |
cūrṇaṃ tu hṛtvā puruṣo mṛto jāyeta barhiṇaḥ || 95 ||
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi tato daśa ca pañca ca || 97 ||
adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyeta mānavaḥ |
yas tu corayate tailaṃ naro mohasamanvitaḥ |
so 'pi viprā mṛto jantus tailapāyī prajāyate || 99 ||
arthārthaṃ yadi vā vairī mṛto jāyeta vai kharaḥ || 100 ||
kharo jīvati varṣe dve tataḥ śastreṇa vadhyate |
mṛgo vidhyeta śastreṇa gate saṃvatsare tataḥ |
hato mṛgas tato mīnaḥ so 'pi jālena badhyate || 102 ||
śvāpado daśa varṣāṇi dvīpī varṣāṇi pañca ca || 103 ||
vādyaṃ hṛtvā tu puruṣo lomaśaḥ samprajāyate |
tathā piṇyākasammiśram annaṃ yaś corayen naraḥ || 105 ||
sa jāyate babhrusaṭo dāruṇo mūṣiko naraḥ |
daśan vai mānuṣān nityaṃ pāpātmā sa dvijottamāḥ || 106 ||
ghṛtaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhiḥ kāko madguḥ prajāyate |
matsyamāṃsam atho hṛtvā kāko jāyeta mānavaḥ || 107 ||
sa gatāyur naras tena matsyayonau prajāyate |
pāpāni tu naraḥ kṛtvā tiryag jāyeta bho dvijāḥ || 110 ||
na cātmanaḥ pramāṇaṃ tu dharmaṃ jānāti kiñcana |
ye pāpāni narāḥ kṛtvā nirasyanti vrataiḥ sadā || 111 ||
asaṃvītāḥ prajāyante mlecchāś cāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 112 ||
varjayanti hi pāpāni janmaprabhṛti ye narāḥ || 113 ||
arogā rūpavantaś ca dhaninas te bhavanty uta |
striyo 'py etena kalpena kṛtvā pāpam avāpnuyuḥ || 114 ||
eteṣām eva pāpānāṃ bhāryātvam upayānti tāḥ |
prāyeṇa haraṇe doṣāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ || 115 ||
etad vai leśamātreṇa kathitaṃ vo dvijarṣabhāḥ |
aparasmin kathāyoge bhūyaḥ śroṣyatha bho dvijāḥ || 116 ||
etan mayā mahābhāgā brahmaṇo vadataḥ purā |
surarṣīṇāṃ śrutaṃ madhye pṛṣṭaṃ cāpi yathā tathā || 117 ||
etac chrutvā muniśreṣṭhā dharme kuruta mānasam || 118 ||
Chapter 218: Merit of giving food to Brahmins
adharmasya gatir brahman kathitā nas tvayānagha |
dharmasya ca gatiṃ śrotum icchāmo vadatāṃ vara || 1 ||
kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi kathaṃ yānty aśubhāṃ gatim |
karmaṇā ca kṛteneha kena yānti śubhāṃ gatim || 2 ||
kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi tv adharmavaśam āgataḥ |
mohād adharmaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ samanutapyate |
yathā yathā naraḥ samyag adharmam anubhāṣate |
yathā yathā manas tasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhate |
tathā tathā śarīraṃ tu tenādharmeṇa mucyate || 7 ||
bhujaṅga iva nirmokān pūrvabhuktāñ jahāti tān |
dānāni tu pravakṣyāmi yāni dattvā dvijottamāḥ || 9 ||
naraḥ kṛtvāpy akāryāṇi tato dharmeṇa yujyate |
sarveṣām eva dānānām annaṃ śreṣṭham udāhṛtam || 10 ||
sarvam annaṃ pradātavyam ṛjunā dharmam icchatā |
prāṇā hy annaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmāj jantuḥ prajāyate || 11 ||
anne pratiṣṭhitā lokās tasmād annaṃ praśasyate |
annasya hi pradānena svargam āpnoti mānavaḥ |
yasya tv annam upāśnanti brāhmaṇāś ca sakṛd daśa || 14 ||
hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatir bhavet |
kṣatriyas tarasā prāptam annaṃ yo vai prayacchati |
tenāpohati dharmātmā duṣkṛtaṃ karma bho dvijāḥ |
annaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ śūdraḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi sevate |
annam ūrjaskaraṃ loke dattvorjasvī bhaven naraḥ || 23 ||
dānavidbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ || 24 ||
teṣv apy annasya dātāras tebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
kāryān nyāyāgataṃ nityam annaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ |
annasya hi pradānena naro yāti parāṃ gatim || 26 ||
yas tu prāṇāhutīpūrvam annaṃ bhuṅkte gṛhī sadā || 28 ||
bhojayitvā śataṃ nityaṃ naro vedavidāṃ varam || 29 ||
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsāraṃ na ca sevate || 30 ||
etad vaḥ sarvam ākhyātam annadānaphalaṃ mahat |
mūlam etat tu dharmāṇāṃ pradānānāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ || 32 ||
teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ jñeyaṃ putraiś cānyaiś ca bandhubhiḥ || 1 ||
purā kokājale magnān pitṝn uddhṛtavān vibhuḥ |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tadā devo yathā tatra dvijottamāḥ || 3 ||
kimarthaṃ te tu kokāyāṃ nimagnāḥ pitaro 'mbhasi |
kathaṃ tenoddhṛtās te vai vārāheṇa dvijottama || 4 ||
śrotum icchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 5 ||
purā merugireḥ pṛṣṭhe viśvair devaiḥ saha sthitāḥ || 6 ||
kanyā kāntimatī divyā purataḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitā |
tām ūcuḥ pitaro divyā ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ || 7 ||
kāsi bhadre prabhuḥ ko vā bhavatyā vaktum arhasi || 8 ||
sā provāca pitṝn devān kalā cāndramasīti ha |
ūrjā nāmāsti prathamaṃ svadhā ca tadanantaram |
bhavadbhiś cādyaiva kṛtaṃ nāma koketi bhāvitam || 10 ||
te hi tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā pitaro divyamānuṣāḥ |
tasyā mukhaṃ nirīkṣanto na tṛptim adhijagmire || 11 ||
bhagavān api śītāṃśur ūrjāṃ nāpaśyad ātmajām |
sa viveda tadā somaḥ prāptāṃ pitṝṃś ca kāmataḥ |
taiś cāvalokitāṃ hārdāt svīkṛtāṃ ca tapobalāt || 14 ||
yasmād dhṛtavatī ceyaṃ patīn pitṛmatī satī || 16 ||
svatantrā dharmam utsṛjya tasmād bhavatu nimnagā |
kokā nāma tato vegān nadī tīrthaśatākulā |
plāvayantī gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ sarpaṇāt tu sarit smṛtā || 20 ||
atha te pitaro viprā yogahīnā mahānadīm |
dadṛśuḥ śītasalilāṃ na vidus tāṃ sulocanām || 21 ||
tatas tu girirāḍ dṛṣṭvā pitṝṃs tāṃs tu kṣudhārditān |
kṣīraṃ madhu ca tad divyaṃ kokāmbho badarīphalam |
tayā vṛttyā tu vasatāṃ pitṝṇāṃ munisattamāḥ |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi yayur ekam aho yathā || 24 ||
daityā babhūvur balino yātudhānāś ca rākṣasāḥ || 25 ||
te tān pitṛgaṇān daityā yātudhānāś ca vegitāḥ |
kokātaṭasthām uttuṅgāṃ śilāṃ te jagṛhū ruṣā || 27 ||
gṛhītāyāṃ śilāyāṃ tu kokā vegavatī pitṝn |
pitṝn antarhitān dṛṣṭvā daiteyā rākṣasās tathā |
jagur janārdanaṃ devaṃ pitaraḥ śaraṇaṃ harim || 30 ||
tvaṃ pitā jagataḥ śambho nānyaḥ śaktaḥ prabādhitum |
niśācaragaṇaṃ bhīmam atas tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 34 ||
itthaṃ stutaḥ sa pitṛbhir dharaṇīdharas tu |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā salile magnaṃ kroḍarūpī janārdanaḥ |
bhītaṃ pitṛgaṇaṃ viṣṇur uddhartuṃ matir ādadhe || 37 ||
pitṝn ādāya ca vibhur ujjahāra śilātalāt || 38 ||
uddhṛtya ca pitṝn devo viṣṇutīrthe tu śūkaraḥ |
dadau samāhitas tebhyo viṣṇur lohārgale jalam || 40 ||
svedodbhavāṃs tilāṃś caiva cakre colmukam uttamam || 41 ||
jyotiḥ sūryaprabhaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ tīrthaṃ ca kāmikam |
ādāya dhenuṃ saraso ratnāny ādāya cārṇavāt |
tair apy ukte kuruṣveti viśvān devāṃs tato vibhuḥ |
āhūya mantratas teṣāṃ viṣṭarāṇi dadau prabhuḥ || 47 ||
rakṣanti sarvatra diśo rakṣārthaṃ nirmitā hi te || 49 ||
nahi kaścit kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktaś carācare || 50 ||
na kenacit kṛtaṃ yasmāt tasmāt te hy akṣatāḥ kṛtāḥ |
devānāṃ te hi rakṣārthaṃ niyuktā viṣṇunā purā || 51 ||
kuśagandhayavaiḥ puṣpair arghyaṃ kṛtvā ca śūkaraḥ |
viśvebhyo devebhya iti tatas tān paryapṛcchata || 52 ||
pitṝn āvāhayiṣyāmi ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ |
āvāhayasveti ca tair uktas tv āvāhayec chuciḥ || 53 ||
jānāv āropya hastaṃ tu dadau savyena cāsanam || 54 ||
saṃvatsarair ity udīrya tato 'rghyaṃ teṣu vinyaset || 57 ||
yās tiṣṭhanty amṛtā vāco yan maiti ca pituḥ pituḥ |
yan me pitāmahāity evaṃ dadāv arghyaṃ pitāmaha || 58 ||
yan me prapitāmahāiti dadau ca prapitāmahe |
tadvan mātāmahebhyas tu vidhiṃ cakre janārdanaḥ |
tān arcya bhūyo gandhādyair dhūpaṃ dattvā tu bhaktitaḥ || 60 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā ity uccārya jagatprabhuḥ |
vidhāya pātre tac caiva paryapṛcchat tato munīn |
agnau kariṣya iti taiḥ kuruṣveti ca coditaḥ || 62 ||
ye māmakāiti ca japed yajuḥsaptakam acyutam || 63 ||
trir āhutikam ekaikaṃ pitaraṃ tu prati dvijāḥ || 64 ||
yad brāhmaṇeṣu pradadau piṇḍapātre pitṝṃs tathā |
bhuñjāneṣu tu vipreṣu japan vai mantrapañcakam || 68 ||
yat te prakāram ārabhya nādhikaṃ te tato jagau |
jajāpa vaiṣāṃ jāpyaṃ tu sūktaṃ sauraṃ sapauruṣam |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pṛṣṭvā tṛptā stha ity uta || 70 ||
tṛptāḥ smeti sakṛt toyaṃ dadau maunavimocanam |
sā tad annaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā tridhaikaikam athākarot |
vārāho bhūm athollikhya samācchādya kuśair api || 72 ||
dakṣiṇāgrān kuśān kṛtvā teṣām upari cāsanam |
satileṣu samūleṣu kuśeṣv eva tu saṃśrayaḥ || 73 ||
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ piṇḍaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
pṛthivī dadhīr ity uktvā tataḥ piṇḍaṃ pradattavān || 74 ||
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ dadau piṇḍān sa śūkaraḥ || 75 ||
etad vaḥ pitar ity uktvā dadau vāsāṃsi bhaktitaḥ || 76 ||
ācamyācāmayed viprān paitrān ādau tataḥ surān |
tatas tv abhyukṣya tāṃ bhūmiṃ dattvāpaḥ sumanokṣatān || 78 ||
satilāmbu pitṛṣv ādau dattvā deveṣu sākṣatam |
akṣayyaṃ nas tv iti pitṝn prīyatām iti devatāḥ || 79 ||
tato nivṛtya tu japed yan me nāma itīrayan || 80 ||
svastīty ukte paitṛkais tu sorāhne pnāvatarpayan |
rajataṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā viprān devo gadādharaḥ || 83 ||
saṃvibhāgaṃ manuṣyebhyo dadau svad iti cābruvan |
kaścit sampannam ity uktvā pratyuktas tair dvijottamāḥ || 84 ||
abhiramyatām ity uvāca procus te 'bhiratāḥ sma vai |
śiṣṭam annaṃ ca papraccha tair iṣṭaiḥ saha coditaḥ || 85 ||
pāṇāv ādāya tān viprān kuryād anugatas tadā |
vāje vāje iti paṭhan bahir vedi vinirgataḥ || 86 ||
alagnān vipulān vālān prārthayām āsa cāśiṣam || 87 ||
āsanāni dadau caiṣāṃ chādayām āsa śūkaraḥ |
chāyāmayī mahī patnī tasyai piṇḍam adāt prabhuḥ |
ādhatta pitaro garbham ity uktvā sāpi rūpiṇī || 90 ||
visarjanaṃ pitṝṇāṃ sa kartukāmaś ca śūkaraḥ || 91 ||
kokā ca pitaraś caiva procuḥ svārthakaraṃ vacaḥ |
śaptāś ca bhagavan pūrvaṃ divasthā himabhānunā || 92 ||
yogabhraṣṭā bhaviṣyadhvaṃ sarva eva divaś cyutāḥ |
tad evaṃ bhavatā trātāḥ praviśanto rasātalam || 93 ||
tat te bhūyo 'bhirakṣantu viśve devā hi naḥ sadā || 94 ||
svargaṃ yāsyāmaś ca vibho prasādāt tava śūkara |
yogādhāras tathā somas trāyate na kadācana |
divi bhūmau sadā vāso bhavatv asmāsu yogataḥ || 96 ||
antarikṣe ca keṣāñcin māsaṃ puṣṭis tathāstu naḥ |
ūrjā ceyaṃ hi naḥ patnī svadhānāmnā tu viśrutā || 97 ||
bhavatv eṣaiva yogāḍhyā yogamātā ca khecarī |
ity evam uktaḥ pitṛbhir vārāho bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 98 ||
provācātha pitṝn viṣṇus tāṃ ca kokāṃ mahānadīm |
yad uktaṃ tu bhavadbhir me sarvam etad bhaviṣyati || 99 ||
adhiyajñas tathaivāgnir bhavatāṃ kalpanā tv iyam || 100 ||
agnir vāyuś ca sūryaś ca sthānaṃ hi bhavatām iti |
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca bhavatām adhipūruṣāḥ || 101 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā bhavatāṃ mūrtayas tv imāḥ |
yogino yogadehāś ca yogadhārāś ca suvratāḥ || 102 ||
svargasthān narakasthāṃś ca bhūmisthāṃś ca carācarān || 103 ||
asyām adya prabhṛti vai nivatsyāmy aghanāśakṛt |
tīrtheṣv āplavanaṃ puṇyam upavāsaś ca svargadaḥ || 108 ||
māghe māsy asite pakṣe bhavadbhir uḍupakṣaye || 109 ||
tasmin kāle tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nirvapiṣyati || 110 ||
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca stheyam atra mayā sadā || 111 ||
yas tatropavased dhīmān sa prāguktaphalaṃ labhet |
tad vrajadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ sthānam iṣṭaṃ yatheṣṭataḥ || 112 ||
aham apy atra vatsyāmīty uktvā so 'ntaradhīyata |
gate varāhe pitaraḥ kokām āmantrya te yayuḥ || 113 ||
tato 'syāḥ prābhavat putro bhaumas tu narakāsuraḥ |
prāgjyotiṣaṃ ca nagaram asya dattaṃ ca viṣṇunā || 115 ||
Chapter 220: Prescriptions for ancestral rites; their effects
kathaṃ kva ca kadā keṣu kais tad brūhi tapodhana || 1 ||
yathā yatra yadā yeṣu yair dravyais tad vadāmy aham || 2 ||
saritsu puṇyatoyāsu nadeṣu ca saraḥsu ca |
saṅgameṣu nadīnāṃ ca samudreṣu ca saptasu || 6 ||
śrāddham eteṣu dātavyaṃ varjyam eteṣu cocyate |
pūrveṣu karatoyāyā na deyaṃ śrāddham ucyate |
śrāddhaṃ deyam uśantīha māsi māsy uḍupakṣaye || 10 ||
nityaśrāddham adaivaṃ ca manuṣyaiḥ saha gīyate || 11 ||
naimittikaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā |
tatra yugmān dvijān āhur mantrapūrvaṃ tu vai dvijāḥ || 13 ||
kanyāṃ gate savitari dināni daśa pañca ca |
śriyaṃ prāpnoti pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūjyo bhaven naraḥ |
prajāvṛddhiṃ paśuṃ medhāṃ svātantryaṃ puṣṭim uttamām || 18 ||
yuvānaḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa vā hatāḥ || 20 ||
tena kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptim abhīpsatā |
śrāddhaṃ kurvann amāvāsyāṃ yatnena puruṣaḥ śuciḥ || 21 ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti svargaṃ cānantam aśnute |
pitṝṇāṃ prītaye yatra yad deyaṃ prītikāriṇā |
māsaṃ tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu haviṣyānnena jāyate || 23 ||
trīn māsān hāriṇaṃ māṃsaṃ vijñeyaṃ pitṛtṛptaye || 24 ||
puṣṇāti caturo māsāñ śaśasya piśitaṃ pitṝn |
śākunaṃ pañca vai māsān ṣaṇ māsāñ śūkarāmiṣam || 25 ||
chāgalaṃ sapta vai māsān aiṇeyaṃ cāṣṭamāsakān |
karoti tṛptiṃ nava vai rurumāṃsaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 26 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ tathā gavyaṃ payaḥ pāyasam eva ca |
vādhrīnam āmiṣaṃ lohaṃ kālaśākaṃ tathā madhu || 28 ||
anantaṃ vai prayacchanti tṛptiyogaṃ sutāṃs tathā || 29 ||
pitṝṇāṃ nātra sandeho gayāśrāddhaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ |
yo dadāti guḍonmiśrāṃs tilān vā śrāddhakarmaṇi || 30 ||
madhu vā madhumiśraṃ vā akṣayaṃ sarvam eva tat |
api naḥ sa kule bhūyād yo no dadyāj jalāñjalim || 31 ||
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca |
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yady eko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet || 32 ||
gaurīṃ vāpy udvahet kanyāṃ nīlaṃ vā vṛṣam utsṛjet |
kṛttikāsu pitṝn arcya svargam āpnoti mānavaḥ || 33 ||
śauryam ārdrāsu cāpnoti kṣetrāṇi ca punarvasau || 34 ||
puṣye tu dhanam akṣayyam āśleṣe cāyur uttamam |
maghāsu ca prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu ca || 35 ||
prayāti śreṣṭhatāṃ śāstre haste śrāddhaprado naraḥ || 36 ||
rūpaṃ tejaś ca citrāsu tathāpatyam avāpnuyāt |
ādhipatyaṃ ca jyeṣṭhāsu mūle cārogyam uttamam || 38 ||
śravaṇena śubhāṃl lokān dhaniṣṭhāsu dhanaṃ mahat || 39 ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃs tathāpnoti bharaṇīṣv āyur uttamam || 41 ||
evaṃ phalam avāpnoti ṛkṣeṣv eteṣu tattvavit |
tasmāt kāmyāni śrāddhāni deyāni vidhivad dvijāḥ || 42 ||
yān yān kāmān abhidhyāyan kanyārāśigate ravau || 43 ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvanti manujās tāṃs tān kāmāṃl labhanti te |
kanyāṃ gate savitari yāny ahāni tu ṣoḍaśa || 46 ||
yo 'rcayet svapitṝn bhaktyā tasya vāsas triviṣṭape |
aṣṭakāsu ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ manvantarāsu vai || 51 ||
saṅkrāntiṣu ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidhivad uttamam |
eṣu kāryaṃ dvijāḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvāpaṇād ṛte || 54 ||
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tu śuklāyāṃ saṅkrāntividhinā naraiḥ || 55 ||
yadā ca śrotriyo 'bhyeti gehaṃ vedavid agnimān |
tenaikena ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidhivad uttamam || 57 ||
pārvaṇena vidhānena śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathā dvijaiḥ || 58 ||
pitṛvyasyāpy aputrasya bhrātur jyeṣṭhasya caiva hi || 59 ||
pārvaṇaṃ devapūrvaṃ syād ekoddiṣṭaṃ surair vinā |
dvau daive pitṛkārye trīn ekaikam ubhayatra vā || 60 ||
mātāmahānām apy evaṃ sarvam ūhena kīrtitam |
pretībhūtasya satataṃ bhuvi piṇḍaṃ jalaṃ tathā || 61 ||
dvādaśe 'hani māse ca tripakṣe ca tataḥ param || 64 ||
māsi māsi ca kartavyaṃ yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti nirmuktāḥ pretatvāt pitṛtāṃ gatāḥ || 66 ||
amūrtā mūrtimantaś ca pitaro dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ |
nāndīmukhās tv amūrtāḥ syur mūrtimanto 'tha pārvaṇāḥ |
pretībhūtasya vidhivad brūhi no vadatāṃ vara || 68 ||
apasavyaṃ ca tatrāpi bhojayed ayujo dvijān || 70 ||
taṃ kathyamānam ekāgrāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ me dvijottamāḥ || 71 ||
kuryāt pitṝṇāṃ tritayam ekaṃ pretasya ca dvijāḥ || 72 ||
ye samānā iti japan pūrvavac cheṣam ācaret || 73 ||
strīṇām apy evam eva syād ekoddiṣṭam udāhṛtam |
mṛtāhani ca tat kāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vidhicoditam || 75 ||
kuryur etaṃ vidhiṃ samyak putrasya ca sutāḥ sutāḥ || 76 ||
tadabhāve ca nṛpatiḥ kārayet tv akuṭumbinām |
tajjātīyair naraiḥ samyag vāhādyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ || 79 ||
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ bāndhavo nṛpatir yataḥ |
etā vaḥ kathitā viprā nityā naimittikās tathā || 80 ||
darśas tatra nimittaṃ tu vidyād indukṣayānvitaḥ || 81 ||
nityas tu niyataḥ kālas tasmin kuryād yathoditam |
sa tu lepabhujaṃ yāti praluptaḥ pitṛpiṇḍataḥ |
teṣāṃ hi yaś caturtho 'nyaḥ sa tu lepabhujo bhavet || 83 ||
piṇḍasambandhino hy ete vijñeyāḥ puruṣās trayaḥ |
prabhṛtyuktās trayas teṣāṃ yajamānaś ca saptamaḥ |
ity eṣa munibhiḥ proktaḥ sambandhaḥ sāptapauruṣaḥ || 86 ||
tato 'nye pūrvajāḥ sarve ye cānye narakaukasaḥ || 87 ||
ye 'pi tiryaktvam āpannā ye ca bhūtādisaṃsthitāḥ |
tān sarvān yajamāno vai śrāddhaṃ kurvan yathāvidhi || 88 ||
sa samāpyāyate viprā yena yena vadāmi tat |
annaprakiraṇaṃ yat tu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi || 89 ||
tena tṛptim upāyānti ye piśācatvam āgatāḥ |
yad ambu snānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati bho dvijāḥ || 90 ||
tena ye tarutāṃ prāptās teṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate |
tābhir āpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ devatvaṃ ye kule gatāḥ |
uddhṛteṣv atha piṇḍeṣu yāś cāmbukaṇikā bhuvi || 92 ||
tābhir āpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye tiryaktvaṃ kule gatāḥ |
ye cādantāḥ kule bālāḥ kriyāyogād bahiṣkṛtāḥ || 93 ||
bhuktvā cācāmatāṃ yac ca yaj jalaṃ cāṅghriśaucajam || 94 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaivānyat tena tṛptiṃ prayānti vai |
evaṃ yo yajamānasya yaś ca teṣāṃ dvijanmanām || 95 ||
kaścij jalānnavikṣepaḥ śucir ucchiṣṭa eva vā |
tenānnena kule tatra ye ca yonyantaraṃ gatāḥ || 96 ||
anyāyopārjitair arthair yac chrāddhaṃ kriyate naraiḥ || 97 ||
evam āpyāyanaṃ viprā bahūnām eva bāndhavaiḥ || 98 ||
tasmāc chrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā śākenāpi yathāvidhi || 99 ||
kurvīta kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ kule kaścin na sīdati |
śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ tu vipreṣu saṃyateṣv agnihotriṣu || 100 ||
daive niyoge pitrye ca tāṃs tathaivopakalpayet || 105 ||
taiś ca saṃyamibhir bhāvyaṃ yas tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati |
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati || 106 ||
pitaras tasya vai māsaṃ tasmin retasi śerate |
gatvā ca yoṣitaṃ śrāddhe yo bhuṅkte yas tu gacchati || 107 ||
bhikṣārtham āgatāṃś cāpi kālena saṃyatān yatīn || 109 ||
yoginaś ca tadā śrāddhe bhojanīyā vipaścitā || 110 ||
yogādhārā hi pitaras tasmāt tān pūjayet sadā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi eko yogī bhaved yadi || 111 ||
yajamānaṃ ca bhoktṝṃś ca naur ivāmbhasi tārayet |
yā gītā pitṛbhiḥ pūrvam ailasyāsīn mahīpateḥ |
kadā naḥ santatāv agryaḥ kasyacid bhavitā sutaḥ || 113 ||
yo yogibhuktaśeṣān no bhuvi piṇḍān pradāsyati |
gayāyām athavā piṇḍaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ tathā haviḥ || 114 ||
kālaśākaṃ tilājyaṃ ca tṛptaye kṛsaraṃ ca naḥ |
vaiśvadevaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca khaḍgamāṃsaṃ paraṃ haviḥ || 115 ||
dadyāc chrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca yathāvidhi || 116 ||
tasmāt sampūjayed bhaktyā svapitṝn vidhivan naraḥ || 117 ||
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca || 119 ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sambhojya ca dvijottamān |
visarjayet priyāṇy uktvā praṇipatya ca bhaktitaḥ || 122 ||
tato nityakriyāṃ kuryād bhojayec ca tathātithīn || 123 ||
nityakriyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca kecid icchanti sattamāḥ |
na pitṝṇāṃ tathaivānye śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret || 124 ||
pṛthaktvena vadanty anye kecit pūrvaṃ ca pūrvavat |
tatas tad annaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhir naraḥ || 125 ||
evaṃ kurvīta dharmajñaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitryaṃ samāhitaḥ |
mitradhruk kunakhī klībaḥ kṣayī śuklī vaṇikpathaḥ || 127 ||
mūkaḥ paṅguḥ kuṇiḥ ṣaṇḍho duścarmā vyaṅgakekarau || 128 ||
vṛṣalīpatis tatsutaś ca na bhavec chrāddhabhug dvijaḥ || 130 ||
bhṛtakādhyāpako yas tu bhṛtakādhyāpitaś ca yaḥ || 131 ||
abhiśastas tathā stenaḥ patito vārddhuṣiḥ śaṭhaḥ || 132 ||
vṛddhadviḍ durdharaḥ krūro mūḍho devalakas tathā |
ayājyayājakaḥ ṣaṇḍho garhitā ye ca ye 'dhamāḥ |
na te śrāddhe niyoktavyā dṛṣṭvāmī paṅktidūṣakāḥ || 135 ||
daṇḍo devakṛtas tatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ || 136 ||
hitvāgamaṃ suvihitaṃ bāliśaṃ yas tu bhojayet |
yas tv āśritaṃ dvijaṃ tyaktvā anyam ānīya bhojayet |
vastrābhāve kriyā nāsti yajñā vedās tapāṃsi ca |
śrāddhe tv etāni yo dadyāt kāmān āpnoti cottamān || 140 ||
yathā goṣu prabhūtāsu vatso vindati mātaram |
nāmagotraṃ ca mantrāṃś ca dattam annaṃ na yanti te |
api ye nidhanaṃ prāptās tṛptis tān upatiṣṭhate || 142 ||
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś ca mahāyogibhya eva ca |
namaḥ svāhāyai svadhāyai nityam eva bhavantv iti || 143 ||
ādyāvasāne śrāddhasya trir āvṛttyā japet tadā |
kṣipram āyānti pitaro rākṣasāḥ pradravanti ca |
prīyante triṣu lokeṣu mantro 'yaṃ tārayaty uta || 145 ||
kṣaumasūtraṃ navaṃ dadyāc chāṇaṃ kārpāsikaṃ tathā |
pattrorṇaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ ca vivarjayet || 146 ||
varjayec cādaśaṃ prājño yadyapy avyāhataṃ bhavet |
na prīṇayanty athaitāni dātuś cāpy anayo bhavet || 147 ||
na nivedyo bhavet piṇḍaḥ pitṝṇāṃ yas tu jīvati |
piṇḍam agnau sadā dadyād bhogārthī satataṃ naraḥ |
patnyai dadyāt prajārthī ca madhyamaṃ mantrapūrvakam || 149 ||
uttamāṃ dyutim anvicchan piṇḍaṃ goṣu prayacchati |
prajñāṃ caiva yaśaḥ kīrtim apsu caiva nivedayet || 150 ||
prārthayan dīrgham āyuś ca vāyasebhyaḥ prayacchati |
eke viprāḥ punaḥ prāhuḥ piṇḍoddharaṇam agrataḥ |
anujñātas tu viprais taiḥ kāmam uddhriyatām iti || 152 ||
tasmāc chrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ yathoktam ṛṣibhiḥ purā |
anyathā tu bhaved doṣaḥ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati || 153 ||
yavair vrīhitilair māṣair godhūmaiś caṇakais tathā |
paṭolaṃ ca priyālaṃ ca karkandhūbadarāṇi ca || 157 ||
vikaṅkataṃ vatsakaṃ ca kastvārur vārakān api |
gavyaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca tilasambhavam || 159 ||
saindhavaṃ sāgarotthaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ sārasaṃ tathā |
śākam āraṇyakaṃ cāpi dadyāt puṣpāṇy amūni ca || 161 ||
yūthikām atimuktaṃ ca śrāddhayogyāni bho dvijāḥ |
kamalaṃ kumudaṃ padmaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca yatnataḥ || 164 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī vālakaṃ ca kukkuṭī jātipattrakam || 165 ||
gugguluṃ candanaṃ caiva śrīvāsam aguruṃ tathā |
vipruṣān markaṭāṃś caiva kodravāṃś caiva varjayet || 168 ||
straiṇam auṣṭram āvikaṃ ca dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tyajet || 169 ||
jambīraṃ raktabilvaṃ ca śālasyāpi phalaṃ tyajet || 170 ||
pālaṅkaṃ ca kumārīṃ ca kirātaṃ piṇḍamūlakam || 172 ||
jīvaṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ ca nālikāṃ gandhaśūkaram || 173 ||
halabhṛtyaṃ sarṣapaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ tyajet |
vārtākaṃ śivajātaṃ ca lomaśāni vaṭāni ca |
kālīyaṃ raktavāṇāṃ ca balākā lakucaṃ tathā || 176 ||
āranālaṃ ca śuktaṃ ca śīrṇaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā || 177 ||
atyamlaṃ picchilaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yātayāmaṃ ca sattamāḥ || 178 ||
na ca deyaṃ gatarasaṃ madyagandhaṃ ca yad bhavet |
āmrātakaṃ jīvakaṃ ca tumburuṃ ca niyojayet |
pānakaṃ ca rasālaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ ca nivedayet |
āsurāṇīha bhojyāni tāny ato dūratas tyajet |
siṃhatuṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca śrāddhe yojyaṃ tathocyate |
yad apy uktaṃ hi manunā rohitaṃ pratiyojayet || 187 ||
mayā niṣiddhaṃ bhuñjāno rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnāṃ na deyāni pitṛṣv api |
rohitaṃ śūkaraṃ kūrmaṃ godhāhaṃsaṃ ca varjayet || 190 ||
cakravākaṃ ca madguṃ ca śalkahīnāṃś ca matsyakān |
kuraraṃ ca nirasthiṃ ca vāsahātaṃ ca kukkuṭān || 191 ||
etān anyāṃś ca sanduṣṭān yo bhakṣayati durmatiḥ || 193 ||
sa mahāpāpakārī tu rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
pitṛṣv etāṃs tu yo dadyāt pāpātmā garhitāmiṣān || 194 ||
sa svargasthān api pitṝn narake pātayiṣyati |
piṇyākaṃ vipruṣaṃ caiva masūraṃ gṛñjanaṃ śaṇam |
phalaṃ tālatarūṇāṃ ca bhuktyā narakam ṛcchati || 197 ||
dattvā pitṛṣu taiḥ sārdhaṃ vrajet pūyavahaṃ naraḥ |
na tv eva hi niṣiddhānām ādānaṃ pumbhir ādarāt |
ajñānād vā pramādād vā sakṛd etāni ca dvijāḥ || 200 ||
evaṃ niṣiddhācaraṇe kṛte sakṛd api dvijaiḥ || 202 ||
śuddhiṃ neyaṃ śarīraṃ tu viṣṇubhaktair viśeṣataḥ |
niṣiddhaṃ varjayed dravyaṃ yathoktaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 203 ||
pitā jīvati yasyātha mṛtau dvau pitarau pituḥ |
kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ hi kartavyam etad vistaraśo vada || 205 ||
yasmai dadyāt pitā śrāddhaṃ tasmai dadyāt sutaḥ svayam |
evaṃ na hīyate dharmo laukiko vaidikas tathā || 206 ||
mṛtaḥ pitā jīvati ca yasya brahman pitāmahaḥ |
sa hi śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kuryād etat tvaṃ vaktum arhasi || 207 ||
pituḥ piṇḍaṃ pradadyāc ca bhojayec ca pitāmaham |
prapitāmahasya piṇḍaṃ vai hy ayaṃ śāstreṣu nirṇayaḥ || 208 ||
mṛteṣu piṇḍaṃ dātavyaṃ jīvantaṃ cāpi bhojayet |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ nāsti na ca pārvaṇam iṣyate || 209 ||
ācāram ācared yas tu pitṛmedhāśritaṃ naraḥ |
āyuṣā dhanaputraiś ca vardhaty āśu na saṃśayaḥ || 210 ||
tad annam asya pitaro 'śnanti ca triyugaṃ dvijāḥ || 211 ||
evaṃ samyag gṛhasthena devatāḥ pitaras tathā |
bhikṣavo yācamānāś ca ye cānye pānthakā gṛhe || 2 ||
kathitaṃ bhavatā vipra nityanaimittikaṃ ca yat |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ karma pauruṣam || 4 ||
sadācāraṃ mune śrotum icchāmo vadatas tava |
yaṃ kurvan sukham āpnoti paratreha ca mānavaḥ || 5 ||
na hy ācāravihīnasya bhadram atra paratra vā || 6 ||
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyur vindate mahat |
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi sadācārasya bho dvijāḥ |
tatsaṃsiddhau gṛhasthasya siddhir atra paratra ca || 10 ||
pādenāpy asya pāratryaṃ kuryāc chreyaḥ svam ātmavān |
evam ācarato viprā arthaḥ sāphalyam ṛcchati || 12 ||
ubhābhyāṃ ca dvidhā kāmaṃ tena tau ca dvidhā punaḥ || 16 ||
asacchāstram asadvādam asatsevāṃ ca vai dvijāḥ || 19 ||
pūrvāhṇa eva kāryāṇi devatānāṃ ca tarpaṇam || 21 ||
na viṇmūtram anuṣṭheyaṃ na ca kṛṣṭe na govraje || 22 ||
nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣen na paśyed ātmanaḥ śakṛt |
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret |
nādhitiṣṭhet tathā prājñaḥ pathi vastrāṇi vā bhuvi || 25 ||
kṛtvā vibhavataḥ paścād gṛhastho bhoktum arhati || 26 ||
bhuñjīta cānnaṃ taccitto hy antarjānuḥ sadā naraḥ || 27 ||
pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ varjyam annam ucchiṣṭam eva ca || 28 ||
na gacchan na ca tiṣṭhan vai viṇmūtrotsargam ātmavān |
kurvīta caivam ucchiṣṭaṃ na kiñcid api bhakṣayet || 29 ||
ucchiṣṭo nālapet kiñcit svādhyāyaṃ ca vivarjayet |
na paśyec ca raviṃ cenduṃ nakṣatrāṇi ca kāmataḥ || 30 ||
bhinnāsanaṃ ca śayyāṃ ca bhājanaṃ ca vivarjayet |
naikavastraś ca bhuñjīta na kuryād devatārcanam |
nāvāhayed dvijān agnau homaṃ kurvīta buddhimān || 33 ||
na snāyīta naro nagno na śayīta kadācana |
na pāṇibhyām ubhābhyāṃ tu kaṇḍūyeta śiras tathā || 34 ||
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ budhaiḥ |
śiraḥsnātaś ca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiñcid upaspṛśet || 35 ||
duṣkṛtaṃ na guror brūyāt kruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet |
parivādaṃ na śṛṇuyād anyeṣām api kurvatām || 38 ||
panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥkhāturasya ca |
vidyādhikaṃ guruṃ caiva budhaḥ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā bhogaṃ yoṣitaś ca vivarjayet || 42 ||
na cāpi vikṣipet pādau pādaṃ pādena nākramet || 43 ||
dambhābhimānaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca na kurvīta vicakṣaṇaḥ |
sāyaṃ prātaś ca bhoktavyaṃ kṛtvā cātithipūjanam |
nodakśirāḥ svapej jātu na ca pratyakśirā naraḥ || 49 ||
śiras tv āgastyām ādhāya śayītātha purandarīm |
na tu gandhavatīṣv apsu śayīta na tathoṣasi || 50 ||
uparāge paraṃ snānam ṛte dinam udāhṛtam |
na cāvadhūnayet keśān vāsasī na ca nirdhunet |
na cāpi raktavāsāḥ syāc citrāsitadharo 'pi vā |
na ca kuryād viparyāsaṃ vāsasor nāpi bhūṣayoḥ || 53 ||
varjyaṃ ca vidaśaṃ vastram atyantopahataṃ ca yat |
na bhakṣayec ca satataṃ pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ naraḥ |
varjyaṃ ciroṣitaṃ viprāḥ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat || 56 ||
tathā māṃsavikārāś ca naiva varjyāś ciroṣitāḥ || 57 ||
nāsnāto naiva saṃviṣṭo na caivānyamanā naraḥ || 58 ||
na caiva śayane norvyām upaviṣṭo na śabdakṛt |
ācāmec caiva tadvac ca prāṅmukhodaṅmukho 'pi vā |
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāś ca varjayet pañca vai mṛdaḥ |
prakṣālya hastau pādau ca samabhyukṣya samāhitaḥ || 65 ||
antarjānus tathācāmet triś catur vāpi vai naraḥ |
parimṛjya dvir āvartya khāni mūrdhānam eva ca || 66 ||
samyag ācamya toyena kriyāṃ kurvīta vai śuciḥ |
yathāvibhavato hy etat pūrvābhāve tataḥ param |
svāpe 'dhvani tathā bhuñjan svādhyāyaṃ ca vivarjayet || 70 ||
sandhyāyāṃ maithunaṃ cāpi tathā prasthānam eva ca |
śiraḥsnānaṃ ca kurvīta daivaṃ pitryam athāpi ca |
vyaṅginīṃ varjayet kanyāṃ kulajāṃ vāpy arogiṇīm |
udvahet pitṛmātroś ca saptamīṃ pañcamīṃ tathā || 73 ||
rakṣed dārāṃs tyajed īrṣyāṃ tathāhni svapnamaithune |
tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajed rātryāṃ jyeṣṭhayugmāsu rātriṣu |
kṣurakarmaṇi cānte ca strīsambhoge ca bho dvijāḥ |
snāyīta cailavān prājñaḥ kaṭabhūmim upetya ca || 79 ||
parivādaṃ na kurvīta parihāsaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ |
sadā māṅgalyaveṣaḥ syān na vāmāṅgalyavān bhavet |
na cātivyayaśīlaiś ca puruṣair naiva vairibhiḥ || 83 ||
kāryākṣamair ninditair na na caiva viṭasaṅgibhiḥ |
nisvair na vādaikaparair naraiś cānyais tathādhamaiḥ || 84 ||
uttiṣṭhed vibhavāc cainān arcayed gṛham āgatān || 85 ||
sampūjayet tathā vahnau pradadyāc cāhutīḥ kramāt |
prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyāt prajānāṃ pataye tataḥ || 87 ||
pūrvaṃ khyātā mayā yā tu nityakramavidhau kriyā |
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryād vadata śṛṇuta dvijāḥ || 89 ||
yathāsthānavibhāgaṃ tu devān uddiśya vai pṛthak |
vāyave ca pratidiśaṃ digbhyaḥ prācyādiṣu kramāt |
viśvebhyaś caiva devebhyo viśvabhūtebhya eva ca |
svadhā ca nama ity uktvā pitṛbhyaś caiva dakṣiṇe |
devānāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād brāhmaṇānāṃ namaskriyām || 94 ||
aṅguṣṭhottarato rekhā pāṇer yā dakṣiṇasya ca |
etad brāhmam iti khyātaṃ tīrtham ācamanāya vai || 95 ||
pitṝṇāṃ tena toyāni dadyān nāndīmukhād ṛte || 96 ||
evam ebhiḥ sadā tīrthair vidhānaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha |
prājāpatyena tīrthena yac ca kiñcit prajāpateḥ || 100 ||
yugapaj jalam agniṃ ca bibhṛyān na vicakṣaṇaḥ |
gurudevapitṝn viprān na ca pādau prasārayet || 101 ||
nācakṣīta dhayantīṃ gāṃ jalaṃ nāñjalinā pibet |
śaucakāleṣu sarveṣu guruṣv alpeṣu vā punaḥ |
na vilambeta medhāvī na mukhenānalaṃ dhamet || 102 ||
tatra viprā na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam |
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaś ca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī || 103 ||
tatra nityaṃ vaset prājñaḥ kutaḥ kunṛpatau sukham || 104 ||
tatra viprā na vastavyaṃ yatraitat tritayaṃ sadā |
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaś ca janaś ca satatotsavaḥ || 107 ||
ity etat kathitaṃ viprā mayā vo hitakāmyayā |
śaśakaḥ kacchapo godhā śvāvin matsyo 'tha śalyakaḥ |
prokṣitaṃ cauṣadhārthaṃ ca khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati || 112 ||
pātrāṇāṃ camasānāṃ ca ambunā śaucam iṣyate || 114 ||
sasnehānāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ śuddhir uṣṇena vāriṇā || 115 ||
saṃhatānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇāt sañcayasya ca || 116 ||
tathā kārpāsikānāṃ ca śuddhiḥ syāj jalabhasmanā |
śuddhaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā || 120 ||
mṛdambu bhasma cāpy anne prakṣeptavyaṃ viśuddhaye |
bhasmāmbubhiś ca kāṃsyānāṃ śuddhiḥ plāvo dravasya ca |
anyeṣāṃ caiva dravyāṇāṃ varṇagandhāṃś ca hārayet |
rathyāgataṃ ca tailādi śuci gotṛptidaṃ payaḥ |
ajāśvaṃ mukhato medhyaṃ na gor vatsasya cānanam || 129 ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ taṭau nadyās tṛṇāni ca || 130 ||
śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryād ācamyādbhis tathā mṛdā |
ajñāne jñānapūrve tu taddoṣopaśame na tu |

tasya sā vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā svaṃ rūpam uttamam |

siddhiṃ yāsyasi viprendra tatas tvaṃ mām avāpsyasi || 145 ||

Chapter 234: On suffering and final release from existence (absolute

ādhyātmikādi bho viprā jñātvā tāpatrayaṃ budhaḥ |

Chapter 235: Description of the practice of Yoga
śrutvā sa vacanaṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanas tadā |
yogaṃ vakṣyāmi bho viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ bhavanāśanam |
itihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ ca vedāṃś caiva vicakṣaṇaḥ || 4 ||
āhāraṃ yogadoṣāṃś ca deśakālaṃ ca buddhimān |

na dvandve na ca śīte ca na coṣṇe nānilātmake || 7 ||
na caitye na ca valmīke sabhaye kūpasannidhau |
deśān etān anādṛtya mūḍhatvād yo yunakti vai |
pravakṣye tasya ye doṣā jāyante vighnakārakāḥ || 10 ||
bādhiryaṃ jaḍatā lopaḥ smṛter mūkatvam andhatā |
jvaraś ca jāyate sadyas tadvad ajñānasambhavaḥ || 11 ||
tasmāt sarvātmanā kāryā rakṣā yogavidā sadā |
āśrame vijane guhye niḥśabde nirbhaye nage |
rajanyāḥ paścime yāme pūrve ca susamāhitaḥ |
nātinīce na cocchrite niḥspṛhaḥ satyavāk śuciḥ || 15 ||
nābhau nidhāya hastau dvau śāntaḥ padmāsane sthitaḥ |
saṃsthāpya dṛṣṭiṃ nāsāgre prāṇān āyamya vāgyataḥ || 17 ||
rajasā tamaso vṛttiṃ sattvena rajasas tathā |
kṣetrajñaś ca pare yojyas tato yuñjati yogavit || 21 ||
yadā nirviṣayaṃ cittaṃ pare brahmaṇi līyate |
bhavaty ānandam āsādya tadā nirvāṇam ṛcchati || 24 ||
prāpya yogabalād yogī mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
indriyāṇi na seveta vairāgyeṇa ca yogavit |
na ca padmāsanād yogo na nāsāgranirīkṣaṇāt |
manasaś cendriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyogo yoga ucyate || 28 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā yogaḥ prokto vimuktidaḥ |
saṃsāramokṣahetuś ca kim anyac chrotum icchatha || 29 ||
śrutvā te vacanaṃ tasya sādhu sādhv iti cābruvan |
vyāsaṃ praśasya sampūjya punaḥ praṣṭuṃ samudyatāḥ || 30 ||
pibatāṃ no dvijaśreṣṭha na tṛptir iha dṛśyate || 1 ||
tasmād yogaṃ mune brūhi vistareṇa vimuktidam |
sāṅkhyaṃ ca dvipadāṃ śreṣṭha śrotum icchāmahe vayam || 2 ||
sāṅkhye vā yadi vā yoga etat pṛṣṭo vadasva naḥ || 4 ||
yenopāyena puruṣas tat tvaṃ vyākhyātum arhasi || 5 ||
bhūmer deho jalāt sneho jyotiṣaś cakṣuṣī smṛte |
krāntau viṣṇur bale śakraḥ koṣṭhe 'gnir bhoktum icchati |
karṇayoḥ pradiśaḥ śrotre jihvāyāṃ vāk sarasvatī || 9 ||
karṇau tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī |
śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pañcamam |
indriyārthān pṛthag vidyād indriyebhyas tu nityadā || 11 ||
indriyāṇi mano yuṅkte avaśyān iva rājinaḥ |
manaś cāpi sadā yuṅkte bhūtātmā hṛdayāśritaḥ || 12 ||
niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā manasas tathā || 13 ||
prāṇāpānau ca jīvaś ca nityaṃ deheṣu dehinām || 14 ||
āśrayo nāsti sattvasya guṇaśabdo na cetanāḥ |
sattvaṃ hi tejaḥ sṛjati na guṇān vai kathañcana || 15 ||
evaṃ saptadaśaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ |
manīṣī manasā viprāḥ paśyaty ātmānam ātmani || 16 ||
na hy ayaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyo na ca sarvair apīndriyaiḥ |
manasā tu pradīptena mahān ātmā prakāśate || 17 ||
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ || 20 ||
sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jaṅgameṣu dhruveṣu ca |
vasaty eko mahān ātmā yena sarvam idaṃ tatam || 21 ||
yadā paśyati bhūtātmā brahma sampadyate tadā || 22 ||
yāvān ātmani vedātmā tāvān ātmā parātmani |
ya evaṃ satataṃ veda so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate || 23 ||
yathā gatir na dṛśyeta tathā jñānavidāṃ gatiḥ || 25 ||
yasmiṃs tu pacyate kālas tan na vedeha kaścana || 26 ||
na tad ūrdhvaṃ na tiryak ca nādho na ca punaḥ punaḥ |
na madhye pratigṛhṇīte naiva kiñcin na kaścana || 27 ||
sarve tatsthā ime lokā bāhyam eṣāṃ na kiñcana |
yady apy agre samāgacched yathā bāṇo guṇacyutaḥ || 28 ||
naivāntaṃ kāraṇasyeyād yady api syān manojavaḥ |
tasmāt sūkṣmataraṃ nāsti nāsti sthūlataraṃ tathā || 29 ||
tad evāṇor aṇutaraṃ tan mahadbhyo mahattaram |
tad antaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhan na dṛśyate || 31 ||
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva dvedhā bhāvo 'yam ātmanaḥ |
kṣaraḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu divyaṃ tv amṛtam akṣaram || 32 ||
navadvāraṃ puraṃ kṛtvā haṃso hi niyato vaśī |
haṃsoktaṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva kūṭasthaṃ yat tad akṣaram |
tad vidvān akṣaraṃ prāpya jahāti prāṇajanmanī || 35 ||
bhavatāṃ pṛcchatāṃ viprā yathāvad iha tattvataḥ |
sāṅkhyaṃ jñānena saṃyuktaṃ yad etat kīrtitaṃ mayā || 36 ||
yogakṛtyaṃ tu bho viprāḥ kīrtayiṣyāmy ataḥ param |
ātmano vyāpino jñānaṃ jñānam etad anuttamam |
yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ || 39 ||
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam |
dhṛtyā śiśnodaraṃ rakṣet pāṇipādaṃ ca cakṣuṣā || 41 ||
cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca karmaṇā |
evam etān yogadoṣāñ jayen nityam atandritaḥ |
agnīṃś ca brāhmaṇāṃś cātha devatāḥ praṇamet sadā || 43 ||
brahmatejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvam idaṃ jagat || 44 ||
dhyānam adhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīr ārjavaṃ kṣamā || 45 ||
śaucaṃ caivātmanaḥ śuddhir indriyāṇāṃ ca nigrahaḥ |
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā niṣeved brahmaṇaḥ padam |
pūrvarātre parārdhe ca dhārayen mana ātmanaḥ |
jantoḥ pañcendriyasyāsya yady ekaṃ klinnam indriyam || 49 ||
tato 'sya sravati prajñā gireḥ pādād ivodakam |
manasaḥ pūrvam ādadyāt kūrmāṇām iva matsyahā || 50 ||
tataḥ śrotraṃ tataś cakṣur jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca yogavit |
tata etāni saṃyamya manasi sthāpayed yadi || 51 ||
tathaivāpohya saṅkalpān mano hy ātmani dhārayet |
prasīdanti ca saṃsthāyāṃ tadā brahma prakāśate || 53 ||
vidhūma iva dīptārcir āditya iva dīptimān |
sarvaṃ tatra tu sarvatra vyāpakatvāc ca dṛśyate |
taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ || 55 ||
āsīno hi rahasy eko gacched akṣarasāmyatām |
kuryāt paricayaṃ yoge trailokye niyato muniḥ || 59 ||
ekāgraṃ cintayen nityaṃ yogān nodvijate manaḥ |
tatra yukto niṣeveta na caiva vicalet tataḥ |
nātivrajet paraṃ vācā karmaṇā manasāpi vā |
yaś cainam abhinandeta yaś cainam abhivādayet |
samas tayoś cāpy ubhayor nābhidhyāyec chubhāśubham || 64 ||
na prahṛṣyeta lābheṣu nālābheṣu ca cintayet |
evaṃ tu nirato mārgaṃ viramen na vimohitaḥ || 67 ||
api varṇāvakṛṣṭas tu nārī vā dharmakāṅkṣiṇī |
tāv apy etena mārgeṇa gacchetāṃ paramāṃ gatim || 68 ||
Chapter 237: On the opposition of action and knowledge
yady evaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca |
kāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti kāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā || 1 ||
etad vai śrotum icchāmas tad bhavān prabravītu naḥ |
yāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti yāṃ gacchanti ca karmaṇā |
śṛṇudhvaṃ sāmprataṃ viprā gahanaṃ hy etad uttaram || 4 ||
asti dharma iti yuktaṃ nāsti tatraiva yo vadet |
yakṣasya sādṛśyam idaṃ yakṣasyedaṃ bhaved atha || 5 ||
dvāv imāv atha panthānau yatra vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
karmaṇā badhyate jantur vidyayā ca vimucyate |
tasmāt karma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ || 7 ||
vidyayā jāyate nityam avyaktaṃ hy akṣarātmakam || 8 ||
karma tv eke praśaṃsanti svalpabuddhiratā narāḥ |
ye tu buddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā dharmanaipuṇyadarśinaḥ |
na te karma praśaṃsanti kūpaṃ nadyāṃ pibann iva || 10 ||
vidyayā tad avāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || 11 ||

na jīryate yatra gatvā yatra gatvā na vardhate || 12 ||
yatra tad brahma paramam avyaktam acalaṃ dhruvam |
dvandvair na yatra bādhyante mānasena ca karmaṇā |
samāḥ sarvatra maitrāś ca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || 14 ||
na vaktuṃ śakyate draṣṭuṃ cakratantum ivāmbare || 16 ||

devo yaḥ saṃśritas tasmin buddhīndur iva puṣkare |
tamo rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca jñeyaṃ jīvaguṇātmakam |

te cainaṃ na prajānanti na jānāti sa tān api || 21 ||
taiś caiva kurute kāryaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhair ihendriyaiḥ |
indriyebhyaḥ parā hy arthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ |

dṛśyate tv agryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ || 25 ||
anīśvaraḥ praśāntātmā tato gacchet paraṃ padam || 27 ||
sattve cittaṃ samāveśya tataḥ kālañjaro bhavet || 29 ||

nirvāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyamāno na kampate || 31 ||
evaṃ pūrvāpare rātre yuñjann ātmānam ātmanā |
navanītaṃ yathā dadhnaḥ kāṣṭhād agnir yathaiva ca |
yad apy asya mahīṃ dadyād ratnapūrṇām imāṃ naraḥ |
idam eva tataḥ śreya iti manyeta tattvavit || 40 ||
yat tan maharṣibhir dṛṣṭaṃ vedānteṣu ca gīyate || 41 ||
tad yuṣmabhyaṃ prayacchāmi yan māṃ pṛcchata sattamāḥ |
yan me manasi varteta yas tu vo hṛdi saṃśayaḥ |
śrutaṃ bhavadbhis tat sarvaṃ kim anyat kathayāmi vaḥ || 42 ||
adhyātmaṃ vistareṇeha punar eva vadasva naḥ |
yad adhyātmaṃ yathā vidmo bhagavann ṛṣisattama || 43 ||
adhyātmaṃ yad idaṃ viprāḥ puruṣasyeha paṭhyate |
bhūmir āpas tathā jyotir vāyur ākāśam eva ca |
ākāraṃ tu bhaved yasya yasmin dehaṃ na paśyati |
indriyāṇāṃ guṇāḥ kecit kathaṃ tān upalakṣayet || 46 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ tad ihaikāgryā yathātattvaṃ yathā ca tat || 47 ||
śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayam ākāśalakṣaṇam |
prāṇaś ceṣṭā tathā sparśa ete vāyuguṇās trayaḥ || 48 ||
rūpaṃ cakṣur vipākaś ca tridhā jyotir vidhīyate |
raso 'tha rasanaṃ svedo guṇās tv ete trayo 'mbhasām || 49 ||
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca bhūmer ete guṇās trayaḥ |
vāyoḥ sparśo raso 'dbhyaś ca jyotiṣo rūpam ucyate |
mano buddhiḥ svabhāvaś ca guṇā ete svayonijāḥ |
te guṇān ativartante guṇebhyaḥ paramā matāḥ || 52 ||
yad ūrdhvaṃ pādatalayor avārkordhvaṃ ca paśyati |
etasminn eva kṛtye sā vartate buddhir uttamā || 54 ||
guṇais tu nīyate buddhir buddhir evendriyāṇy api |
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyā bhāvāt kuto guṇāḥ || 55 ||
indriyāṇi naraiḥ pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tan mana ucyate |
saptamīṃ buddhim evāhuḥ kṣetrajñaṃ viddhi cāṣṭamam || 56 ||
rajas tamaś ca sattvaṃ ca traya ete svayonijāḥ |
samāḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tān guṇān upalakṣayet || 58 ||
tatra yat prītisaṃyuktaṃ kiñcid ātmani lakṣayet |
praśāntam iva saṃyuktaṃ sattvaṃ tad upadhārayet || 59 ||
yat tu santāpasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet |
pravṛttaṃ raja ity evaṃ tatra cāpy upalakṣayet || 60 ||
yat tu sammohasaṃyuktam avyaktaṃ viṣamaṃ bhavet |
akasmād yadi vā kasmād vadanti sāttvikān guṇān || 62 ||
tathā mohaḥ pramādaś ca tandrī nidrāprabodhitā |
indriyebhyaḥ parā hy arthā arthebhyaś ca paraṃ manaḥ |
manasas tu parā buddhir buddher ātmā paraḥ smṛtaḥ || 66 ||
yadā vikurute bhāvaṃ tadā bhavati sā manaḥ || 67 ||
indriyāṇāṃ pṛthagbhāvād buddhir vikurute hy anu |
śṛṇvatī bhavati śrotraṃ spṛśatī sparśa ucyate || 68 ||
paśyantī ca bhaved dṛṣṭī rasantī rasanā bhavet |
jighrantī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ buddhir vikurute pṛthak || 69 ||
indriyāṇi tu tāny āhus teṣāṃ vṛttyā vitiṣṭhati |
kadācil labhate prītiṃ kadācid api śocati |
na sukhena ca duḥkhena kadācid iha muhyate || 71 ||
svayaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃs trīn etān ativartate |
yadā prārthayate kiñcit tadā bhavati sā manaḥ |
adhiṣṭhāne ca vai buddhyā pṛthag etāni saṃsmaret || 73 ||
sarvāṇy evānupūrveṇa yad yadā ca vidhīyate || 74 ||
pravartamānas tu rajaḥ sattvam apy ativartate || 75 ||
ye vai bhāvena vartante sarveṣv eteṣu te triṣu |
anv arthān sampravartante rathanemim arā iva || 76 ||
evaṃsvabhāvam evedam iti buddhvā na muhyati |
na hy ātmā śakyate draṣṭum indriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ |
teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīn yadā samyaṅ niyacchati |
sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ tamasy upagate yathā |
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran |
vimuktātmā tathā yogī guṇadoṣair na lipyate || 82 ||
evam eva kṛtaprajño na doṣair viṣayāṃś caran |
tyaktvā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma ratir yasya sadātmani |
svayam ātmā prasavati guṇeṣv api kadācana |
na guṇā vidur ātmānaṃ guṇān veda sa sarvadā || 85 ||
paridadhyād guṇānāṃ sa draṣṭā caiva yathātatham |
sṛjate tu guṇān eka eko na sṛjate guṇān |
iṣikā vā yathā muñje pṛthak ca saha caiva ha |
sṛjate tu guṇān sattvaṃ kṣetrajñas tv adhitiṣṭhati |
svabhāvayuktaṃ tat sarvaṃ yad imān sṛjate guṇān |
ūrṇanābhir yathā sūtraṃ sṛjate tad guṇāṃs tathā || 2 ||
evam eke vyavasyanti nivṛttim iti cāpare || 3 ||
anenaiva vidhānena bhaved vai saṃśayo mahān || 4 ||
anādinidhano hy ātmā taṃ buddhvā viharen naraḥ |
ity evaṃ hṛdaye sarvo buddhicintāmayaṃ dṛḍham |
tarayet pracyutāṃ pṛthvīṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ |
avagāhya ca vidvāṃso viprā lolam imaṃ tathā || 7 ||
na tu tapyati vai vidvān sthale carati tattvavit |
evaṃ vicintya cātmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñānam ātmanaḥ || 8 ||
tāṃ tu buddhvā naraḥ sargaṃ bhūtānām āgatiṃ gatim |
samaceṣṭaś ca vai samyag labhate śamam uttamam || 9 ||
tattvaṃ buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kim anyad buddhalakṣaṇam |
tac ca nindayati yat purā kṛtam |
yat priyaṃ tad ubhayaṃ na vāpriyaṃ |
yasmād dharmāt paro dharmo vidyate neha kaścana |
yo viśiṣṭaś ca bhūtebhyas tad bhavān prabravītu naḥ || 15 ||
dharmaṃ ca sampravakṣyāmi purāṇam ṛṣibhiḥ stutam |
manasaś cendriyāṇāṃ cāpy aikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ |
vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate || 18 ||
ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṃ kva me phalam || 22 ||
evam ātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kuto 'nv aham |
anyo hy asyāntarātmāsti yaḥ sarvam anupaśyati || 23 ||
dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ tathā yūyaṃ virāgā bhavata dvijāḥ || 24 ||
tāṃ tīrṇaḥ sarvato mukto vidhūtātmātmavāñ śuciḥ || 30 ||
etad dhi sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ || 33 ||
abravaṃ yad ahaṃ viprā ātmasākṣikam añjasā |
naiva strī na pumān evaṃ na caivedaṃ napuṃsakam || 36 ||
naitaj jñātvā pumān strī vā punarbhavam avāpnuyāt || 37 ||
yathā matāni sarvāṇi tathaitāni yathā tathā |
kathitāni mayā viprā bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 38 ||
tam upāyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotum icchāmahe mune || 40 ||
ghaṭopakaraṇe buddhir ghaṭotpattau na sā matā |
pūrve samudre yaḥ panthā na sa gacchati paścimam |
ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tac chṛṇudhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ || 43 ||
apramādād bhayaṃ rakṣed rakṣet kṣetraṃ ca saṃvidam |
icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet || 45 ||
nidrāṃ ca pratibhāṃ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit |
lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca santoṣād viṣayāṃs tattvadarśanāt |
anukrośād adharmaṃ ca jayed dharmam upekṣayā || 47 ||
āyatyā ca jayed āśāṃ sāmarthyaṃ saṅgavarjanāt |
anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhāṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ || 48 ||
utthānena jayet tandrāṃ vitarkaṃ niścayāj jayet || 49 ||
maunena bahubhāṣāṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet |
yacched vāṅmanasī buddhyā tāṃ yacchej jñānacakṣuṣā || 50 ||
jñānam ātmā mahān yacchet taṃ yacchec chāntir ātmanaḥ |
yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam || 52 ||
dhyānam adhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīr ārjavaṃ kṣamā || 53 ||
śaucam ācārataḥ śuddhir indriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ |
etair vivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānam upahanti ca || 54 ||
sidhyanti cāsya saṅkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate |
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā nirviśed brahmaṇaḥ padam |
eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ |

Chapter 239: On the difference between Sāṅkhya and Yoga; on the practice of
          Yoga
sāṅkhyaṃ yogasya no vipra viśeṣaṃ vaktum arhasi |
tava dharmajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ munisattama || 1 ||
anīśvaraḥ kathaṃ mucyed ity evaṃ munisattamāḥ |
vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ yogaṃ samyaṅ manīṣiṇaḥ || 3 ||
vadanti kāraṇaṃ vedaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ samyag dvijātayaḥ |
vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ || 4 ||
ūrdhvaṃ sa dehāt suvyaktaṃ vimucyed iti nānyathā |
etad āhur mahāprājñāḥ sāṅkhyaṃ vai mokṣadarśanam || 5 ||
svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam |
śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śiṣṭasammataiḥ || 6 ||
ubhe caite mate tattve samavete dvijottamāḥ || 7 ||
ubhe caite mate jñāte munīndrāḥ śiṣṭasammate |
tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayor yuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānaghāḥ |
vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ tv asamaṃ tayoḥ || 9 ||
yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra mahāmune |
tulyaṃ taddarśanaṃ kasmāt tan no brūhi dvijottama || 10 ||
rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam |
yathā vānimiṣāḥ sthūlaṃ jālaṃ chittvā punar jalam |
prāpnuvanti tathā yogāt tat padaṃ vītakalmaṣāḥ || 12 ||
tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ |
chittvā yogāt paraṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalaṃ śubham || 14 ||
acalās tv āvilā viprā vāgurāsu tathāpare |
vinaśyanti na sandehas tadvad yogabalād ṛte || 15 ||
balahīnāś ca viprendrā yathā jālaṃ gatā dvijāḥ |
bandhaṃ na gacchanty anaghā yogās te tu sudurlabhāḥ || 16 ||
yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmaṃ prāpya jālam arindamāḥ |
karmajair bandhanair baddhās tadvad yogaparā dvijāḥ |
abalā na vimucyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ || 18 ||
alpakaś ca yathā viprā vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ |
ākrānta indhanaiḥ sthūlais tadvad yogabalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 19 ||
sa eva ca tadā viprā vahnir jātabalaḥ punaḥ |
samīraṇagataḥ kṛtsnāṃ dahet kṣipraṃ mahīm imām || 20 ||
durbalaś ca yathā viprāḥ srotasā hriyate naraḥ |
balahīnas tathā yogī viṣayair hriyate ca saḥ || 22 ||
tad eva tu yathā sroto viṣkambhayati vāraṇaḥ |
tadvad yogabalaṃ labdhvā na bhaved viṣayair hṛtaḥ || 23 ||
viśanti vā vaśād vātha yogād yogabalānvitāḥ |
na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mṛtyur bhīmavikramaḥ |
yogaṃ kuryād balaṃ prāpya taiś ca sarvair mahīṃ caret || 26 ||
prāpnuyād viṣayān kaścit punaś cograṃ tapaś caret |
saṅkṣipyec ca punar viprāḥ sūryas tejoguṇān iva || 27 ||
nidarśanārthaṃ sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punar dvijāḥ || 29 ||
ātmanaś ca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati vā dvijāḥ |
apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ |
yuktaḥ samyak tathā yogī mokṣaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam || 31 ||
snehapātre yathā pūrṇe mana ādhāya niścalam |
muktas tathāyam ātmānaṃ yogaṃ tadvat suniścalam |
yathā ca nāvaṃ viprendrāḥ karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ |
mahārṇavagatāṃ śīghraṃ nayed viprāṃs tu pattanam || 34 ||
durgamaṃ sthānam āpnoti hitvā deham imaṃ dvijāḥ || 35 ||
sārathiś ca yathā yuktaḥ sadaśvān susamāhitaḥ |
deśam iṣṭaṃ nayaty āśu dhanvinaṃ puruṣarṣabham || 36 ||
tathaiva ca dvijā yogī dhāraṇāsu samāhitaḥ |
prāpnoty āśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣyamukta ivāśugaḥ || 37 ||
pāśaṃ hatveva mīnānāṃ padam āpnoti so 'jaram || 38 ||
nābhyāṃ śīrṣe ca kukṣau ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ |
ātmanā sūkṣmam ātmānaṃ yuṅkte samyag dvijottamāḥ || 40 ||
āhārān kīdṛśān kṛtvā kāni jitvā ca sattama |
yogī balam avāpnoti tad bhavān vaktum arhati || 42 ||
kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bho dvijāḥ |
snehānāṃ varjane yukto yogī balam avāpnuyāt || 43 ||
pakṣān māsān ṛtūṃś citrān sañcaraṃś ca guhās tathā |
apaḥ pītvā payomiśrā yogī balam avāpnuyāt || 45 ||
akhaṇḍam api vā māsaṃ satataṃ munisattamāḥ |
upoṣya samyak śuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt || 46 ||
kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇaṃ varṣam eva ca |
bhayaṃ śokaṃ tathā svāpaṃ pauruṣān viṣayāṃs tathā || 47 ||
aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bho dvijāḥ |
sparśaṃ nidrāṃ tathā tandrāṃ durjayāṃ munisattamāḥ || 48 ||
durgas tv eṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām |
yaḥ kaścid vrajati kṣipraṃ kṣemeṇa munipuṅgavāḥ || 50 ||
yogamārgaṃ samāsādya yaḥ kaścid vrajate dvijaḥ |
dhāraṇā sā tu yogasya durgeyam akṛtātmabhiḥ || 54 ||
viṣamā dhāraṇā viprā yānti vai na śubhāṃ gatim |
netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vai dvijāḥ || 55 ||
yas tu tiṣṭhati yogādhau dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi |
paraṃ yogasya panthānaṃ niścitaṃ taṃ dvijātiṣu || 57 ||
tamaś ca kaṣṭaṃ sumahad rajaś ca |
sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca |
tejaś ca kṛtsnaṃ sumahac ca dhairyam || 59 ||
viśvāṃś ca devān uragān pitṝṃś ca |
śailāṃś ca kṛtsnān udadhīṃś ca vācalān |
nadīś ca sarvāḥ sanagāṃś ca nāgān || 60 ||
sāṅkhye tv idānīṃ dharmasya vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ |
triṣu lokeṣu yaj jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ hi te || 2 ||
guṇāś ca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniś ca kevalā || 4 ||
mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃs tathā || 5 ||
pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñ jñātvā tiryaktvaṃ caratāṃ dvijāḥ || 6 ||
āsurān viṣayāñ jñātvā vaiśvadevāṃs tathaiva ca |
devarṣiviṣayāñ jñātvā yogānām api vai parān || 8 ||
viṣayāṃś ca pramāṇasya brahmaṇo viṣayāṃs tathā |
āyuṣaś ca paraṃ kālaṃ lokair vijñāya tattvataḥ || 9 ||
sukhasya ca paraṃ kālaṃ vijñāya munisattamāḥ |
prāptakāle ca yad duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām || 10 ||
tiryaktve patatāṃ viprās tathaiva narakeṣu yat |
svargasya ca guṇāñ jñātvā doṣān sarvāṃś ca bho dvijāḥ || 11 ||
vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ |
jñānayoge ca ye doṣā jñānayoge ca ye guṇāḥ || 12 ||
sāṅkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāṃs tathaiva ca guṇā dvijāḥ |
sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā || 13 ||
tamaś cāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā |
ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā tamaś ca triguṇaṃ mahat || 14 ||
dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvaṃ caikaguṇaṃ punaḥ |
prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param || 16 ||
rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca |
śabdagrāhyaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇena ca || 17 ||
tvacaṃ sparśaṃ tathā śakyaṃ vāyuṃ caiva tadāśritam |
mohaṃ tamasi saṃyuktaṃ lobhaṃ moheṣu saṃśritam || 18 ||
viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam |
apsu devīṃ samāyuktām āpas tejasi saṃśritāḥ || 19 ||
tejo vāyau tu saṃyuktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam |
nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ tamo mahasi saṃsthitam || 20 ||
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani |
saktam ātmānam īśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā || 21 ||
devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃyuktaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca na kvacit |
jñātvā sattvaguṇaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ || 22 ||
madhyastham iva cātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasmin na vidyate || 23 ||
dvitīyaṃ karma vai jñātvā viprendrā viṣayaiṣiṇām |
prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ || 25 ||
ādyaṃ caivānilaṃ jñātvā prabhavaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ |
saptadhā tāṃs tathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivat punaḥ || 26 ||
prajāpatīn ṛṣīṃś caiva sargāṃś ca subahūn varān |
saptarṣīṃś ca bahūñ jñātvā rājarṣīṃś ca parantapān || 27 ||
aiśvaryāc cyāvitān dṛṣṭvā kālena mahatā dvijāḥ || 28 ||
mahatāṃ bhūtasaṅghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ |
gatiṃ vācāṃ śubhāṃ jñātvā arcārhāḥ pāpakarmaṇām || 29 ||
vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yad duḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye |
yoniṣu ca vicitrāsu sañcārān aśubhāṃs tathā || 30 ||
vijñāya hitam ātmānaṃ yogāṃś ca vividhān dvijāḥ |
upaplavāṃs tathā ghorāñ śaśinas tejasas tathā |
tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam || 35 ||
dvandvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇaṃ dvijāḥ |
bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya pakṣadehasya cāśubham |
rāgaṃ mohaṃ ca samprāptaṃ kvacit sattvaṃ samāśritam || 37 ||
viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya ca punar dvijāḥ || 39 ||
gatāsūnāṃ ca sattvānāṃ dehān bhittvā tathā śubhān |
sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bho dvijāḥ |
jananīṣu ca vartante yena samyag dvijottamāḥ |
tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya ca gatīḥ pṛthak || 44 ||
vedavādāṃs tathā citrān ṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃs tathā |
kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ tathā || 45 ||
pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṅkṣayam |
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatas tathā || 46 ||
vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ |
kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punar vṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca || 47 ||
saṃyogānāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
ātmadoṣāṃś ca vijñāya sarvān ātmani saṃsthitān |
svadehād utthitān gandhāṃs tathā vijñāya cāśubhān || 49 ||
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ || 50 ||
pañca doṣān dvijā dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate |
guṇān guṇaśatair jñātvā doṣān doṣaśatair api || 54 ||
hetūn hetuśataiś citraiś citrān vijñāya tattvataḥ |
apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇor māyāśataiḥ kṛtam || 55 ||
rajas tamasi sammagnaṃ paṅke dvipam ivāvaśam || 57 ||
sāṅkhyā viprā mahāprājñās tyaktvā snehaṃ prajākṛtam |
rājasān aśubhān gandhāṃs tāmasāṃś ca tathāvidhān |
puṇyāṃś ca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān || 59 ||
tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ |
tatas tān sukṛtīñ jñātvā sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ || 69 ||
tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti cānaghāḥ || 70 ||
sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaś ca sukhasparśaś ca bho dvijāḥ || 71 ||
saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān |
sa tān vahati viprendrā nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 72 ||
nabho vahati lokeśān rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim |
rajo vahati viprendrāḥ sattvasya paramāṃ gatim || 73 ||
sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātmā paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti ca dvijāḥ || 75 ||
paramā sā gatir viprā nirdvandvānāṃ mahātmanām |
ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te ramante tatra vā na vā || 77 ||
yad atra tathyaṃ tattvaṃ no yathāvad vaktum arhasi |
tvadṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭum arhāma sattama || 78 ||
mokṣadoṣo mahān eṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatān ṛṣīn |
yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare || 79 ||
magnasya hi pare jñāne kintu duḥkhāntaraṃ bhavet || 80 ||
yathānyāyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaś ca saṅkaṭaḥ |
atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama |
buddhiś ca paramā yatra kapilānāṃ mahātmanām || 82 ||
indriyāṇy api budhyante svadehaṃ dehināṃ dvijāḥ |
karaṇāny ātmanas tāni sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti tais tu saḥ || 83 ||
vinaśyanti na sandeho velā iva mahārṇave || 84 ||
sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ smṛtvā spṛśati cānaghāḥ |
indriyāṇi ha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi |
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣv eva sarvaśaḥ |
ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmā varaty ātmā na saṃśayaḥ || 88 ||
sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaś ca guṇān punaḥ |
guṇāṃś ca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheś ca sattamāḥ || 89 ||
guṇāṃś ca manasaś cāpi nabhasaś ca guṇāṃs tathā |
guṇān vāyoś ca sarvajñāḥ snehajāṃś ca guṇān punaḥ || 90 ||
apāṃ guṇās tathā viprāḥ pārthivāṃś ca guṇān api |
sarvān eva guṇair vyāpya kṣetrajñeṣu dvijottamāḥ || 91 ||
ātmā carati kṣetrajñaḥ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubhe |
śiṣyā iva mahātmānam indriyāṇi ca taṃ dvijāḥ || 92 ||
prakṛtiṃ cāpy atikramya śuddhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parāt param |
vimuktaṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ ca hy anāmayam |
paramātmānam aguṇaṃ nirvṛtaṃ taṃ ca sattamāḥ || 94 ||
śreṣṭhaṃ tatra mano viprā indriyāṇi ca bho dvijāḥ |
śakyaṃ vālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇāṃs tathā |
sāṅkhyā viprā mahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim |
jñānenānena viprendrās tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate || 97 ||
atra vaḥ saṃśayo mā bhūj jñānaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ paraṃ matam |
akṣaraṃ dhruvam evoktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam || 98 ||
kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yad vadanti śamātmakāḥ || 99 ||
sarve viprāś ca vedāś ca tathā sāmavido janāḥ |
prārthayantaś ca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ |
samyag uktās tathā yogāḥ sāṅkhyāś cāmitadarśanāḥ || 102 ||
amūrtis tasya viprendrāḥ sāṅkhyaṃ mūrtir iti śrutiḥ |
jñānaṃ mahad vai mahataś ca viprā |
jñānaṃ ca loke yad ihāsti kiñcit |
jñānaṃ ca mokṣaś ca yathāvad uktam |
na vā pradhānā api te dvijātayo |
ye jñānam etan munayo na saktāḥ || 110 ||

kiṃ tad akṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ |
kiṃsvit tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmād āvartate punaḥ || 1 ||
tvaṃ hi jñānavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ procyase vedapāragaiḥ |
ṛṣibhiś ca mahābhāgair yatibhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ || 3 ||
tad etac chrotum icchāmas tvattaḥ sarvaṃ mahāmate |
papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param || 6 ||
svacchandaṃ sukṛtaṃ caiva madhuraṃ cāpy anulbaṇam |
bhagavañ śrotum icchāmi paraṃ brahma sanātanam |
yac ca tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ yatredaṃ kṣarate jagat |
yac cākṣaram iti proktaṃ śivaṃ kṣemam anāmayam || 10 ||

aṇimā laghimā prāptir īśānaṃ jyotir avyayam |
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān eṣa buddhir iti smṛtiḥ || 16 ||

pañcamaṃ viddhi rājendra bhautikaṃ sargam arthakṛt || 25 ||
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇam eva ca pañcamam |
vāg hastau caiva pādau ca pāyur meḍhraṃ tathaiva ca || 26 ||
evam etat samutpannaṃ trailokyam idam uttamam |
