Chapter 242: On the worldly bondage and destiny of the soul
dehād dehasahasrāṇi tathā ca na sa bhidyate || 1 ||
manuṣyatvād divaṃ yāti devo mānuṣyam eti ca |
dvandvam eti ca nirdvandvas tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu |
ekavāsāś caturvāsāḥ śāyī nityam adhas tathā || 8 ||
vīram āsanam ākāśe tathā śayanam eva ca || 9 ||
vastrāṇi cānyāni bahūny abhimatya ca buddhimān || 14 ||
upāśrayān apy aparān pākhaṇḍān vividhān api |
viviktāś ca śilāchāyās tathā prasravaṇāni ca || 21 ||
kānaneṣu viviktāś ca śailānāṃ mahatīr guhāḥ || 22 ||
niyamān vividhāṃś cāpi vividhāni tapāṃsi ca |
yajñāṃś ca vividhākārān vidyāś ca vividhās tathā || 23 ||
sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca || 25 ||
prakṛtiḥ kurute devī bhayaṃ pralayam eva ca |
evam evaiṣa tat sarvaṃ krīḍārtham abhimanyate || 30 ||
prakṛtyā sarvam evedaṃ jagad andhīkṛtaṃ vibho |
rajasā tamasā caiva vyāptaṃ sarvam anekadhā || 33 ||
evaṃ dvandvāny atītāni mama vartanti nityaśaḥ |
matta etāni jāyante pralaye yānti mām api || 34 ||
sukham evaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sakṛt kṛtvā sukhaṃ mama |
yāvad eva tu me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati || 37 ||
bhaviṣyati na me duḥkhaṃ kṛtenehāpy anantakam |
sukhaduḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam || 38 ||
nirayāc cāpi mānuṣyaṃ kālenaiṣyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ |
manuṣyatvāc ca devatvaṃ devatvāt pauruṣaṃ punaḥ || 39 ||
eṣa evaṃ dvijātīnām ātmā vai sa guṇair vṛtaḥ || 40 ||
sa evaṃ phalam āpnoti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān |
prakṛtiś ca tathāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu kāmagā |
trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyāt prākṛtāni ha |
tathaiva pauruṣaṃ liṅgam anumānād dhi manyate |
sa liṅgāntaram āsādya prākṛtaṃ liṅgam avraṇam || 46 ||
śrotrādīni tu sarvāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇy atha || 47 ||
rāgādīni pravartante guṇeṣv iha guṇaiḥ saha |
aham etāni vai kurvan mamaitānīndriyāṇi ha || 48 ||
nirindriyo hi manyeta vraṇavān asmi nirvraṇaḥ |
aliṅgo liṅgam ātmānam akālaṃ kālam ātmanaḥ || 49 ||
asattvaṃ sattvam ātmānam amṛtaṃ mṛtam ātmanaḥ |
amṛtyuṃ mṛtyum ātmānam acaraṃ caram ātmanaḥ || 50 ||
akṣetraṃ kṣetram ātmānam asaṅgaṃ saṅgam ātmanaḥ |
atattvaṃ tattvam ātmānam abhavaṃ bhavam ātmanaḥ || 51 ||
akṣaraṃ kṣaram ātmānam abuddhatvād dhi manyate |
candramā iva kośānāṃ punas tatra sahasraśaḥ || 54 ||
kalā pañcadaśī yonis tad dhāma iti paṭhyate || 55 ||
nityam eva vijānīhi somaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ |
dhīmāṃś cāyaṃ na bhavati nṛpa evaṃ hi jāyate |
ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām || 57 ||
na tūpayujyate devair devān api yunakti saḥ |
prakṛtes triguṇāyās tu sa eva triguṇo bhavet || 58 ||
Chapter 243: Dialogue between Karālajanaka and Vasiṣṭha (cont.)
strīpuṃsayor vā sambandhaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate || 1 ||
ṛte tu puruṣaṃ neha strī garbhān dhārayaty uta |
ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartate tathā || 2 ||
rūpaṃ nirvartayed etad evaṃ sarvāsu yoniṣu || 3 ||
ṛtau nirvartate rūpaṃ tad vakṣyāmi nidarśanam || 4 ||
ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca mātur guṇās tathā |
asthi snāyu ca majjā ca jānīmaḥ pitṛto dvija || 5 ||
pramāṇaṃ yac ca vedoktaṃ śāstroktaṃ yac ca paṭhyate |
yac cāpi bhagavaṃs tasmān mokṣadharmo na vidyate || 8 ||
tan mamācakṣva tattvena pratyakṣo hy asi sarvadā || 9 ||
mokṣakāmā vayaṃ cāpi kāṅkṣāmo yad anāmayam |
evam etad yathā vakṣye tattvagrāhī yathā bhavān || 11 ||
dhāryate hi tvayā grantha ubhayor vedaśāstrayoḥ |
na ca granthasya tattvajño yathātattvaṃ nareśvara || 12 ||
yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ |
na ca granthārthatattvajñas tasya taddhāraṇaṃ vṛthā || 13 ||
bhāraṃ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṃ na vetti yaḥ |
yas tu granthārthatattvajño nāsya granthāgamo vṛthā || 14 ||
granthasyārthaṃ sa pṛṣṭas tu mādṛśo vaktum arhati |
na yaḥ samutsukaḥ kaścid granthārthaṃ sthūlabuddhimān |
sa kathaṃ mandavijñāno granthaṃ vakṣyati nirṇayāt || 16 ||
ajñātvā granthatattvāni vādaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ |
lobhād vāpy athavā dambhāt sa pāpī narakaṃ vrajet || 17 ||
nirṇayaṃ cāpi cchidrātmā na tad vakṣyati tattvataḥ |
tasmāt tvaṃ śṛṇu rājendra yathaitad anudṛśyate |
yathā tattvena sāṅkhyeṣu yogeṣu ca mahātmasu || 19 ||
yad eva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṅkhyaṃ tad anugamyate |
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān || 20 ||
tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca |
etad aindriyakaṃ tāta yad bhavān ittham āttha mām || 21 ||
dravyād dravyasya nirvṛttir indriyād indriyaṃ tathā |
dehād deham avāpnoti bījād bījaṃ tathaiva ca || 22 ||
guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva viramanti ca |
evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtijā jāyante na ca yānti ca || 24 ||
tvaṅ māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca |
aṣṭau tāny atha śukreṇa jānīhi prākṛtena vai || 25 ||
pumāṃś caivāpumāṃś caiva strīliṅgaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam |
vāyur eṣa pumāṃś caiva rasa ity abhidhīyate || 26 ||
yathā puṣpaphalair nityaṃ mūrtaṃ cāmūrtayas tathā || 27 ||
evam apy anumānena sa liṅgam upalabhyate |
kevalaṃ tv abhimānitvād guṇeṣu guṇa ucyate || 29 ||
guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ |
tasmād evaṃ vijānanti ye janā guṇadarśinaḥ || 30 ||
yadā tv eṣa guṇān etān prākṛtān abhimanyate |
tadā sa guṇavān eva guṇabhedān prapaśyati || 31 ||
yat tad buddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṅkhyayogaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
aprabuddhaṃ yathā vyaktaṃ svaguṇaiḥ prāhur īśvaram |
nirguṇaṃ ceśvaraṃ nityam adhiṣṭhātāram eva ca || 33 ||
prakṛteś ca guṇānāṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṃ budhāḥ |
etan nidarśanaṃ samyaṅ na samyag anudarśanam |
ekatvam akṣaraṃ prāhur nānātvaṃ kṣaram ucyate || 37 ||
tattvavit tattvayor eva pṛthag etan nidarśanam |
varjyasya varjyam ācāraṃ tattvaṃ tattvāt sanātanam || 40 ||
paśyatas tad dhi sandigdham etayor vai nidarśanam || 41 ||
sthūlabuddhyā na paśyāmi tattvam etan na saṃśayaḥ || 42 ||
akṣarakṣarayor uktaṃ tvayā yad api kāraṇam |
tad apy asthirabuddhitvāt pranaṣṭam iva me 'nagha || 43 ||
dvandvaṃ caivāniruddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ || 44 ||
vidyāvidye ca bhagavann akṣaraṃ kṣaram eva ca |
sāṅkhyayogaṃ ca kṛtsnena buddhābuddhiṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 45 ||
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi yad etad anupṛcchasi |
yogakṛtyaṃ mahārāja pṛthag eva śṛṇuṣva me || 46 ||
yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānam eva paraṃ balam |
tac cāpi dvividhaṃ dhyānam āhur vidyāvido janāḥ || 47 ||
ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmas tathaiva ca |
prāṇāyāmas tu saguṇo nirguṇo mānasas tathā || 48 ||
mūtrotsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa |
sa codanābhir matimān nātmānaṃ codayed atha |
tiṣṭhantam ajaraṃ taṃ tu yat tad uktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 51 ||
viśvātmā satataṃ jñeya ity evam anuśuśruma |
pūrvarātre parārdhe ca dhārayīta mano hṛdi || 53 ||
mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ || 54 ||
sthāṇuvac cāpy akampyaḥ syād dāruvac cāpi niścalaḥ |
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na ca paśyati kiñcana |
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na ca saṅkalpate manaḥ || 56 ||
na cāpi manyate kiñcin na ca budhyeta kāṣṭhavat |
tadā prakṛtim āpannaṃ yuktam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 57 ||
na bhāti hi yathā dīpo dīptis tadvac ca dṛśyate |
niliṅgaś cādhaś cordhvaṃ ca tiryaggatim avāpnuyāt || 58 ||
tadā tadupapannaś ca yasmin dṛṣṭe ca kathyate |
nirdhūma iva saptārcir āditya iva raśmivān |
tad evāhur aṇubhyo 'ṇu tan mahadbhyo mahattaram |
sarvatra sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhan na dṛśyate || 62 ||
mahatas tamasas tāta pāre tiṣṭhan na tāmasaḥ || 63 ||
tamaso dūra ity uktas tattvajñair vedapāragaiḥ |
yoga eṣa hi lokānāṃ kim anyad yogalakṣaṇam |
evaṃ paśyan prapaśyeta ātmānam ajaraṃ param || 65 ||
yogadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te tattvato mayā |
avyaktam āhuḥ prakhyānaṃ parāṃ prakṛtim ātmanaḥ |
ahaṅkāras tu mahatas tṛtīya iti naḥ śrutam |
etāḥ prakṛtayas tv aṣṭau vikārāś cāpi ṣoḍaśa |
pañca caiva viśeṣāś ca tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca || 69 ||
etāvad eva tattvānāṃ sāṅkhyam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
yasmād yad abhijāyeta tat tatraiva pralīyate |
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca tathā sṛji || 73 ||
evam eva ca rājendra vijñeyaṃ jñānakovidaiḥ |
ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛter anu tattvavān |
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt || 75 ||
tac ca kṣetraṃ mahān ātmā pañcaviṃśo 'dhitiṣṭhati || 76 ||
adhiṣṭhānād adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇām iti naḥ śrutam || 77 ||
kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate |
avyaktike pure śete puruṣaś ceti kathyate || 78 ||
anyad eva ca kṣetraṃ syād anyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate |
kṣetram avyakta ity uktaṃ jñātāraṃ pañcaviṃśakam || 79 ||
anyad eva ca jñānaṃ syād anyaj jñeyaṃ tad ucyate |
jñānam avyaktam ity uktaṃ jñeyo vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ || 80 ||
avyaktaṃ kṣetram ity uktaṃ tathā sattvaṃ tatheśvaram |
anīśvaram atattvaṃ ca tattvaṃ tat pañcaviṃśakam || 81 ||
saṅkhyā prakurute caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pravakṣyate || 82 ||
yadā budhyati ātmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ || 84 ||
evam etad vijānantaḥ sāmyatāṃ pratiyānty uta || 85 ||
na tv evaṃ vartamānānām āvṛttir vartate punaḥ |
vidyate kṣarabhāvaś ca na parasparam avyayam || 87 ||
paśyanty amatayo ye na samyak teṣu ca darśanam |
te vyaktiṃ pratipadyante punaḥ punar arindama || 88 ||
sarvam etad vijānanto na sarvasya prabodhanāt |
sarvam avyaktam ity uktam asarvaḥ sarvaṃ pañcaviṃśakaḥ |
ya evam abhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate || 90 ||
Chapter 244: Dialogue between Karālajanaka and Vasiṣṭha (cont.)
vidyāvidye tv idānīṃ me tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ || 1 ||
sargapralaya ity uktaṃ vidyāvidye ca viṃśakaḥ || 2 ||
buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam || 4 ||
viṣayāṇāṃ manas teṣāṃ vidyām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
manasaḥ pañca bhūtāni vidyā ity abhicakṣate || 5 ||
ahaṅkāras tu bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ahaṅkāras tathā vidyā buddhir vidyā nareśvara || 6 ||
vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiś ca paramaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7 ||
avyaktam aparaṃ prāhur vidyā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ |
sarvasya sarvam ity uktaṃ jñeyajñānasya pāragaḥ || 8 ||
jñānam avyaktam ity uktaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam |
vidyāvidye tu tattvena mayokte vai viśeṣataḥ |
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yad uktaṃ tan nibodha me || 10 ||
ubhāv etau kṣarāv uktau ubhāv etāv anakṣarau |
kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathājñānaṃ tu jñānataḥ || 11 ||
tad etad guṇasargāya vikurvāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 13 ||
adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṣetram āhur etad vai pañcaviṃśakam || 14 ||
yad antarguṇajālaṃ tu tad vyaktātmani saṅkṣipet |
tad ahaṃ tad guṇais tais tu pañcaviṃśe vilīyate || 15 ||
guṇā guṇeṣu līyante tad ekā prakṛtir bhavet |
nirguṇatvaṃ ca vai dehe guṇeṣu parivartanāt || 17 ||
prakṛtyā nirguṇas tv eṣa ity evam anuśuśruma || 18 ||
kṣaro bhavaty eṣa yadā guṇavatī guṇeṣv atha |
prakṛtiṃ tv atha jānāti nirguṇatvaṃ tathātmanaḥ || 19 ||
anyo 'ham anyeyam iti yadā budhyati buddhimān || 20 ||
tadaiṣo 'vyathatām eti na ca miśratvam āvrajet |
yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tat prākṛtaṃ vijugupsate |
paśyate ca paraṃ paśyaṃs tadā paśyan nu saṃsṛjet || 22 ||
kiṃ mayā kṛtam etāvad yo 'haṃ kālanimajjanaḥ |
yathā matsyo hy abhijñānād anuvartitavāñ jalam || 23 ||
aham eva hi sammohād anyam anyaṃ janāj janam |
ātmānaṃ tad avajñānād anyaṃ caiva na vedmy aham || 25 ||
mamāstu dhik kubuddhasya yo 'haṃ magna imaṃ punaḥ |
anuvartitavān mohād anyam anyaṃ janāj janam || 26 ||
ayam anubhaved bandhur anena saha me kṣayam |
sāmyam ekatvatāṃ yāto yādṛśas tādṛśas tv aham || 27 ||
tulyatām iha paśyāmi sadṛśo 'ham anena vai |
ayaṃ hi vimalo vyaktam aham īdṛśakas tadā || 28 ||
saṃsargād atisaṃsargāt sthitaḥ kālam imaṃ tv aham || 29 ||
so 'ham evaṃ vaśībhūtaḥ kālam etaṃ na buddhavān |
sahavāsaṃ na yāsyāmi kālam etaṃ vivañcanāt |
vañcito hy anayā yad dhi nirvikāro vikārayā || 32 ||
na tat tadaparāddhaṃ syād aparādho hy ayaṃ mama |
prakṛtyā ca tayā tena tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu |
nirmamasya mamatvena vikṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca || 35 ||
samatā na mayā kācid ahaṅkāre kṛtā mayā || 36 ||
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā so 'yaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām |
kṣemaṃ mama sahānena naivaikam anayā saha || 39 ||
nirguṇaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛg bhavati maithila || 41 ||
niḥsandigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca viśuddhaṃ vimalaṃ tathā |
pravakṣyāmi tu te bhūyas tan nibodha yathāśrutam || 43 ||
yad eva sāṅkhyaśāstroktaṃ yogadarśanam eva tat || 44 ||
bṛhac caivam idaṃ śāstram ity āhur viduṣo janāḥ |
pañcaviṃśāt paraṃ tattvaṃ paṭhyate ca narādhipa |
sāṅkhyānāṃ tu paraṃ tattvaṃ yathāvad anuvarṇitam || 47 ||
buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
Chapter 245: Dialogue between Karālajanaka and Vasiṣṭha (cont.)
guṇānāṃ dhāryatāṃ tattvaṃ sṛjaty ākṣipate tathā || 1 ||
ajo hi krīḍayā bhūpa vikriyāṃ prāpta ity uta |
etad evaṃ vikurvāṇo budhyamāno na budhyate |
guṇān ācarate hy eṣa sṛjaty ākṣipate tathā || 3 ||
na tv evaṃ budhyate 'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ tāta nirguṇam || 4 ||
kadācit tv eva khalv etat tad āhuḥ pratibuddhakam |
budhyate yadi cāvyaktam etad vai pañcaviṃśakam || 5 ||
budhyamāno bhavaty eṣa mamātmaka iti śrutaḥ |
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahātmānaṃ na cāsāv api budhyate || 7 ||
avyaktaṃ caiva tad brahma budhyate tāta kevalam || 9 ||
budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ viśuddhām amalāṃ yathā || 11 ||
ṣaḍviṃśaṃ rājaśārdūla tadā buddhaḥ kṛto vrajet |
etat tu tattvam ity āhur nistattvam ajarāmaram || 14 ||
na caiva tattvavāṃs tāta saṃsāreṣu nimajjati |
eṣām upaiti tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ budhyasva lakṣaṇam || 16 ||
ekatvaṃ vai bhavet tasya yadā buddhyānubudhyate || 19 ||
vibhus tyajati cāvyaktaṃ yadā tv etad vibudhyate || 21 ||
eṣa hy apratibuddhaś ca budhyamānas tu te 'nagha || 22 ||
evam eva ca gantavyaṃ nānātvaikatvam etayoḥ || 24 ||
paraś ca paradharmā ca bhavaty eva sametya vai |
vimokṣiṇā vimokṣaś ca sametyeha tathā bhavet |
kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai |
sadaiva guhyaṃ tv idam eva deyam || 35 ||
karāla mā te bhayam asti kiñcid |
etad uktaṃ paraṃ brahma yasmān nāvartate punaḥ |
etan niḥśreyasakaraṃ jñānaṃ bhoḥ paramaṃ mayā |
kathitaṃ tattvato viprāḥ śrutvā devarṣito dvijāḥ || 44 ||
nāradād viditaṃ mahyam etad uktaṃ sanātanam |
mā śucadhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ śrutvaitat paramaṃ padam || 46 ||
yena kṣarākṣare bhinne na bhayaṃ tasya vidyate |
vidyate tu bhayaṃ yasya yo nainaṃ vetti tattvataḥ || 47 ||
avijñānāc ca mūḍhātmā punaḥ punar upadravān |
devalokaṃ tathā tiryaṅ mānuṣyam api cāśnute |
yadi vā mucyate vāpi tasmād ajñānasāgarāt || 49 ||
ahany ahani majjanti yatra bhūtāni bho dvijāḥ || 50 ||
tasmād yūyaṃ virajaskā vitamaskāś ca bho dvijāḥ || 51 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ sārāt sārataraṃ param |
kathitaṃ paramaṃ mokṣaṃ yaṃ jñātvā na nivartate || 52 ||
na duṣṭamataye viprā na śraddhāvimukhāya ca || 53 ||
evaṃ purā munīn vyāsaḥ purāṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā |
hṛṣṭā babhūvuḥ suprītā vismitāś ca punaḥ punaḥ |
na te 'sty aviditaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vai prabho || 7 ||
sarvajñas tvaṃ mahābhāga deveṣv iva bṛhaspatiḥ |
yena tvayā tu vedārthā bhārate prakaṭīkṛtāḥ |
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tava sarvān mahāmune || 9 ||
adhītya caturo vedān sāṅgān vyākaraṇāni ca |
kṛtavān bhārataṃ śāstraṃ tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ || 10 ||
evam uktvā samabhyarcya vyāsaṃ te caiva pūjitāḥ |
jagmur yathāgataṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāḥ svam āśramam || 13 ||
tathā mayā muniśreṣṭhā kathitaṃ hi sanātanam |
prāpnoti brāhmaṇo vidyāṃ kṣatriyo vijayaṃ raṇe |
vaiśyas tu dhanam akṣayyaṃ śūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt || 18 ||
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyañ śṛṇoti puruṣaḥ śuciḥ |
taṃ taṃ kāmam avāpnoti naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
etad vo yan mayākhyātaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam |
upoṣya yad avāpnoti tad asya śravaṇān naraḥ || 22 ||
yad agnihotre suhute varṣe nāpnoti vai phalam |
mahāpuṇyamayaṃ viprās tad asya śravaṇāt sakṛt || 23 ||
mathurāyāṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prāpnoti puruṣaḥ phalam || 24 ||
tad āpnoti phalaṃ samyak samādhānena kīrtanāt |
yat phalaṃ kriyam ālokya puruṣo 'tha labhen naraḥ |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād api || 26 ||
idaṃ yaḥ śraddhayā nityaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasammitam |
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyān martyaḥ sa yāti bhuvanaṃ hareḥ || 27 ||
śrāvayed brāhmaṇo yas tu sadā parvasu saṃyataḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 28 ||
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhed vidvāñ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ |
idaṃ variṣṭham ākhyānaṃ sa sarvam īpsitaṃ labhet || 30 ||
rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
jātismaratvaṃ vidyāṃ ca putrān medhāṃ paśūn dhṛtim |
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ tu labhate naraḥ || 32 ||
yān yān kāmān abhipretya paṭhet prayatamānasaḥ |
tāṃs tān sarvān avāpnoti puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 33 ||
yaś cedaṃ satataṃ śṛṇoti manujaḥ svargāpavargapradaṃ |
viṣṇuṃ lokaguruṃ praṇamya varadaṃ bhaktyekacittaḥ śuciḥ |
bhuktvā cātra sukhaṃ vimuktakaluṣaḥ svarge ca divyaṃ sukhaṃ |
paścād yāti hareḥ padaṃ suvimalaṃ mukto guṇaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ|| 34 ||
tadvat kṣatriyapuṅgavais tu niyataiḥ śreyorthibhiḥ sarvadā |
vaiśyaiś cānudinaṃ viśuddhakulajaiḥ śūdrais tathā dhārmikaiḥ |
śrotavyaṃ tv idam uttamaṃ bahuphalaṃ dharmārthamokṣapradam || 35 ||
sa hy eka eva paralokagatasya bandhuḥ |
arthāḥ striyaś ca nipuṇair api sevyamānā |
naiva prabhāvam upayānti na ca sthiratvam || 36 ||
āyuś ca kīrtiṃ ca tapaś ca dharmaṃ |
dharmaḥ sakhā cātra pare ca loke |
trātā ca dharmas tv iha mokṣadaś ca |
dharmād ṛte nāsti tu kiñcid eva || 38 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca purāṇaṃ vedasammitam |
